jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About LiveX AI** LiveX AI is a fast\-growing startup based in the San Francisco Bay Area, building the next generation of physical AI agents—intelligent, embodied systems that interact with people in real\-world environments. We combine cutting\-edge language models, multimodal AI, and custom hardware to power transformative AI experiences in airports, stadiums, conferences, and more. We’re trusted by top enterprises and city partners, and backed by renowned investors. **About the Role** ------------------ We're building realtime, interactive AI avatars that can see, listen, and respond with natural speech and expressive motion. As an AI Engineer, you'll help train, fine\-tune, and serve the generative models behind them—from data curation and training diffusion and video models to low\-latency inference for live streaming. You'll work closely with our backend, product, and research teams to ship avatar experiences used in the real world. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Generative avatar models:** Train and fine\-tune generative models for talking\-head synthesis, audio\-driven facial animation, and full\-body avatar video. * **Data pipelines:** Build data pipelines for large\-scale video, audio, and multimodal datasets. * **Realtime optimization:** Optimize models for realtime serving, targeting sub\-200ms end\-to\-end latency, using techniques such as distillation, quantization, and custom kernels. * **ML infrastructure:** Build and maintain training, evaluation, and deployment infrastructure on GPU clusters. * **Quality metrics:** Define and improve metrics such as lip\-sync accuracy, identity preservation, expression naturalness, latency, and throughput. * **Ship with the team:** Work with backend, product, and research teams to ship avatar features and iterate on user feedback, while keeping up with the latest in generative video, multimodal AI, and neural rendering. **Who You Are** --------------- **Must\-haves** * 3\+ years of hands\-on ML engineering experience, or strong research experience with production\-quality code. * Deep PyTorch expertise and the ability to reproduce and extend research papers. * Background in diffusion models, video generation, computer vision, multimodal AI, speech synthesis, or neural rendering. * Experience optimizing realtime inference (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX, Triton, CUDA, mixed precision). * Strong Python skills and experience with multi\-GPU or multi\-node distributed training. * Comfort with ambiguity and fast\-changing environments, with a strong sense of ownership. **Bonus points** * Experience with talking\-head, lip\-sync, or digital human systems, or related areas such as 3D Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, or face reenactment. * Publications at top venues (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, ICLR, ICML) or notable open\-source contributions. **Why Join LiveX AI?** ---------------------- * **World\-Stage Experiences:** Your work goes live in front of millions—at the Super Bowl, major airports, and NVIDIA GTC—not just inside an office. * **Full\-Real Scope:** AI, hardware, and real customers—you'll build a skill set most people don't reach until years into their careers. * **Silicon Valley, Front Row:** Work at the center of the physical AI movement, with the connections and momentum that come with it. * **Mentorship That Matters:** Work directly with founders and senior leaders who want to see you grow—not hand you busywork. * **Real Ownership \& Growth:** Top performers take on more scope fast—leading projects, owning customers, and shaping the product. * **Compute to Build With:** Access to GPU compute for training and experimentation, plus competitive salary, equity, and benefits. Ready to launch the next phase of your career and build the future of physical AI? Apply to join LiveX AI today.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: If you thrive in fast paced environments, enjoy hands\-on problem solving, and want to make a measurable impact while working with modern automation and control systems, this role offers the challenge, autonomy, and growth opportunities to take your engineering career to the next level. In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print ‑and apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities. What You’ll Do * Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety. * Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package. * Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on\-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed. * Inspect systems to ensure the operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieve operational conditions prescribed by the client. * Oversee scope of development, work request initiation, scheduling, and inspection of work performed by outside contractors, which includes proprietary work, licensed installations, upgrades, and maintenance and inspection of specialized systems. * Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation. * Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS\-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems. * Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies. * Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts. * Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents. * Perform controls systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability. * Clearly communicate technical issues, project timelines, and product impacts with site leadership, operations and maintenance teams. * Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members. * Perform other job\-related duties as needed or assigned. What You’ll Need * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. * Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2\-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered. * Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming. * 2\+ years of experience working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA\-based monitoring and control systems. * Ability to be available and work in a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays. * Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight. * Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more. * Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems. Preferred Qualifications * 2\+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming. * Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems. * Experience with robotic maintenance. * In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc. * Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset. * Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial\-related calculations. \*Must flexible with being on\-call on weekends as needed\* You should be proficient in: * PLC Programming Experience * SCADA Experience Machines \& technologies you'll use: * Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)

jobs.title: Customer Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Customer Solutions Engineer **Wanderland Intelligence** Remote / Flexible Commission\-Based \+ Revenue Participation Customer Success • Solutions Engineering • Technical Support • AI\-Assisted Development About Wanderland Wanderland Intelligence is building the next generation of location and territory decision intelligence. We help franchise organizations and other territory\-based businesses understand where to grow, how to design territories, how markets compare, and where their greatest opportunities exist. Our platform brings together geospatial intelligence, market data, territory management, customer profiling, scoring, AI, and decision support to help organizations make better growth decisions. Our mission is simple: **Know Where to Grow.** We are looking for someone who wants to become one of the most important technical and customer\-facing people in the company. The Role The **Customer Solutions Engineer** sits directly between our customers, product, sales, and technology. This is not traditional customer support. And it is not purely a software engineering role. You will work directly with customers to understand what they are trying to accomplish, demonstrate Wanderland, investigate issues, solve technical problems, help customers use the platform successfully, and—when appropriate—actually build or improve solutions yourself. Some days you may be demonstrating Wanderland to a prospective franchise company. Another day you may be reviewing an Intercom ticket to understand why a customer is having difficulty with a territory. You may discover that the issue requires a data correction, configuration change, integration adjustment, prompt improvement, API change, or small piece of development work—and you should be comfortable helping solve it. We increasingly use AI\-assisted development tools throughout Wanderland. We care less about whether you can write every line of code from memory and more about whether you can **understand a technical problem, reason through it, use modern tools intelligently, and get to a reliable solution.** What You Will DoCustomer Success \& Technical Support * Develop a deep understanding of how Wanderland customers use the platform. * Help customers solve product, data, territory, workflow, and technical issues. * Review and evaluate customer trouble tickets through Intercom. * Determine whether issues involve user education, configuration, data, product behavior, or engineering. * Reproduce technical issues and document findings clearly. * Coordinate with engineering when deeper development work is required. * Follow customer issues through resolution rather than simply forwarding tickets. * Help identify recurring customer problems that should become product improvements. * Assist with onboarding and customer transition into new Wanderland functionality. Solutions Engineering * Conduct and support product demonstrations. * Participate in discovery conversations with prospective customers. * Understand the customer's business problem and demonstrate the Wanderland capabilities most relevant to that problem. * Help Sales answer technical and product questions. * Support proofs of concept and customer evaluations. * Translate customer requirements into understandable technical requirements. * Help determine whether Wanderland can support unusual customer workflows or integrations. * Become a trusted technical voice in important customer conversations. Applied Development You do not need to be a traditional full\-time software engineer. You do need to be technically capable and willing to build. You may: * Diagnose application issues. * Write or modify small pieces of code. * Build internal tools. * Create scripts or automations. * Work with APIs. * Analyze databases or data. * Improve AI workflows and prompts. * Prototype customer\-requested functionality. * Use AI\-assisted coding tools to accelerate development. * Test fixes and new product functionality. * Work with engineering resources on larger technical issues. We want someone who looks at a problem and thinks: **“Let me see if I can figure this out.”** Where You Sit in the Company This role works across several functions. **With Customers:** Understand what they need, help them succeed, and solve problems. **With Sales:** Demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, and help convert qualified opportunities. **With Account Management:** Help protect customer relationships by resolving technical problems quickly and intelligently. **With Product:** Bring actual customer problems and requests into product decisions. **With Engineering:** Diagnose problems clearly, solve what you can, and escalate well\-defined technical issues when necessary. This person should eventually know the Wanderland platform extraordinarily well. Who We Are Looking For You could come from several different backgrounds: * Solutions Engineer * Sales Engineer * Customer Success Engineer * Technical Account Manager * Implementation Engineer * Support Engineer * Software Engineer who enjoys customers * Technical Product Specialist * Developer Relations / Solutions role * Technical consultant Your exact previous title matters less than your combination of technical capability and customer instinct. You May Be a Strong Fit If You * Enjoy talking with customers. * Can explain technical concepts in plain language. * Are naturally curious when something isn't working. * Have enough technical knowledge to investigate software problems independently. * Are comfortable working with APIs, databases, web applications, or SaaS systems. * Have some ability to code or are highly effective using modern AI\-assisted development tools. * Can conduct a confident product demonstration. * Understand that solving the customer's problem matters more than proving how technical you are. * Are organized enough to manage customer issues without allowing things to disappear. * Can distinguish between a bug, configuration problem, data problem, training issue, and product limitation. * Enjoy learning unfamiliar technology. * Can work effectively in an early\-stage environment where job boundaries are intentionally broad. Technical Experience We Value Experience with some combination of the following is helpful: * SaaS applications * APIs * SQL / PostgreSQL * JavaScript / TypeScript * Python * Web applications * AWS / cloud infrastructure * AI / LLM tools * AI\-assisted coding environments * CRM and customer\-support platforms * Intercom * GIS or geospatial technology * Data analysis * Technical integrations You do not need to know all of these. We care considerably more about your ability to **learn, diagnose, communicate, and solve.** Compensation This is a **commission and revenue\-participation role** designed to align compensation directly with customer success and Company growth. Compensation will include participation in revenue from the **existing customer book you help support and retain**, creating direct economic alignment between customer success and your earnings. You will also earn additional commission from **new business where you materially support the selling motion**, including qualified demonstrations, technical discovery, solution design, proofs of concept, or other meaningful technical involvement that helps Wanderland win the customer. Specific percentages, attribution rules, collection requirements, and payment timing will be defined in the compensation agreement. As with other Wanderland commercial roles, revenue\-based compensation is designed around **cash actually collected by Wanderland**, rather than simply contracts signed or invoices issued. The opportunity is intended to grow as Wanderland's customer base grows. What Success Looks Like A successful Customer Solutions Engineer becomes someone customers and teammates instinctively call when something important needs to get figured out. You know the product. You know the customers. You know how the technology works. You can demonstrate it. You can troubleshoot it. You can explain it. And increasingly, you can improve it. Over time, you should become one of the people with the clearest understanding of the connection between: **what customers need → what Wanderland sells → what Wanderland builds.** Why Wanderland This is an opportunity for someone who does not want to spend their career trapped inside a narrowly defined job description. You will have direct exposure to customers, product decisions, sales, AI, software development, data, and company leadership. There is substantial room for this role to grow as Wanderland grows. If you enjoy solving customer problems, understand technology, are excited about what AI makes possible for a highly capable individual, and want the opportunity to become a critical part of an early\-stage technology company, we would like to meet you. **Wanderland Intelligence** **Know Where to Grow** Pay: $25,000\.00 \- $45,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Data Engineer

employs systems thinking to solve complex problems * Experience documenting data requirements and data rules (standardization, cleansing, validation) * Track record of taking ownership of project deliverables and day\-to\-day work product * Strong SQL and Excel skills; This summary is not an all\-inclusive description of job duties. Other job duties and responsibilities may also be assigned by the incumbent’s supervisor at any time based upon Company need. Employment with Progress Residential is conditional on a satisfactory background and drug screen. Progress Residential is a proud Equal Opportunity employer, m/f/d/v. **Privacy Policy** ------------------

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer

The role is focused on hands\-on delivery: engineering reliable data pipelines, developing Microsoft Fabric and OneLake, supporting agreed system data exchanges, and turning changing business requirements into sustainable technical solutions. Working with the Business Systems Lead, application owners, software engineering, business analysts and functional stakeholders, the engineer will translate architectural direction into operational capability. This role is intended to provide dedicated engineering capacity so that enterprise architecture, strategic planning and stakeholder governance can remain with the Business Systems Lead. Key Responsibilities * Develop and operate Microsoft Fabric and OneLake capabilities for business, manufacturing and finance data, including lakehouses, pipelines, notebooks and appropriate data processing services. * Build, test and maintain ingestion, transformation and publishing pipelines; implement reusable patterns and curated datasets for reporting, analytics and operational use. * Apply data modelling, orchestration, scheduling, error handling, reconciliation and performance optimisation to production data workflows. * Implement source control, deployment processes, monitoring, alerting, documentation and appropriate automated tests for platform changes. * Support secure access, environment configuration, capacity usage and cost awareness in collaboration with platform and security teams. * Engineer agreed data exchanges across ERP, PLM, MES and component lifecycle systems, including IFS, Teamcenter and RVG, in collaboration with system owners and the relevant integration/software engineering teams. * Translate interface requirements and source\-to\-target mappings into robust data extraction, validation and transformation processes, using approved APIs, events, connectors or scheduled transfers as appropriate. * Diagnose data flow failures, identify root causes and improve resilience, observability and supportability; escalate application\-side issues to the accountable owners. * Support defined data exchange with specialist platforms, including Databricks and AWS, where business requirements justify it; avoid unnecessary duplication of datasets and processing. * Implement agreed data definitions, quality rules, lineage and reconciliation controls with business data owners and stewards. * Maintain technical data documentation, including mappings, pipeline specifications, dependencies and interface details, aligned with the enterprise data dictionary and architecture repository. * Apply enterprise standards for authoritative sources, access, security, change control and reusable engineering patterns. * Provide technical options, estimates and implementation advice to the Business Systems Lead; jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: **About Mavria** ---------------- Mavria’s mission is to **build the industrial capacity America needs to lead in AI.** We believe that sustaining America’s AI leadership requires an unprecedented expansion of power, manufacturing, supply chains and physical infrastructure. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs who met at the U.S. Department of Energy, working on some of the country’s hardest energy and infrastructure projects. There, they saw a widening gap: AI labs and cloud providers were racing to scale compute, while the infrastructure underneath them was still built one custom project at a time, on timelines measured in years. We founded Mavria to close that gap. We are building to **industrialize intelligence**: turning the physical infrastructure AI runs on into products we manufacture, deploy and improve with every build. We’re starting with data centers. Our first product, Terrain, is a factory\-built data center platform. Terrain 01 is being built in Houston now, and we’ve raised $130M as of October 2026 to accelerate our roadmap. Terrain is our first product, not the limit of our ambition. We intend to eliminate the physical bottlenecks that constrain American AI leadership and build one of the foundational infrastructure companies of the AI era. **How we build** ---------------- At Mavria, three principles guide how we work: * **Ambition**: We want to build a generational company. To do that, we build capabilities, not just products. Terrain is our first product, not our last – and we seek to eliminate strategic bottlenecks across the entire AI supply chain. * **Urgency**: AI moves in weeks, while infrastructure tends to move in years. We match the frontier’s pace by making decisions quickly, building in parallel and securing critical supply ahead of demand. We surface problems early and never compromise on safety or engineering rigor. * **Ownership**: When we say we’ll do something, we do it. Keeping our word is how we stand apart, and taking radical ownership over our scope and our domain is how we build trust – internally and externally – while moving fast. **Role scope** ============== This is a horizontal data position embedded in our engineering and manufacturing teams. You’ll work side by side with those teams to learn how they design and build Terrain, then build the internal tools that make them faster. You’ll own each tool end to end, from the data pipelines underneath to the apps our engineers use every day, with one goal: 10x the productivity of the teams you support. You will: * **Embed with the teams**: Sit with our engineers and manufacturing leads, earn their trust and learn their workflows well enough to see where software can remove bottlenecks. * **Build the data foundation**: Design and run the pipelines that bring together data from CAD, PLM, ERP, suppliers and spreadsheets into clean, reliable models our tools can build on. * **Automate design work**: Build configurators and generators that turn engineering rules into BOMs, layouts and documentation, so our engineers spend their time on engineering. * **Streamline supply chain and procurement**: Build tools that track suppliers, lead times, costs and inventory, so we can secure critical supply ahead of demand. * **Build with AI**: Use LLMs, agents and AI coding tools to ship quickly, and put AI assistants into our engineers’ daily work where they save the most time. **What we're looking for** ========================== We are looking for hands\-on builders with experience across **data science**, **data engineering** and **product engineering** who can be: * **A builder**: You’ve shipped tools end to end, from data pipeline to user interface, and people relied on them. * **A partner**: You build rapport quickly, listen closely and turn a messy workflow into a clear spec. * **AI\-native**: You build with LLMs and AI coding tools every day and know where they help and where they don’t. * **Full\-stack with data**: You’re fluent in SQL and Python, comfortable with the AWS console, git, the command line, and with modern data stack tools (e.g. dbt or Airflow), and can stand up a web app when the job calls for it. * **An owner**: You move fast, own outcomes and measure your work by the hours it saves the people who use it. * **Technically curious**: AI, energy, manufacturing and infrastructure energize you, and you want to learn how hardware gets designed and built. Experience at early\-stage startups, on internal tools or platform teams, or in forward\-deployed or solutions engineering roles is especially relevant. We value ability over years or titles. **To apply:** Share your background, a link to your GitHub or portfolio, and a short note on a problem you solved by building a tool for someone else. **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive total compensation package * Medical, dental, and vision insurance is 100% paid for the employee * Retirement Plan with a 3\.5% company match * Flexible time off Mavria is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Mavria will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable law. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Insurance
jobs.description: **Enterprise Account Executive, Insurance** =========================================== **Company** ----------- Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into formal representations so AI answers can be traced, challenged and proved. Our architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4\. Pramaana was founded by a team from Google, DeepMind and Glean, bringing together frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts. Our commercial team is building the go\-to\-market motion to bring this technology to enterprises where correctness matters most. **The Role** ------------ Insurance businesses outside health insurance operate under complex policy contracts, coverage conditions, underwriting guidelines, claims rules and regulatory obligations. As carriers, reinsurers, brokers and insurance technology companies adopt AI, accuracy and traceability become critical. Pramaana is building the verification layer for AI by formalizing selected rules and enabling machine\-checked conclusions. We are hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to build our non\-health insurance vertical. You will own strategic accounts across property and casualty, life insurance, annuities, commercial and specialty insurance, reinsurance, insurance brokerage, MGAs and insurtech. This is a quota\-carrying, zero\-to\-one role: open executive relationships, find tractable high\-value workflows, structure paid pilots and turn verified outcomes into long\-term enterprise revenue. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and execute a named\-account strategy across non\-health P\&C, life and annuities, commercial/specialty insurers, reinsurers, brokers, MGAs and insurance technology providers; explicitly exclude health insurers, health plans and healthcare payer subsidiaries from this territory. * Develop trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, heads of AI/digital, underwriting and claims executives, distribution and brokerage leaders, chief risk and compliance officers, and non\-health insurance operations teams. * Lead rigorous discovery around policy wording and exclusions, coverage determination, underwriting rule application, eligibility, claims workflow decisions, regulatory obligations and AI\-generated recommendations. Identify authoritative policy versions, jurisdiction, exceptions and current error costs. * Own the complete enterprise deal cycle and revenue target—from sourcing and account planning to executive sponsorship, pilot design, model/technology risk review, information security, procurement, legal, negotiation, close and expansion. * Partner with research, product, insurance domain experts and Forward Deployed Engineers to define narrowly scoped paid pilots with explicit source documents, assumptions, verification boundaries, success criteria and production plans. * Develop business cases around reduced manual review, faster policy interpretation, improved consistency, auditability and fewer costly exceptions without promising elimination of claims risk or replacing professional judgment. * Build differentiated plays for P\&C, life/annuity, reinsurance and commercial/specialty insurance; translate market findings into product feedback and repeatable sales narratives. **You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have** -------------------------------------------- * Proven record of personally closing complex enterprise technology deals into property and casualty, life, annuities, commercial/specialty insurers, reinsurers, brokers or insurance software companies—with meaningful quota ownership. Health\-insurance\-only selling is not sufficient for this role. * Strong senior relationships and practical knowledge of insurance buying committees, budgets, underwriting/claims operations, procurement, governance and technology modernization. * Understanding of how insurance policy terms, coverage, product rules, jurisdiction and exceptions affect workflow design and buyer priorities. * Strategic discovery, account planning, value\-based selling and ability to orchestrate multi\-stakeholder evaluations and long enterprise sales cycles. * Technical curiosity and precision when explaining formal verification, AI limitations and how machine\-checked claims interact with source policy documents and human review. * High ownership, commercial judgment and willingness to build a new vertical playbook from first conversations to repeatable revenue. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** ---------------------------------------------- * Experience selling policy administration, claims systems, underwriting technology, actuarial/risk platforms, compliance software, data/AI, core insurance platforms or enterprise workflow tools. * Direct buyer relationships with P\&C and life insurers, specialty carriers, reinsurers, brokers or insurtech businesses. * Personally built a new insurance sales vertical or moved a regulated technical pilot to a multi\-year enterprise deployment.

jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Company Summary:** *Fermi America is pioneering the development of next\-generation energy infrastructure to power the future of artificial intelligence. By delivering highly reliable, gigawatt\-scale power solutions, we are helping meet the rapidly growing energy demands of advanced AI technologies. Our flagship HyperGrid™ campus in Amarillo, Texas, is designed to become one of the world's largest energy\-driven AI complexes, integrating nuclear, natural gas, utility, solar, and battery power. With a planned 17 gigawatts of power capacity and 18 million square feet of AI infrastructure, Fermi America is positioned to play a leading role in the future of energy and artificial intelligence. At Fermi America, we are building more than infrastructure. We are creating opportunities for talented professionals to help shape the next generation of energy and AI innovation.* **Job Summary:** The Field Engineer serves as Fermi America’s on\-site engineering representative, supporting Owner oversight of construction activities and technical coordination across assigned projects scopes. Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, the position monitors field conditions, identities potential engineering discrepancies, and facilitates timely resolution of technical issues through the responsible EPC contractors, engineering consultation, and design authorities. This is a site\-based Owner oversight position. The Field Engineer coordinates with Fermi's Construction, Project Engineering, Quality, and Commissioning teams to monitor compliance with approved engineering requirements, identify construction interface concerns, and support resolution of field technical issues. The position does not assume responsibility for contractor construction means and methods, engineering design, or the technical obligations of the Engineer of Record. **Responsibilities:** **RFI and Technical Query Resolution** * Receive, review, and track RFIs and technical queries raised by EPC contractors and site construction teams. * Ensure each RFI and technical query receives an adequate, technically sound response from the responsible engineering party. * Monitor and facilitate timely resolution of RFIs and field technical issues by the responsible EPC contractor or design authority, escalating unresolved items that could affect safety, quality, schedule, or project execution. * Coordinate Owner review of field change requests and nonconformance reports with the responsible engineering organization and Fermi Quality team, monitoring contractor disposition and corrective action closure in accordance with established project procedures. * Coordinate with Project Engineers, internal engineering teams, and external design engineers to obtain timely technical responses. * Communicate approved engineering clarifications and design changes to the appropriate construction teams. * Maintain the status of open RFIs and field technical items and report aging items to the Field Engineering Manager. **Field Engineering Support** * Provide on\-site Owner engineering oversight of construction activities across assigned civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and other applicable disciplines with approved engineering requirements and coordinating resolution through the responsible parties. * Review approved construction drawings, engineering specifications, and technical documentation to support Owner field oversight, identify potential discrepancies, and facilitate technical clarification through the responsible engineering organization. * Walk active construction areas to verify field conditions and identify discrepancies between the design and actual conditions. * Identify potential installation conflicts and constructability concerns before they impact field execution. * Follow and reinforce the Fermi America safety standard in the field and report unsafe conditions observed during field walks to HSSE and construction management. **Field Documentation and Quality Support** * Track technical issues, engineering changes, and field resolutions through completion. * Monitor contractor maintenance and submission of field engineering records, redline drawings, and as\-built documentation, identifying deficiencies and coordinating resolution through established document control procedures. * Support the owner Quality team by identifying potential deviations from approved design requirements observed in the field. * Participate in Owner mechanical completion and turnover walkdowns, monitor contractor resolution of identified deficiencies and punch\-list items, and support Owner review of commissioning readiness and turnover documentation. **Construction Coordination** * Participate in daily construction coordination meetings, field walks, and planning discussions. * Work with construction management and EPC contractors to identify engineering related risks to the schedule. * Escalate unresolved technical issues to the Field Engineering Manager. * Identify and communicate field engineering interfaces between EPC contractors, equipment vendors, Owner\-furnished equipment, and shared campus infrastructure. * Coordinate with the responsible Fermi Project Engineer and Construction Manager to ensure field technical issues are evaluated for potential impacts to project scope, schedule, cost, and contractual requirements. * Monitor contractor implementation of approved engineering changes and technical dispositions, identifying apparent discrepancies and escalating concerns through established Owner procedures. Requirements: **Required Qualification:** * 3\+ years of field engineering, construction engineering, or related technical experience on power generation, heavy industrial, data center, utility scale, or major capital construction projects, preferably involving EPC contractors and multidisciplinary construction activities. * Experience with, or working knowledge of, RFIs, field changes, and as built documentation. **Technical Knowledge** * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, construction specifications, and technical documentation. * Familiarity with applicable industry codes and standards for the assigned discipline. * Strong communication, problem solving, and organizational skills, with a sense of urgency in closing open items. **Tools and Systems** * Familiarity with industry standard engineering design and model review software, such as AVEVA, Hexagon SmartPlant, and Autodesk AutoCAD and Navisworks, or equivalent. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and document review tools such as Bluebeam. **Education and Credentials** * Bachelor's degree in civil, mechanical, or electrical engineering, construction engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant field experience may be considered. * Ability to work full time on site at Project Matador. * OSHA 10\-hour construction certification, or the ability to obtain it within 90 days of hire. * Valid driver license and the ability to meet site access and background requirements. * Owner oversight personnel are recommended to have OSHA 30 hour certified. **Preferred Qualification:** * Experience working directly on active construction sites with superintendents, contractors, and engineering teams. * Experience coordinating with EPC contractors, design engineers, and multiple construction trades. * Experience with power generation, electrical distribution, mechanical systems, structural concrete, or underground utilities. * Familiarity with construction document management platforms such as Oracle Aconex, Procore, or SharePoint. * Familiarity with construction quality requirements, inspection processes, and field verification. * Familiarity with construction survey and layout processes, and with AutoCAD or Civil 3D. * Experience supporting Owner field oversight, construction quality monitoring, contractor coordination, or technical interface management on major capital projects. **Equal Employment Opportunity \& Benefits** Fermi America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Fermi America offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, and employee assistance programs, subject to eligibility and plan terms. Reasonable accommodation is available to qualified applicants with disabilities throughout the hiring process.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Forward Deployed Engineer** **— Banking Platform** *Ship it, then go sit with the people using it. · Charlotte, NC* **Location** Charlotte, NC — on\-site at our headquarters, with travel to partner and client sites **Experience Required** 5\+ years building and shipping production software, including meaningful time in financial services and hands\-on experience building with Claude **Employment Type** Full\-time, exempt **Reports To** Technical Program Manager **Direct Reports** None. You work across engineering, product, operations, and directly with external partners. **Core Stack** React, Flutter, AWS, GitHub Actions, Claude (Claude Code and the Claude API) **Portfolio** Expected — see "Show Us Your Work" below **The Trade We're Offering** ============================ We're a smaller institution headquartered in a city full of very large ones, and we're not going to pretend we can match what the largest of them offer on every dimension. What we're offering instead is scope that those jobs structurally cannot give you. At a large bank, this work is split across four teams — a mobile team, a web team, a platform team, and a client\-facing integration group — and you'd own a lane in one of them. **Here, the whole path from commit to customer is yours.** You'll write the Flutter code, write the React code, own the pipeline that ships both, and then sit across the table from the people using what you built and watch where it breaks. Engineers who want that loop rarely get it at scale. If that's the job you've been trying to find, this is it.**About the Role** ================== We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to build our banking platform and then take it into the field. This is a hybrid of product engineering and client\-facing solutions work: roughly two\-thirds building, one\-third embedded with the partners, vendors, and internal teams who depend on what you ship. The forward\-deployed part is the point. Most engineering organizations put layers between the person who writes the code and the person who has to live with it, and quality suffers in both directions. You'll close that gap. When an integration fails at a partner, you're the one who diagnoses it — not a support tier that escalates to a queue that eventually reaches engineering three days later. We also expect this person to be genuinely fluent with Claude — not as a novelty, but as core tooling. A small team competing against institutions a hundred times our size only works if each engineer's output is multiplied. You should already be building this way and be able to show us how. You'll work closely with the Senior Product Manager who owns the banking portfolio, and you'll have real influence over technical direction. We have opinions but not much legacy, which means your architectural decisions will still be standing in five years.**What You'll Own** =================== **Mobile Development — Flutter** -------------------------------- * Build and ship our customer\-facing mobile banking application in Flutter across iOS and Android. * Own the release process end to end — store submissions, staged rollouts, versioning, and the deprecation strategy for older clients. * Handle the parts of mobile banking that are genuinely hard: biometric authentication, secure local storage, session handling, offline states, and deep links from notifications. * Keep performance and app size honest on the low\-end devices real customers actually carry. **Web Development — React** --------------------------- * Build customer\-facing web banking experiences and the internal tooling our operations teams use daily. * Share logic and design language across web and mobile so the two products don't quietly diverge. * Build to accessibility standards — WCAG conformance is a regulatory expectation in consumer banking, not a nice\-to\-have. **Cloud Infrastructure — AWS** ------------------------------ * Design, deploy, and operate services on AWS — compute, storage, networking, secrets, and identity. * Own infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible and auditable rather than hand\-assembled. * Build for the availability and recovery expectations of a regulated financial institution, and be able to prove them to an examiner. * Watch the bill. Cloud cost discipline matters more at our size than it does at a bank that can absorb the waste. **Delivery Engineering — GitHub Actions** ----------------------------------------- * Own the CI/CD pipelines for web, mobile, and backend services. * Build automated testing, security scanning, dependency checks, and deployment gates into the pipeline. * Maintain the change controls and audit trail that a regulated environment requires — approvals, artifacts, and release evidence. * Make shipping boring. A deployment should be an ordinary Tuesday, not an event. **AI\-Assisted Engineering — Claude** ------------------------------------- * Use Claude Code as a daily part of how you build — across the codebase, in your hat You Get Here** **What You Won't Get Here** The full path from commit to customer, owned by one person Anywhere to hide when something you shipped breaks Architectural decisions that will still be standing in five years A platform team that handles infrastructure so you don't have to Direct contact with the people using what you build Insulation from customers when a deploy goes badly Deploys in days, not release trains scheduled a quarter out A mature engineering organization with established process Genuine influence on technical direction from your first month Deep specialization — you'll work across mobile, web, cloud, and AI A mandate to define how a company uses AI, not to inherit someone's rules An existing AI platform team, or someone else's guardrails to inherit Budget for conferences, certifications, and continued learning A remote or fully flexible arrangement — this role is on\-site **Education** ============= * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. * **No degree requirement we'll hold rigidly.** Show us what you've shipped. Self\-taught engineers with production track records are welcome here. * AWS certifications are a plus and are not required. **Work Environment** ==================== On\-site at our Charlotte headquarters, Monday through Friday, standard business hours. Expect periodic travel to partner and client sites — typically a few days at a time, several times a year. Banking platform work occasionally means an evening or a weekend around a release, a core conversion, or an incident. We run a real on\-call rotation and we keep it humane.**Show Us Your Work** ===================== We ask candidates for this role to share code. A resume tells us where you've been; a repository tells us how you think. Send us **one or two repositories you've built** — ideally something involving Claude, a mobile or web application, or infrastructure you're proud of. Personal projects, open\-source contributions, and side work all count. **If your best work is proprietary, that is not a disqualifier.** Most engineers coming out of financial services cannot share what they built, and we're not going to penalize you for honoring an agreement you signed. In that case, tell us and we'll substitute a walkthrough conversation — you talk us through the architecture of something you built, the trade\-offs you made, and what you'd do differently. That serves the same purpose. What we're looking for either way: how you structure a project, how you handle the unglamorous parts, whether the README exists, and — where Claude is involved — what you chose to delegate to it and what you kept for yourself. We are not grading polish. A rough repository with clear thinking beats a tidy one with none. We will not ask you to complete an unpaid take\-home assignment. Your existing work, plus a conversation about it, is enough.**How to Apply** ================ Send a resume, links to your repositories (or a note that your work is proprietary), and a short note about something you shipped and then had to support in the field: what broke, what you learned from the people using it, and what you changed as a result. That story tells us more than a stack list does. If invited to initial screening, we'll ask you to share a portfolio or a few examples of your work so we can get a better understanding of your experience and creative approach.**Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ *We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team that reflects the customers we serve. jobs.title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mavria** ---------------- Mavria’s mission is to **build the industrial capacity America needs to lead in AI.** We believe that sustaining America’s AI leadership requires an unprecedented expansion of power, manufacturing, supply chains and physical infrastructure. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs who met at the U.S. Department of Energy, working on some of the country’s hardest energy and infrastructure projects. There, they saw a widening gap: AI labs and cloud providers were racing to scale compute, while the infrastructure underneath them was still built one custom project at a time, on timelines measured in years. We founded Mavria to close that gap. We are building to **industrialize intelligence**: turning the physical infrastructure AI runs on into products we manufacture, deploy and improve with every build. We’re starting with data centers. Our first product, Terrain, is a factory\-built data center platform. Terrain 01 is being built in Houston now, and we’ve raised $130M as of October 2026 to accelerate our roadmap. Terrain is our first product, not the limit of our ambition. We intend to eliminate the physical bottlenecks that constrain American AI leadership and build one of the foundational infrastructure companies of the AI era. **How we build** ---------------- At Mavria, three principles guide how we work: * **Ambition**: We want to build a generational company. To do that, we build capabilities, not just products. Terrain is our first product, not our last – and we seek to eliminate strategic bottlenecks across the entire AI supply chain. * **Urgency**: AI moves in weeks, while infrastructure tends to move in years. We match the frontier’s pace by making decisions quickly, building in parallel and securing critical supply ahead of demand. We surface problems early and never compromise on safety or engineering rigor. * **Ownership**: When we say we’ll do something, we do it. Keeping our word is how we stand apart, and taking radical ownership over our scope and our domain is how we build trust – internally and externally – while moving fast. **Role scope** ============== As our first forward\-deployed engineer, you’ll be the technical lead on Mavria’s customer pursuits, working side by side with our co\-founder Seth Cohen. You’ll sit with frontier labs, neoclouds and developers, learn what it takes to bring their compute online, and show them how our Terrain product gets them there. * **Lead technical discovery**: Work through a customer’s site, power, cooling and schedule to define what a Terrain deployment looks like for them. * **Drive sales enablement**: Embed deeply with our engineering team in Houston to build and own the decks, technical briefs and demos our commercial team sells with, so every claim matches what we’re building. * **Design the solution**: Turn customer needs into deployment concepts, technical proposals and RFP responses our commercial team can close on. * **Be the voice of the customer**: Bring what you learn in the field back to engineering and manufacturing, so every deployment shapes the next product. * **Carry it through**: Stay with each customer from first conversation to signed deal and into deployment, so nothing gets lost at the handoff. **What we're looking for** ========================== For this role, we’re interested in an established forward\-deployed or deployments professional with the following qualities: * **An engineer first**: You have a background in data centers, power, electrical or mechanical systems, and you can go deep with a customer’s engineering team. * **Customer\-facing**: You’re as comfortable in a boardroom as on a job site, and you can explain technical tradeoffs to engineers and executives alike. * **A problem\-finder**: You start with open questions and work out what the customer needs, not only what they asked for. * **An owner**: You run with little direction and take responsibility for outcomes. * **Ready to travel**: You’ll spend real time on both customer sites, Terrain sites, and our Houston manufacturing facilities, up to 50% of the year. Experience in solutions engineering or a forward\-deployed role at an **AI, infrastructure**, **energy,** or **defense** company is especially relevant. We value ability over years or titles. **To apply:** Share your background and an example of a technical sale or deployment you led. **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive total compensation package * Medical, dental, and vision insurance is 100% paid for the employee * Retirement Plan with a 3\.5% company match * Flexible time off Mavria is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Mavria will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable law. Compensation Range: $150K \- $300K

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description: Agile Six is a people\-first, remote\-work company that serves shoulder\-to\-shoulder with federal agencies to find innovative, human\-centered solutions. We build better by putting people first. We are animated by our core values of Purpose, Wholeness, Trust, Self\-Management and Inclusion. We deliver our solutions in autonomous teams of self\-managed professionals (no managers here!) who genuinely care about each other and the work. We know that’s our company’s purpose, and that we can only achieve it by supporting a culture where people feel valued, self\-managed, and love to come to work. ### **The role** Agile Six is looking for a Fullstack Engineer to advance the Department of Veterans Affairs’ Veteran Appointments and Check\-in Experience, which lets Veterans schedule, prepare for, and check in to health care appointments. As part of a cross\-functional Agile team, you will design, build, and continuously improve features on VA.gov primarily in React on the front end, with growing contributions to the Ruby on Rails back end, working across both VistA and Oracle Health Millennium EHR back\-ends and integrating FHIR\-based services, secure authentication, and analytics that align with the Digital Services Playbook and VA Design System. In this role, you will leverage emerging technologies and practices to deliver state of the art software. You will support and champion AI\-assisted engineering, using tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor to analyze, generate, and debug code, expand test coverage, and speed delivery while safeguarding privacy and security. Much of the work involves integrating with other services’ APIs and working through ambiguity, so you will collaborate closely with product managers, designers, engineers, VA stakeholders, other vendor teams, and the broader Agile Six community to ensure continuous, user\-centered value. ### **Contract timeline** The current contract period ends February 16, 2027\. We expect VA to extend the work through May 16, 2027\. These plans have not been finalized, and the timeline is subject to change. We welcome questions and will share what we know as transparently as we can throughout the hiring process. ### **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain front\-end features in React, and contribute to back\-end services in Ruby on Rails, for appointment scheduling and check\-in on VA.gov. * Effectively leverage AI\-powered IDEs such as Copilot and Cursor to analyze existing code, develop features, write unit tests, and debug issues while retaining responsible oversight and reviewing all work produced. * Integrate with other services’ APIs, mostly REST and often with incomplete or inconsistent documentation, through secure, scalable patterns, and work through unclear requirements with partner teams and stakeholders. * Pair with designers and researchers to run usability tests and iterate quickly, following the Digital Services Playbook and VA human\-centered design guidance. * Write and maintain comprehensive unit, integration, accessibility, and end\-to\-end tests; invest in test\-driven development and contract testing. * Participate in code reviews, architecture spikes, and collaborative working sessions as needed. * Catch issues early through QA and debugging. * Collaborate closely with UX and product, review pull requests, and look across the apps for gaps and needs. * Rotate with peers on daytime production support in half\-day shifts between 7 am and 8 pm ET, with occasional weekend coverage. * Uphold Section 508, HIPAA, FISMA\-moderate, and VA security controls, ensuring PII and PHI are always protected. * We expect the responsibilities of this position to shift and grow organically over time, in response to considerations such as the unique strengths and interests of the selected candidate and other team members and an evolving understanding of the delivery environment. * Adapt to changing priorities. Effectively shift focus as organizational, client, and team needs evolve; manage multiple concurrent responsibilities, effectively navigate context switching, and reprioritize work as needed. * Support the practice of engineering within the organization as needed, through activities such as help with recruitment and hiring, code challenges, and participating in our community of practice. ### **Basic qualifications** * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including strong React experience. * Proven experience integrating applications with REST APIs and handling auth flows (OAuth2, SSO, SAML). * Comfort building with limited information: external services often have missing or misleading documentation, so you build, test with trusted users, and adjust quickly. * Experience experimenting with and/or utilizing AI tools and services to create and deliver software, and a strong willingness to leverage AI where appropriate to improve outcomes. * Experience with automated testing (unit, integration, and end\-to\-end). * Comfortable  discuss it with us at your initial interview. ### **Additional desired qualifications** * Experience with Ruby on Rails, or interest in growing into back\-end work. * Experience with GraphQL or FHIR. * Experience leveraging AI tools and services to create and deliver software to production in a professional capacity. * Experience with VA.gov, healthcare, or government digital services, especially appointment scheduling, EHR integration, or FHIR, including the vets\-website or vets\-api codebases. * Familiarity with Cerner/Oracle Health Millennium APIs or similar healthcare platforms. * Experience with Datadog, Google Analytics, or similar monitoring and analytics tools * Experience with React Native or mobile development * Experience developing in AWS or Azure cloud environments * Familiarity with the US Web Design System * Experience working with government agencies * You are a U.S. Veteran. We recognize the transition to civilian life can be tricky, and welcome and encourage Veterans to apply *At Agile Six, we are committed to building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We’re eager to meet people who believe in our mission and who can contribute to our team in a variety of ways.* ### **Salary and Sixer Benefits** As a small organization and government contractor, the roles we hire for depend on the contracts we hold and the funding available. Salaries at Agile Six are tied to predefined peer groups based on the staffing plans we sell to clients. People in the same peer group are paid within 2\.5% of the peer group’s salary mean, even when their project work differs. We post fixed, non\-negotiable salaries so that you know what to expect, and to remove the bias and inequity that often show up in salary negotiations. We also periodically raise the salary of all Sixers to keep pace with market conditions. For more information about our Pay and Equity practices, please contact our Recruitment team. **The salary for this position is $129,152\.** Our benefits are designed to reinforce our core values of Wholeness, Self Management and Inclusion. The following benefits are available to all employees. We respect that only you know what balance means for your life and season. While we offer support from coaches, we expect you to own your wholeness, show up for work whole, and go home to your family the same. You will be seen, heard and valued. We expect you to offer the same for your colleagues, be kind (not controlling), be caring (not directive) and ready to participate in a state of flow. We mean it when we say “**We build better by putting people first”.** All Sixers Enjoy: * Self\-managed work/life balance and flexibility * Competitive salary * Employee Stock Ownership (ESOP) for all employees! * 401K matching * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Employer paid short and long term disability insurance * Employer paid life insurance * Self\-managed and generous paid time off * Paid federal holidays and two floating holidays * Paid parental leave * Self\-managed professional development spending * Self\-managed wellness days **Hiring practices** Agile Six is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Note: We participate in E\-Verify. Upon hire, we will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Unfortunately, we are unable to sponsor visas at this time. **If you need assistance or reasonable accommodation in applying for any of these positions, please reach out to** **careers@agile6\.com****. We want to ensure you have the ability to apply for any position at Agile Six.** Please read and respond to the application questions carefully. Interviews are conducted on a rolling basis until the position has been filled.

jobs.title: Injection Molding Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **A day in the life** --------------------- You start the morning scanning downtime dashboards, sifting through CMMS records, and reviewing last night’s alarms. A trend jumps out: a recurring screw recovery issue on a high\-cavitation press. By mid\-morning, you’re at the machine with a tech, walking through controls and hydraulics, checking temperature control loops, and validating electrical signals. After lunch, you facilitate a quick root\-cause huddle with Production, Tooling, Quality, and Maintenance to lock in countermeasures. You close the day updating PM strategies, capturing learnings in standard work, and prepping specs for an upcoming chiller upgrade. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * Drive equipment reliability, availability, and maintainability across an injection molding operation—raising uptime, quality, and safety while lowering cost. * Serve as the go\-to technical resource for injection molding machines, recycling equipment, robots, automation, conveyors, thermolators, chillers, dryers, material handling systems, compressors, and other auxiliary assets; support utilities, electrical systems, and facility infrastructure. * Investigate chronic failures and downtime patterns; lead root cause analysis and structured corrective actions to remove repeat issues. * Develop, refine, and sustain preventive maintenance strategies; right\-size PM frequencies and tasks using equipment history, OEM guidance, failure modes, and operating conditions. * Advance predictive maintenance—deploy vibration analysis, infrared thermography, oil sampling, ultrasonic inspection, and other condition\-monitoring tools; retire activities that don’t add value. * Set equipment standards and maintenance requirements for critical assets; build a deep understanding of molding processes and the interaction of machines, molds, robots, and auxiliaries. * Troubleshoot controls, hydraulics, electrical and temperature control systems, injection units, and screw recovery; support equipment setups, commissioning, and optimization. **Turn data into action** ------------------------- * Compile and analyze maintenance, failure, and performance data to pinpoint high\-impact opportunities. * Create dashboards, KPI reports, and Pareto views to prioritize improvements that reduce unplanned downtime, cost, and recurrence. * Lead continuous improvement projects focused on reliability, efficiency, cost reduction, and process stability using Lean/5S, RCA, and structured problem\-solving. **Build and improve assets** ---------------------------- * Provide engineering leadership for capital projects—new purchases, replacements, and upgrades. * Author equipment specifications, participate in vendor selection, and coordinate installation, startup, and qualification. * Partner with vendors, contractors, electricians, technicians, and internal stakeholders to deliver results. * Ensure new assets are documented and integrated into the maintenance program; identify upgrades to existing equipment through automation, controls improvements, energy reductions, or design changes. **Systems, documentation, and spares** -------------------------------------- * Develop the CMMS to strengthen planning, scheduling, and history. * Maintain accurate equipment records, PM procedures, BOMs, manuals, and technical documentation. * Publish troubleshooting guides, standard work, and equipment standards. * Define equipment criticality, set maintenance priorities, and identify critical spares with appropriate stocking levels. **Safety and compliance first** ------------------------------- * Embed safety into engineering changes—machine guarding, electrical safety, and lockout/tagout. * Support investigations of equipment\-related incidents; verify modifications meet codes, standards, and company requirements. **What you bring** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Mechatronics, or related engineering field. * Hands\-on experience in manufacturing with strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills. * Proven track record improving reliability and leading RCA. * Analytical mindset; fluent in interpreting schematics, mechanical drawings, manuals, and technical docs. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel) and data analysis. * Clear communicator and project organizer; collaborative with technicians, operators, engineers, vendors, and leadership. **Benefits and perks** ---------------------- * 401(k) with company match plus annual/quarterly bonus opportunities. * Medical, dental, and vision coverage. * Short\- and long\-term disability insurance. * Optional employee\-paid life insurance and supplemental plans. * Competitive PTO, paid holidays, and a company\-paid Christmas shutdown. * Fun extras: raffles for concerts/sports/entertainment and locally sourced prizes; monthly happy hours. **About Monoflo International, Inc.** ------------------------------------- Since 1973, Monoflo International, Inc. has been a family\-owned leader in innovative, eco\-conscious, reusable B2B plastic transport packaging. Our commitment to advanced technology helps customers move products efficiently and reliably. We empower team members to chart their careers, recognize excellence, and grow—balancing collaborative teamwork with individual accountability and ownership.

(1\-2 times per year) * Partner with industrial design on form and materials, and with electrical, firmware, and systems engineering on packaging, thermal management, and integration. * Use tolerance analysis, simulation, and testing to find failure modes before a build, and bring reliability test results back into the design **What You'll Bring \| Experience, Expertise \& Qualifications** * 12 or more years of mechanical engineering experience, including at least 3 years managing engineers * Experience taking consumer electronics, robotics, or other electromechanical products from prototype through mass production with contract manufacturers * Hands\-on depth in mechanism design, such as joints, gear trains, and motor integration, for parts that move, carry load, and wear over time * Creo, and experience with a product lifecycle management (PLM) system * Experience setting up design review and release practices for a hardware team * Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Experience designing products that people touch and handle every day, or integrating soft materials with mechanical parts, is a plus **How You'll Succeed \| Mindset, Judgment \& Ways of Working** * Balance prototype speed now with manufacturability at volume, and be clear about which standard each part is designed to * Find where the product's mechanical risk sits, and put the team's time there first * Refine and implement processes for the team that amplify our output and justifies any reductions in our current flexibility and pace * Help balance complex mechanical trade\-offs, such as weight vs. performance vs cost * Give candid, specific feedback, and help each engineer grow their skills and scope * Encourage a team that supports each\-other, share designs early and often * Be the link between mechanical engineering and the teams that depend on its work * Be energized by designing a Familiar that people will live with every day ### **Please Note: We have often hired those that do not meet the exact requirements but that we found to be a great culture fit and have the relevant experience to be successful in the role. Please consider applying if this is you.** ### **Familiar Machines \& Magic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer (Control Systems)
jobs.description: **Benefits:** * Paid time off * 401(k) * Competitive salary * Opportunity for advancement * Stock options plan **About the Role:** Radiant Robotics is looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on Controls Systems to join our innovative development team in San Leandro, CA. If you're passionate about building smart, data\-driven physical AI systems with real\-world impact, we want to hear from you. **Responsibilities:** * Design control strategies including PID, model predictive control and learned policies, and recommend which to deploy. * Develop and optimize control algorithms using ML techniques such as reinforcement learning and predictive modeling. * Design, develop, and deploy ML models and apply in areas where they add value, including disturbance modeling, and trajectory optimization. * Build and maintain simulation models of dynamic magnetic forces, moving payloads, and the sensing chain, and validate them against bench measurements * Build and validate simulations of various control strategies by running comparative experiments. * Define performance metrics for the magnetic levitation system, such as positional error and report results against them. * Document models, assumptions, and results for analysis and improvement, and so that other engineers can reproduce and extend the work. * Work with firmware and electronics engineers to move proven strategies from simulation onto the real hardware and tune them in the loop. **Requirements:** * Master's degree or higher in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, robotics, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related field. * Working knowledge of control theory, including PID design and tuning, state\-space methods, and model predictive control (MPC). You can derive a plant model, linearize it, and explain the tradeoffs of each approach. * Applied machine learning experience, with at least one project where a learned model or policy improved a physical or simulated system. * Experience building dynamic simulations of physical systems and checking them against real measurements. * Proficiency in Python, C\+\+, or MATLAB/Simulink for controls and ML development * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain controller behavior to engineers outside the controls discipline. * Comfort using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or similar for simulations development. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience deploying controllers on embedded targets such as microcontrollers or real\-time Linux, and tuning them with hardware in the loop. * Experience with multi\-physics or finite element modeling of magnetic fields, for example with FEMM or COMSOL. Experience with designing, analyzing, or fabricating systems that generate or manipulate magnetic fields. * **About Us:** Radiant Robotics (formerly US Positronix) is an innovator and leader in magnetic levitation solutions, with a focus on warehousing and logistics applications. Radiant’s mission is to unify all materials handling workflows for warehousing and manufacturing into a single, simple intelligent automation platform. engineers use daily * Strong production experience in at least one of Rust, Python, or TypeScript, with a center of gravity in command\-line tools or backend services and the ability to work across
