jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, AI
jobs.description: Drug development shouldn’t be guesswork, not when patients are waiting. Pathos is building a next\-generation biotech with AI at the core. Not as a feature, but as the operating system for how medicines get developed. We believe most drugs don't fail because the science was wrong. They fail because they were tested in the wrong patients, with the wrong assumptions, in trials that couldn't answer the real question: who benefits, and why? Pathos exists to change that. We're building the largest foundation model in oncology and pairing it with proprietary AI systems, deep oncology expertise, and 200\+ petabytes of multimodal data linked to patient outcomes, so we can make development decisions with more precision, much earlier. This is not theoretical. We’re well\-capitalized and have the leadership to build a generational company. We invest in and advance our own clinical\-stage programs, using our AI platform to sharpen trial design, patient selection and biomarker strategy. So therapies reach the patients most likely to benefit, sooner. **How We Build** Pathos does not operate like a traditional biotech. There is no middle management. There are no layers of approval. The company is designed, from the ground up, around small teams of 2–4 subject matter experts who each command hundreds of AI agents to do the work that used to require dozens of people. Everyone builds. Everyone ships. Every function at Pathos — from clinical execution to asset selection to the foundation model itself — runs on this model. Our product velocity delivers meaningful outcomes in hours instead of weeks. This is not a future aspiration. It is how we operate today. The people who thrive here are operators: deep experts who can specify what needs to happen, orchestrate AI agents to execute at scale, and make high\-judgment calls that compound over time. If you have spent your career building and shipping AI systems at scale, this is the environment where that experience becomes a superpower. **About the role** ------------------ **Applications will be reviewed continuously, with priority consideration for submissions received by December 7, 2026\.** You will play a major role in advancing the foundation model and building the agentic systems behind Foundry, the AI platform that informs every drug decision at Pathos, and make them continually improve over time from real\-world feedback. You will own how we train and adapt frontier open\-weight models specifically for drug development. You will leverage 200\+ petabytes of multimodal, multi\-scale oncology data spanning over 8 million patient records linked to longitudinal outcomes, alongside live data streams from clinical trial sites. Supported by a dedicated large\-scale GPU cluster and our internal wet lab for experimental validation, your models will directly inform design and execution of clinical trials. You will operate within a lean, high\-velocity team where every builder maintains end\-to\-end ownership over key platform capabilities. If you want to build the intelligence behind how new medicines are developed, and prove rigorously that it gets better, this is the place to do your career’s best work. **What You’ll Build** --------------------- * Advance mid\- and post\-training of our oncology foundation model across SFT and RL, including reward design and verifiers for scientific and clinical tasks whose correctness is hard to check automatically. * Run and debug training at scale, addressing instability, divergence and reward hacking. * Build the harness for scientific and clinical workflows: memory, context management, orchestration and tools, plus methods that optimize the harness automatically and evolve it together with the underlying model. * Design evaluations for open\-ended, long\-horizon scientific, clinical and operational tasks, calibrate them against expert judgment, investigate where they fail, and use them to decide what ships. * Build pipelines that generate, filter and curate training and evaluation data, with safeguards for quality, provenance and contamination. * Turn expert feedback, wet\-lab results and real\-time signals from clinical trial sites into improvements to models, harness and evaluations, so the platform learns from experience with very high sample efficiency. * Work directly with oncologists, biologists and the clinical team to translate drug development needs into tractable ML problems, and publish in top ML and scientific venues. **Who You Are** --------------- We’re looking for researchers and engineers who have gotten models or agents working at scale, care as much about the drugs as about the models, and want their work to reach patients. You take ambiguous problems through experiments to results people can use. We’re hiring across levels, from exceptional early\-career talent to experienced researchers. **Must\-haves** * Deep, hands\-on expertise in at least one of the following, which we value equally: * + Mid\- or post\-training at scale, such as SFT, RL, reward modeling or preference optimization, with direct ownership of training runs and results. + Evaluation, data and agent harness design, such as evaluation and feedback design for scientific, clinical and operational tasks, synthetic data pipelines, or harness optimization spanning memory, context management, orchestration and tools. * Rigorous scientific judgment, including when ground truth is limited, delayed or disputed. * Strong engineering skills in Python, with production\-quality code. * Clear communication of evidence, limitations and uncertainty. * Willingness to learn biology and drug development, and work closely with domain experts. Publications, research software and deployed systems are all valid evidence. Publications are welcome but not required. ### **Bonus** * You’ve built self\-improving agentic systems, for example through self\-play, synthetic data generation, self\-training on past trajectories or test\-time learning, or systems that automate ML research. * You’ve built AI systems for real\-world scientific workflows, such as agents that generate hypotheses and design, run and analyze experiments using lab or clinical data. * You’ve built RL environments or task suites for training agents on realistic, long\-horizon tasks. * You’ve modeled multimodal biomedical data, such as genomics, transcriptomics, pathology and radiology images, clinical notes and EHRs, ideally combining several modalities in one model. * You’ve worked on uncertainty estimation, calibration or causal inference, especially where model outputs inform high\-stakes decisions. * You’ve built or scaled infrastructure for efficient training and inference, such as distributed training, custom kernels (CUDA or Triton) or high\-throughput serving. * You’ve shipped ML systems that real users rely on, then monitored them in production and improved them from user feedback. * You have a background in oncology, drug development or clinical research, or a track record of working closely with clinicians and biologists. * You’ve worked with patient\-level or clinical trial data under privacy and regulatory constraints, such as HIPAA. None of these are required. We value depth in one area over breadth across all of them. **Location** ------------ The preferred location for this position is in our New York City HQ, though exceptional remote candidates will also be considered. **Compensation** ---------------- We are hiring across levels. The anticipated salary range is $220,000 to $350,000 plus equity, and we have flexibility for exceptional candidates.

jobs.title: Network Architecture Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mavria** ---------------- Mavria’s mission is to **build the industrial capacity America needs to lead in AI.** We believe that sustaining America’s AI leadership requires an unprecedented expansion of power, manufacturing, supply chains and physical infrastructure. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs who met at the U.S. Department of Energy, working on some of the country’s hardest energy and infrastructure projects. There, they saw a widening gap: AI labs and cloud providers were racing to scale compute, while the infrastructure underneath them was still built one custom project at a time, on timelines measured in years. We founded Mavria to close that gap. We are building to **industrialize intelligence**: turning the physical infrastructure AI runs on into products we manufacture, deploy and improve with every build. We’re starting with data centers. Our first product, Terrain, is a factory\-built data center platform. Terrain 01 is being built in Houston now, and we’ve raised $130M as of October 2026 to accelerate our roadmap. Terrain is our first product, not the limit of our ambition. We intend to eliminate the physical bottlenecks that constrain American AI leadership and build one of the foundational infrastructure companies of the AI era. **How we build** ---------------- At Mavria, three principles guide how we work: * **Ambition**: We want to build a generational company. To do that, we build capabilities, not just products. Terrain is our first product, not our last – and we seek to eliminate strategic bottlenecks across the entire AI supply chain. * **Urgency**: AI moves in weeks, while infrastructure tends to move in years. We match the frontier’s pace by making decisions quickly, building in parallel and securing critical supply ahead of demand. We surface problems early and never compromise on safety or engineering rigor. * **Ownership**: When we say we’ll do something, we do it. Keeping our word is how we stand apart, and taking radical ownership over our scope and our domain is how we build trust – internally and externally – while moving fast. **Role scope** ============== As our first dedicated network architecture hire, you’ll design, deploy and run the data center network behind every Terrain site: how servers, switches and cabling sit in each rack, the leaf\-spine fabric that connects racks, rows and halls, and the long\-haul circuits that connect each site to the outside world. The standards you set will become the template for every site we build. You will: * **Design the fabric:** Design and evolve Ethernet leaf\-spine fabrics for AI and GPU workloads, with redundancy so no single failure takes a site down. * **Design from the rack up**: Lay out rack\-level networks, including top\-of\-rack or end\-of\-row, port density, patching, fiber or copper, and how network and power sit together in the cabinet, plus the structured cabling and fiber plant across rows and halls. * **Connect the sites**: Own long\-haul and data center interconnect circuits, carrier handoffs and storage network integration. * **Deploy and run it:** Deploy, configure and manage network infrastructure across our campus and sites, keep install packages, as\-builts and the network asset database current, and plan upgrades, migrations and decommissioning. * **Set the standard**: Define standards for configuration, routing, congestion management, firmware lifecycle and safe change management, and test new hardware and software platforms. * **Own the incidents:** Act as the escalation point for network incidents, drive permanent fixes, and keep improving uptime, latency and capacity. * **Build it into the product:** Work with our manufacturing, MEP and integration teams so the network design fits each standardized unit and site, including power and cooling. **What we're looking for** ========================== For this role, we’re looking for a hands\-on data center network engineer with the following qualities: * **A data center builder**: You have 6\+ years designing and running large\-scale data center networks, and you’ve physically built and logically designed leaf\-spine fabrics in production, not only office or enterprise networks. * **Rack\-literate**: You know what an IT rack looks like, how it’s wired, and how to connect hundreds of them into a resilient fabric. * **Deep on protocols**: You work with BGP, IS\-IS, OSPF, MPLS, ECMP, EVPN\-VXLAN and IPv4/IPv6 across multi\-vendor platforms such as Arista, NVIDIA Spectrum, Juniper or Cisco. * **Optics\-fluent**: You’ve designed fiber plants and worked with 100G\-and\-above optics, CWDM/DWDM and coherent optics. * **A clear explainer**: You can explain complex jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Company Summary:** *Fermi America is pioneering the development of next\-generation energy infrastructure to power the future of artificial intelligence. By delivering highly reliable, gigawatt\-scale power solutions, we are helping meet the rapidly growing energy demands of advanced AI technologies. Our flagship HyperGrid™ campus in Amarillo, Texas, is designed to become one of the world's largest energy\-driven AI complexes, integrating nuclear, natural gas, utility, solar, and battery power. With a planned 17 gigawatts of power capacity and 18 million square feet of AI infrastructure, Fermi America is positioned to play a leading role in the future of energy and artificial intelligence. At Fermi America, we are building more than infrastructure. We are creating opportunities for talented professionals to help shape the next generation of energy and AI innovation.* **Job Summary:** The Project Engineer serves as Fermi America's primary engineering coordination and oversight representative for assigned scopes, reporting to the Vice President of Engineering. The role is responsible for monitoring and coordinating engineering activities performed by EPC contractors, engineering consultants, equipment vendors, and suppliers to support compliance with contractual requirements, approved design criteria, project objectives, and established schedules. This is an Owner\-side engineering management position rather than a design execution role. The Project Engineer coordinates engineering priorities, monitors contractor and vendor performance, facilitates technical decisions, and engages subject matter experts as needed. EPC contractors, engineering consultants, and the Engineer of Record retain responsibility for their respective design and engineering obligations. **Responsibilities:** **Engineering Execution** * Oversee and monitor engineering execution by EPC contractors, engineering consultants, and vendors for assigned scopes, from design development through construction support, commissioning, and turnover, ensuring alignment with contractual requirements and project objectives. * Lead engineering progress and interface meetings, and track engineering deliverables, actions, and decisions to closure. * Identify technical risks, scope gaps, and interface conflicts early, and drive resolution with the responsible parties. * Coordinate across civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation and controls disciplines to resolve design conflicts. * Ensure engineering deliverables address safety in design, constructability, operability, maintainability, and long term asset reliability. * Monitor engineering progress against contractual deliverable schedules, approved design criteria, and established project milestones, identifying deficiencies and escalating risks requiring Owner intervention. * Coordinate technical interfaces between EPC contractors, equipment vendors, Owner\-furnished equipment, and shared campus infrastructure to identify scope gaps, design conflicts, and potential impacts to project execution. **EPC, Vendor, and Supplier Engagement** * Engage directly with EPC contractors, vendors, and suppliers to align on engineering scope, deliverables, interfaces, and schedule. * Hold EPC contractors, vendors, and suppliers accountable for the quality, completeness, and timely delivery of engineering and technical deliverables. * Lead technical evaluation of bids, contractor and vendor proposals, technical clarifications, and deviation requests. * Provide technical input to the evaluation of contractor and vendor change requests. **Technical Review** * Manage the owner's review cycle for drawings, specifications, calculations, and vendor data, assigning reviews to discipline subject matter experts and consolidating a single owner position. * Coordinate and oversee Owner technical reviews to assess whether EPC and vendor engineering deliverables align with approved project specifications, design criteria, and applicable codes and standards, while maintaining contractor and Engineer of Record responsibility for design accuracy, completeness, and compliance. * Coordinate owner participation in factory acceptance testing and site acceptance testing, and review test plans and reports. * Oversee adherence to established design configuration control and management of change procedures, ensuring proposed technical changes receive appropriate Owner review and approval in accordance with contractual requirements and delegated authority. **Interfaces and Reporting** * Support the Field Engineering team in resolving requests for information and field technical issues that require engineering direction. * Work with Procurement, Project Controls, Construction, Quality, HSSE, and Commissioning to keep engineering aligned with project priorities. * Uphold the Fermi America safety standard on site and coordinate with HSSE on safety related engineering matters. * Report engineering status, risks, a nt of Engineering. Requirements: **Required Qualification:** * Project Engineer: 7\+ years of engineering experience on large industrial or data center capital projects, on the owner side or the EPC side, including experience leading engineering scopes with contractors and vendors. * Senior Project Engineer: 10 to 15 years of engineering experience on large industrial or data center capital projects, on the owner side or the EPC side, including experience in engineering management. * Demonstrated experience managing engineering execution with EPC contractors, equipment vendors, and suppliers. * Experience leading multi discipline engineering teams or contractors through design, procurement, construction, and commissioning. * Demonstrated ability to oversee EPC engineering performance, manage contractor technical interfaces, evaluate engineering changes, and identify technical and contractual risks from an Owner or project delivery perspective **Technical Knowledge** * Working knowledge of engineering deliverables, design review processes, vendor data requirements, and management of technical change. * Working knowledge of applicable industry codes and standards, such as ASME, IEEE, NFPA, NEC, and API. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documents across multiple disciplines. * Strong leadership, communication, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to influence contractors and vendors without direct authority. * Tools and Systems * Working knowledge of industry standard engineering design and model review software, such as AVEVA, Hexagon SmartPlant, and Autodesk AutoCAD and Navisworks, or equivalent. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Microsoft Teams. **Education and Credentials** * Bachelor's degree in civil, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * Ability to travel regularly to Project Matador and to meet site access requirements. **Preferred Qualification:** * Experience on large scale EPC projects in power generation, electrical infrastructure, or industrial construction. * Experience managing original Regular travel to Project Matador is required based on project activities and milestones. Site visits require access to active construction areas and use of required personal protective equipment. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Voice AI [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event\-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco. **About this role** =================== As a Research Engineer, Voice AI at Concurrence, you'll build and tune speech models for patient conversations and ambient clinical audio. You'll own models from data and training through evaluation and production, working with runtime engineers on streaming inference, latency and turn\-taking. The work includes full\-duplex speech\-to\-speech models that listen and speak at the same time, handle interruptions and preserve clinical details. **What you'll do** ================== * Train and fine\-tune speech and audio models for patient calls and clinical encounters * Own data preparation, training experiments and evaluation code * Improve streaming inference, turn\-taking and interruption handling, balancing model quality, latency and cost * Define clinical failure cases with clinicians, product and evaluation engineers, and measure the errors that matter to patients * Evaluate changes on held\-out examples, investigate regressions and carry improvements into production * Use evidence from real conversations to choose the next experiment and shape our modeling approach **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've personally trained or fine\-tuned speech or audio models on large audio datasets as a substantial part of your work * You've shipped a model into a real\-time product, with concrete results on streaming inference, latency, turn\-taking or overlapping speech * You've taken an ambiguous problem, defined a useful metric and led the work through to a model running in production * You write the training and evaluation code yourself and can explain the choices behind an experiment * You use coding agents in your work and independently verify their output * You're low ego, direct, and hold yourself to a high bar * You can work on site in New York City or San Francisco **Nice to have** ================ * Experience building or tuning a full\-duplex speech\-to\-speech model, our strongest preference * Neural audio codecs or audio language models * Telephone audio, overlapping speech or multi\-speaker audio * Model adaptation for a particular customer, domain or regulated environment **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $220K \- $300K

jobs.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: **YOUR ROLE** We are seeking a Senior Agentic AI Engineer to architect, build, and operate intelligent AI agents that execute complex, end\-to\-end business workflows. This role goes beyond building conversational interfaces: you will develop reliable agentic systems that can reason over business context, plan and perform actions, collaborate with other agents, integrate with enterprise platforms, and involve people when judgment or approval is needed. You will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep hands\-on experience in LLM\-based systems, agent orchestration, tool integration, and production operations. You will own technical outcomes from architecture and prototyping through deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement, while helping establish engineering standards and mentoring other engineers. **WHAT YOU'LL** **DO** * Design and implement robust single\-agent and multi\-agent systems using patterns such as supervisor, planner, specialist agents, and delegated task execution. * Build agent workflows that support planning, tool use, state transitions, retries, checkpoints, resumability, and human\-in\-the\-loop approvals. * Define clear boundaries between probabilistic agent reasoning and deterministic business rules, validations, and transaction execution. * Develop reusable agent capabilities, tools, prompts, workflow components, and orchestration patterns that can be adopted across products. * Manage agent context, memory, conversation state, task state, and long\-running workflow lifecycle. * Integrate and evaluate foundation models from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and AWS Bedrock. * Engineer prompts, structured outputs, function/tool calling, context assembly, and model\-routing strategies. * Build retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems using embeddings, semantic search, metadata filtering, and vector databases. * Improve quality and reliability through grounding, validation, confidence\-aware workflows, fallback strategies, and hallucination mitigation. * Optimize model selection, latency, throughput, token consumption, and inference cost without compromising business outcomes. * Integrate agents with enterprise APIs, microservices, data platforms, and business applications. * Build and consume Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools using secure, well\-defined contracts. * Implement agent\-to\-agent (A2A) communication and interoperability patterns, including task lifecycle, status, input, and result handling. * Design capability discovery, delegation, and invocation patterns for internal and external agents. * Create resilient integration patterns for asynchronous operations, streaming, event delivery, and external system failures. * Build scalable, fault\-tolerant agent services using asynchronous and event\-driven architectures. * Implement durable workflow execution, persistence, checkpointing, idempotency, retries, timeouts, and recovery from partial failures. * Establish observability across agent decisions, tool calls, traces, latency, token usage, costs, and business outcomes. * Develop automated testing and evaluation strategies for agent behavior, tool correctness, regression detection, and end\-to\-end workflows. * Implement enterprise security controls including authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, secrets management, auditability, and policy enforcement. * Deploy and operate services using cloud\-native infrastructure, CI/CD, containers, and appropriate runtime platforms. * Lead technical design discussions and make pragmatic architecture decisions that balance speed, quality, scalability, and maintainability. * Partner with product, platform, security, and domain teams to translate business problems into agentic solutions with measurable outcomes. * Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing. * Evaluate emerging agent frameworks, protocols, models, and tools; recommend adoption based on evidence rather than novelty. * Drive prototypes and proofs of concept into production\-ready capabilities, including documentation and operational readiness. * Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. **YOUR LOCATION** This is a fully remote role, with the exception of onboarding and optional in\-office events. **SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** * Typically 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial backend or distributed\-systems development experience. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience building and deploying LLM\-powered applications or AI agents in production or production\-like environments. * Strong Python skills and experience designing maintainable services, APIs, and software components. * Practical experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent technologies. * Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, including prompting, tool calling, structured generation, context management, and model evaluation. * Experience designing REST APIs, integrating microservices, and working with asynchronous or event\-driven systems. * Experience with RAG architectures, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector. * Experience deploying cloud\-based applications and using Docker, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation; Kubernetes experience is valuable. * Understanding of production concerns including reliability, observability, performance, cost management, testing, and secure software development. * Ability to independently own a technical problem, communicate trade\-offs, and deliver a working solution across the development lifecycle. * Experience designing multi\-agent systems with supervisor, planner, worker, or specialist\-agent patterns (preferred) * Hands\-on experience implementing MCP servers, MCP clients, and tool integrations (preferred) * Experience with A2A or other agent interoperability protocols and distributed task lifecycle management (preferred) * Experience with AWS Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, or comparable managed model and agent runtime platforms (preferred) * Experience with agent memory, long\-running workflows, state persistence, and human\-in\-the\-loop interaction patterns (preferred) * Familiarity with agent tracing and evaluation tools such as LangSmith, as well as operational platforms such as Datadog or CloudWatch (preferred) * Knowledge of enterprise identity and security patterns, including OAuth 2\.0, JWT, RBAC, and multi\-tenant authorization (preferred) * Experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another domain with complex workflows and compliance requirements (preferred) **Physical Requirements** * Must be able to sit/stand/walk for prolonged periods of time (up to 8 hours per day), at a desk working on a computer. * Must be able to use standard office equipment for extended periods of time, including but not limited to, a mouse, keyboard, phone and video conferencing. * Must be able to travel to the Bold Penguin office in Dublin, Ohio for New Hire Onboarding \& Orientation (2 days, 2 nights); travel costs are covered by Bold Penguin. * Must be able to travel occasionally (up to 10%) for corporate events and team planning sessions. Bold Penguin is the premier digital broker for commercial insurance. Their technology expands top\-of\-funnel demand and increases yield for enterprise partners. Through digital distribution, wholesale capabilities, and AI\-driven insights, they transform the lifecycle of both simple and complex risks, from prospecting to placement. **Benefits** We offer competitive compensation and progressive benefits that include: * Medical, Dental, and Vision * Flexible PTO Policy * 401(k) with a company match * Employee Assistance Program * Parental Leave * Disability and Life Benefits **Stay connected to the Glacier.** We have great SLACK channels for work and play. We also like to video conference and hold all\-hands "Waddles" regularly. **Penguin bling.** Like swag themed after a certain Antarctic bird? Just. You. Wait. Bold Penguin believes in inclusion. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer that considers all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. To learn more about our results\-focused culture and employee\-focused perks, read more on our **careers page**.

jobs.title: Senior Firmware / Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: **Dyna Robotics** builds general\-purpose robots powered by a proprietary embodied AI foundation model with top\-in\-industry generalization and real\-world performance. Already deployed with customers across multiple industries, our robots do commercial\-grade work in the physical world. Our team comes from Google DeepMind, Meta, and Cruise, and we're backed by CRV, First Round, and other leading investors. As the first dedicated Firmware Engineer on our US team, you’ll own firmware across our robots and the new devices we build for research. On the robot, that means the embedded Linux and EtherCAT layer. For research devices, that means sensing hardware whose camera, IMU, and encoder firmware has to be reliable enough to collect training data at scale. This is a hands\-on role working side by side with researchers. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, Mechanisms
jobs.description: **Location:** Onsite — Austin, TX **Employment Type:** Direct Hire, Full\-Time **Job Title:** Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, Mechanisms **About 9 Mothers** The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"—we are building the shield. Backed by top\-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real\-time. Our flagship product is a low\-power, counter\-drone system built for the edge—on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack. **Why 9 Mothers?** While others build for "awareness" or "long\-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission\-driven builders who value field\-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month—not next year—this is your playground. **Position Summary** * We are hiring a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer who specializes in complex assemblies and mechanisms. Our products are machines that have to move quickly, absorb high loads, and keep working: precise motion platforms, belt\-fed and high\-capacity shotgun actions, feed systems, gimbals, drive trains, and the gearboxes and linkages that tie them together. Many of our hardest engineering problems are problems of motion, and we are adding an engineer whose strength is understanding how parts move and interact before the parts exist. * This role is not tied to a single product. You will own mechanisms and subsystems across our product line, and the work is a mix of new design and problem solving: ground\-up mechanisms for new products, taken from a set of requirements and a blank page through to production hardware, alongside the difficult problems on existing designs, such as a feed path that hangs up under one particular loading or a mount that has to work at temperature after ten thousand cycles. You will work alongside our existing mechanical engineering team as its specialist in kinematics and mechanism design. * The right person pairs an intuition for how things can be made to move with a practical understanding of what resists that motion: friction, backlash, inertia, compliance, wear, thermal growth, and contamination. The role is hands\-on, and you will build and test much of what you design. **What You'll Do** * **Design new mechanisms from the ground up.** Take new feed, action, drive, and motion\-platform mechanisms from requirements and first sketch through working hardware and into production. * **Solve the hard mechanism problems.** Take on the feed, action, drive, latching, and timing problems that are blocking a product, from first sketch through working hardware. Own the concept, the kinematic and dynamic analysis, the detailed design, and the test. * **Design for motion under load.** Cams, linkages, gear trains, springs, ratchets, escapements, detents, and the interfaces between them. Get the forces, timing, and energy budgets right, and make the mechanism tolerant of the real\-world conditions it will see. * **Prototype with your own hands.** Machine, print, fit, and assemble your own test articles. Instrument them. Cycle them until they break, then explain exactly why. * **Diagnose by ear, by hand, and by data.** Find the root cause of a jam, a stall, a noise, a wear pattern, or an intermittent failure, and separate what the hardware is telling you from what the drawing says it should be doing. Partner with our test engineer on high\-speed video and instrumented testing when the failure is too fast to see. * **Kill bad ideas early.** Bring the judgment to recognize when a concept will not survive contact with tolerances, contamination, temperature, or a soldier, and say so before we spend months finding out. * **Define requirements and prove them out.** Write the requirements for your mechanisms and the test plans that verify them, then run the tests and report what the hardware did against what it was required to do. * **Select materials and finishes.** Choose the materials, heat treatments, and coatings that give a mechanism the strength, wear life, and corrosion resistance it needs. * **Make it manufacturable.** Design mechanisms that can be built repeatably with the processes and tolerances we can actually hold, and work with our manufacturing engineer and machine shop to get there. Produce drawings with GD\&T that suppliers can build to. * **Work with suppliers.** Engage directly with machine shops, heat treaters, coating vendors, and other suppliers on manufacturability, process capability, and first\-article problems. * **Work across disciplines.** Collaborate with electrical, firmware, and controls on actuator selection, sensing, and the electromechanical interfaces where motion meets control. * **Support testing in the field.** Go to the range. Watch the har mode analysis:** friction and lubrication, wear, fatigue, backlash, fretting, galling, contamination, and thermal effects, and the material and surface\-treatment choices that address them. * **Working knowledge of materials, heat treatment, and coatings.** You choose them deliberately for strength, wear, fatigue, and corrosion, and you understand what each choice does to cost and lead time. * **Experience writing requirements and test plans.** You can turn a need into requirements that can be verified, and write the test plan that verifies them. * **Hands\-on prototyping and troubleshooting skills.** You are comfortable on a mill, a lathe, and a bench, and you have a history of taking machines apart and putting them back together, on the job and on your own time. * **Proficiency in SolidWorks.** You model complex moving assemblies in SolidWorks, with models and assemblies structured so that others can work in them. * **Strong GD\&T and drawing skills.** You produce drawings that fully constrain a moving assembly and that suppliers can build to. * **Experience engaging with suppliers.** You have worked directly with machine shops and special\-process vendors to get parts quoted, built, and corrected. * **The judgment to say no.** You have seen enough clever ideas fail to know which ones will, and you are direct about it without being difficult. * Efficient, low\-ego, and easy to work with. You build rapport quickly and move work forward without drama. **Nice\-to\-Have** * **An enthusiasm for firearms as mechanical machines.** Firearms are among the most refined mechanisms ever built, and people who appreciate that tend to be good at this job. Experience designing or working on firearm actions, feed systems, or fire control is a strong plus. * Experience with high\-rate, high\-shock, or high\-cycle mechanisms: firearms, ammunition handling, automotive powertrain, industrial automation, printing or packaging machinery, aerospace actuation, or similar. * Experience with precision gear trains, harmonic drives, or servo\-driven gimbal and turret systems. * Sheet metal and weldment design experience. * Experience taking a mechanism from prototype through production, including working with machine shops and contract manufacturers on tolerancing and process capability. * Experience in a venture\-backed hardware startup. **Benefits** * **Meaningful Early Equity:** You aren't just an employee; you are a foundational owner. Your contributions directly drive the value of your stake in the company. * **Direct Roadmap Influence:** Forget the bureaucracy of big defense. You will have a seat at the table, directly shaping our product and technology trajectory from day one. * **Mission\-Critical Work:** We don't build for "what if." We build systems the Department of War actively needs to counter immediate, real\-world threats. * **The Builder's Playground:** Work in a brand\-new lab fully optimized for rapid prototyping, equipped with NVIDIA Jetsons, high\-end scopes, and 3\-D printers. * **100% Employer\-Paid Premiums:** We cover 100% of your medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums and cover 50% of healthcare premiums for your dependents. * **Unlimited PTO:** We value results, not clock\-watching. Take the time you need to stay sharp and recharge. * **Zero Red Tape:** You have the autonomy to make technical decisions that would take months of committee approval at a larger firm. * **Austin\-Based Culture:** Join an onsite team in Austin, TX, where we prioritize high\-bandwidth collaboration and rapid field\-testing. * **Relocation Assistance:** We want the best talent in the room. If you aren't in Austin yet, we’ll help you get here, to make your transition to the Silicon Hills seamless. **About the Interview** * Initial screen with recruiter (30 min phone call) * Virtual interview with Director of Hardware Operations (30 min via MS Teams) * Onsite interview at our Austin facility (1 hour in\-person) Compensation Range: $165K \- $200K

You set the experience quality standards, identify the gaps between what we ship and what the experience should be, prioritize the fixes, and drive design and engineering to deliver polished launches. This is a hands\-on role on a small team, and it demands a proactive working attitude: nobody will hand you the list of what is wrong — you go find it. The product exists and is live with customers; your job is to make it excellent and make every launch land. You will spend time in front of live deployments, with the people who walk up to them and the customers who buy them, and turn what you see into a ranked plan the team executes. You work directly with the CEO, who owns product, and with the founders who lead AI and engineering. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own the end\-to\-end customer experience:** Treat the hardware (Gateway and Portal: screen, camera, microphones, speakers, mounting, installation) and the software (character, conversation, touch and voice interface, 3D content, enterprise AI agent, admin portal) as one product with one experience, not a hardware spec and a software backlog. * **Set the experience quality standards:** Define what good looks like at every step of the journey — approach, greeting, conversation, product display, handoff, recovery from errors — and put measurable standards behind it: response latency, recognition accuracy, conversation completion, uptime, time to install. * **Identify the gaps:** Visit live deployments, run walk\-up tests, review conversation logs and customer feedback, and audit every new build against the standard. Keep a living list of what is broken, rough, or missing, ranked by impact on the customer and the end user. * **Prioritize the fixes:** Turn that list into a sequenced roadmap. Make the calls between fixes, polish, and new features, and defend them with evidence from the field. * **Drive design and engineering to delivery:** Write clear specs and acceptance criteria, run the product review cadence, remove blockers, and hold the team — and yourself — to the bar. Know when good enough is not. * **Drive launch readiness:** For every product release and every customer go\-live: readiness checklist, go/no\-go, on\-site or remote acceptance, day\-one monitoring, and fast post\-launch fixes. Nothing reaches a customer floor without your sign\-off that it is polished. * **Close the loop with customers:** Partner with sales, deployment, and customer success so field issues become product fixes and product fixes become customer updates. * **Be the voice of the user across the stack:** Represent the person standing in front of the screen across all five layers of the LiveX stack — IP design, hardware, interaction, enterprise AI agent, and deployment. **Who You Are** --------------- **Must\-haves** * 4–8 years of product management experience, including several years on products that combine hardware and software — devices, kiosks, robotics, consumer electronics, in\-store or in\-venue technology. * Early\-stage startup experience (seed to Series B, under \~50 people): you have owned a product end to end with no product team behind you. * A track record of taking a product from working to polished — launches you drove where quality, not scope, was the deliverable. * Product judgment for physical, walk\-up experiences: touch, voice, and large screens in public spaces, used by people in a hurry who did not read a manual. * Experience with AI or conversational products, and a clear method for defining and measuring quality in a system whose output is probabilistic. * The ability to write crisp specs, acceptance criteria, and readiness checklists, and comfort working from data — logs, metrics, and dashboards. * Field orientation: you go to the store, the lobby, or the stadium, and you have run site acceptance yourself. * Credibility with engineers and designers: technical enough to debate tradeoffs, design\-literate enough to tell finished from unfinished. * Hands\-on use of AI tools in your own work — analysis, prototyping, writing — is required. Product judgment and a high quality bar remain our most important hiring criteria. * A proactive working attitude is required. You notice the gap before anyone reports it, raise it, propose the fix, and move it forward without waiting to be asked. We will not hire a reactive operator into this role, however strong the resume. * Ownership and a clear point of view on what the product should be. * The ability to work on\-site in Palo Alto, with current residence in or willingness to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area. **Bonus points** * Launch or quality ownership for a hardware\-plus\-software product deployed at scale in retail, hospitality, healthcare, or venues is strongly preferred. We will prioritize candidates who have personally owned launch readiness across many sites. * Digital human, avatar, voice assistant, or conversational AI products. * Hardware programs: build validation, manufacturing partners, installation, and field service. * End\-to\-end product ownership in a startup or small team. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- Every LiveX deployment is judged in the first few seconds by the person who walks up to it. Because we build every layer ourselves, there is no vendor to blame when the experience falls short — and no vendor standing between us and fixing it. You will be the person who makes sure the whole thing feels like one finished product, every time it ships, with a direct line to the CEO and the authority to hold a launch until it is right. **Why Join LiveX AI?** ---------------------- * **World\-Stage Experiences:** Your work goes live in front of millions—at the Super Bowl, major airports, and NVIDIA GTC—not just inside an office. * **Full\-Real Scope:** AI, hardware, and real customers—you'll build a skill set most people don't reach until years into their careers. * **Silicon Valley, Front Row:** Work at the center of the physical AI movement, with the connections and momentum that come with it. * **Mentorship That Matters:** Work directly with founders and senior leaders who want to see you grow—not hand you busywork. * **Real Ownership \& Growth:** Top performers take on more scope fast—leading projects, owning customers, and shaping the product. Ready to launch the next phase of your career and build the future of physical AI? Apply to join LiveX AI today.

jobs.description: Focus V makes connected smart devices, including the CARTA 3\. We're looking for a software engineer to work across device firmware, our mobile app, and the cloud services that connect them. **What you'll do** * Build and maintain embedded firmware for our devices: Bluetooth LE, Wi\-Fi, OTA updates, bootloader, display UI, storage, and heating control. * Ship features and fixes in our React Native (Expo) mobile app, including device pairing, control, and update flows. * Develop the Firebase backend: authentication, device provisioning and ownership, security rules, usage data, and rewards. * Maintain factory tools for flashing, provisioning, and validating devices, and support our manufacturing partner on production issues. * Diagnose field issues with customer support and beta testers, and ship fixes quickly. * Contribute to internal web tools used by our operations teams. **What we're looking for** * 3\+ years of professional software experience, with shipped embedded or connected\-device products. * Strong C/C\+\+ on microcontrollers (ESP32 or similar): RTOS, UART/SPI/I2C, memory\-constrained debugging. * Hands\-on Bluetooth LE experience (GATT, custom protocols) and OTA update design. * React Native and TypeScript experience; app store release experience. * Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions, security rules). * Comfort owning a problem end to end, from device to app to server. **Nice to have** * Experience with Telink or Espressif SDKs, LVGL, FatFs, or bootloader work. * Experience with Next.js, Supabase/Postgres, or Vercel. * Experience with manufacturing test and provisioning. * Consumer hardware launch experience.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **New York, NY · Full\-time · Hybrid (in office 3 days a week) · $150,000 \- $275,000 \+ equity** **We’re deploying advanced agents into the real world to solve some of the biggest pain points in healthcare, and bringing the JOY back to healthcare by fixing the financial chaos behind it.** Every year, healthcare practices fail to collect an estimated $125 billion in earned revenue. The money disappears into fragmented financial data, manual workflows, and opaque payer systems that don’t talk to one another. Often, these costs are passed on to patients through higher bills or rising health costs, and for many practices the losses are fatal. Joyful Health builds AI agents that take on insurers so providers get paid for the care they deliver. We didn’t start with a product. We spent ten months working as fractional CFOs for a dozen practices, doing the work alongside providers before we wrote the technology that automates it. We just announced our $22M Series A, led by CRV, with world\-class investors including the founders of MongoDB and KAYAK. Now we’re doubling our engineering team. **This role is full\-time. We’re looking for someone NYC\-based who is open to coming into the office 3 days a week.** **ABOUT THE ROLE** ------------------ We’re looking for a talented and ambitious Software Engineer with 4\+ years of backend experience to build the internal engines and systems that let us scale. Every new customer adds claims, people, and operational complexity to the business behind our agents. These systems will handle hundreds of thousands of claims and automate complex operational processes, so they need to work at scale. You’ll find the bottlenecks across the company and build reliable, auditable, self\-healing systems around them. You’ll partner with eng, ops, RCM and finance teams to find the work that eats the most hours, then design a system that replaces it. You’ll ship in small steps, measure the impact, and move to the next bottleneck. As a software engineer, you’ll have an outsized impact on the company’s trajectory, working on a critical problem that’s central to our success. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to work on something extremely challenging and make a huge difference. You should be comfortable (and excited!) about working in a fast\-paced, early\-stage startup environment where you'll be able to wear many hats and take on new challenges as they arise. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** ------------------ Here are some examples of what you’ll build: * **Automatic claim routing.** An allocation engine that assigns work dynamically as volume, priorities, and capacity change. * **Claims forecasting engine.** Models that predict incoming volume and workload, so we plan ahead of demand. * **Staffing rebalancing.** Systems that match specialist and BPO capacity to demand across accounts. * **Customized invoicing systems.** Billing that adapts to each customer’s terms and reconciles automatically. * **Quality and monitoring systems.** Checks that catch process failures before they reach a customer. * **Access and credential automation.** Secure, auditable provisioning for the portals and systems our team works in. * **Internal metrics.** Reporting that updates itself and ties back to source data. * **Privacy and Security.** Because this work touches sensitive data, you’ll design for security and HIPAA compliance from the start. **WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF…** ---------------------------------- * **You’re passionate about Joyful Health’s mission.** You want to solve real, pressing problems for providers and put them in control of their businesses. You naturally empathize with users and enjoy building with their needs in mind. * **You have 4\+ years of experience in backend engineering,** with a focus on building data pipelines, integrations, and the infrastructure that supports them. * **You have strong technical execution.** You view coding as a craft, not just a task, and you care about building a product that works at scale, with the user at the forefront. You bring: + Proficiency in Python and database systems, with familiarity in performance and optimization for scale + Experience in distributed systems coordination and AI pipelines + Familiarity with big data technologies and comfort working with massive datasets + Experience with CI/CD workflows such as GitHub Actions + Experience building reliable, observable production systems * **You have a radical sense of ownership.** You have the ability and desire to own technical roadmaps and refine ambiguous problems. * **You have a low ego and a growth mindset,** and you’re excited to shape our engineering team and culture as an early team member, leading by example and growing your impact as the product and team scale. * We care more about your drive, hustle, and passion than a college degree from a shiny institution or experience at name\-brand companies. **Bonus points** * You have experience working with healthcare data or solving interoperability challenges. * You’ve built internal platforms or developer tooling used by other engineers. * You’ve been a founder or an early engineer at a startup. **WORKING AT JOYFUL** --------------------- **Meaningful impact.** You’ll work on one of the most hair\-on\-fire problems providers face, so they can focus on caring for patients. **Autonomy and ownership.** As an early team member, you’ll shape the company from the ground up. **Growth and learning.** You’ll get direct access to experienced founders and advisors, plus stipends for professional development courses and books. **Competitive compensation and equity.** $150K \- $275K base, plus strong equity in Joyful Health. **Be your best self.** Comprehensive healthcare benefits, unlimited PTO (with a minimum of 10 days off a year), flexibility, and regular team off\-sites and events. Please apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. Nobody checks every box every time, and we’d love to talk with you about how you see yourself growing into this role. We’re also very open to candidates with non\-traditional experience. Joyful Health is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Ataraxis AI** ===================== Ataraxis is a clinical AI research lab working at the intersection of multi\-modal AI and precision medicine. Our goal is to make disease predictable. To accomplish this, we develop new AI methods that predict patient outcomes and treatment response, and build clinical tools to assist physicians in selecting the most optimal treatments for their patients. Our AI research lab discovers and develops methods to recognize patterns and predict outcomes across complex, multi\-modal clinical data. This spans our causality (Ataraxis Tau), foundation model (Falcon and Kestrel for digital pathology), and survival analysis research. Our first clinical products, such as Ataraxis Breast for breast cancer, already help patients get the most appropriate treatment across the best academic institutions and community clinics worldwide. At Ataraxis, you will have a unique opportunity to shape not only the future of our company, but also the future of healthcare. You will join an exceptional team at the forefront of clinical AI research and deployment. Our advisors include AI pioneers such as our founding advisor, Yann LeCun, and distinguished oncologists from top cancer research institutions, all united by the mission to redefine precision medicine. Ataraxis has raised over $24 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by top venture capital funds such as Thiel Capital/Founders Fund (OpenAI, SpaceX, Palantir), Obvious Ventures (AMI Labs, Inceptive, Radical Numerics, Recursion), and AIX Ventures (Hugging Face, Perplexity). We are an company with a flat organizational structure, where every team member is empowered to actively contribute. Leadership roles are earned by those who demonstrate initiative and consistently deliver exceptional results. Strong work ethic and the ability to prioritize ruthlessly are essential. **Responsibilities** ==================== This is a high\-ownership generalist role. You'll work across 3 services spanning TypeScript/React, Python backends, and ML/CV inference, all running on Google Cloud and Modal. Comfort moving between product code and ML infrastructure is essential. * **Physician web portal:** Next.js / React app where clinicians place orders, view slides, and read reports. * **Order service:** the system of record such as orders, patients, clinical data, insurance billing claims, report (PDF) generation, and a web of third\-party integrations. * **Slide tiles service:** generates and serves DeepZoom pyramids from gigapixel pathology slides. **Who You Are** =============== * **Product\-obsessed builder:** You're never satisfied with "good enough"—you relentlessly spot opportunities to improve the product and move fast to ship them, knowing that done and iterating beats perfect and waiting. * **AI\-native**: You're comfortable using latest AI tools (e.g., Cursor/Windsurf) to quickly build, refine, and document your code. * **Sense of style**: You appreciate polished, professional UIs, enjoy collaborating closely with designers, and understand that great UX is integral to great products. * **Creative thinker**: You thrive in environments requiring innovation and aren't limited by past experience. * **Self\-directed leader:** You take ownership, set your own agenda, and move with urgency. You don't need a roadmap handed to you. You identify what matters and rally others around it. * **Effective collaborator:** You keep teammates informed, surface blockers early, and turn around feedback rapidly, making it easy for those around you to do their best work. * **Strong external communicator:** You can represent the product and company confidently to customers, partners, and the outside world—translating technical work into clear, compelling narratives. **Qualifications** ================== * Frontend + Strong TypeScript and React (we run React 19 /Next.js 15, App Router) + Tailwind CSS, component\-driven UI, and modern testing with Jest\+ React Testing Library and Playwright for E2E + Bonus: data viz (Recharts), rich\-text (Tiptap), or medical image viewers (OpenSeaDragon) * Backend + Strong Python, with production experience in Flask (or similar) and SQLAlchemy/PostgreSQL + Database schema migrations (Alembic / Flask\-Migrate) + Designing and consuming REST APIs; integrating third\-party services + Async/background job processing (Google Cloud Tasks) * Cloud \& DevOps + Hands\-on Google Cloud Platform: Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage (GCS), Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks + Docker and CI/CD with GitHub Actions; tag\-based semantic\-versioned releases + Comfort with Vercel (portal) and serverless GPU deploys (Modal) * Testing \& quality + A genuine testing discipline—pytest, Jest, and Playwright are first\-class here, and our work feeds a regulated requirements\-traceability process Compensation Range: $100K \- $180K

jobs.title: Sr Front End Engineer (SE III)
jobs.description: Farmer’s Fridge makes fruits and vegetables accessible and approachable for everyone. We offer a variety of fresh, healthy, ready\-to\-eat meals and snacks through our fresh food vending machines, wholesale partners, and our office pantry solution — providing chef\-curated meals to customers within seconds. Today, we operate a network of Fridges and partner with clients nationwide in high\-foot\-traffic areas, such as airports, hospitals, universities, and large office buildings — where there is limited accessibility to fresh, healthy, grab\-n\-go options. We care deeply about what we’re creating and aspire to make sure our customers feel that through every touchpoint. This shows up in many ways across the business. We are committed to prioritizing food safety, we are passionate about product quality, we value our employees, we champion the best idea no matter where it comes from, and we’re committed to making an overall positive impact as we scale. **About this Role:** As a **Senior Front End Engineer (SE III)**, you’ll raise the team’s ability to deliver high\-quality software by contributing to development, improving our practices, and mentoring others. Our engineers take pride in crafting great software, but even more pride in product ownership: taking ideas from concept to release and beyond. You’d be joining the front end team that builds the applications that power the business, including the driver restocking app, the touchscreen interface on our Smart Fridges, the Farmer’s Fridge mobile app for reserving orders, and internal tools. Our near\-term focus is the tools that support our Supply Chain and Operations teams, so you’ll work closely with those teams here in Chicago. You’ll also help shape how we use AI day to day. We’re actively building our standards for LLM\-assisted development, and we expect our engineers to be fluent with these tools. **In a typical week, the Senior Front End Engineer will...** * Own projects end\-to\-end, from technical design through implementation, testing and deployment * Work directly with Supply Chain, Operations and other business stakeholders to understand pain points and build solutions that fix the root of the issue * Partner with Product to stay aligned on business goals * Build POCs quickly to prove out ideas and resolve uncertainty * Lead technical design for the projects you own and contribute to architecture discussions across the team * Work across greenfield and legacy systems, modernizing where it makes sense and raising the testing floor on the systems you touch * Perform timely PR reviews and mentor other engineers * Explore what’s newly possible with AI tooling and contribute to our standards for using it * Improve our engineering practices to accelerate the pace of delivery * Have creative liberty to operate and push the boundary * Help out the menu development team by tasting new recipes **In a Senior Front End Engineer, we're looking for someone who…** * Has 7\+ years of software engineering experience and a clear understanding of software best practices * Has strong experience with Flutter, React, or a similar framework * Has native app experience (a plus) * Is comfortable working in the back end when needed (full stack and AWS experience a plus) * Has side projects they’re passionate about (a plus) * Takes a deliberate, thoughtful approach to LLM\-assisted development and stays current as the tooling changes * Solves difficult problems, takes full ownership, and adapts to changing requirements * Is comfortable in both legacy codebases and greenfield projects, with a passion for raising standards * Makes the engineers around them better through mentorship and code review * Communicates technical challenges and solutions clearly, with a focus on outcomes * Is comfortable digging into data to inform decisions, flag issues, and measure whether what we built worked * Brings curiosity, attention to detail, a sense of urgency, and a desire to keep learning * Wants to build technology that directly impacts the company’s path to profitability and sets us up for long\-term success * Is based in the Chicago area and able to work from our office 3 days a week * Has a passion for making healthy food accessible to all The base salary range for this role is **$145,000 \- $155,000**. The base pay offered will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, training, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for company performance\-based bonuses and equity. We provide a **comprehensive benefits package**, including: * **Medical, dental, and vision insurance** (multiple plans available) * **401(k)** with immediate **employer match vesting** * **Paid time off (including vacation, sick leave, and holidays)** * **Paid sabbatical after 5 years of service** * **Employee discounts** * **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)** **Benefits at Farmer's Fridge:** ***In This Together \-*** We stay connected, whether in person or virtually. We encourage business transparency through monthly town hall meetings and weekly financial updates. We set out to make the best product on the market, and we believe we’ve done it. We value your input in the new menu creation process. From regular tasting panels, where employees provide new menu feedback. ***Happier Workdays \-*** Each day at work should fill you with joy. We're a fun and passionate group, and we don't take ourselves too seriously. Bring your unique self to work, dress comfortably, and always feel free to share your thoughts and opinions. We encourage curiosity; there's no hierarchy here when we're all swapping ideas. ***Never run on empty \-*** Daily Farmer's Fridge meal and office snacks are just some of the offerings to make sure you aren't distracted by a growling stomach. Recharge with our paid sabbatical program after five years of service. ***Innovate \& Elevate \-*** We're all teachers and learners. You'll grow and help grow the company through cross\-functional collaboration, open access to leadership, and regular business updates. You have a direct impact on the company’s bottom line. You can also impact your bottom line by participating in our 401(k) plan that includes a company match with immediate vesting. **Farmer’s Fridge Diversity Statement:** ***"Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Farmer’s Fridge, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.”*** Farmer’s Fridge is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity in all employment practices, including hiring, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer - AI and Observability
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** **Job Description** **Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology** Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. **Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:** * **Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach, Scale \& Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment \& ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. The Observability \& Insights group ensures that Disney Streaming’s distributed systems are reliable, performant, and transparent. We build the telemetry, dashboards, alerting, insights pipelines, and developer experience tooling that enable engineers across the organization to understand system health and take action quickly. **Job Summary:** As a Senior Software Engineer (P3\), you will lead the design and implementation of intelligent, AI\-driven systems that safeguard the reliability and performance of Disney’s global streaming ecosystem. You will be a technical leader in developing agentic systems, complex machine learning models, and high\-throughput real\-time pipelines that transform massive telemetry and log datasets into automated detection, root cause analysis, and proactive insights. In this role, you will own the architectural vision for autonomous agents capable of reasoning over complex system behaviors across Disney\+, Hulu, and ESPN. You will act as a bridge between engineering, product, and platform teams, translating high\-level business needs into scalable AI solutions that reduce operational overhead. As a P3 engineer, you are expected to deliver mission\-critical features, mentor junior engineers, and drive engineering excellence through rigorous design reviews and high\-quality, production\-ready code in a fast\-paced, AI\-native environment. **Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:** * Own the design and operation of production\-grade, intelligent systems leveraging real\-time signals and AI\-driven detection to ensure the health of critical services and premium customer experiences. * Lead the development of agentic AI systems powered by modern foundation models (e.g., Claude Opus/Sonnet, GPT\-4\). You will define the strategy for automated reasoning, decisioning, and predictive modeling for global\-scale system reliability. * Oversee the creation of end\-to\-end data pipelines that process high\-volume telemetry and user signals into actionable, automated insights and root cause analysis. * Design and maintain scalable APIs and microservices that provide explainability and predictive signals to cross\-functional engineering and product stakeholders. * Partner with leadership and cross\-functional teams to embed intelligence into global workflows (incident response, release validation), significantly reducing Time\-to\-Detect (TTD) and Time\-to\-Resolve (TTR). * Promote engineering best practices, provide technical guidance through code and design reviews, and drive innovation in observability and developer productivity through applied AI. **Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:** **Basic Qualifications** * 5\+ years of applicable experience in backend development, with a proven track record of building and scaling AI\-powered or data\-driven applications. * Advanced proficiency with modern models (GPT\-4/o1, Claude Opus/Sonnet, Bedrock), including deep experience in prompt engineering, model evaluation, and building complex agentic workflows using frameworks like LangChain or LangGraph. * Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience deploying and monitoring ML systems (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and large\-scale data processing (PySpark, Pandas) in production environments. * Strong experience with AWS ecosystem and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) at scale. * Proven ability to lead technical projects, mentor junior talent, and champion software development best practices (Git, CI/CD, Agile). * Expert level use of AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to accelerate team velocity and maintain high code quality. * Exceptional communication skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and explain complex AI/technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical partners. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience implementing observability and monitoring systems for high\-volume, low\-latency production environments. * Experience with modern databases and observability platforms (Datadog, Grafana, Conviva, MongoDB) handling billions of events. * Advanced knowledge of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and API design patterns. **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY Job Posting Statement The hiring range for this position in New York City, NY is $148,700 \- $199,400 per year, and in Glendale, CA is $141,900 \- $190,300 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs. jobs.title: Staff Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: **YOUR ROLE** We are seeking a Staff Agentic AI Engineer to lead our agentic AI engineering team: setting technical direction, driving delivery, and turning fast\-moving model and orchestration capabilities into secure, reusable, observable production systems. You will be the team's technical lead. You will own the architecture of our agent platform, define how the team builds and operates agents, and make sure the work ships reliably within enterprise controls. You will stay hands\-on in the most critical architectural and engineering work while guiding Senior engineers, shaping the roadmap with engineering and product leadership, and partnering with data, security, and operations to deliver measurable business outcomes. **WHAT YOU'LL** **DO** * **Team technical leadership:** Act as the technical lead for the agentic AI engineering team. Set the technical roadmap with engineering and product leadership, break large initiatives into well\-scoped work, assign clear ownership, and hold the team accountable for quality and delivery. * **Architecture and platform strategy:** Define the target architecture, technical principles, and evolution plan for the agent platform.
