jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Full Stack & AI
jobs.description: ***Every day, we work together for what matters – bold, swift, and equitable climate action.*** **ABOUT THE ROLE** At 3Degrees, a Certified B Corporation driving climate action, our proprietary, mission\-critical platform is the system of record for our transaction data and the core of our business. It brings teams across the company together around a single source of truth and powers high\-stakes, high\-value workflows where accuracy, auditability, and speed all matter. We are now reimagining that platform from the ground up, with AI at its core. Think intelligent document understanding that turns inbound emails and contracts into structured records, rules engines that validate every detail and explain their reasoning, agentic assistants that plan work in plain language or by voice, and open integrations that let the AI tools we choose work directly with our data. Through it all, one principle holds: the AI drafts, and a person approves. An early prototype has already shipped hundreds of improvements in a single month, and now we are building the team that will take it to production and beyond. How we build matters as much as what we build. Across 3Degrees, our engineering teams put AI agents to work throughout the development lifecycle: drafting code and tests, preparing pull requests for review, and even writing the release notes that tell users what is new, often several times a week. Engineers stay firmly in the loop as architects, reviewers, and decision\-makers, and they are always looking for the next way to work smarter. You will join a growing community of product engineers across the company who share ideas openly and raise the bar for one another. As Senior Engineer, Full Stack \& AI, you will be a core builder on a small, senior team, reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering and working closely with our Lead Engineer and the business teams who use the platform every day. You will own meaningful \& complex enough slices of the system end to end, from data models and services to polished user interfaces and AI\-powered features, and ship them at a pace that only an AI\-first workflow makes possible. This role is for builders who love modern tools, feel a genuine thrill with each new leap in AI, move fast with discipline, and want their work to matter. You will see your features used by colleagues in days, not quarters, and you will help prove what a next\-generation enterprise platform built around AI can be. *This is a full\-time role reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering. We value camaraderie, team collaboration, and the benefits of in\-person connection, while offering flexibility. For this role, we prefer candidates to join us in a voluntary, flexible hybrid work style in our San Francisco Bay Area office. We may also consider candidates who are able to join us at one of our office hubs in New York, NY, or Portland, ME.* *For exceptional remote candidates, we strongly prefer those located in states where we are currently eligible to hire: CA, OR, NY, WA, ME, TX, CO, MI, FL, MA, MN, VA, DC, GA, UT, and IL. While we prioritize candidates in, or open to relocating to, these states, we may consider outstanding remote candidates from other US states. Hiring in a new state would involve evaluating the implications of establishing a new hiring presence there. 3Degrees does not provide relocation assistance or work authorization sponsorship for this position; pre\-existing right\-to\-work status in the U.S. is required.* **WHAT YOU’LL DO** As Senior Engineer, you will design, build, and ship major parts of our next\-generation internal platform, using AI throughout your own workflow and building AI into the product itself. Your responsibilities will include: Full\-Stack Platform Engineering * Design, build, and operate features end to end, including data models, APIs, services, integrations, and user interfaces * Own vertical slices of the platform, from a business user’s first request through production, and ship them on a fast, steady cadence * Build clean, intuitive interfaces for complex workflows, with strong product judgment even when a designer is not available, including one\-click exports that ease the move from spreadsheets * Integrate with partner systems, such as ERP/CRM systems, accounting, identity, and external data providers, through secure, well\-tested interfaces AI Product Engineering * Build AI features that read inbound documents and emails, extract structured data, and draft records and outbound communications for human review * Contribute to the platform’s intelligent assistant, including natural language and voice interactions, retrieval over the system of record, and connections to AI tools through open standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) * Implement evaluations, guardrails, and observability so AI features stay accurate, explainable, and safe, with a person always approving the final action Rules, Controls \& Data Quality * Encode complex busi r, proactive communicator who builds trust with engineers and business users alike, and enjoys learning a new domain * Genuine curiosity about AI: you keep up with new releases of tools like Claude, try them early, and get excited about what they make possible * A learning mindset: you seek out feedback, give it generously in code review, and love picking up new tools and techniques * Comfortable moving fast inside an established company, adapting as requirements evolve, while keeping standards for quality high * Curiosity about climate, energy, or environmental markets, and a desire for your work to support real climate impact Education * Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience **HOW WE DEFINE SUCCESS** This role is about taking meaningful parts of our next\-generation platform from idea to production at AI\-first speed, while meeting the standards for accuracy, control, and reliability that our business teams depend on. Within 30 days * Build a working understanding of the business workflows the platform supports, the current prototype, and the codebase * Establish strong partnerships with the Lead Engineer, the engineering team, and the business users you build for * Ship your first end\-to\-end feature or improvement to production Within 90 days * Own the design and delivery of one or more significant features that business users rely on. * Deliver at least one AI\-powered capability with clear evaluations, guardrails, and human approval built in * Demonstrate measurable impact, such as time saved, errors avoided, or adoption, through telemetry and user feedback * Contribute to the migration and parallel\-run plan for moving workflows from the legacy platform * Contribute at least one improvement to how the team builds or ships, such as a new agent, workflow, or tool Within 6 months * Help bring the platform into production for a first set of workflows, with results that match or exceed existing tools * Own a major area of the production platform, including its quality, monitoring, and ongoing improvement * Respond quickly to feedback from business users after launch, shipping fixes and improvements within days Within 1 year * Help expand the platform to additional workflows and teams as the legacy system is retired. * Consistently ship high\-quality improvements at a pace that sets the bar for modern, AI\-first engineering at 3Degrees * Be a go\-to engineer for a major area of the platform, trusted by both the engineering team and business users * Be an active voice in the broader product engineering community at 3Degrees, sharing ideas and techniques that elevate how we all work **Benefits** COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS * Compensation: The starting base salary for this position is $160,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 in the US. jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: A\&A Coatings is a thermal spray coatings company in South Plainfield, New Jersey. We are in process of building our own business platform: an AI\-assisted system that runs sales intake, quoting, the deal pipeline, production scheduling and analytics, used every day by our sales, operations, scheduling and purchasing teams. We are hiring an engineer to own it and keep building it. THE ROLE You will be the engineer responsible for the platform day to day: keeping it running, fixing what users report, and building the next modules together with the people who use them. You will work directly with the VP of Engineering and Quality, the President, the sales team, operations, scheduling and purchasing. This is a hands\-on role with a lot of ownership. A request raised in a morning meeting often becomes a shipped change within days. WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON * Sales intake: AI processing of the sales inbox (Gmail). Each email is classified, engineering data is extracted from RFQs and drawings (dimensions, tolerances, coating and specification requirements), repeat\-job and quote history is looked up in our ERP, and a reply is drafted for a person to review and send. * Quoting and pipeline: the quote workspace, the deal pipeline from first inquiry to won order, follow\-up reminders, customer records and sales rep assignment. * Operations: the production schedule that replaced our spreadsheet schedule, job routing, ship dates and purchasing. * Analytics: sales rep performance, lead quality (ad leads against organic leads, cost per lead) and business reporting alongside our Power BI reports. * Integrations: the JobBOSS2 (E2\) ERP API, Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Sheets), and our website forms and ad tracking. * Support and releases: run the issue tracker, triage and fix bugs, write release notes that non\-technical users can follow, train users, and join the daily scrum and production meetings. * What comes next: shipping with carrier integration (USPS, FedEx and others), powder inventory, a full purchasing module, a system for our sister company, and a sales prospecting tool. OUR STACK Python 3\.11 with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic and Pydantic. Next.js 14 with TypeScript. PostgreSQL on Cloud SQL. Google Cloud Run. Gemini on Vertex AI. Google sign\-in with role\-based access and audit logging. jobs.title: Product Manager – Mobile & IoT
jobs.description: **Join us on the Product Management team as a Product Manager – Mobile \& IoT**, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe. **Start your journey with Anova today!** **Role Summary:** This role’s center of gravity is the customer — their experience of the Anova solution and their ability to realize meaningful value from it. You’ll own the mobile experience of Anova Unify: the iOS and Android apps our customers and field teams rely on, and how they work with our devices and cloud platform. The Product Manager owns discovery and delivery for the Unify mobile platform. Reporting to the Platform Software Product Manager, you drive the full product lifecycle for your area — from structured customer research through to shipping, measuring adoption, and iterating. This is a hands\-on role: you will write specs, manage a backlog, partner daily with engineering, and get close to customers. You won’t be handed a roadmap to execute — you’ll help shape it. **Job Duties and Responsibilities:** * Own the mobile roadmap. Set the direction for the Unify mobile app across iOS and Android, including release planning, app store cadence, and how mobile features work with devices in the field. * Lead customer discovery. Run ongoing discovery programs — interviews, site visits, usage analysis, win/loss reviews — to understand what customers need, what they’ll pay for, and how IoT transforms their business. Use AI tools to accelerate research and synthesis. * Own the mobile backlog end\-to\-end. Write specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, prioritize based on real customer insight, and keep the backlog current and free of ambiguity. * Ship and measure. Define success metrics before each release, monitor adoption after launch, and iterate until customers can point to the value. * Deliver predictably. Keep your area shipping on cadence, with clear specs, edge cases handled, and engineering unblocked. * Partner with engineering and design daily. Be a reliable, responsive partner, make trade\-off calls with good judgment, and know when to escalate. * Reason across the full stack. Understand how Anova’s physical devices, connectivity layer, mobile app, and cloud platform interact — and make product decisions that account for hardware constraints, firmware cycles, and sensor data quality, not just software capabilities. * Enable go\-to\-market. Write clear release notes, internal briefings, and customer\-facing materials. Help sales and customer success understand what you’ve shipped and why it matters. * Support customers. Triage escalated product issues in your area and keep a feedback loop with support and customer success, so you surface patterns early and bring the voice of the customer into every decision. **What you’ll need to succeed:** **Minimum Requirements \-** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with mobile platform development, device connectivity, and software deployment. * 3\+ years of experience as a Product Manager shipping software in close partnership with engineering teams using Agile/DevOps, with direct ownership of product area strategy and adoption outcomes. * 6\+ years of total professional experience, spanning product management, software engineering, or related technical functions. * Hands\-on iOS and/or Android product experience: you have been the directly responsible PM for a mobile app in production, including roadmap, releases through the App Store and/or Google Play, and post\-launch adoption. * Hands\-on IoT or connected\-device experience: you have owned product decisions for software that works with physical devices, where firmware, connectivity (such as Bluetooth or cellular), device provisioning, over\-the\-air updates, or sensor data shaped what you built. * You have at least one example of taking a product, feature, or initiative from zero — no spec, no playbook — to something real and used. * Experience conducting customer discovery interviews and translating qualitative and quantitative insight into prioritized, well\-scoped backlog items. * Demonstrated use of AI and LLM tools in a PM context, and the ability to write clear, structured specs, one\-pagers, and narratives for cross\-functional audiences. * Comfort reasoning about technical trade\-offs — APIs, data models, integration patterns — credibly with engineers, plus data fluency: defining metrics and analyzing data in BI tools to make evidence\-based roadmap calls. * Ability to work standard business hours aligned to Eastern time zone to support internal and external stakeholders. * Willingness and ability to travel up to 25\-35% domestically, concentrated in certain months rather than every month. **Preferred Qualifications \-** * Prior experience in industrial or field\-operations environments, with an understanding of how things work in the physical world. * Experience shipping ML\- or AI\-assisted features in a software product. * Background in venture or private\-equity\-backed high\-growth industrial technology companies. **ABOUT ANOVA** We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable. We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well\-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we’ve got you covered. If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better. For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

jobs.title: Founding Product Designer
jobs.description: **About Arini** --------------- Arini is building the single platform to run all healthcare operations. Healthcare has spent the last decade consolidating under large enterprises, but operations are still fragmented, manual, and expensive. A large group runs dozens of disconnected systems for scheduling, billing, insurance, accounts payable, and reporting, with people moving data between them by phone, fax, and spreadsheet. Outpatient healthcare is a $650 billion market, and almost every dollar of it still runs on manual work. Consolidators bought thousands of clinics on the promise that scale would expand margins and lift their EBITDA multiple. Scale alone has not delivered it. Automation is now the only way to hit the numbers they promised investors, and Arini is how they get there. We partner with some of the largest healthcare enterprises in the country, covering thousands of clinics and billions of dollars in annual revenue. We ship the systems that run their operations end to end, and the best of that work becomes the platform that scales across enterprises. When operations run themselves, patients feel it: calls answered on the first ring, appointments booked in seconds, insurance sorted before they walk in, and clinicians who spend their day on care instead of paperwork. That is what we are building, for every clinic in the country. We are backed by Y Combinator (W24\) and on track to grow more than tenfold in 2026\. **The team** ------------ Everyone at Arini ships code, including operators, growth, and customer leads. Our founders, Rami and Abdul, have worked together for over a decade. Rami studied computer science at MIT, Abdul at Harvard. Everyone carries more than one job, and nobody has time for work that does not matter. If AI can do it, a person should not be doing it. We move extremely fast and take extreme ownership. **The role** ------------ You will design the products that run operations for the largest healthcare enterprises in the country. Our forward deployed engineers find the problems inside each customer, and our software engineers build the systems that solve them. You make sure the people who depend on those systems love using them. That is three groups of people: front desk staff who work alongside our agents every day, operators at headquarters who run hundreds to thousands of locations, and our own FDEs who stand up a new enterprise in weeks. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Shadow operators at every level, from the front desk of a clinic to regional managers to C\-suite executives. Combine what you learn with requirements from engineering and data on how our products are actually used, and design something that holds up to all three. * Design the products operators at multi\-billion dollar healthcare enterprises use every day, working directly with the FDEs who build them: business intelligence and reporting across thousands of clinic locations, agents that automate accounting, procurement, insurance verification, and more. * Decide how our agents show their work. What a person sees after an agent books an appointment, flags an invoice for review, or hands off a call it could not handle. * Prototype in code. Use Figma when it helps, but expect to build in Cursor or Claude Code and ship small changes yourself. * Build the design system our engineers and growth team use, so they ship good interfaces without waiting on you. **First 90 days** ----------------- * Day 30: shadow operators alongside an FDE, then redesign one interface operators use daily and ship it. * Day 60: own one product surface end to end, such as call review or agent setup, from research through what ships. * Day 90: have a design system our engineering and growth teams build with on their own. **Who you are** --------------- * You have shipped B2B products where you were not the user, and you worked closely with the people who were. * You care about craft. Your type, spacing, and interaction details hold up when someone looks closely. * You prototype in code and build with AI every day. If a model can do it, you do not do it by hand. * You have a view on how AI should show its reasoning in an interface, and when it should not. * You question the workflow before the screen. When an interface feels crowded, you ask whether the work should happen there at all, and you change the workflow instead of polishing the UI. * You are opinionated, you back it up with what you saw in the field, and you say it directly. You hold your ground with engineers, founders, and customers, and change your mind when the evidence says to. **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive salary with meaningful equity * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Lunch and dinner in the office * Unlimited PTO

jobs.title: AI Researcher - New Grad (PhD)
jobs.description: **Who we are** Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress. Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We're changing that. Atoms builds Physical AI real\-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive. This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don't just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale. We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life. If you want to work on hard problems with real\-world impact, join us. **About the Role** We are seeking a full\-time AI Researcher \- New Grad (PhD) to join our founding team and bridge the gap between high\-level AI research and real\-world physical actuation for our next\-generation autonomous transport platforms. In this role, you will lead and drive core research initiatives across Perception, World Models, and Action models. You will translate cutting\-edge theoretical breakthroughs into scalable, real\-world deployment on physical autonomous systems, shaping how our platforms perceive, simulate, and navigate complex environments. **What you'll do** * Lead and integrate emerging research from the broader AI community, identifying, prototyping, and deploying the most promising solutions. * Design, train, and deploy end\-to\-end multimodal models that translate real\-time visual perception and high\-level behavioral goals into physical vehicle actuation. * Research, architect, and develop cutting\-edge reinforcement learning and distillation techniques for trajectory planning. * Develop interactive world models from raw multi\-sensor logs, allowing the team to re\-simulate events and query what a vehicle would see if it altered its trajectory. * Ensure core autonomous driving models can seamlessly adapt to novel urban environments and rare edge cases. * Partner with validation, systems, and engineering teams to benchmark models through rigorous simulated and on\-vehicle scenarios, detecting regressions and resolving systemic performance bottlenecks. **What we're looking for** * **Education:** PhD degree in Computer Science, EECS, Robotics, AI, or a closely related field (completed or anticipated completion within the current academic year). * **Research Track Record:** Demonstrated publication record (including first\-author papers or accepted work) in top\-tier AI or robotics conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, RSS, ICRA, CoRL). * **Core Expertise:** Deep doctoral research focus in at least one of the following domains: * Generative World Models, Video Generation, or Diffusion Models * Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) models or embodied AI * Reinforcement Learning (RL), trajectory optimization, or decision\-making systems * Large\-scale multimodal Transformer architectures applied to robotics or spatio\-temporal data * **Framework Fluency:** Advanced hands\-on proficiency with PyTorch or JAX for training, distributed scaling, and fine\-tuning large foundation models. * **Programming:** Strong production\-level proficiency in Python and working knowledge of C\+\+ for performant system integration. **Preferred qualifications** * Prior research or industry internship experience in autonomous driving, mobile robotics, or spatial AI. * Hands\-on experience with multi\-modal sensor fusion across camera rigs, LiDAR, and Radar. * Familiarity with Bird's\-Eye\-View (BEV) representations, 3D occupancy forecasting, multi\-task learning, or specialized spatial tokenization strategies. * Practical experience with large\-scale distributed training on GPU/TPU clusters using frameworks such as DeepSpeed, Megatron\-LM, Ray, or PyTorch FSDP. **Why join us** At Atoms, you'll work on one of the defining challenges of our time bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what's known and building what doesn't yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it's grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow. **What else you need to know** This role is based in our Mountain View or San Francisco office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change, we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That's why all of our office\-based teams work onsite, five days a week. The base salary range for this role is **$190,000 per year.** Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards and an annual performance\-based bonus. **Benefits Summary (USA Full\-Time Exempt Employees):** * Medical, dental, and vision insurance (multiple plans, incl. HSA options). * Company\-paid life and disability insurance (short\- and long\-term). * Voluntary insurance: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity. * Optional supplemental life insurance for self, spouse, and children. * Pet insurance discount. * 401(k). * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter) * Time Off policies: * + Discretionary vacation days + 8 paid holidays per year + Paid sick time + Paid Bereavement leave + Paid Parental Leave Benefits are subject to change at the company's discretion. Atoms accepts applications on an ongoing basis. **Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?** *\#LI\-Onsite*

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Simulation
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day\-to\-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top\-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com. **Software Engineer, Simulation** --------------------------------- You will own and extend our simulation: the simulator itself, how it connects to the autonomy stack, the models of the tractor and of the aircraft, people, and vehicles around it, and the scenarios we run. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build and extend the simulator and its integration with the production autonomy stack. * Model vehicle dynamics, actor behavior, and sensors so that the stack behaves in simulation as it does on the road. * Find where simulated and real inputs differ enough to change the stack's behavior, and close those gaps. * Bring field data into simulation: replay real\-world recordings through the stack, and rebuild field events as scenarios. * Grow scenario generation and the authoring tools, across backend and frontend, and extend coverage to new maps and sites. * Run simulation at scale in the cloud: orchestration, parallel execution, artifacts, and cost. * Build the evaluation that turns a run into a pass/fail result, and the triage tools that autonomy engineers use on their own. * Keep the simulation deterministic, reproducible, and fast as the number of scenarios grows. **What you'll need** -------------------- * 3\+ years of experience in simulation work for autonomous vehicles, robotics, or aerospace * Strong Python, with a track record of maintainable code in a shared codebase * Experience with a simulator such as CARLA, Applied Intuition, Foretellix, NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or an in\-house platform * Understanding of simulation and modeling methodology: vehicle and actor models, fidelity, and how simulated results support claims about real\-world behavior * Docker, Linux, and distributed\-systems fundamentals, with experience running GPU\-based simulation * Experience running simulation at scale in the cloud and in CI * Experience debugging and profiling distributed, GPU\-bound systems, and finding bottlenecks and failure modes in simulation output and telemetry * Git and code review experience * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience **Nice to have** ---------------- * 6\+ years building simulation for autonomous vehicles, robotics, or aerospace * Experience with ROS 2 or other autonomous vehicle software stacks * Vehicle dynamics or actor behavior modeling * Sensor modeling (camera, lidar, radar), environment generation, or perception ground\-truth pipelines * Unreal Engine or other game engines * Log replay and reconstruction of scenarios from real\-world recordings * Large\-scale cloud simulation infrastructure * Determinism and reproducibility work in simulators, including golden\-output comparison * Safety\-critical systems in autonomous driving, aerospace, or robotics * Safety standards: ISO 26262, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), UL 4600, ISO 13849 **Leveling** ------------ We hire remotely from Europe and North America at two levels and set the level from the interviews, based on demonstrated depth rather than years. Mid level (typically 3\-6 years): you own defined parts of the simulation end to end, ship them tested and documented, and make routine design decisions on your own. Senior level (typically 6\+ years): you own the roadmap for an area, such as scenario expansion or cloud execution. You find problems in how we build and use the simulation, not only in the code, and you mentor other engineers. Compensation Range: $110K \- $170K

landing pages, or similar digital experiences, including integrations with backend services and third\-party systems. * **Proven technical leadership and execution skills**, with a track record of leading complex engineering initiatives, making sound architectural decisions, navigating technical tradeoffs, and delivering high\-quality solutions end to end. * **Strong product judgment, ownership, and people leadership**, with the ability to mentor and develop engineers, work effectively with Product, Design, and Marketing, navigate ambiguity, and translate business goals into measurable engineering outcomes. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience building or owning growth\-oriented web platforms, including corporate websites, headless CMS, landing page platforms, marketing websites, or self\-service product experiences. * Experience with growth s , and end\-to\-end system design, and you stay close enough to implementation to guide critical technical decisions. * **You care about the intersection of engineering, user experience, and growth.** You understand that fast, reliable, intuitive web experiences directly influence acquisition, engagement, and conversion. * **You're pragmatic and outcome\-oriented.** You balance engineering quality, delivery speed, and business impact, prioritizing solutions that deliver meaningful customer and business jobs.description: **Laboratory Instrument Integration Engineer \- Legacy Equipment \& Data Acquisition****Location:** Remote \- United States (Eastern Time Zone preferred)**Employment Type:** Project\-Based Consulting / Contract**Compensation:** $75\-$100/hour W2, with flexibility for exceptionally qualified candidates**Travel:** Potential travel to U.S. client sites, as needed**Start:** ASAP **Position Overview:** Alphanumeric is seeking an experienced, hands\-on **Laboratory Instrument Integration Engineer** to support a pharmaceutical manufacturing client with the assessment, design, and implementation of automated data collection and preservation solutions for standalone laboratory and manufacturing instruments. Many of these instruments operate independently, lack conventional operating systems or network connectivity, and rely on legacy communication interfaces such as RS\-232, USB, or Ethernet. Some have limited internal storage and may overwrite historical data or stop operating when storage capacity is reached. The objective is to develop a practical, scalable solution that automatically or semi\-automatically extracts instrument\-generated data and transfers it to centralized network storage for preservation through the client's existing enterprise backup infrastructure. The ideal consultant has personally designed and implemented instrument connectivity and automated data acquisition solutions using communication gateways, scripting, middleware, or specialized integration technologies. **This is a hands\-on instrumentation integration and solution architecture role, not a traditional IT infrastructure, cloud engineering, or computer system validation position.** **Responsibilities****Instrument Assessment \& Technical Feasibility:*** Assess standalone laboratory and manufacturing instruments to determine communication capabilities, available interfaces, data formats, and storage limitations. * Evaluate legacy equipment utilizing RS\-232, USB, Ethernet, or proprietary communication protocols. * Identify technical limitations involving instruments without conventional operating systems, network connectivity, or automated export capabilities. * Determine appropriate hardware, software, drivers, communication gateways, or middleware required to enable reliable data extraction. * Evaluate vendor\-specific integration requirements and recommend practical alternatives where automated extraction is not technically feasible. **Automated Data Collection \& Integration:*** Design and implement automated or semi\-automated methods to retrieve data from standalone laboratory and manufacturing instruments. * Configure serial\-to\-Ethernet converters, communication gateways, data acquisition software, or other instrument integration technologies. * Develop or configure scripts, utilities, middleware, or software agents to automate data capture and transfer. * Establish reliable transfer of instrument\-generated data to centralized network shares or repositories. * Design solutions that minimize routine manual intervention, including the need to connect laptops, transfer USB drives, or manually clear instrument storage. * Address instruments with limited storage capacity, including FIFO or overwrite behavior. * Implement appropriate logging, monitoring, error handling, and notifications for unsuccessful data collection or transfer. * Evaluate scalable approaches capable of supporting multiple instruments without requiring a dedicated computer for every device. **Data Preservation \& System Integration:*** Preserve original instrument\-generated data, including available timestamps and associated metadata. * Collaborate with client IT teams to ensure collected data can be securely transferred to centralized storage and protected through existing enterprise backup processes. * Support appropriate access controls, data retention, traceability, and operational monitoring. * Recommend solutions that accommodate different instrument manufacturers, generations, and communication methods. * Minimize instrument\-specific customization and ongoing administrative requirements wherever technically feasible. **Solution Architecture \& Proof of Concept:*** Evaluate technical feasibility across a diverse population of laboratory and manufacturing instruments. * Design a scalable integration architecture that addresses current requirements and supports potential expansion across additional sites. * Develop and demonstrate a working proof of concept for automated instrument data extraction and transfer. * Identify technical risks, integration limitations, and potential alternatives. * Prepare solution recommendations, technical documentation, implementation plans, and estimated project costs. * Collaborate with laboratory operations, engineering, IT, Quality, and other stakeholders throughout assessment, design, and implementation. **Required Qualifications:*** Demonstrated hands\-on experience integrating laboratory, analytical, manufacturing, o t reduce manual data collection and support reliable transfer to centralized storage. * Ability to assess technical feasibility, recommend appropriate integration architectures, and identify equipment limitations. * Experience developing technical documentation, proof\-of\-concept solutions, or implementation recommendations. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently with technical and business stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, laboratory, or other regulated manufacturing environments. * Familiarity with analytical instruments such as balances, pH meters, titrators, Karl Fischer instruments, TOC analyzers, dissolution testers, HPLC systems, or chromatography equipment. * Experience with **Python, LabVIEW, PowerShell**, or comparable automation and data acquisition tools. * Experience configuring serial\-to\-Ethernet gateways or industrial communication devices such as Moxa, Digi, or Lantronix. * Familiarity with scientific instrument communication protocols, vendor\-specific software, or instrument data export utilities. * Experience with laboratory platforms such as Waters Empower, LabWare LIMS, or other laboratory data management systems. * Understanding of GxP, ALCOA\+ data integrity principles, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, or computerized system validation. * Experience with network shares, centralized repositories, enterprise backup environments, and secure file transfer. * Experience supporting multisite instrumentation or laboratory automation projects. * Experience estimating technical effort, preparing project budgets, and developing implementation plans. **Project Objectives \& Expected Outcomes:** The client is seeking a scalable and supportable approach to preserving electronic data generated by standalone laboratory and manufacturing instruments while significantly reducing manual collection and backup activities. **Potential initial deliverables include:*** Assessment of instrument connectivity and technical feasibility. * Recommended data acquisition and integration architecture. * Identification of hardware, software, gateways, or middleware required. * Working proof of concept demonstrating automated data extraction and transfer. * Monitoring, exception handling, and data preservation recommendations. * Technical documentation, implementation strategy, and estimated costs for broader deployment. Final deliverables and implementation scope will be established during project planning. The project is expected to initially involve a limited number of U.S. sites, with potential expansion based on technical feasibility and project requirements. **Important Candidate Considerations:** We are particularly interested in candidates who have **personally configured instrument communication interfaces, developed automated data acquisition solutions, or implemented systems that extract and preserve data from standalone equipment**. Candidates should be prepared to discuss specific examples of instruments they have integrated, communication methods used, technical challenges encountered, and solutions they personally designed or implemented. Experience limited to general IT infrastructure administration, cloud data engineering, laboratory testing, or validation documentation without direct instrument integration experience will not meet the primary technical requirements. Professionals from laboratory automation, scientific instrumentation, industrial automation, test engineering, and manufacturing systems integration backgrounds are encouraged to apply. **Additional Information:** Alphanumeric is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. **Please Note:** We are unable to accept applications from third\-party agencies for this position. Candidates must be eligible to work directly on Alphanumeric's W2 without requiring sponsorship now or in the future.

Our team works at the intersection of large\-scale distributed systems, machine learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic AI to solve some of the most complex challenges in Amazon's product catalog. You will have the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge technologies, influence technical architecture, and deliver solutions that directly impact customers and sellers worldwide. If you enjoy solving complex engineering problems, building innovative AI\-powered solutions, and operating systems at Amazon scale, this is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact. jobs.title: Mission Software Engineer
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. **About the Team** ------------------ The Imaging team builds and fields state\-of\-the\-art camera and sensor systems deployed to solve real security challenges for the United States and its allies. We work across the full stack, from bare\-metal hardware and firmware to networked services and cloud integrations, and we own our systems all the way through to the field. When something breaks in a deployed environment, we fix it. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Mission Software Engineer to join the Imaging Interfaces team. This is not a pure product development role. You will spend meaningful time keeping fielded systems alive, triaging issues across the full stack, and serving as a technical representative for our products in integrations with external teams and customers. The work is varied and sometimes ambiguous. You might spend a morning extending a gRPC service, an afternoon diagnosing a time sync issue on a deployed device over the phone with a field operator, and a week traveling to support a customer integration. You'll need to be comfortable with that range\-and ideally energized by it. If you want to own your software end\-to\-end in a fast\-moving environment where the stakes are real, this role is built for you. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Own fielded system success.** You are responsible for the health and uptime of deployed imaging systems. When issues arise\-whether the root cause is in your code, the firmware, the network, or the hardware\-you triage, diagnose, and drive resolution. **Build and maintain production services.** You'll develop and extend modular software services that run on edge\-compute devices in austere environments. These services need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable by engineers who didn't write them. **Support field operations.** You'll work directly with field operators and non\-technical users to diagnose and resolve issues on deployed hardware. Clear communication under pressure is part of the job. **Represent the team externally.** You'll serve as a subject matter expert in integrations with other products and teams; sometimes remotely, sometimes on\-site. You don't need to know everything, but you need to be able to speak credibly across the full system stack and know what you don't know. **Maintain end\-to\-end system understanding.** Our devices sit at the intersection of hardware, firmware, networking, and software. You'll develop broad fluency across that stack over time, and apply it to optimize how our services interact and degrade gracefully when components fail. **Collaborate across teams.** You'll plan, build, and test complex functionality alongside firmware, hardware, and platform engineers. You'll need to be effective working across team and organizational boundaries. Travel expected approximately 25% of the time for field testing and customer integrations. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required** ------------ * **3\+ years of software development with meaningful production ownership:** not just shipping features, but owning systems after they ship (their health, uptime, and behavior once they are in users' hands). * **Deep proficiency in at least one of C\+\+, TypeScript(node.js/React), or Python, and the ability to work effectively across the stack boundary in a second language** (reading, debugging, and modifying code outside your primary). Our work spans a large TypeScript/React operator\-facing UI and a growing body of C\+\+ services running on edge hardware, and C\+\+ depth is increasingly central as we expand across our imaging product lines. * **Comfort ramping quickly into unfamiliar languages, tools, and deployment systems.** Our language and tooling mix varies by product and shifts over time; we value engineers who get productive in a new stack rather than staying in one lane. * **3\+ years working in Linux\-based environments,** including hands\-on work with bare\-metal hardware. * **Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve issues across system boundaries** (networking, services, hardware interaction) without always having full visibility into every component. * **Strong written and verbal communication skills,** including the ability to explain techn hey find, share what they learn, and keep the people who need to know informed. They're comfortable with ambiguity at the stack boundary. When a device behaves unexpectedly in the field, the root cause could be anywhere. They have a methodology for narrowing it down systematically rather than guessing or waiting for someone else to have the answer. They represent the team well externally. In customer integrations and partner engagements, they're the face of what we've built. They take that seriously. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (VCA Inc. dba Antech Diagnostics, Fountain Valley, CA)
jobs.description: We understand that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today, and that’s why we’re inspired to make A Better World for Pets. Antech is comprised of a diverse team of individuals who are committed to each other’s growth and development. Our culture is centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom. Today Antech is driving the future of pet health as part of Mars Science \& Diagnostics , a family\-owned company focused on veterinary care. Current Associates will need to apply through the internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on Menu or View All Apps, select the Jobs Hub app, then click the magnifying glass to Browse Jobs. WANTED—Software Engineer (VCA Inc. dba Antech Diagnostics, Fountain Valley, CA)–Architect, develop, deploy, and fine\-tune sophisticated software applications for diagnostic testing solutions, including the automation of blood serum sampling robots and high\-precision CCD (Charge Coupled Device)\-based readers, as well as analysis of the resulting data to provide final test results. Utilize Unified Modeling Language (UML) to model and document software systems, providing a set of graphical notation techniques to create visual models of object\-oriented software systems. Troubleshoot hardware and software systems in production to ensure that software outputs meet end\-user needs and reliably produce accurate and consistent results under varied conditions. Test diagnostic systems to verify that software correctly processes input data and accurately outputs test results. This includes unit testing individual components or code segments for correctness, integration testing to ensure multiple components work together properly, and system testing to verify that the entire system meets requirements and functions as expected. Perform complex data analysis and testing to validate and ensure the accuracy and reliability of diagnostic testing. Examine data generated by diagnostic tests to identify patterns, anomalies, and insights using statistical methods, machine learning algorithms, and other advanced data analysis techniques to ensure accurate diagnostic results. Calibrate software and hardware elements to maintain precision and accuracy over time. Utilize Python to efficiently manipulate and analyze data, support data\-driven decision\-making, and perform data manipulation tasks such as handling missing values and merging data sources. Use SQL Alchemy to connect to databases and execute complex queries. Manage and optimize relational databases, including SQL and MySQL, for effective data storage and retrieval, and regularly monitor and assess database performance. Maintain comprehensive comments within source code to explain the purpose, logic, and functionality of code segments, facilitating maintenance and future updates. Perform design, implementation, testing, and maintenance of application software and graphical user interfaces (GUIs) with a focus on high performance and user experience, including advanced GUI development using Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF). Develop intricate code to interface seamlessly with various hardware components. Implement specialized techniques to detect, manage, and recover from errors during program execution, handle errors gracefully, provide meaningful user feedback, maintain system stability, log errors for debugging, and implement fallback mechanisms for critical failures. Maintain accurate documentation reflecting engineering changes, features, bug fixes, and system modifications to keep stakeholders informed. Provide expert\-level support and ongoing maintenance for critical software components, including websites, databases, reporting scripts, and middleware applications. Reqs Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field, or its foreign educational equivalent, and 12 months of experience as a Software Engineer. Prior experience must include 1 year of a) database development and design using MySQL, b) experience with Django, Nginx, and Apache, c) Object\-Oriented Programming experience, d) coding with JavaScript, Node.js, and ReactJS, e) Java, Apex, LWC, and SOQL, f) performing API testing with Postman. **Salary:** $130,000 per year. Full\-time, 40 hours per week. Worksite: 17620 Mt. Herrmann St., Fountain Valley, CA 92708\. About Antech Antech is a leader in veterinary diagnostics, driven by our passion for innovation that delivers better animal health outcomes. Our products and services span 90\+ reference laboratories around the globe; in\-house diagnostic laboratory instruments and consumables, including rapid assay diagnostic products and digital cytology services; local and cloud\-based data services; practice information management software and related software and support; veterinary imaging and technology; veterinary professional education and training; and board\-certified specialist support services. jobs.title: Developer Relations, Platform
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As a member of Platform Developer Relations at Anthropic, you'll shape how developers discover, onboard, build, and scale applications and agents on the Claude Platform. You'll build with our APIs, teach developers how to get the most out of them, and bring what you learn back to the teams building our products. This role sits within our platform engineering organization. You'll work across content, community, and product influence, and partner closely with product managers, engineers, communications, and marketing. Your audience ranges from independent developers working on side projects to platform teams at large enterprises. The relationships you build between developers and our internal teams will help us advance our mission of creating reliable, interpretable AI that follows human intent. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Create high\-quality technical content, including demos, sample apps, tutorials, videos, and integration guides, that shows developers how to build effectively on the Claude Platform * Tailor content to individual developers and enterprise builders, choosing formats and channels that work for each * Contribute directly to the developer experience of the Claude Platform, including our docs, code samples, cookbooks, and open source skills like the Claude API skill * Make our docs, SDKs, and samples work well for both developers and the coding agents they build with, and keep them accurate as our APIs change * Partner with product and engineering on launches from early feedback through release day, with docs, samples, and migration guidance ready when we ship * Translate developer feedback into clear recommendations, and get involved early enough to influence API and product decisions * Find pain points in our APIs, SDKs, docs, and agent tooling, and work with engineering to get them fixed, including shipping directly yourself when it makes sense * Be a voice developers trust, and engage directly and thoughtfully with their questions and criticism * Build and grow developer communities online and in person through events, workshops, and the places developers already gather * Partner with communications, marketing, and GTM teams on launches, campaigns, and events, and advocate for messaging that is useful and credible to developers * Collaborate with research to translate new AI capabilities into accessible educational resources * Prioritize your work based on data, developer feedback, and business needs, and measure its impact **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * You have significant experience in developer relations, developer experience, or developer\-facing product or engineering roles, with a track record of measurably improving how developers adopt or use a platform * You have hands\-on technical abilities: you've recently built with LLM APIs, can write and explain your own demos, and know what makes a code sample reliable and easy to adapt * You have informed opinions about AI platforms and developer tooling, including what works well and what needs to improve * You've created technical content that developers use, and you can explain complex ideas to audiences ranging from individual developers to enterprise technical leaders * You've used developer feedback to influence product or engineering decisions, including ones that were difficult to advocate for * You collaborate well across engineering, product, communications, and marketing, can disagree constructively, and take ownership of communicating a decision once it's made * You're passionate about AI's potential and committed to developing it responsibly, with a genuine interest in AI safety **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience building agents, including work with tool use, MCP, evals, or managed agent runtimes * Experience growing a developer community and building trust with skeptical audiences * Experience supporting both individual developers and enterprise platform teams * Experience using Claude or other AI tools in your own developer relations or engineering work * A scrappy, autonomous working style as a low\-ego, kind, and direct collaborator with a bias toward shipping * Public speaking experience at industry conferences and events The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $365,000 \- $435,000 USD **Logistics** -------------   degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description: Summary Join us in shaping the future of Generative AI at Apple! Are you passionate about making AI systems safer, more inclusive, and globally representative? In this role, you will build the Python platform our ML and safety engineers rely on to train, evaluate, deploy, and configure safety classifiers, guardrail models, and model behavior overrides. You will turn manual, one\-off workflows into automated, scalable, and reproducible systems, so that every evaluation runs the same way, every deployment is validated, and every configuration change is safe to ship Description Our team leads Responsible AI initiatives for global generative AI products, operating at the intersection of policy, product, and GenAI. We build the safety guardrails, and policy enforcement layers that protect users from unintended model behavior. This role builds the platform underneath that work. You will build the systems that enable consistent training and evaluation at scale: an training/evaluation platform that runs any benchmark the same way every time, deployment pipelines that package and release models and mitigation assets to devices and the cloud, and tooling that lets engineers across many languages and modalities author and validate configuration changes with confidence. You will also dig into the failures and regressions the platform surfaces, and turn them into concrete fixes. This role leads a team of highly capable software engineers and engineering managers who build scalable, secure, microservice\-based solutions for the enterprise ecosystem. You will set technical direction, define architecture, turn business problems into technical solutions, and lead the strategy for bringing GenAI and agentic capabilities into engineering groups to raise productivity. You are expected to stay hands\-on and credible across the technology stack. **Core Responsibilities** ========================= * **Solution architecture.** Define and own target\-state architectures for microservice\-based solutions, including service decomposition, API\-first and event\-driven boundaries, and documented architecture decisions. * **Enterprise integration.** Design solutions that work within the enterprise ecosystem, including identity and access management, networking and security standards, without one\-off exceptions. * **Cloud\-native runtime.** Set the standard for Kubernetes and containerized workloads, covering Docker packaging, orchestration, scaling and lifecycle management. * **Cloud deployment.** Architect AWS and/or Azure deployments for network security, scalability and resilience, and own how solutions are deployed and operated in production. * **Pipeline ownership.** Own CI/CD and DevOps from the application side for heavy workloads: automated testing, code\-quality gates, container scanning, progressive delivery and infrastructure as code. * **GenAI strategy.** Lead the strategy for evaluating, piloting and adopting AI tools and agentic solutions, and integrate them with existing engineering systems so adoption is seamless. * **GenAI architecture.** Define patterns for AI\-enabled solutions: AI coding tools, MCP servers and connectors, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector indexing, model selection and AI gateway architecture. * **Engineering productivity.** Lead GenAI enablement across software engineering groups. Set measurable productivity goals, track adoption and show the impact on delivery. * **Technical delivery.** Hold teams to the architecture and the committed dates. Keep technical priorities aligned with business outcomes. * **Hands\-on leadership.** Stay credible across JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, React, Node.js and REST APIs. Manage engineers and engineering managers, and build a culture of ownership, quality and continuous improvement. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field. Master's preferred. * 7\+ years of experience in software engineering, building robust and scalable applications. * 3\+ years leading teams of software engineers and/or engineering managers. * Hands\-on programming in JavaScript and Python, with strong experience in TypeScript, React, Node.js and REST APIs. * Proven experience designing and building microservices and scalable web\-based solutions. * Deep  ls, MCP servers, connectors, RAG pipelines, vector indexing, LLM model architectures and AI gateway architectures. * Demonstrated success bringing GenAI capabilities to software engineering groups, with measurable productivity gains. * Track record of evaluating AI tools and agentic solutions and integrating them into existing enterprise systems. * Proven ability to work with cross\-functional stakeholders to understand business problems and turn them into technical architecture and solutions. * Accountability for delivering software to committed dates across multiple teams. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * 5\+ years leading engineering organizations with managers reporting in. * Experience building or operating an internal developer platform or AI gateway used across multiple business units. * Experience establishing AI governance, including acceptable use, evaluation standards and model risk, in an IP\-sensitive enterprise. * Background in developer enablement at scale, including champion networks, technical communities, hackathons and measured adoption of engineering tools. * Experience defining evaluation frameworks for LLM\-based solutions, such as golden datasets, groundedness metrics and prompt\-injection defenses. * Familiarity with engineering metrics such as DORA, and with using them to improve delivery performance. * Semiconductor or manufacturing industry experience. **Competencies** ================ **Architectural judgment.** Knows which decisions are expensive to reverse and which are not, and spends rigor accordingly. **Business translation.** Hears a business problem in the stakeholder's own language and returns a design that solves it, without mistaking the stated request for the underlying need. **Delivery ownership.** Treats the date and the quality bar as their own responsibility, not something to hand off. **Technical credibility.** Earns the respect of senior engineers by being able to do the work, not only direct it. **AI championship.** Drives adoption of AI tools with clear, measurable outcomes, and declines AI where a simpler or deterministic method works better. **People leadership.** Builds high\-performing teams, develops leaders and holds a high bar for talent. **Influence without authority.** Moves stakeholders who do not report to this role toward shared goals, and keeps them aligned when competing priorities pull the other way. **Additional Information** **Time Type:** Full time **Employee Type:** Assignee / Regular **Travel:** Yes, 10% of the Time
