jobs.title: Virtualization & Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** Arctiq is a global, intelligence\-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking \& Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data \& AI, Autonomous Operations \& Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management. We help organizations operate, secure, and modernize complex environments by unifying infrastructure, networking, data, security, automation, and observability under a single, integrated operating model. Our work focuses on helping customers reduce operational friction, improve resilience, and make better, faster decisions as their environments evolve. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer\-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries. **This is a contract\-to\-hire opportunity for one of Arctiq’s clients in Marcus Hook, PA. This is an onsite position for the first \~3 months and will become a hybrid arrangement after that requiring onsite presence 3 days/week.** **Position Overview:** We are seeking a well\-rounded Senior Virtualization \& Systems Engineer who is equally comfortable building new infrastructure from scratch and keeping existing systems running at peak performance. This role blends hands\-on engineering standing up VMware clusters, deploying Active Directory environments, and commissioning physical servers with ongoing administration, troubleshooting, and operational ownership of our core systems. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise across virtualization and Microsoft platforms, takes pride in both the build and the day\-to\-day, and has the experience to work independently across the full infrastructure lifecycle. **Responsibilities:** * Build and configure VMware vSphere clusters from scratch — including ESXi host deployment, vCenter installation, vSAN setup, distributed virtual switches, and HA/DRS policies. * Plan, rack, cable, and commission physical Windows Server hardware including BIOS/firmware configuration, RAID setup, NIC teaming, and bare\-metal OS installation. * Administer and maintain the VMware environment on an ongoing basis, including VM lifecycle management, host patching, snapshot management, and capacity monitoring. * Perform day\-to\-day Active Directory administration including user and group management, delegation of control, trust relationships, and replication health monitoring. * Implement Group Policy frameworks for security baselines, software deployment, user environment management, and compliance enforcement — and manage ongoing GPO changes and troubleshooting. * Administer DNS, DHCP, and PKI/certificate services in support of Active Directory and the broader enterprise environment. * Manage and support Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint, with a focus on hybrid identity and integration with on\-premises Active Directory. * Implement and maintain VMware disaster recovery solutions including vSphere Replication, Site Recovery Manager, and Veeam\-based backup strategies; test and validate recovery procedures regularly. * Monitor infrastructure health across physical servers, virtual hosts, and storage — proactively identifying and resolving performance issues before they impact operations. * Develop PowerShell scripts and automation to streamline builds, administrative workflows, and recurring operational tasks. * Produce and maintain engineering documentation including infrastructure diagrams, build runbooks, GPO specs, and DR playbooks. * Provide Tier 3 escalation support and serve as the subject matter expert across VMware, Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365\. **Requirements:** * 5\-7\+ years of hands\-on experience in systems or infrastructure engineering, with a track record spanning both building new environments and administering them long\-term. * Proven experience standing up VMware vSphere clusters from bare metal — ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, distributed switches, and HA/DRS — as well as ongoing vSphere administration. * Strong day\-to\-day Active Directory administration skills. * Strong Group Policy experience spanning both initial design and framework build\-out as well as ongoing GPO management and troubleshooting. * Hands\-on experience with physical Windows Server hardware: racking, BIOS/iDRAC/iLO configuration, RAID provisioning, NIC teaming, and bare\-metal OS deployment. * Deep proficiency with Windows Server (2016/2019/2022\) including AD DS, DNS, DHCP, PKI, DFS, and print services. * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration including Exchange Online, licensing, tenant configuration, and hybrid connectivity via Azure AD Connect. * Strong PowerShell scripting skills for both infrastructure automation and routine administrative tasks. * Solid understanding of networking fundamentals — VLANs, routing, DNS, and firewall rules — as they apply to VMware and Windows environments. * Experience with enterprise backup and DR platforms such as Veeam, Zerto, or VMware Site Recovery Manager. * Ability to produce clear technical documentation including build guides, diagrams, and operational runbooks. * Microsoft Intune experience is a plus. Familiarity with Intune for endpoint enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and co\-management alongside on\-prem Group Policy is highly desirable. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent professional experience Arctiq is an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond, please let us know. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply. *We thank you for your interest in joining the Arctiq team! While we welcome all applicants, only those who are selected for an interview will be contacted.*

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Job Description** ﻿Argentys is seeking an experienced Full\-Stack Developer to design, develop, integrate, test, modernize, and support secure, data\-intensive enterprise applications, supporting the projects at the FDA. The successful candidate will work across both modern and legacy technology stacks, including Python, C/C\+\+, shell scripting, REST APIs, and SQL/MariaDB. The role requires the ability to create new applications and services while maintaining, troubleshooting, integrating, and incrementally modernizing existing legacy code and systems. The position will work closely with solution architects, front\-end developers, DevOps engineers, AI/ML engineers, QA personnel, and business stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop interfaces and backend services supporting AI/ML, large language model (LLM), and AI agent capabilities, including human\-in\-the\-loop review and approval workflows. * Integrate AI/LLM and agent\-based services through APIs and approved application interfaces, including tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, structured outputs, and application guardrails. * Integrate legacy C/C\+\+, Python, shell, JavaScript, database, and modern web components through well\-defined APIs and interfaces. * Develop server\-side APIs, application services, and business logic. Design and implement RESTful APIs supporting front\-end and system integrations. * Implement server\-side validation, error handling, logging, and application security controls. * Implement authentication, authorization, and role\-based access control (RBAC), including support for enterprise SSO/MFA. * Develop and maintain application functionality using SQL and MariaDB/MySQL. * Design and work with relational database tables, relationships, queries, views, indexes, and data structures. * Integrate applications with enterprise document\-management and other internal services, including Microsoft 365 and/or SharePoint where applicable. * Implement application logging, exception handling, auditing, and operational diagnostics. * Collaborate with DevOps engineers on CI/CD, build, deployment, configuration, and release processes. * Refactor and modernize legacy code incrementally while preserving required behavior, compatibility, security, and operational continuity. * Develop and maintain shell scripts for Linux\-based automation, application support, data processing, deployment, and operational tasks. * Develop backend services, automation, data\-processing utilities, and integration components using Python. * Use Visual Studio Code (VS Code) for application development, debugging, Git workflows, and related engineering activities. * Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning and daily stand\-ups. * Support iterative software releases and respond to feedback identified during testing and stakeholder reviews. Write unit, integration, and automated application tests and participate in peer code reviews. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s and nine (9\) years or more experience; Master’s and seven (7\) years or more experience. Master's degree is preferred in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline. * Experience developing modern, component\-based, data\-intensive web applications. Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and server\-side business logic. * Strong programming experience with Python for backend development, automation, integration, data processing, or application support. * Strong programming experience with C and C\+\+, including the ability to read, debug, maintain, and enhance existing legacy codebases. * Working knowledge of AI/LLM concepts and AI agent\-based application patterns, including prompt\-driven workflows, tool/function calling, orchestration, context handling, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Experience integrating front\-end applications with backend APIs and enterprise services. * Proficiency with Linux shell scripting (such as Bash) for automation, troubleshooting, and operational support. * Hands\-on experience with MariaDB/MySQL or comparable relational database technologies. * Experience implementing authentication, authorization, and role\-based access controls. Experience with Git and modern source\-control practices. Experience with automated unit and integration testing. * Experience using Visual Studio Code (VS Code) or a comparable modern IDE. * Understanding of secure software\-development practices. **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced experience with React and TypeScript and modern React routing, state\-management, and data\-fetching approaches. * Experience developing applications incorporating AI/ML, LLM, or agentic AI capabilities and integrating AI services through APIs. * Familiarity with AI agent frameworks, agent orchestration patterns, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, structured outputs, evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails is a plus. * Develop front\-end functionality using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3\. * Familiarity with human\-in\-the\-loop AI workflows, CI/CD, DevSecOps practices, and containerized application environments. * Experience supporting federal government, healthcare, life\-sciences, or other regulated environments is preferred. **Core Technical Skills** * C/C\+\+ \| Python \| Shell/Bash \| React \| JavaScript \| HTML5/CSS3 \| REST APIs \| Backend Development \| Legacy Code Maintenance/Modernization \| SQL \| MariaDB/MySQL \| Linux \| VS Code \| Git \| Automated Testing \| RBAC \| SSO/MFA \| Agile/Scrum **Preferred:** Posit/RStudio \| AI/ML/LLM Integration \| AI Agents/Agentic Workflows \| RAG \| SharePoint/Microsoft 365 \| Section 508/WCAG \| CI/CD \| DevSecOps Target salary range: $150,001 \- $180,000\. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors. Full benefits included. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Green card sponsorship * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Prescription drug insurance * Relocation assistance * Visa sponsorship * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Silver Spring, MD 20993

jobs.description: **Position:** Director, Cybersecurity Engineering – Full Time/Exempt **Department:** Information Technology **Reports to:** Vice President, Information Technology **Location:** Arizona Cardinals (Tempe, AZ) *NOTE: Starting 2028, this role will be based at the* *new Arizona Cardinals Training Facility in north Phoenix, AZ* (https://www.azcardinals.com/news/new\-arizona\-cardinals\-practice\-facility\-on\-target\-for\-opening\-in\-2028\)*.* **Format:** In\-person *Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a student or employment Visas (including, but not limited to F\-1, M\-1, J\-1, H\-1B, OPT and/or CPT programs, etc.).* **Cardinals Organizational Summary:** The Arizona Cardinals Football Club is a professional football team within the National Football League (NFL). We compete in the National Football Conference (NFC) West division and call State Farm Stadium, in Glendale, Arizona, our home. As one of the oldest pro football franchises in the U.S., the Club has established itself as a sport and cultural hallmark within Arizona, as well as a trailblazer for diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) initiatives and firsts around the League. Learn more about the Arizona Cardinals and see what’s happening here (https://www.azcardinals.com/community/). **Job Summary:** The Arizona Cardinals are seeking an experienced, highly motivated, and technically proficient Director of Cybersecurity Engineering to lead the engineering, operation, cyber awareness, and continuous improvement of the organization’s enterprise cybersecurity systems. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role responsible for protecting the organization’s users, data, networks, endpoints, cloud services, applications, venues, and critical technology infrastructure. The Director will manage and execute an enterprise cybersecurity engineering strategy aligned with business requirements, evolving cyber threats, NFL cybersecurity expectations, and the organization’s growing adoption of artificial intelligence. The existing role also calls for support across corporate networks, venues, endpoint systems, live events, and other operational environments. The Director will provide operational oversight for cybersecurity technologies and platforms. The position will also guide the secure adoption of AI applications, AI platforms, automation capabilities, and data\-driven systems. The successful candidate will combine strong cybersecurity engineering expertise with the leadership, communication, and operational discipline required to protect a professional sports organization and its high\-visibility, event\-driven technology environment. Additional responsibilities include event support, game day duties at games, training camp and extended trips. This position will be required to work at all home games and team functions at the State Farm Stadium located in Glendale, AZ. **Primary Job Duties:** The Director, Cybersecurity Engineering position will have the daily responsibilities, without limitation, to include the following: Cybersecurity Engineering and Platform Leadership * Manage, scale, and execute the enterprise cybersecurity engineering strategy in alignment with organizational priorities, technology architecture, NFL requirements, and the evolving threat landscape. * Serve as the technical owner for the organization’s cybersecurity platforms, integrations, security controls, monitoring capabilities, and related services. * Lead the architecture, monitoring, integration, configuration, implementation, administration, optimization, and lifecycle management of cybersecurity technologies, including: * + SIEM, endpoint, identity, email, cloud, data protection, vulnerability management, and security monitoring solutions * Evaluate the effectiveness, coverage, integration, and business value of cybersecurity platforms and recommend enhancements or replacements when appropriate. * Design and support security solutions within a complex hybrid multi\-cloud environment. * Implement automation and orchestration that improve threat detecti ccess, authentication protocols, and least\-privilege security. * Knowledge of data classification, sensitivity labeling, data loss prevention, retention, insider risk, and information\-protection technologies. * Understanding of AI security risks, including sensitive\-data exposure, insecure integrations, access\-control failures, AI agent risks, model misuse, and prompt\-based attacks. * Knowledge of network security concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPN, segmentation, firewalls, wireless security, 802\.1X, IPv6, and intrusion detection and prevention. * Experience securing endpoints, servers, networks, cloud services, applications, mobile devices, IoT systems, and third\-party integrations. * Familiarity with recognized cybersecurity and risk frameworks such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST 800\-53, NIST AI\-100, CIS Controls, ISO/IEC 27001, and related industry practices. * Ability to interpret audit requirements, gather evidence, develop corrective\-action plans, and manage remediation activities. * Experience developing cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, incident playbooks, architectural documentation, and executive reports. * Experience with scripting, automation, APIs, and security orchestration using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, or comparable tools. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, and decision\-making capabilities. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommended actions to executive and business audiences. * Demonstrated discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential, sensitive, and incident\-related information. * Participation in an on\-call cybersecurity escalation rotation is required. * The Director must be able to operate effectively during high\-severity incidents and time\-sensitive live\-event situations. * The position requires a proactive problem\-solving approach, strong work ethic, sound technical judgment, and effective communication with technical staff, leadership, vendors, and operational departments. * Domestic and international travel may be required. * Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays; hours will vary depending on business needs. * Must complete all pre\-employment forms and successfully pass a background check. **Cardinals Benefits/Perks Summary:** The Arizona Cardinals Football Club has developed a comprehensive benefits package that provides economic and inclusive benefits to full\-time employees. The Cardinals benefits offer care, protection, and support for employees and their loved ones. The Cardinals organization encourages an environment that is conducive to living a healthy, productive, and flexible lifestyle. Benefits and Perks include, but are not limited to: * Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance options; effective the first day of hire * 401 (k) retirement option with employer match contribution * Paid Time Off Accruals (including sick time accruals) * Paid Time Off for most Federal holidays * Time off for Maternity, Paternity, Military, and Bereavement * MDLIVE: 24/7 medical support * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) \& Health Care Saving Account options * Discounts on Cardinals gear \& paraphernalia * Tuition reimbursement \& Professional Growth opportunities * Daily free lunch * Complimentary season tickets * Subsidized gym memberships *The Arizona Cardinals Football Club is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.* *\#LI\-Onsite* Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description: **About Aroma360** ------------------ Aroma360 is a leader in luxury scent marketing and home fragrance, bringing the signature scents of five\-star hotels and exclusive destinations to homes and businesses around the world. As a full\-service scent company, we guide clients from concept and development through implementation, with essential oil\-based scenting solutions and a strong focus on customer service. Our mission is to transform environments through fragrance and share the power of Aromachology — the science of how scent influences mood and experience. Technology runs through everything we do — from our Shopify storefront and ad platforms to our ERP, CRM, contact center, fulfillment, and data infrastructure. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to be the operational hub of Aroma360's technology organization. You'll coordinate the work of our technical leads, keep the roadmap and budget on track, and serve as the main link between the technology teams and company leadership. This is a coordination and operations role, not a hands\-on technical one. Our leads for Software Engineering, E\-commerce Development, Data Engineering, and Corporate IT own the architecture, technical decisions, and delivery in their areas. You make sure their work is prioritized, resourced, sequenced, and visible — and that the business gets what it needs from technology. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Roadmap \& Program Coordination** * Maintain the company\-wide technology roadmap, built from the plans of each technical lead and aligned with business priorities. * Run planning cycles, track milestones, and manage dependencies across teams. * Report program status, risks, and decisions to the President and leadership team. **Business Intake \& Prioritization** * Serve as the single point of intake for technology requests from Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, and Legal. * Facilitate prioritization with leadership and route approved work to the right team lead. **Budget \& Vendor Administration** * Track and report the IT budget; flag overruns and cost\-saving opportunities. * Manage vendor contracts, renewals, and licensing across our core platforms (Salesforce, Shopify, NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Google Cloud, and others). * Run make\-vs\-buy and vendor selection processes — scoping, RFPs, and evaluations — with technical leads providing the recommendation and leadership approving. **Team Coordination** * Act as management liaison for the leads of Software Engineering, E\-commerce Development, Data Engineering, and Corporate IT, who report directly to the President. * Oversee the Project Manager and coordinate cross\-team projects. * Hold regular syncs with leads to surface blockers, resource conflicts, and escalations. **Process \& Governance** * Establish consistent processes across teams: release calendars, change management, risk tracking, and KPI reporting. * Keep documentation and status visible to stakeholders. **AI Rollout Coordination** * Coordinate company\-wide AI adoption — Claude for engineering, legal, and design; Slackbot for general use and analytics; and on\-prem LLM initiatives — including rollout plans, training, and adoption tracking. Technical leads own the build and configuration. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Education** * BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, Business, or a related field. * PMP, PgMP, or Agile/Scrum certification is a plus. **Experience** * Program or project management experience coordinating multiple technical teams. * Working familiarity — enough to understand scope, risk, and tradeoffs — with corporate IT, software engineering, data engineering, e\-commerce/martech, and business systems. * Exposure to some of our core systems: Salesforce, Shopify, NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Google Cloud Platform, Claude, Slack. * IT budget tracking and vendor contract management. * Familiarity with SDLC and Agile delivery practices, and project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, or similar). * Strong communicator who can translate between technical teams and business stakeholders. **Nice to have** * Experience in a DTC, e\-commerce, or consumer products company. * A prior hands\-on technical role (engineer, analyst, or sysadmin). **Schedule and Pay** * M\-F In office 9am\-6pm (in Office) * Salary Based on Experience *Our organization is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any candidate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are committed to promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion in our workplace and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply for any open positions.* Join us at Hotel Collection \| Aroma360 and become part of a dynamic team that's setting the standard for luxury fragrance contracts in the industry. jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Arrive Logistics is a leading transportation and technology company in North America with plans to grow significantly year over year. Our success is a testament to our remarkable team and what we're building together. We're committed to providing employees with a meaningful work experience and have established an award\-winning culture that supports personal and career development in a fun, casual, and collaborative environment. **Who We Want** --------------- The Senior Data Scientist will lead the design and delivery of Arrive's intent classification platform and the AI agents built on top of it. Our carrier and customer\-facing reps handle thousands of email conversations every week, and most of their decisions follow patterns we can learn, classify, and increasingly automate. You'll own that work end to end: discovering how reps actually work, turning it into a production intent taxonomy, designing the real\-time classification service that every agent depends on, and delivering the agents with our Engineering partners. This is a senior individual contributor role with technical ownership. You'll set the technical direction for the platform, decide what gets built and in what order, and partner with Engineering, ML Engineering, and Product on how classification and decisioning fit into Arrive's existing matching, pricing, and load\-tracking systems. The ideal candidate has shipped LLM and NLP systems to production, knows how to measure whether they're working, and is comfortable starting from an ambiguous business problem with no spec. ### **What You'll Do** * Lead discovery into how carrier and customer\-facing reps work. Analyze email threads at scale, map them to workflows and decisions, and size where automation creates the most value. * Own the production intent taxonomy across carrier and business development workflows, including how it's validated with stakeholders and how it evolves as the business changes. * Design and develop a real\-time, multi\-intent classification service that serves multiple downstream agents and products, and partner with Engineering to deploy and serve it with clear accuracy and reliability targets. * Define the evaluation strategy for the platform and the agents: golden datasets, annotation guidelines, offline and online metrics, and the monitoring that tells us when performance drifts. * Work with stakeholders and partners to prioritize which agents to build and in what order, based on volume, value, and feasibility, and define what success looks like for each before it's built. * Design AI agents that act on rep workflows, such as load offering, rate negotiation, capacity management, and shipment execution, and partner with Engineering to ship them and integrate them with Arrive's matching, pricing, and load\-tracking systems. * Build guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop review, and observability into every agent, including tracing, logging, cost tracking, and performance monitoring, so agents act safely in production. * Choose the right approach for each problem, from classical NLP and fine\-tuned models to prompting, retrieval, and agent orchestration, and make the trade\-offs explicit. * Lead technical design with Engineering and Product, representing Data Science in decisions about where classification and decisioning live. * Consolidate existing email classification systems onto the shared platform over time, reducing duplicated effort across teams. * Mentor other data scientists through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing, and raise the team's standards for building and evaluating LLM systems. * Communicate progress, results, and trade\-offs clearly to business and executive stakeholders. ### **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (computer science, statistics, linguistics, or related) and 5\+ years of applied ML or data science experience; or a PhD in a relevant field (such as NLP, machine learning, or computer science) and 3\+ years of industry experience shipping production ML systems; or equivalent practical experience. * A track record of shipping NLP or LLM\-based systems to production and owning them after launch, including evaluation, monitoring, and iteration. * Deep experience with text classification and information extraction, including multi\-label problems, taxonomy design, and how these systems fail in practice. * Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and retrieval or RAG architectures, with the judgment to choose between them and explain why. * Experience designing evaluation frameworks from scratch: golden datasets, annotation guidelines, label quality processes, and statistically sound offline and online metrics. * Experience building or designing LLM agents or multi\-step LLM workflows that take actions in production systems, including guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and observability. * Experience setting technical direction for a system or product area, including leading design reviews and making architecture decisions with Engineering partners. * Ability to turn an ambiguous business problem into a scoped roadmap, and to change course when the data says to. * Proficiency in Python and SQL, and comfort working with large volumes of structured and unstructured data. * Solid software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, code review, and CI/CD, and the ability to write production\-quality code alongside engineers. * Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting trade\-offs and recommendations to non\-technical audiences. ### **The Perks of Working With Us** * Take advantage of excellent benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage. * Invest in your future with our matching 401(k) program. * Build relationships and take part in learning opportunities through our Employee Resource Groups. * Enjoy office wide engagement activities, team events, happy hours and more! * Leave the suit and tie at home; our dress code is casual. * Work in the heart of downtown Chicago, IL! * There are CTA and L train stops walking distance from the office and you can store your bike safely inside of the building. * Sweat it out at the LifeStart gym in our office building that includes brand new Peloton bikes, top\-of\-the\-line equipment and personal training options. * Maximize your wellness with free counseling sessions through our Employee Assistance Program * Get paid to work with your friends through our Referral Program! * Take time to manage your physical and mental health \- we offer company paid holidays, paid vacation time and wellness days. * Receive 100% paid parental leave when you become a new parent. * Get relocation assistance! If you are not local to the area, we offer relocation packages. *The base salary range for this position is $163,000 \- $195,000, plus bonus and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the pay range for the position across all locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on work location, job\-related skills, experience, relevant education or training.***Your Arrive Experience** When we say “award\-winning culture,” we mean it. We’ve been recognized as a top workplace by Inc. Fast Company, Fortune, and earned Top Workplaces and Great Place to Work, to name a few. We intend on topping many more of those lists in the years to come, but we’re not in it for the trophies. Qualifications** * Minimum of 2 years of experience in software testing, hardware testing, quality assurance, or a related technical role. * Experience or working knowledge of electrical systems and electronic components. * Associate's or bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience executing test cases, identifying defects, and documenting technical issues. * Comfortable working hands\-on with electronic hardware, test equipment, and basic electrical tools such as multimeters. * jobs.title: QA Lead Remote — Full-time Remote Role
jobs.description: **About Baselane** Baselane is a rapidly growing banking and financial management platform for individual landlords and real estate investors. We are backed by leading FinTech investors, including Activant Capital, Collaborative Fund, Conversion Capital, Diagram Ventures, ThomVest, and many FinTech leaders from PayPal, eBay, Google, and more. We are building the future of financial services for the 12\+ million individual landlords and real estate investors who own over 25 million homes in the United States. We have previously worked at companies including The Boston Consulting Group, Morgan Stanley, Plaid, Harry’s, Better, WealthSimple, RBC Ventures, Affirm, NorthOne, RazorPay, and more. Learn more at baselane.com. **About the Role** We operate in an AI\-first engineering environment, where AI\-powered development is at the core of how we design, build, and deliver software. As our engineers ship faster with AI coding agents, quality has to keep pace, and that means automation. We’re looking for a hands\-on QA Lead who is equally comfortable writing Playwright tests and leading a team of both manual and automation testers. This is a player\-coach role: you’ll spend a significant part of your time building automation yourself, while guiding our manual QA team as they grow into automation, and help the engineering team write better test cases. Expect roughly half your time hands\-on in the codebase, building new automated tests, healing flaky or broken ones, and helping our engineers write better tests for the features they ship. You’ll set the quality strategy, lead by example, and work closely with Engineering, Product, Design, and DevOps to help our engineers own quality end\-to\-end. The other half focused on building the QA team and practice. Our stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Our test stack is built around Playwright. ### **Core Responsibilities** * Build automation hands\-on: Write, review, and maintain Playwright tests yourself, covering critical user flows, APIs, and regression suites. You’ll be one of the most active contributors to our test codebase. * Coach and grow the QA team: Lead our manual QA team through pairing, code reviews, and hands\-on mentorship, upskilling team members into automation and setting clear expectations for quality ownership. * Own the automation framework: Define the architecture, patterns, and conventions of our test framework so it stays fast, reliable, and easy for both QA and engineers to contribute to. * Integrate quality into delivery: Embed automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so every change is validated before it reaches production, and partner with DevOps on test environments and data. * Test with AI agents: Use tools like Claude Code and Cursor to accelerate test creation, maintenance, and debugging while owning the reliability of the output, and teach the team to do the same. * Define quality standards: Establish acceptance criteria, test plans, and release readiness standards with Product and Engineering, and track meaningful quality metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flakiness, cycle time). * Protect what matters most: Ensure high confidence in money\-movement, banking, and compliance\-sensitive flows where correctness is non\-negotiable. ### **Key Requirements** * 7\+ years in software quality, including 2\+ years leading QA teams while remaining hands\-on. * Strong, current hands\-on experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks with Playwright (or Cypress, Selenium, or similar), using TypeScript/JavaScript. You still enjoy writing tests every week. * Experience testing web applications and APIs (GraphQL for main product, REST for partner endpoints), including test data management and environment setup. * Proven track record coaching manual testers into automation and integrating tests into CI/CD workflows. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to write and maintain tests, with the judgment to validate their output. * Strong communication skills and the ability to influence quality practices across engineering and product. * Experience testing AI/LLM\-powered features: building eval sets (golden datasets), defining pass criteria for non\-deterministic output, and running evals in CI to catch regressions from prompt or model changes. * Nice to Have + Experience in FinTech, banking, payments, or integrations with Stripe, Plaid, or BaaS providers. + Experience with performance, load, or security testing. + Experience with visual regression, contract testing, or test observability tooling. $100,000 \- $130,000 a year This is a remote first role. While we expect you to come to the office for monthly team building events, the work is remote first. We offer competitive salaries, benefits, and the opportunity for you to help build a new product and culture from the ground up with founders with deep experience and who know what they are doing. If you are interested in learning more, we'd love to chat. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Team (NYC-based)
jobs.description: **Who we are** Bowery Valuation is one of the leading startups in the emerging world of real estate tech and the only company of its kind in the commercial real estate appraisal space. We are also the first\-ever venture capital\-backed commercial appraisal firm, having raised over $80MM. Powered by big data, advanced technology, and extensive expertise, Bowery is redefining the entire commercial appraisal space. Inside Bowery, we’re a people\-forward company dedicated to providing a productive and inspiring working culture. We are a collection of hard\-working and enthusiastic types focused on building great teams to support great work. We balance our dedication to success with a commitment to gratitude, kindness, and a team\-first attitude. **About the Role** ------------------ Bowery is in a new phase: rethinking the whole appraisal process with AI at the core. We’re hiring a Software Engineer to join our AI\-first engineering team, reporting to our Head of Technology. As the first truly tech\-enabled appraisal firm \- having raised over $80mm backed by Goldman Sachs, Capital One, and numerous venture funds \- Bowery has a strong foundation to build on: a proprietary appraisal\-writing platform, high\-quality data, and a team of 100\+ appraisers across 17 offices from more than 1,000 clients. We’ve grown over 30% year\-over\-year and are fully profitable. Few industries are better suited for AI than appraisal. The work is structured, repetitive, and data\-driven, and it pulls from fragmented sources. We want to use AI to turbocharge appraisers, who can spend their time on judgment, comparables, and compliance instead of data entry. The result will be a better product for our clients and a transformation in the industry. This is a senior engineering role, not a prompt\-writing role. We want someone with a strong software engineering foundation who also uses AI tools like Claude Code and Codex to get far more done than they could alone. You’ll make product decisions, own systems end to end, and hold a high bar for how they’re built. Bowery is a post\-Series B company with clear product\-market fit and material scale, but with a small engineering team. You get the security and data of a late\-stage startup with the impact of a very early one. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, and ship features end to end across our appraisal platform and AI\-powered workflows, from data extraction and analysis to narrative generation * Work directly with appraisers and Ops to understand the problem, decide what to build, and make the product calls to get it shipped * Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) every day, and help shape how the team uses them well, including knowing where not to trust them * Build LLM\-backed features with evaluation, testing, and monitoring in place so quality is measured, not guessed at * Own infrastructure and deployments on AWS, including CI/CD with GitHub Actions, infrastructure as code with Terraform, and containerized services with Docker * Keep the bar high on system design, code review, testing, and observability as we move faster **Experience and Skills** ------------------------- * 4\+ years building and shipping production software, ideally including time at an early\-stage or fast\-moving company * Strong fundamentals in system design, data modeling, APIs, and testing * Fluent in TypeScript and Node.js; React experience is a plus * AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) are a real part of how you work today, and you have opinions on how to use them without giving up quality * Experience building with LLMs: prompt design, RAG, structured outputs, and evals * Experience with AWS preferred, along with GitHub Actions, Terraform, and Docker **Why You’d Be a Good Fit** --------------------------- * **You want ownership.** You’d rather figure out what should be built than wait for a fully specced ticket, and you’re comfortable making and defending product decisions. * **You think critically.** You use AI to multiply your output, and you review its work the way you’d review a teammate’s. You know when something is good enough to ship and when it isn’t. * **You care how things are built.** Speed matters, but so do clean interfaces, tests, and systems that the next engineer can understand. * **You enjoy having direct access to end users.** Our core users (appraisers and Ops teams) are all in\-house, so you’d be iterating with a tight feedback loop. Many of them work 3x/week from our office in Cooper Square. * **You value a remote\-first eng culture.** Our engineers prioritize async communication and make space for deep focus time to help us ship faster. **Why You Might Not Be a Good Fit** ----------------------------------- * **You want well\-defined tickets and a narrow scope.** This role means wearing many hats and working through ambiguity with the business. * **You’d rather not use AI tools in your work.** They’re central to how our team operates and how we expect to scale. * **You’d ship code you don’t understand.** AI\-generated code still needs to meet our engineering standards, and you own what you merge. **Bowery’s Tech Stack** ----------------------- * **Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript * **Frontend:** React * **Backend:** Node.js (NestJS framework) * **Database:** MongoDB, Postgres * **Infrastructure:** AWS, Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions **Bowery Leadership** --------------------- * John Meadows, Chief Executive Officer; LinkedIn * Madeline Pinkner, Head of Technology; LinkedIn * Eliot Jenkins, President and Chief Operating Officer; LinkedIn * Steve Schaller, Chief Revenue Officer; LinkedIn **The pay range for this role is:** 180,000 \- 200,000 USD per year(New York)

jobs.title: Infrastructure & IT Engineer
jobs.description: **THIS IS AN ONSITE POSITION in Carlsbad, CA**. Please do not apply if you are not able to be in the office daily. There may be flexibility for occasional remote days over time, but not at the start. **Our Company** Carecraft is a buying group of swimming pool construction and service owners who buy through Carecraft’s private ordering system. It is like a private version of Amazon for only the Members. There are 350 Suppliers of pool equipment, chemicals and other products available to the Members. We have a unique and healthy culture at Carecraft; your personality, drive, and attitude will be a big factor in our selection. We want someone who cares about their work, their coworkers, our customers, and can have a positive impact on the organization. This is a critical job. **The Role** This is a full\-time onsite role reporting directly to the CTO. Technology Services is a team of four: the CTO, two software engineers, and you. Carecraft depends on its technology systems. Reliability, security, and operational continuity are responsibilities of this role. We run a hybrid environment: Microsoft and AWS run on premises and in the cloud. 16 servers and 40 laptops support a staff of 20, and hundreds of customer businesses who use our systems to order, track, and get pay. We are working to consolidate and simplify. Consistency makes an environment this size maintainable by a small team, a well\-ordered foundation is what lets us move faster on everything else. A good deal of this work is foundational, the kind nobody notices when it's done well. We are deliberately investing here, and we need someone who finds that satisfying. **What you'll do** * Administer Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365 across on\-premises and cloud environments * Run and improve cloud infrastructure in AWS and Azure * Run and improve networking: the office, remote access, and connectivity between our environments * Administer and improve our security tooling: CrowdStrike, multi\-factor authentication, email security, server monitoring, and network security * Own the end\-user environment, including laptops, printers, scanners, phones, accounts, onboarding and offboarding, and helping team members when something doesn't work * Document what you do and train team on the tools and policies they use **Qualifications** * Proactive attitude, sound judgment, reliability, and accountability. On a team this small, these matter more than any particular technology on a resume * Strong communication, explaining technical concepts to non\-technical team members, and genuine caring for the people you support * Several years of experience owning production systems and responding to incidents independently when things don't go according to plan * Strong Windows Server and Active Directory, including hybrid identity with Entra ID * AWS and/or Azure administration, with real depth in at least one * Microsoft 365 administration * Networking you can reason about. VPNs, routing, and why something that should work doesn't * Security as part of operations. You understand why multi\-factor, patching, and least privilege matter, and you do them without being asked * Ability to independently investigate and resolve problems with incomplete information * Comfortable making recommendations for solutions, in addition to identifying problems * Scripting, especially PowerShell, is a plus **What this is actually like** You'll work across the whole stack, not one slice of it. You'll touch more here in a month than in a year at a larger company. You'll work close to the people you support. While we use a ticketing system and queue the work, at twenty staff you'll also work directly with team members on what they need. You'll report to and work alongside the CTO, who carries this work today and will be in it with you. **How this role grows** This position supports the CTO today. Over time, and for someone who earns it, there is a direct path to owning this domain, and to shaping how our infrastructure and IT fit together rather than only running them. That depends on judgment, reliability, and accountability, not on time served. It means owning outcomes, not just completing tasks. We'd rather say that plainly than imply it. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Salary * Profit Sharing (averaging 8%) * Bonus * Paid Time Off * 401(k) with 6% matching * Health, Dental and Vision Insurance for entire family * Life and Disability Insurance * HRA Account (Health Reimbursement for non\-covered expenses) * Office Breakfast, Lunch and Snacks daily * And more! Please send your resume and salary requirements to enghiring@carecraft.com. \*\*\*No 3rd party replies!\*\*\* Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Please describe what you are looking for in a new role. Experience: * AWS: 2 years (Preferred) * Microsoft Admin: 3 years (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Carlsbad, CA 92008 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Lead Advanced Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **About HCC/CCI** Henry Crown \& Company/CC Industries is a Chicago\-based, privately\-held company that manages business, philanthropic, and family interests on behalf of a multi\-generational family. The business ventures fall into broadly\-defined categories: wholly\-owned operating companies, public and private equity investments, and real estate. The enterprise also supports individual and collective giving through Crown Family Philanthropies and provides traditional family office services across generations. The enterprise employs approximately 350 professionals in the areas of investment management, corporate development, financial operations, tax, research and innovation, human resources, information technologies, and legal. **Why work for us?** We are a private enterprise with more than a 100\-year legacy and track record of financial success, supporting our communities, and taking care of our employees. We plan strategically with a long\-term time horizon and an integrated approach to access superior opportunities and optimize financial results. Integrity, collaboration, and dedication are cornerstones of our workplace culture that create rewarding professional experiences. **Position Description** At HCC, our systems automation researchers work directly with multi\-disciplinary project teams to understand key manufacturing challenges and determine how digital technologies can be used to solve them. This includes problem assessment \& technology evaluation, application development and testing, automation, integration, prototyping, and more. Team members are integral to our Research \& Innovation Center (2Ci), contributing to a dynamic environment of diverse projects while collaborating with colleagues across HCC companies, Virginia Tech, suppliers, and other research centers. The Lead Advanced Manufacturing Engineer will contribute to the guidance of the team by applying their knowledge and skills, tempered by industrial experiences, to shape durable solutions. These include applications of process monitoring and control, advanced automation, and new sensing techniques to drive automation into processes and mentoring. These solutions will contribute to developing the Lead Advanced Manufacturing Engineer as a future leader within the organization, as well as a subject matter expert in the adaptive control and motion control applications. **Responsibilities**: * Transform customer specifications into proof\-of\-concept demonstrations. * Assist in design of factory automation and coordinated systems including hardware integration and programming using off the shelf industrial automation hardware and drives (Siemens, Rockwell, etc.). * Mentor to all levels and groups within the broader organization. Collaborates with 2Ci management with regards to planning and executing team development. * Contribute to overall design and analysis using available technology tools and analytical methods (brainstorming, thought experimentation, etc.). * Collaborate with Mechanical Design and Manufacturing Engineers to optimize system performance and machine process state sequencing to provide intuitive machine controls. * Genuine enthusiasm for the application of research to adding value to manufacturing processes and product development. * Employ best engineering practices in the conception, design, and analysis of automated solutions. * Provide training to users in the operation and diagnostics of the systems as Subject Matter Expert * Maintain a safe working environment and utilize safe work practices in the office, manufacturing spaces, and at production facilities. * Collaborate and support partner companies’ partners throughout project lifecycle. * Experience with the implementation of advanced analytical and control techniques such as statistical process control, model predictive control, artificial intelligence, machine learning, precision motion control of mechanisms, etc. * Experience collaborating with multiple shareholders from partnering companies. * Establish and maintain a network within the partnering companies and collaborative partners. * Assume responsibility to continually improve your efficiency and skills. * Participate in user groups and industrial societies. **Qualifications**: * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, or similar engineering. * 7\+ years of experience within a manufacturing environment, with team leadership, project management, and tool \& fixture design (SolidWorks or applicable CAD software) experience with foundation in SolidWorks. Fabrication, welding, controls, and/or programming knowledge a plus. * Holistic approach to advanced manufacturing systems design \& implementation, including mechanical design, system analysis, inspection requirements, and control strategies. * Exposure to manufacturing automation systems, utilizing vision, robotics, sensors, and data analysis. * Experience implementing Industrial Internet of Things (IIOT) related technologies to develop adaptive processes utilizing actionable data\-based algorithms. (Industry 4\.0\) * Effective communicator with diverse teams and stakeholders. * Excels at problem definition; able to work effectively with open ended or ambiguous problem statements and/or applications and be comfortable in adapting strategies to achieve results. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills; clearly conveys ideas at both technical and non\-technical levels; must be an active listener, as well as experience in conflict resolution. * Exposure to factory automation and coordinated drive systems including hardware integration and programming using off the shelf industrial automation hardware and drives (Siemens, Rockwell, etc.). * Contribute to overall (systems, electrical \& mechanical) design and analysis using available technology tools (such as, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Excel, etc.) and analytical methods (brainstorming, thought experimentation, etc.). * Employ best engineering practices in the conception, design, and analysis of automated solutions. * Approaches work with a collaborative, team first mentality; proactive, positive with a can\-do attitude. * Be an effective steward of project budgets and schedules. Project Management experience and Capex planning are a plus. * Comfortable with travel 25% of the time. The Starting Salary Range: $154k \- $173k. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. To see an overview of all our benefits please go to our career portal here. *Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women, members of the LGBTQIA\+ community, individuals experiencing disability and BIPOC are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At CC Industries we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

jobs.title: Data Infrastructure Engineer, Query Engine
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join the data infrastructure team building a query engine for graph\-native queries across internal storage and live enterprise data platforms. You will extend the engine's coordinator, compiler, and executor so organizations can reason and aggregate across diverse data sources. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and extend compiler and executor components to support new language features and functions. * Build and optimize graph\-native query capabilities that work across multiple data sources. * Develop pass\-through query logic for platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and Oracle. * Collaborate with the platform team to improve performance, reliability, and scalability. * Debug complex query execution issues in production enterprise environments. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 4 years building databases, data infrastructure, or distributed data systems, including query, storage, or processing engines. * Experience with database or query engine internals, such as query planning, optimization, execution, compilers, or storage engines. * Strong systems programming skills in C\+\+, Rust, or Java, and experience building high\-performance systems. * Experience optimizing query performance in high\-volume or latency\-sensitive environments. * Knowledge of SQL, query optimization, or compiler design, and familiarity with federated queries across heterogeneous data sources. * Experience with distributed query processing, graph databases or query languages, semantic layers, or enterprise data platforms is valuable. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Mateo, California, United States.

jobs.title: Founding Data Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Build the data infrastructure for an agentic operating system serving farms. You will create reliable ways to bring information from disconnected farm systems into a unified platform, enabling product agents and insights to work with consistent, trustworthy data. ### **What You'll Do** * Build a connector framework that makes integrations reusable and faster to configure for new customers. * Develop a reliable process for AI\-assisted connector creation using vendor documentation. * Create ways to access data from systems without APIs, including collectors that run on farm servers. * Design and maintain a canonical farm data model, with proposed mappings reviewed before implementation. * Own data quality and evaluation tools to detect and diagnose failures. * Build tools for agents to query data and prepare machine learning training sets. * Occasionally work on\-site to connect farm systems. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to four years of engineering experience building and operating production pipelines or integrations with messy data sources. * Strong Python and SQL skills, plus experience with PostgreSQL, a data warehouse such as BigQuery, and tools such as dbt. * Experience designing schemas that other people and systems depend on, and resolving production issues directly. * Daily experience building with AI and a practical understanding of its limitations. * Experience with data quality and evaluation frameworks. * Helpful background includes Airbyte, Fivetran or similar connector frameworks; document extraction or OCR; and data from ERP, IoT, agriculture, logistics, or food supply chain systems. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $170,000 to $200,000 annually, plus 1% equity with four\-year vesting and a one\-year cliff. Healthcare, AI coding tools and model access, and necessary hardware are provided. Visa sponsorship is not available; candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, five days per week. The role includes approximately one week per quarter visiting farms in Washington, Oregon, and California.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer (AI/ML)
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Build the AI and machine learning systems behind a recruiting marketplace, including the recommendations and matching that connect candidates with roles. You will own this core product layer from early design through production. ### **What You'll Do** * Own recommendation, ranking, and retrieval systems end to end. * Build LLM\-powered matching features that improve candidate\-role alignment. * Take features from problem definition to production, shipping at a rapid cadence. * Architect and maintain the data pipelines and services that support production models. * Work closely with company leadership to turn product goals into shipped systems. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to five years of software engineering experience, building and shipping end\-to\-end product features in production. * Hands\-on experience building production recommendation systems, ranking algorithms, or ML\-powered matching. * Experience shipping LLM\-powered features using LLM APIs, and applying ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, or equivalent. * Strong production engineering skills in TypeScript or Python; proficiency in either language is sufficient. * Experience maintaining production data pipelines and services, and working in fast\-paced environments with frequent releases. * Strong computer science fundamentals and evidence of technical achievement through projects, open\-source contributions, or comparable work. * React, Supabase, Prisma, search and ranking infrastructure, embeddings, vector search, and workflow automation experience are helpful. * Existing U.S. work authorization or eligibility for a supported sponsorship route, and willingness to work in person in San Francisco. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $130,000 to $170,000 annually, plus founding\-hire equity. jobs.title: Founding Engineer, AI Agents
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join the founding engineering team building an AI agent framework for farm operations. You will work closely with AI leadership to design and ship agents that support real business decisions across multiple farms. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and own the agent framework, including roles, tools, permissions, approvals, and a runtime for tasks that span multiple days. * Build memory and context systems that capture farm\-specific knowledge, including operational knowledge that may not be documented. * Develop code automation that lets agents create and reuse code for recurring work, with human oversight when unexpected situations arise. * Create evaluations and safety measures to improve agent reliability and demonstrate ongoing performance improvements. * Build tools on top of the data layer and integrate machine learning insights into the agent framework. * Observe farm teams using the system and refine the product based on their feedback. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to four years of engineering experience, including shipping production LLM agents or agentic workflows that people rely on. * Experience building agents with tool use, orchestration, context and memory design, and evaluation. * Strong Python skills and familiarity with PostgreSQL, asynchronous systems, and workflow engines. * Experience writing evaluations as part of agent development, critically reviewing AI\-generated code, and independently handling system design. * Strong judgment around retrieval, context management, and when work should be handed to a person or implemented with conventional code. * Experience with Temporal or similar durable workflow engines, agent observability and tracing, or security measures for prompt injection and permissions is helpful. * Authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship, and able to work on\-site in San Francisco and travel to farms for about one week per quarter. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $170,000 to $200,000 annually, plus 1% equity with four\-year vesting and a one\-year cliff. Benefits include healthcare, AI coding tools and model access, and work hardware. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, five days per week, with about one week of quarterly travel to farms in Washington, Oregon, and California. Compensation Range: $170K \- $200K

jobs.title: Founding Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** As the first machine learning engineer on the team, you will build the ML foundation for software that helps improve farm operations. You will turn fragmented agricultural data into carefully evaluated forecasts and insights that growers can use to make important decisions. ### **What You'll Do** * Audit and integrate historical data from farm systems, identifying useful signals and data gaps. * Build machine learning tools for forecasting, performance analysis, and operational efficiency. * Develop backtesting and evaluation frameworks to assess model accuracy before deployment. * Create privacy\-first, anonymized datasets that support shared learning across farms. * Collaborate with product and engineering teammates to present useful insights to farm managers. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to four years of engineering experience, including shipping production ML models used to inform real decisions. * Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience using pandas or polars, scikit\-learn, gradient boosting, and forecasting libraries. * Experience with tabular or time\-series data, data pipelines, and tools that help explain model behavior. * A rigorous approach to evaluation, including awareness of data leakage, backtesting, and production readiness. * Ability to explain model outputs and uncertainty to non\-technical stakeholders. * Daily experience building with AI and interest in combining LLMs and agents with classical ML. * Experience with large\-scale data, messy startup data, or applied forecasting in agriculture, weather, supply chain, or other physical\-world domains is valuable. Privacy\-preserving or federated data experience is also useful. * Ability to work from the San Francisco office five days a week and travel to farms in the western United States about one week per quarter. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $170,000 to $200,000 annually, plus 1% equity with four\-year vesting and a one\-year cliff. Healthcare and AI development tools are provided. Visa sponsorship is not available; candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, five days per week. Compensation Range: $170K \- $200K

This individual must have led or been chief architect in a major IT applications implementation effort. This individual must also have a strong background in software engineering principles and techniques. **Specialized Experience:** The proposed candidate must have at least six (6\) years of experience in designing medium to large\-scale sites, and management of at least five Internet projects. * Provide guidance on modernization of legacy applications and refactoring into cloud\-native and service\-oriented architectures. * Maintain technical documentation, architecture decision records (ADRs), and architectural runbooks. * Mentor junior architects and senior developers on architectural thinking, scalability, and best practices. * Proficient in Python, Java, or C\#; familiar with CI/CD for machine learning (MLOps). * Strong communication, presentation, and consulting skills for working with stakeholders and executives. Extensive IT Experience: Significant experience in software development, engineering, and IT, often moving up from roles like Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer. * AI/ML Expertise: Proven experience in running and fine\-tuning models (e.g., LLMs, LoRA, RLHF). * Cloud \& Data: Strong proficiency in cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and data architecture. * Domain Expertise: Often requires experience in specialized areas like healthcare, finance, or security\-sensitive environments. At least ten (10\) years of experience with architecting multi\-tier web solutions * At least five (5\) years of experience with JavaScript frameworks such as Node.JS * Strong programming skills in designing and implementation of multi\-tier, distributed and highly scalable applications using Node.JS, Java, J2EE, Spring, JavaScript, Hibernate, JSON. * Strong experience in developing and deploying solutions using Node.JS on Linux based AWS EC2 Cloud Infrastructure and Docker container. * Experience with modern DevOps automation and modern containerization, orchestration, and virtualization technologies * Experience with architecting and developing mobile applications for iOS or android platforms is a plus. * Experience with Test\-Driven Development using automated testing frameworks such as Selenium, Cucumber and Protractor **EDUCATION:** * A Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related scientific or technical discipline. * (Note: A Master's degree is preferred). **Join Our Team:** At **CMT Services**, we believe that extraordinary results come from empowering exceptional people. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Crusoe Managed Data Transfer
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** Crusoe's Managed Platform Services (MAPS) organization builds the managed services that make Crusoe Cloud easy to adopt and hard to leave, including Crusoe Container Registry, Cloud Monitoring and Managed Logs. Managed Data Transfer (MDT) is its newest service. MDT moves petabyte\-scale training data from AWS S3, and later other clouds, into Crusoe storage with a single API call: the service shards the work across a fleet of transfer workers, verifies every object, and asks the customer to run nothing. For AI labs and Physical AI companies whose data lives with a hyperscaler, it removes one of the biggest obstacles to training on Crusoe GPUs. We are hiring Senior Software Engineers to build the MDT control plane: the job API, scheduler and job state that turn a customer request into a coordinated, resumable transfer. You will join a new team at the beginning, take the service from first commit to its preview launch with design\-partner customers, and shape the API that new clouds and Crusoe\-internal transfers will plug into later. You will work closely with the Storage, Network, IAM and Cloud Console teams, and report to the Engineering Manager of Managed Data Transfer. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Job API and Lifecycle:** Design and build the data\-transfer API (create, list, get, cancel) with a provider\-neutral model for sources and destinations, so new clouds and storage types can be added without breaking customers. * **Scheduling and Job State:** Build the scheduler and state machine that split a bucket listing into units of work, place them on regional worker pools, and track progress, retries and resume across failures. * **Correctness at Scale:** Make petabyte\-scale jobs safe to retry and cancel, with end\-to\-end checksum verification and clear errors when a customer's permissions or destination are wrong. * **Cross\-Cloud Identity:** Implement secure access to customer buckets with short\-lived, least\-privilege credentials (AWS role assumption first, other clouds next), integrated with Crusoe IAM and audit logging. * **Customer Surfaces:** Ship the CLI and, with partner teams, the Terraform and Console experiences for creating and monitoring transfers. * **Operational Excellence:** Instrument the service with metrics, logs and alerts, write the runbooks, and take part in the team's on\-call rotation. * **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** Agree the interfaces MDT depends on with Storage, Network, IAM and Console, and work with Product and Solutions Architects on early customer onboarding. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Backend Engineering Craft:** Experience designing and shipping production backend services and APIs, ideally in Go, with gRPC or REST, relational databases and Kubernetes. * **Professional Experience:** 5\+ years building cloud infrastructure or platform services, including taking a service from zero to general availability. * **Distributed Systems Judgment:** Comfort with long\-running, failure\-prone work: idempotency, retries with backoff, leases, checkpointing and partial failure. * **API Design:** Ability to design public APIs that customers automate against and that can grow without breaking changes. * **Security Mindset:** Working knowledge of authentication, authorization and least privilege, and care in handling customer credentials. * **Operational Ownership:** You have run services in production, been on call, and built the dashboards and alerts that keep incidents short. * **Collaboration and Writing:** You work well across teams with different priorities, and your design docs settle decisions. * **Educational Foundation:** A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Bonus Points** * Experience with large\-scale data movement, such as S3 multipart uploads, rclone, s5cmd, AWS DataSync or Google Storage Transfer Service. * Hands\-on experience with cross\-cloud identity: AWS IAM and STS, GCP service\-account impersonation, or Azure workload identity. * Experience with storage systems (object storage, NFS, parallel file systems) or high\-throughput networking. * Experience with job orchestration systems such as Temporal, Argo, or Kubernetes operators. * Experience building on GPU or AI infrastructure. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 \- $205,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck.
