If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** We are looking for a Staff Engineer to be the technical lead and systems architect for Crusoe's Managed Data Transfer (MDT) service, the person who owns how its parts fit together and how MDT fits into Crusoe Cloud. MDT moves petabyte\-scale training data between hyperscaler storage and Crusoe storage as a managed service, so AI labs and Physical AI companies can train on Crusoe GPUs without building their own transfer pipelines. You will design the control plane, the transfer worker fleet and the integration with Crusoe's storage and network, and set the path for adding other clouds and Crusoe\-internal transfers. This is an engineering leadership role on a new team. Managed Data Transfer starts from a working prototype that already serves customers in production, so your first decisions are about what to keep, harden or replace, and how to sequence that work without disrupting the customers who depend on it. You will lead the design through Crusoe's architecture review, mentor the engineers who build it, and report to the Engineering Manager of Managed Data Transfer within Managed platform services. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Architecture Ownership:** Own the end\-to\-end design of MDT: the job API and scheduler, the transfer workers on Kubernetes, storage integration and network paths. You decide what the system looks like and explain why. * **Prototype Assessment and Migration:** Evaluate the production prototype, decide what gets refactored, extended or replaced, and move its current users onto the managed service without interruption. * **Throughput and Correctness:** Set the data\-plane strategy (sharding, concurrency, straggler handling, checksum verification) and the benchmarks that prove it, aiming for line\-rate transfers over dedicated interconnects. * **Cross\-Team Contracts:** Own the interfaces between MDT and Storage, Network, Kubernetes, IAM, Console, Billing and Monitoring. You define what partner teams build to and hold the line on it. * **Extensibility and Build\-versus\-Buy:** Design for new clouds and Crusoe\-internal transfers with a pluggable transfer engine and team ships. * **Product Partnership:** Work with Product on scope, pricing trade\-offs and milestones, and surface edge cases early enough to change the plan. * **Technical Mentorship:** Raise the team's level through design reviews, RFC feedback and direct coaching, so the team runs well without depending on you. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Distributed Systems Depth:** Hands\-on experience designing and operating data\-intensive distributed systems at scale, including the failure modes that only appear in production. * **Professional Experience:** 8\+ years shipping production software, including leading a service from prototype to general availability. * **Data Movement and Storage Performance:** Understanding of object storage semantics, file systems and TCP throughput, and the ability to profile and fix a transfer that is slower than it should be. * **Systems Integration Judgment:** Proven ability to evolve a live system toward a better design while keeping risk to current customers low. * **Cross\-Team Influence:** Experience defining API boundaries and schema contracts with partner teams, and negotiating them to agreement. * **Operational Ownership:** You have carried customer\-facing on\-call and built systems that are maintainable, observable and predictable. * **Software Engineering Craft:** Proficiency in Go or another modern compiled language (Go strongly preferred). * **Communication:** You can explain an architectural decision to an engineer, a PM and an EM, and you know which parts matter to each. **Bonus Points** * Experience building or operating bulk data transfer systems, such as AWS DataSync, Google Storage Transfer Service, or rclone at petabyte scale. * Familiarity with cloud networking and interconnects, such as AWS Direct Connect or GCP Interconnect. * Experience with cross\-account cloud IAM and threat modeling for services that hold customer credentials. * Approximate nearest\-neighbor (ANN) indexing in depth: HNSW, IVF, product and scalar quantization, DiskANN\-style indexes that live on SSD. * Experience with AI, HPC or Physical AI data pipelines. **Benefits:** * Competitive account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits switching, segmentation, redundancy, wireless networking, Quality of Service (QoS), IPV4/IPv6, 8021\.x, BGP, OSPF, SD\-WAN, SASE, VPCs, and related technologies. * Conduct security audits, vulnerability assessments, penetration validation activities, and network threat hunting to identify risks, validate security controls, and recommend remediation strategies. * Perform vulnerability scanning, security compliance reviews, and risk assessments to ensure adherence to organizational security standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. * Investigate and respond to security alerts and incidents, including threat identification, containment, eradication, recovery, and root cause analysis. * Proven ability to lead complex technical projects, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced operational environment. * Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills. jobs.description: Electrical Engineer, Industrial Machinery (Worcester, MA) A machine builder in north central Massachusetts is looking for an electrical engineer with around five years on industrial machinery to own the electrical side of their coil winding machines. The machines wind wire and foil into coils for power transformers and MRI systems. They have 10 to 12 core models so most projects start from a reference machine and get adapted to what the customer needs. Each engineer takes a machine from start to finish. That covers the full electrical package from the motors to the panel and every connection in between, the PLC program and the bill of materials. Then you start the machine up on the shop floor with the electrical crew. Safety systems are where the work gets more involved. Customers are asking for specific safety standards and SIL 2 has come up on recent jobs. You will work with the mechanical and pneumatic engineers on those systems. You will need hands on electrical design experience on machinery along with motion control, and you will be comfortable powering up high voltage equipment. Ladder logic matters more than the platform and Rockwell is useful. The team is moving to ePlan and you can learn it on the job. The role is on site five days a week, commutable from Worcester, Fitchburg and Leominster. Travel is 10 to 15% for customer startups and troubleshooting, a week or two at a time across the year. Pay is $85k to $135k depending on experience. You can be hourly or salaried and overtime is paid on both. There is also an annual bonus and a 401k profit share, and the company covers the health insurance deductible. Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) Application Question(s): * Have you designed an electrical system from scratch ? jobs.title: Data Analyst - Payment Success
jobs.description: ***Company Description*** *We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.* *We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.* *Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.* *If you want to do career\-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.* *With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.* **About the team** Payment Success Management (PSM) is a merchant\-facing team that diagnoses and fixes payment performance problems. When a merchant's approval rate falls short of expectations or trails another payment provider, we find out why and close the gap. This role supports US\-based merchants and works with our account managers and technical account managers. **The kind of problems you'll solve** * A merchant's approval rate dropped 3 points last month, and nobody knows why. * One issuing bank is declining far more of a merchant's cards than its peers. * Our machine\-learning optimization engine keeps making the wrong routing or retry decision for a specific bank or card type. * A merchant is comparing us with another provider that calculates success differently, and we need to agree on what "good" looks like. Merchants tell us there's a problem, not where it is. You'll find it, test a fix and prove the result. **How you'll make an impact** * Run merchant engagements from start to finish, usually about three months each. * Investigate large, complex payment datasets in SQL and Python to find the root cause of performance gaps. * Turn findings into hypotheses, design A/B tests and other experiments, and measure the uplift. * Learn how our ML optimization engine makes decisions, spot where it gets things wrong, and work with our ML engineers to fix it. You won't build the models; you'll work out why they decide what they do. * Explain your findings to merchants and non\-technical colleagues clearly and persuasively. * Use automation and AI to make the team's daily work more efficient, and share what you learn across teams. **What we're looking for** * 2\+ years of full\-time experience using data to diagnose and improve a business metric, such as approval rate, conversion, revenue, cost or retention. We're looking for metrics you changed, not reports you delivered. * Hands\-on experience designing or analyzing experiments: A/B tests, holdouts or controlled comparisons. * Strong SQL and Python for analysis. You can check your own queries, and AI\-generated code, for accuracy. You don't need to write production code, and we'll teach you Go. * Curiosity about problems without a ready\-made answer. * The ability to explain complex analysis simply to non\-technical audiences. Payments experience isn't required; you'll learn it in your first weeks. We'd especially like to hear from people with consulting backgrounds, where you linked client teams and technical teams, or startup backgrounds, where you owned and optimized something end to end. **This role probably isn't for you if…** * Most of your recent work is building dashboards and reports for other teams to act on. * Your focus is data engineering, building pipelines and data infrastructure. * Your focus is building, training and deploying ML models. These are valuable skills and you'll use some of them here, but this role is mainly investigation and experimentation. **Logistics** * Hybrid: Tuesday–Thursday **in our Midtown Atlanta office (Colony Square).** * This role does not offer relocation assistance or visa sponsorship. **Additional Information** **Bring all of you to work** We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. **Life at** **Checkout.com** We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Chorus Innovations is a fast\-growing healthcare technology company with an adaptive platform as a service (PaaS) that enables the rapid development of mobile, desktop, text messaging and interactive voice applications. Chorus' platform currently powers transformative healthcare, biomedical research and community health projects across institutions and public health agencies nationwide. We believe every community should have world\-class health technology so they can thrive. Our mission is to improve the lives of people and communities by democratizing technology development in health and research. **About the Role** Chorus builds an AI\-first healthcare SaaS platform for behavioral health specialists and beyond. We are hiring Staff Platform Engineers who treat that opportunity seriously: apply modern LLM and agent\-harness techniques without trading away systems correctness. You are a hands\-on technical backbone for the platform. You design durable, multi\-tenant systems. You ship them across the stack. You encode how they work — RFCs, engineering docs, Skills, Runbooks, and agent context — so hungry engineers (and midtier coding agents) can move fast without creating vibe\-coded slop. This is documentation\-first, not code\-first. Syntax is cheap. Understanding the problem, designing the contract, and leaving a system that others can learn and extend is the job. You get high leverage from midtier models (for example Cursor Auto, Haiku/Sonnet\-class, Composer\-class) through strong harnesses — not by blasting maximal models for high\-speed volume. Your impact shows up as velocity with correctness: reusable platform building blocks (modules, SDKs, UI kits, Skills/Runbooks) that make the next engineer (and the next agent session) 10x — not heroics that only you can repeat. This role carries a high mentorship burden. You are a primary technical guide for Senior Platform Engineers and for Implementation Engineer (IE) teams across the product line squads. You still ship hard yourself — and you spend real time raising others' ceiling through pairing, review, design coaching, and durable docs. **What You'll Be Doing** * **Own platform systems end\-to\-end:** Design, build, and maintain shared platform capabilities that product teams and tenants depend on — data models and migrations, NestJS/GraphQL BFFs, ui\-kits and control\-plane (ACP) surfaces, tests, and rollout safety. You work full\-stack when the system requires it. * **Carry high mentorship load for Seniors and IEs** Guide Senior Platform Engineers on systems design, documentation\-first delivery, and AI harness craft. Guide Implementation Engineer teams on how to reuse shared modules, SDKs, and UI kits safely: permissions, lifecycle, tenant vs platform lanes, and when to escalate to an RFC. Expect substantial time in pairing, design review, and PR review — mentorship is part of the job, not an afterthought. * **Design before you code** Define the problem and the correctness properties first (permissions, lifecycle, view\-state, layouts, auth boundaries). Write RFCs and contracts that other engineers can implement against. Prefer durable abstractions over one\-off feature patches. * **Encode knowledge at discovery** Leave systems easy to learn. Capture decisions in engineering docs, Skills, Runbooks, and agent\_context so humans and agents enforce the same rules. Prefer machine\-readable enabling constraints over tribal knowledge. * **Practice AI harness craft** Use AI\-assisted development as a force multiplier with judgment. Use and improve Skills/Runbooks; contribute new harness artifacts when work recurs. Prompt and review with security, performance, and domain correctness in mind. Teach Seniors and IEs the same discipline. Reject high\-speed slop — volume without understanding is not velocity. * **Force\-multiply the organization** Ship reusable platform building blocks — shared modules, SDKs, UI kits, generators, and Skills/Runbooks — so product and IE teams do not reinvent the same capability. Coach through pairing, heavy review, and durable artifacts. Make yourself replaceable in specific domains by teaching patterns, not by gatekeeping them. * **Operational excellence across tenants** Own reliability for what you ship: migrations, authz, observability, staged rollouts, and recovery. Healthcare and multi\-tenant blast radius are first\-class concerns. * **Cross\-functional technical leadership** Translate tradeoffs for product, clinical solutions, QA, and delivery. Align on domain vocabulary (care objects, programs, roles, statuses) so the platform stays coherent as it grows **What We're Looking For** * **Deep systems experience** 9\+ years building and operating complex systems. Proven ownership of cross\-cutting platform work — not only feature tickets in a single app layer. * **Systems design \+ strong writing** You define the problem accurately, write clear design docs, and treat documentation as part of delivery. Yo uires it **Frontend** * React with TypeScript * Material UI and Emotion for component development and styling * Strong understanding of component composition, state management, and performance considerations * Comfort building staff\-facing and admin/control\-plane UIs that encode platform configuration **Platform and Tooling** * Nx monorepo tooling * Docker and Kubernetes for local and deployed environments * AWS infrastructure including managed databases, identity, and networking * CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar * Agent harnesses: Skills, Runbooks, MCP\-backed workflows, and repo agent context **Engineering Practices** * Domain\-driven design concepts and practical application * Documentation\-first delivery (RFC/ADR implementation encode for agents and humans) * Strong SQL fundamentals and database design * Testing at multiple levels, including unit and integration / DB\-backed tests * Experience designing systems meant to be extended by other teams and by AI agents under human authority **Nice to Have** * **Computer\-science fundamentals** Deep computer\-science fundamentals (systems, data structures, concurrency, networking) — whether from a CS or related degree or equivalent self\-directed study. Formal CS education is a plus; self\-trained candidates who already know how computers work are welcome. **Why Join Us?** * Work on important, meaningful problems in healthcare * Shape the foundation of a platform that will power dozens (eventually hundreds) of applications * Collaborate with a team that values design, pragmatism, and velocity * Competitive compensation, equity, and full benefits **Compensation Disclosure** The anticipated base salary range for this position is $185,000 \- $200,000 in the Los Angeles market. jobs.title: City Engineer/Codes Official
jobs.description: DEFINITION This position is under the administrative direction of the Mayor. The employee is responsible for administration and supervision of the code enforcement compliance programs relative to the construction, alteration and repair of buildings and enforcement of current zoning regulations. Work includes supervision of code inspection activities, review of subdivision and other development plans and providing proper recommendations to the Decherd Regional Planning Commission. The employee performs inspections of subdivisions and other development work, coordinates performance bonds and/or letters of credit and prepares the Decherd Regional Planning Commission agenda. The employee performs various engineering tasks including surveying and traffic control. Instructions to the employee are general and the employee must routinely use independent judgement when performing tasks. EQUIPMENT / JOB LOCATION The employee will operate a computer, fax machine, copier and other modern office equipment. The employee will operate an automobile with radio transmitting and receiving capabilities for constant communication access. The employee typically works indoors in an office environment and may be exposed to tobacco smoke, however sometimes work is performed outdoors regardless of the weather. The employee may be required to lift heavy objects weighing more than 25 pounds. The employee's work may expose him/her to high places, dangerous machinery and its moving parts, sharp tools, fumes, chemicals and/or toxic substances. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB Plans, designs, makes cost estimates and supervises construction and maintenance of street lighting, traffic signals, asphalt paving, pavement marking and other projects and/or activities. Prepares and obtains right\-of\-way easements and/or acquisitions. Reviews subdivision and other development plans, prepares comments and recommendations to the Decherd Regional Planning Commission. Inspects subdivision and other developments and approves or disapproves the acceptance of roads, utilities and other facilities by the town. Performs tests on all water and sewer lines to accepted by the city and assures quality of materials and construction. Submits plans, permit applications and other documentation to the State Department of Transportation, the State Health Department and the Corp of Engineers when required. Administers and supervises underground storage tank compliance. Represents the City of Decherd on the Regional Transportation Authority. Coordinates performance bonds and/or letters of credit by developers held by the city to assure proper completion of developments. Prepares legal descriptions, files plats, researches deeds and other land records. Administration and supervision of the code enforcement compliance programs relative to the construction, alteration and repair of buildings and enforcement of current zoning regulations. Prepares Decherd Regional Planning Commission agenda. Approves plans, specifications and final completion of city construction contracts, such as sewer rehabilitation and expansion, water and waste water system expansion. Investigates and responds to stormwater drainage complaints. ADDITIONAL EXAMPLES OF WORK PERFORMED Performs other related duties and special projects as assigned. REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES Knowledge of modern management and office administration practices and techniques. Knowledge of the principles and practices of construction and maintenance supervision. Knowledge of International Code Council residential and commercial building codes and accepted construction principles and practices. Knowledge of local zoning and subdivision rules and regulations. Knowledge of the principles and practices of inspection of roads, utilities and other facilities in land development. Knowledge of the occupational hazards of work to be accomplished and supervised and the necessary safety precautions needed. Knowledge of laws and regulations regarding employee health, safety and employment practices. Knowledge of state and federal laws governing traffic control, water and sewer extensions and stream maintenance. Knowledge of principles and practices of civil engineering, particularly as applied to municipal utility and public works. jobs.title: Senior Staff GIS Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** With a workforce of over 25,000 people, and opportunities in more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia is the fifth largest city in the United States and one of the largest employers in Southeastern Pennsylvania. As an employer, the City of Philadelphia operates through the guiding principles of service, integrity, respect, accountability, collaboration, diversity and inclusion. Through these principles, we strive to effectively deliver services, to resolve the challenges facing our city, and to make Philadelphia a place where all our residents have the opportunity to reach their potential. The Office of Innovation \& Technology (OIT) is the central IT agency for the City of Philadelphia headed by the Chief Information Officer (CIO). OIT oversees all major information and communications technology initiatives for the City of Philadelphia \- increasing the effectiveness of the information technology infrastructure, where the services provided are advanced, optimized, and responsive to the needs of the City of Philadelphia’s businesses, residents, and visitors. OIT responsibilities include: identifying the most effective approach for implementing new information technology directions throughout city government; improving the value of the city’s technology assets and the return on the city’s technology investments; ensuring data security continuity; planning for continuing operations in the event of disruption of information technology or communications services; and supporting accountable, efficient and effective government across every city department, board, commission and agency. **Job Description** The Philadelphia Water Department (PWD) serves the greater Philadelphia region by providing integrated water, wastewater, and stormwater services. This position supports GIS operations and analytics of PWD, and reports to the GIS Manager. The Staff GIS Software Engineer is responsible for leading the design and development of internal GIS applications that support the design, operation, and maintenance of Philadelphia's drinking water, wastewater, and green stormwater infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can own systems end\-to\-end, from architecture and data modeling through frontend implementation, deployment, and long\-term maintenance. You'll work at the intersection of GIS, software engineering, and database design, building tools that engineering and operations staff depend on every day. The bulk of the role is greenfield development of modern applications that replace aging systems, with the rest spent keeping existing tools reliable, automating GIS editing workflows, and investing in the development practices that make all of it sustainable. A core part of new application work is partnering directly with the many civil, environmental, mechanical, and electrical engineers across PWD to understand their work processes and design tools that fit what their needs. You'll work alongside a team of several GIS professionals and editors who maintain the datasets your applications display. **Essential Functions** * Developing new applications and API’s on modern tech stacks to replace legacy ones. Primarily with C\#, ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server for backend, and JavaScript/TypeScript, React and the Esri ArcGIS Maps SDK for frontend. * Design and maintain a document management system for over 340,000 georeferenced engineering drawings. * Maintaining legacy Visual Basic and ASP.NET Framework applications. * ArcGIS Pro Add\-in/extension development using C\# and the ArcGIS Pro .NET SDK to automate common workflows for GIS editors. * Implementing modern DevOps; CI/CD pipelines and other best practices to support application development, testing, and long\-term maintenance. * Direct collaboration with civil, environmental, mechanical, and electrical engineers, city planners, and field operations staff to gather requirements, validate designs, and iterate on tools that fit their needs. * Python GIS data processing and alerting scripts. * Directs the work of a junior level software engineer **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field. **Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Significant professional experience building and shipping production software, with strong full\-stack range across C\#/.NET on the backend and React \+ TypeScript on the frontend. * Demonstrated ability to design and build polished, maintainable frontend applications — component architecture, state management, type safety, and an eye for UX. * Experience with web mapping development using the Esri JavaScript API (or comparable mapping libraries) and a solid grasp of how spatial data flows from server to browser. * Deep familiarity with SQL Server, including schema design, performance tuning, and permissions. * Strong working knowledge of the Esri ArcGIS ecosystem and the data systems built around it. * Hands\-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and the practices around them — automated builds, deployments, environment promotion, and release management. * Comfort working directly with non\-developer subject matter experts (engineers, GIS editors, operations staff) to elicit requirements and shape the design of new applications. * Willingness to maintain and incrementally improve legacy systems — including older Visual Basic and ASP.NET Framework codebases — while charting a path toward replacing them. * A track record of making pragmatic architectural decisions and avoiding unnecessary complexity. * Strong communication skills, especially around documenting decisions and explaining tradeoffs to non\-developers. **Preferred Skills:** * ArcGIS Enterprise 10\.6 and later * Experience with ArcGIS Pro SDK development. * SQL Server * Windows Server, IIS 10 * Experience as a user of of ArcMap and ArcGIS Pro * Python experience, particularly for GIS data processing and ETL work. Background in utility, municipal, civil engineering, or infrastructure data systems. * **Additional Information** **Salary cannot exceed $110,000** **We’re interested in hiring the best possible candidate for the role. We recognize that experience, education, and qualifications can be attained in a variety of ways and that many skillsets are transferable. If you feel you’re a good fit, please don’t hesitate to apply.** **Please include:** * Resume * A cover letter **Please note: Applications will not be considered without a cover letter.** Did you know? * We are a Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program qualified employer : 25% tuition discount program for City employees (and sometimes spouses and dependents as well) in partnership with area colleges and universities * We offer Comprehensive health coverage for employees and their eligible dependents * Our wellness program offers eligibility into the discounted medical plan * Employees receive paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays * Generous retirement savings options are available **\*The successful candidate must be a city of Philadelphia resident within six months of hire** Effective May 22, 2023, vaccinations are **no longer required** for new employees that work in non\-medical, non\-emergency or patient facing positions with the City of Philadelphia. As a result, only employees in positions providing services that are patient\-facing medical care (ex: Nurses, doctors, emergency medical personnel), must be fully vaccinated. The City of Philadelphia is an Equal Opportunity employer and does not permit discrimination based on race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, source of income, familial status, genetic information or domestic or sexual violence victim status. If you believe you were discriminated against, call the Philadelphia Commission on Human Relations at 215\-686\-4670 or send an email to faqpchr @phila.gov. For more information, go to: Human Relations Website: http://www.phila.gov/humanrelations/Pages/default.aspx

jobs.title: Support Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cleerly** We're Cleerly – a healthcare company that's revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world's leading cardiologists and are a growing team. Most of our teams work remotely and have access to our offices in Denver, Colorado, New, York, New York, Dallas, Texas, and Lisbon, Portugal with some roles requiring you to be on\-site in a location. Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value\-based, AI\-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly's solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world's largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person's risk of heart attacks. At Cleerly, we collaborate digitally and use a wide variety of systems. Our people use Google Workspace (GMail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides), Slack, Confluence/Jira, and Zoom Video, prior experience in these areas is a plus. Role or department specific technology needs may vary and will be listed as requirements in the job description. While we are mostly a remote company, travel is required for some team meetings and cross function projects typically once per month or once per quarter, for some roles like sales or external facing roles travel could be up to 90% of the time. *Cleerly is committed to providing safe and effective medical software that meets customer needs and our intended use. The adherence to all applicable regulatory and statutory requirements establishes a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives. Our commitment to continually improving our products and processes proactively manages risks, ensuring ongoing compliance throughout the entire software lifecycle. Understanding this role's relevance and importance is critical to achieving Cleerly's quality objectives.* **Job Description** We have an immediate opening for a skilled and motivated Support Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting technical issues, developing tools to aid in issue resolution, trending and reporting areas product fragility and opportunities for enhancement, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to assist in bug identification and fixes. This role requires a strong technical background, excellent problem\-solving and communication skills, and the ability to provide top\-tier customer service. You will work closely with our customers and internal teams to ensure the smooth operation of our products and deliver exceptional support in a fast\-paced, high\-impact healthcare environment. **What would I be doing?** You will be troubleshooting complex problems, creating and maintaining diagnostic tools to streamline the support process, and collaborating with software development teams to assist in bug fixes. Your goal is to ensure timely resolution of issues while providing a positive customer experience. This role will interact with our internal Core Lab team, Engineering, IT, Product Management, Customer Support, Implementation and more. On any given day you could be: * Serve as the first point of contact for internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues related to Cleerly products * Analyze system logs, software configurations and monitoring tools, and imaging data to diagnose problems * Identify, replicate, and document software bugs or malfunctions in collaboration with internal teams * Provide prompt and effective assistance via Slack, Zoom, and Jira to our internal teams and occasionally external customers * Deliver clear, step\-by\-step instructions for resolving issues and educating internal users and customers on proper system use * Ensure user satisfaction by resolving issues in a timely manner and escalating critical issues when necessary * Develop and maintain internal tools and scripts to automate troubleshooting processes and improve overall efficiency * Document common issues and solutions to contribute to the internal knowledge base * Work closely with software engineers, product development teams, and quality assurance teams to assist in bug fixes and software updates * Provide detailed bug reports and insights gathered from customer interactions to aid in product improvement * Track, trend, and report potential areas of product fragility or opportunities for product enhancements based on support requests and issues reported * Create and update support documentation, user guides, and FAQs **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field * 3–5 years of experience in a technical support, application support, or sustaining engineering role, preferably in a healthcare or medical technology environment. * Experience with imaging modalities (CT) and related software systems is highly desirable * Proficiency with SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) for data retrieval and troubleshooting. * Familiarity with cloud\-based environments (AWS preferred) and cloud monitoring/logging tools (e.g., Datadog, AWS CloudWatch, Lambda) is a strong plus. * Familiarity with programming/scripting languages (Python, JavaScript, Bash, Typescript, etc.) to develop troubleshooting tools * Comfortable navigating the command line (CLI) and using terminal commands for data manipulation and running scripts. * Basic understanding of medical data formats (e.g., DICOM) is a plus. * Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal * Strong customer service orientation with the ability to manage and de\-escalate high\-pressure situations * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to think critically and troubleshoot complex issues effectively The base salary range for this role varies by location and is aligned to market benchmarks. * Candidates located in **higher\-cost labor markets**, including California, Washington, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts, and Washington, DC represent the middle to high end of the range, while candidates located in **all other U.S. locations** represent the low to middle end of the range. * Final compensation is determined based on location, experience, skills, and internal equity. This role is eligible for a 10**% target annual bonus**, resulting in the following **base salary** and **Total Target Compensation (TTC)** ranges: * **Base Salary:** ***$85,000 \- $99,000*** * Total Target Compensation (TTC): Total Cash Compensation (including base pay, variable pay, commission, bonuses, etc.) Additionally, stock options, paid benefits, and employee perks are part of your total rewards. **Working at Cleerly takes HEART. Discover our Core Values:** * **H: Humility**\- be a servant leader * **E: Excellence**\- deliver world\-changing results * **A: Accountability**\- do what you say; expect the same from others * **R: Remarkable**\- inspire \& innovate with impact * **T: Teamwork**\- together we win Don't meet 100 percent of the qualifications? Apply anyway and help us diversify our candidate pool and workforce. We value experience, whether gained formally or informally on the job or through other experiences. *Job duties, activities and responsibilities are subject to change by our company.* ***OUR COMPANY IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.*** *We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.* For more information see our Privacy Policy (https://cleerlyhealth.com/privacy\-policy). All official emails will come from @cleerlyhealth.com email accounts. *We may share your personal information with third parties for fraud and compliance purposes, including Tofu.* \#Cleerly

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure & Network Engineer / Technical Lead
jobs.description: * **Senior Infrastructure \& Network Engineer / Technical Lead** **Must be able to work onsite in Downtown Sacramento 3 days per week.** **Position Summary** We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Infrastructure \& Network Engineer / Technical Lead** to provide hands\-on technical leadership and engineering support for enterprise infrastructure operations, modernization, security, and network initiatives. The engineer will support day\-to\-day infrastructure operations while also assisting with major initiatives including Windows Server 2019/2022 upgrades, Microsoft Certificate Authority upgrades, enterprise network refreshes, statewide Wi\-Fi deployment, **Palo Alto firewall administration and optimization**, Web Application Firewall implementation, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure security hardening. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on position requiring broad experience across networking, Windows Server, **Palo Alto firewalls**, security, identity/access, encryption, patching, and infrastructure enterprise network infrastructure troubleshooting, maintenance, and upgrades. * Assist with network refresh and modernization projects across multiple locations. * Support implementation and optimization of enterprise wireless/Wi\-Fi infrastructure. * Maintain and patch network and security appliances, including **Palo Alto PAN\-OS firewalls**, in accordance with security and dependencies**. * Review existing operational processes and recommend improvements that reduce technical debt and outstanding support workloads. * Work through prioritized infrastructure tickets, hardening** * Microsoft Front Door Web Application Firewall (WAF) production implementation * Server, firewall, and network vulnerability remediation * Infrastructure security hardening * Disaster recovery and Technology Recovery Plan testing **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise infrastructure, network, or systems engineering. * Strong hands\-on experience administering and troubleshooting Microsoft Windows Server environments. * Strong enterprise networking knowledge including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VLANs, VPNs, firewalls, and wireless networking. * **Hands\-on experience administering Palo Alto Networks firewalls in an enterprise environment.** * Experience with **PAN\-OS**, including security policies, NAT, network zones, objects, services, logging, and troubleshooting. * Experience performing firewall rule administration, cleanup, optimization, troubleshooting, and security reviews. * Experience troubleshooting **site\-to\-site and remote\-access VPN connectivity** and firewall\-related application communication issues. * Experience with Windows Server upgrades, migrations, patching, and services, encryption, and access\-control environments. * Strong understanding of infrastructure security principles and industry security baselines. * Experience producing detailed technical jobs.title: System Planning Engineer 1
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The System Planning Engineer 1 position is pivotal in the strategic planning and design of the gas and electric distribution systems. The System Planning Engineer 1 is responsible for developing a comprehensive five\-year Construction Work Plan and 10\-year load forecast to ensure alignment between system capacity, capital budgets, and anticipated demand. This role designs and assesses infrastructure, conducts detailed system analyses, and ensures compliance with industry standards and regulatory agencies. This position coordinates projects with Engineering, Operations, and Accounting to successfully execute projects involving new gas and electric infrastructure and relocation of facilities. The System Planning Engineering 1 directly contributes to our organizational goal of providing safe, reliable, and economical service by overseeing the budgeting, planning, and implementation of all system improvements and expansions. **Responsibilities** **Primary Position Responsibilities** * Responsible for five\-year Construction Work Plan that specifies system improvements, capital budgets, and schedules that are required to meet the expected demand of the gas and electric distribution systems throughout the planning period. * Prepares 10\-year load forecast for the Construction Work Plan, ERCOT ALDR, and transmission and substation budget. * Designs gas and electric facilities to be placed into the system, including sizing pipe, estimating meter and regulator capacity, calculating pressure and demand requirements for new services, and assessing district regulators. * Determines the size and location of backbone gas and electric equipment using knowledge of infrastructure design and construction. * Reviews designs for new services and advises the proper protective equipment and system configuration that are required to serve the additional load. * Creates engineering models to perform system analyses, including system stability, contingency planning, and load and capacity forecasting. * Performs engineering calculations and analysis, including load flow, pressure drop, Btu factors, system looping, meter and regulator capacities, and reinforcement studies. * Calculates short circuit currents and performs fault current analysis to determine size, setting, and location of protective devices. * Responsible for balancing load between substations to prevent equipment overload and alleviate capacity constraints. * Performs interconnection analyses of motors, DERs, redundant services, and other sensitive loads to identify the impacts to the system. Determines necessary service upgrades and coordinates with project stakeholders. * Applies different statistical analysis techniques to various datasets. * Produces cost estimates on various projects and monitors costs as projects proceed. * Determines easement requirements for infrastructure and coordinates acquisition with the Right Of Way Department. * Collaborates with other engineers, consulting engineering firms, and contractors for the design and construction of city\-gate meter and regulator stations, district laterals, main and service lines, and related facility designs. * Coordinates planned system expansions and improvements from the five\-year construction work plan with project stakeholders. * Manages system power factor to ensure compliance with ERCOT nodal protocols. * Prepares reports related to standard reliability indices to benchmark and prioritize distribution circuits for upgrades. * Coordinates system capacity allocations with customer load estimates and construction schedules from the Business Development Department. * Advises Customer Services and Billing Departments on technical matters concerning energy usage and demand. * Collects field data necessary to maintain system model accuracy. * Develops and maintains a working knowledge of Texas Railroad Commission and Public Utility Commission of Texas regulations and rules, as well as local codes and ordinances. * Develops and maintains working knowledge industry codes, including NFPA, NESC, IEEE, and NEMA. * Complies with established CoServ safety and operating rules, procedures and guidelines including reporting unsafe practices to a supervisor. * Complies with established CoServ Information Security Handbook, policies, procedures, and guidelines including reporting suspected information security incidents to Tech Support. **Secondary Position Responsibilities** * Develops and maintains a thorough knowledge and recognition of construction units, specifications, requirements, and construction practices. * Develops and maintains a thorough knowledge of the equipment specifications for gas and electric infrastructure. * Strives for excellence and process improvement on a consistent basis. * Advise Designers, Staking Techs, and Project Managers with knowledge and understanding of infrastructure design and construction. * Attends industry conferences and trainings to stay abreast of the latest developments related to gas and electric distribution safety, efficiency, and reliability. * Reviews designs, construction records, and inspection reports for accuracy. * Attends regularly scheduled safety meetings and completes monthly online topics. * Attends professional development conferences, webinars and workshops as directed. * Communicates with team members, project stakeholders, Members, and customers in a timely and professional manner. * Attends Business Development and/or Developer appointments as required. * Assures that all safety precautions, procedures, and rules are followed. * Maintains accurate and detailed work records that can be easily referenced. * Maintains company provided tools and equipment in proper working condition. * Operates company vehicles in a safe manner. * Stays informed concerning all development activities within the CoServ service area of interest. * Attends Smith Driving, CPR, and other CoServ required training. * Attends CoServ University required training. * Ability to travel, when necessary for business and training. * Ability to work flexible or extended hours as needed or directed. * Performs other duties and activities as directed. **Position Requirements** **Education, Experience, and Certifications Required** * Bachelor of Science from an ABET accredited university in Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering. **Education, Experience, and Certifications Preferred** * 2 years’ experience in electric utility power distribution. * Engineer In Training certification. **Skills and Abilities Required** * Experience using ESRI and ARC FM mapping software. * Experience using Synergi Gas network modeling software. * Skilled in developing and delivering oral and written presentations. * Ability to work both independently with minimal supervision as well as in teams. * Knowledge of Engineering Analysis software, such as Milsoft WindMil, ETAP, CYME, etc. * Knowledgeable about CIS and MDM systems. * Working knowledge of 16 TAC Part 1 and 49 CFR Part 192 relating to pipeline safety regulations * Ability to work under deadlines and to solve problems effectively. * Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks. * Develop a working knowledge of the company’s service area, distribution system, and system construction. * Develop a working knowledge of Company’s tariff policies, rules, regulations, and procedures. * Have basic skills in the operation and functions of computers including, but not limited to, Windows applications, Excel, Word, Outlook, and Internet Explorer. **Physical Requirements** * Works both in the office, remotely, and field environment. * Ability to lift a minimum of 25 pounds. * Drives company vehicle as needed. * Operates office equipment such as a computer, telephone, fax machine, copier, etc. * Ability to sit for long periods of time. * Works in potentially hazardous conditions caused by pets and wildlife in or near the work site. * Works in areas with possible exposure to poison oak, poison ivy, and insect stings. **Other Requirements** * Must have and maintain a valid Texas driver's license Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Solution Architect (US)
jobs.description: The Machine is the agentic operating system for marketing, built by Code and Theory. It plugs into the tools marketing teams use and turns disconnected workflows into a single intelligent system, connecting brand strategy, creative production, and media performance. The Machine helps power agencies across Stagwell's network and world\-leading brands. As a Solution Architect, you own how The Machine lands inside a customer's environment, from the first technical conversation through production. You assess the client's cloud, data, and security landscape, design the integration architecture, and stay close enough to the build to make sure it works. You are the technical voice customers trust and the person who turns their requirements into a deployment our implementation engineers can execute. You'll spend as much time in working sessions with client DevOps, security, and marketing technology teams as you do in code. Our engineers are AI native and engage in and advance the state of the art in the practice of software development flow with AI. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Lead technical discovery and scoping with enterprise clients, assessing their cloud, data stack, and security perimeter, and turning findings into a clear architecture and deployment plan * Design client environments and integrations across GCP, AWS, or Azure, including infrastructure as code, container orchestration, IAM, and data pipelines that connect client systems to The Machine, with raw data staying inside the client's perimeter * Stay hands\-on through delivery, write code, validate configurations, and work with implementation engineers to debug and unblock critical phases * Own customer relationships through delivery, including the hard conversations about scope, timelines, and tradeoffs * Feed what you learn back into the platform roadmap, and turn each engagement into reusable patterns, runbooks, and playbooks **WHAT YOU'LL NEED** * 7\+ years of engineering experience, including 2\+ years in architecture, solutions, or customer\-facing technical delivery for a software or platform product * Production experience on at least two of GCP, AWS, or Azure, with strong Terraform, Kubernetes, and enterprise API integration skills (OAuth 2\.0, gateways, rate limiting) * Solid security fundamentals, including credential management, container hardening, and data residency * Strong communication skills and a track record of leading technical conversations with enterprise engineering and IT teams * Fluency with AI\-enabled development tools and agent\-driven workflows, with the judgment to review and harden AI\-assisted output; hands\-on experience integrating LLM APIs into production systems is a plus #### **NICE TO HAVE** * Marketing technology experience (DAM, CDP, CRM) and familiarity with tools like Figma, Slack, Adobe, and performance dashboards * Agency, consultancy, or product company background serving multiple enterprise clients at once * Cloud architecture certification (AWS, GCP, or Azure) or pre\-sales/RFP experience **ABOUT US** Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital\-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start\-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic. Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel \& hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok. The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We're always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward\-thinking people to join our team. *The compensation range for this role is $160,000 – $220,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.*

jobs.title: Solution Engineer, Customer Land Team
jobs.description: **What Cognite is** **Relentless****to Achieve** ================================================ Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI and data solutions that solve the world's hardest, highest\-impact problems. Our Moonshot is bold: unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. The Solution Engineer is a hands\-on builder on the Customer Land Team, the dedicated pod that delivers a customer's first project, the Quick Start. jobs.title: Databricks Architect
jobs.description: Confiz is seeking a Databricks Architect in Chicago, IL to lead the data\-layer design and delivery for enterprise AI use cases, serving as the technical authority on the Databricks platform. This role owns the end\-to\-end architecture of the data foundation that powers AI/BI solutions from data discovery and readiness through governed, secure delivery, ensuring every solution aligns with enterprise standards. The Architect explicitly owns security design for the platform, including the Unity Catalog governance model, fine\-grained access controls, and PII handling for natural\-language query experiences. Work Model: Hybrid, 2\-3 days onsite in Chicago, IL **Key Responsibilities** **AI Use Case Data\-Layer Design \& Delivery** * Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of the data layer supporting prioritized AI use cases, from source ingestion through curated, consumption\-ready data products. * Translate AI/BI use case requirements into concrete data models, pipelines, and platform patterns on Databricks (Delta Lake, medallion architecture, streaming and batch ingestion). * Define and enforce data quality, lineage, and observability standards so downstream AI models and natural\-language query experiences operate on trusted data. * Establish reusable reference architectures and design patterns that accelerate delivery across successive use cases. **Data Discovery \& Readiness** * Co\-facilitate live data discovery sessions with the Lead AI/BI Engineer, working directly with business stakeholders and data owners to identify, profile, and validate candidate data sources. * Assess data readiness for each use case — completeness, quality, granularity, latency, and access — and produce clear readiness findings with remediation plans. * Drive resolution of data readiness issues, coordinating with source\-system owners, data engineering teams, and governance stakeholders to close gaps on schedule. * Maintain a data discovery playbook and artifacts (source inventories, profiling results, gap logs) that make each engagement faster than the last. **Databricks Platform Architecture** * Architect the Databricks platform solution — workspace topology, compute strategy, storage layout, networking, and CI/CD — aligned to enterprise standards. * Define environment strategy (dev/test/prod), promotion paths, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices for repeatable, auditable deployments. * Advise on cost optimization, performance tuning, and capacity planning across clusters, SQL warehouses, and serverless compute. * Stay current on the Databricks roadmap (Unity Catalog, Genie/AI\-BI, Delta Sharing, serverless) and guide adoption decisions. **Security Design (Explicit Ownership)** * Own the platform security design end to end, including identity integration, workspace access, secrets management, and network isolation. * Design and implement the Unity Catalog governance model: catalog/schema structure, ownership model, access policies, tagging, and lineage. * Define and implement row\-level and column\-level security, dynamic data masking, and attribute\-based access controls to enforce least\-privilege data access. * Own PII handling for natural\-language query experiences — classification, masking/tokenization strategies, and guardrails that prevent sensitive data exposure through conversational and generative interfaces. * Partner with enterprise security, privacy, and compliance teams to ensure designs satisfy regulatory and audit requirements, and document controls for review. **Collaboration \& Leadership** * Serve as the primary data\-architecture counterpart to the Lead AI/BI Engineer, aligning the data layer with semantic models and AI/BI experiences. * Provide technical direction and design review for data engineers delivering pipelines and data products. * Communicate architecture decisions, trade\-offs, and risks clearly to both technical teams and business stakeholders. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years in data architecture or data engineering, with 3\+ years architecting solutions on Databricks in production environments. * Deep expertise with the Databricks Lakehouse platform: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, workflows/jobs, and medallion architectures. * Demonstrated ownership of data security and governance design, including Unity Catalog governance models, row/column\-level security, and data masking. * Hands\-on experience with PII classification and protection strategies, ideally in the context of AI, natural\-language query, or conversational analytics workloads. * Strong data modeling skills (dimensional, data vault, or domain\-driven data product design) and proficiency in SQL and Python (PySpark). * Experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including networking, identity (e.g., Entra ID/IAM), and storage services. * Proven ability to facilitate discovery workshops and translate ambiguous business needs into actionable data designs. * Experience delivering within enterprise architecture and governance frameworks and standards. **Preferred Qualifications** * Databricks certifications (e.g., Data Engineer Professional, Platform Architect accreditation). * Experience supporting GenAI/LLM or AI\-BI (e.g., Databricks Genie) use cases, including retrieval patterns and semantic layer design. * Familiarity with data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA as applicable) and audit/compliance processes. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform) and CI/CD for Databricks (Asset Bundles, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps). * Background in consulting or multi\-stakeholder delivery environments. **Success Measures** * AI use case data layers delivered on schedule with documented, standards\-aligned architectures. * Data readiness issues identified early and resolved without derailing delivery timelines. * Zero PII exposure incidents through natural\-language query or AI interfaces; security designs passing enterprise security and audit review. * Unity Catalog governance model adopted as the enterprise pattern, with measurable reuse across use cases. We have a global team of amazing individuals working on highly innovative enterprise projects \& products. Our customer base includes Fortune 100 retail and CPG companies, leading store chains, fast growth fintech, and multiple Silicon Valley startups. What makes Confiz stand out is our focus on processes and culture. Confiz is ISO 9001:2015 (QMS), ISO 27001:2022 (ISMS), ISO 20000\-1:2018 (ITSM) and ISO 14001:2015 (EMS) Certified. We have a vibrant culture of learning via collaboration and making workplace fun. People who work with us work with cutting\-edge technologies while contributing success to the company as well as to themselves. To know more about Confiz Limited, visit https://www.linkedin.com/company/confiz/

Qualifications: **What You Bring to the Team*** A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or demonstrable equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining web applications, with substantial hands\-on experience in both frontend and backend development. * Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React, including component design, application state management, asynchronous workflows, and browser fundamentals. * Strong production experience developing backend services and APIs in Python, using frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, Flask, or similar. * Experience with relational databases and SQL, including data modeling, query optimization, transactions, and schema migrations. Familiarity with NoSQL databases is beneficial. * Understanding of distributed application concepts, including service communication, caching, messaging, concurrency, retries, and reliable error recovery. * Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and appropriate use of object\-oriented and other programming approaches. * Experience with automated unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing using tools such as pytest, Jest, React Testing Library, or similar, and familiarity with test\-driven development. * Experience building and deploying Docker containers to a cloud platform such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, code reviews, and monitoring and troubleshooting applications in production. * Understanding of secure software development, including authentication, authorization, and appropriate handling of sensitive information. * Demonstrated ability to lead feature delivery, make sound technical decisions, and balance customer needs, maintainability, performance, and delivery timelines. * Ability to mentor engineers, provide constructive feedback, and contribute effectively to technical interviews. * Practical experience working in Agile teams and collaborating with product, design, and quality engineering partners. * Familiarity with open\-source dependencies, license considerations, and responsible dependency management. * Experience with modern React frameworks, complex interactive applications, or real\-time and event\-driven systems is preferred. * Demonstrated expertise in agentic development lifecycle (ADLC) practices using tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, including task decomposition, context management, agent coordination, and verification of generated code. Experience integrating AI capabilities into software products is a plus. * Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and explain technical decisions clearly. * Sound business ethics, including the protection of proprietary, customer, and confidential information. **Physical Demands and Work Environment** * The physical activities of this position include frequent sitting, telephone communication, and working on a computer for extended periods. jobs.description: Description: Recognized as a Top Workplace in San Diego, we live and work by our core values of integrity, collaboration, innovation, respect, and service. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: At Cotiviti, we are custodians of data for our clients. Using their technical experience in ETL processes, Data Engineers ensure operational functions are occurring as expected. This includes but is not limited to managing data implementations, data production, data quality, and data security. Responsibilities: * Create, maintain and execute basic to intermediate SQL scripts for data management and data validation. * Optimize the queries to improve the efficiency of daily tasks. * Perform data analysis and identify any issues. * Work with other groups such as Engineering team, DBA etc. to troubleshoot and resolve any environmental or network issues that impact your work. Extend your support to after\-hours or weekends as needed. * Create and maintain dashboards as needed. * Validates the tasks results to ensure that all the requirements are met. * Adhere to all the industry level and organization level compliance rules and regulations to maintain data integrity. * Complete individual productivity tracking. * Complete task assignments using department ticketing system within assigned deadline. * Achieve organizational and individual goals as identified in performance reviews and goal setting exercises. * Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting. * Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned. * Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent work experience. * 2\+ years of working knowledge of RDBMS (Oracle, MS SQL, Vertica, etc.) and experience using SQL, PL/SQL or other data integration/ETL tools. * 2\+ years of data analysis. Preferably in the Healthcare industry of enrollment, medical claims and/or pharmacy claims. * Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite applications PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Outlook. * Flexible work schedule. * Experience with project management tools like JIRA. * Strong analytical skills. * Excellent verbal, listening and written communication skills. * Ability to multitask and prioritize projects to meet scheduled deadlines and tight turnaround times. * Ability to work well independently or in a team environment. **Mental Requirements:*** **Critical Thinking:** Analyze problems objectively and make sound, data\-driven decisions. * **Attention to Detail:** Maintain accuracy across code, data, and deliverables. * **Quantitative Skills:** Apply strong analytical and statistical methods to solve problems. * **Data Interpretation:** Extract actionable insights from data, metrics, and visualizations. * **Communication:** Clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * **Learning Agility:** Quickly adopt new tools, technologies, and best practices. * **Resilience:** Adapt to shifting priorities and deliver under pressure. * **Integrity:** Handle data responsibly and uphold engineering and ethical standards. **Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:*** Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods. * Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. * Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area. * Must be able to provide high\-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance. ***Base compensation ranges from $78,000 to $120,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.*** ***Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17\-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our*** ***Careers page.*** ***This role is based remotely and all interviews will be conducted virtually.*** Date of posting: 10/9/2026 Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 12/9/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. \#LI\-REMOTE

Applications received after this date will be considered on an as needed basis until the position is filled.** Be part of a team that is committed to promoting innovative technology that transforms government and its ability to service constituents.
