jobs.title: Systems Engineer I
jobs.description: **About Courser** Courser accelerates the growth of IT service provider companies. We forge dynamic partnerships, leveraging our values of Teamwork, Service, Growth\-Mindedness, Trust, and Innovation to deliver impactful solutions and phenomenal customer experiences. If you thrive in a fast\-paced IT environment, join our rapidly expanding team and contribute to our ongoing success. **Systems Engineer I** A Systems Engineer I is a professional responsible for managing and supporting the IT infrastructure of client organizations within a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment. Their primary role is to ensure the efficient, secure, and reliable operation of systems and networks, provide technical support, and implement solutions that improve the client’s IT environment. The role typically involves working with a wide range of technologies, from networking and servers to security systems and cloud services. **Key Responsibilities:** * Provide technical support for client systems, responding to incidents and resolving issues related to hardware, software, networking, and security. * Offer solutions to complex IT challenges, ensuring high availability and system performance. * Install, configure, and maintain IT infrastructure, including servers, workstations, networks, and software applications for client organizations. * Assist with or lead technical projects, such as server migrations, network upgrades, new software implementations, or cloud integrations. * Deploy, configure, and manage operating systems (Windows Server, Linux, etc.), virtualization technologies, and cloud services. * Monitor and maintain servers, network devices, and other IT infrastructure components. * Ensure the optimal performance and uptime of client networks by configuring routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and other networking equipment. * Troubleshoot and resolve network and server issues, such as connectivity problems, latency, or hardware failures. * Implement security best practices, including firewall configurations, antivirus solutions, encryption, and secure authentication mechanisms. * Manage vulnerability assessments, patch management, and intrusion detection/prevention systems. * Assist in disaster recovery planning and business continuity strategies to minimize downtime during outages. * Serve as an escalation point for complex issues that require in\-depth technical knowledge. * Monitor the health and performance of client networks and systems using monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, SolarWinds, Datto). * Optimize system performance through regular maintenance, updates, and improvements. * Proactively identify potential issues and take corrective actions to prevent system failures or performance degradation. * Support and manage client cloud services (e.g., Microsoft 365, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and virtualized environments (e.g., VMware, Hyper\-V). * Assist with cloud migrations, configuration, backup, and restore processes. * Ensure the smooth operation of virtual machines, storage, and network configurations in cloud environments. * Configure and manage backup solutions for client environments to ensure business continuity. * Maintain detailed documentation of client systems, networks, configurations, and service tickets. * Provide periodic reports on system performance, uptime, security status, and any incidents or issues addressed. * Create and update SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for common systems and services. * Build strong relationships with clients by understanding their needs and providing timely technical solutions. * Communicate technical information in an accessible and understandable way to non\-technical stakeholders. * Participate in regular meetings with clients to discuss IT needs, challenges, and opportunities for improvement. * Manage project timelines, resources, and communication to ensure successful and timely project delivery. * Work closely with other engineers, technicians, and support teams to resolve client issues and implement solutions. * Collaborate with account managers to ensure client satisfaction and effective service delivery. * Occasional travel to customer locations may be required to support on\-site projects, implementations, or issue resolution. **Key Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 2\-4 years of experience in systems engineering, IT infrastructure, or a related field, with a strong understanding of system architecture and design principles. * Proficiency in operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux) and virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper\-V). * Strong knowledge of networking concepts, protocols, and security practices (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN). * Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and automation tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform) is a plus. * Excellent problem\-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex systems and propose effective solutions. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of collaborating effectively with team members and stakeholders. **Preferred Experience:** * Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA Server\+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, AWS Certified Solutions Architect) are advantageous. * Experience with scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation tasks. * Familiarity with database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, MySQL) and data backup and recovery solutions. **Why you’ll love working here** At COURSER, we prioritize the personal and professional development of our employees. We offer best\-in\-class training, mentorship, and clear self\-promotion paths to help you grow. We foster a culture of innovation and encourage challenging the status quo. With teams located across the country, we leverage a wealth of knowledge and a collaborative spirit, eager to share and grow together. **Benefit Highlights** * Competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance * 401k match * Unlimited vacation time\* * Paid sick time * 10 Holidays including your Birthday and a Floating Holiday! * Healthy Lifestyle reimbursement * Amazon Prime reimbursement * 40 Hours for Volunteer Time * Paid parental leave * Reimbursement for ongoing education and certifications * Learning and development programs * *Unlimited vacation time after completing one full year of employment. For the first year of employment, full\-time* *team members are provided 10 vacation days.* Courses is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We support diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, caregiver status, veteran status, uniformed service member status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description: We're partnering with a well established asset management firm, headquartered in Toronto. They operate across private equity, real estate, private credit and venture capital. With $45b in AUM and growing, this is an exciting time to join a progressive forward looking organisation. **Staff Platform Engineer** You will own the shared platform that every AI product and agent runs on. Our client is a multi\-strategy alternative asset manager. The AI \& Data team builds AI products for teams across the firm, from fundraising and finance to investing. Your job is to build the platform those products run on. You report to the Director of Engineering and are based in Toronto. **What You'll Own** ------------------- * **Data access and controls.** Identity, authorization and audit for every app, MCP server and agent, so people and agents reach only the data they are entitled to. * **Context layer.** A governed layer that turns the firm's knowledge, from relationship data to investment memos, data rooms and past deals, into context and memory that products and agents can use, within our retention obligations. * **Agent runtime.** The shared foundation for agents: a shared registry of tools and skills, human approval for consequential actions, and the patterns teams use to ship agents. * **Evals and observability.** How we measure quality, trace behaviour and gate releases across AI products. * **Shared services.** Capabilities every product needs, such as notifications, shared UI components, and cost and model efficiency. * **Developer experience.** Paved paths so every new product starts on the platform by default and developer token efficiency. **How They Build** ------------------ * Decisions that are hard to reverse go through a written RFC and design review. * They buy or adopt open source where the problem is a commodity, and build only what is specific to the firm. * Agentic SDLC is the default. You use coding agents every day and raise the bar for how the team builds with them. * You work with the security team from the start of every project. * They move fast and focus on what delivers value, with a high bar on quality and no overengineering. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 7\+ years building production backend or platform systems including shared infrastructure other teams depend on and that you have kept reliable at scale. * Production experience on GCP or another major cloud: serverless compute, managed data warehouses, IAM, encryption key management. * Design experience in identity and authorization: OAuth and OIDC, service identity, delegated access, and policy engines such as Cerbos, OpenFGA, OPA or Cedar. * LLM or agent systems shipped to production, including retrieval and knowledge systems, tool use and evals. * Sound build\-vs\-buy judgment and clear technical writing, with RFCs that others can make decisions from. * You act like an owner and stay pragmatic when things are uncertain. **Nice To Have** ---------------- * Experience in regulated financial services, such as SEC record\-keeping or SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls. * Building sandboxed execution for agents, or feedback loops that improve AI quality over time. Click **'Apply Now'** to submit your resume or send directly to **richard.riddett@cpl.ie** \#LI\-RR1

jobs.title: Jr. Forward Deployed Software Engineer - (PA)
jobs.description: By joining our team as a Jr. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will serve as a key member of our Data and AI Solutions team and partner with our customers to understand their most complex challenges and design and implement tailored solutions. You will bring your problem\-solving ability, creativity, and technical expertise to help organizations put their data to work, solve critical business challenges, and drive meaningful impact. In this role, you’ll own end\-to\-end execution of high\-impact projects while working across industries to solve complex, real\-world problems. As an Jr. FDE, you will take ownership of projects from concept through implementation, working in small teams to deliver tailored technical solutions. Your work may span designing technical architecture, working with large\-scale datasets, developing custom applications, collaborating with customer executives, and contributing to team strategy. ### **What You'll Do:** * Work directly with clients to understand their most pressing problems and design and implement data\-driven solutions to address them. * Work in small teams with minimal supervision, taking ownership of high\-impact projects from planning through implementation. * Discuss architecture with fellow engineers and establish strategy for your team. * Wrangle massive\-scale data and code custom web applications to deliver client solutions. * Speak with client executives to share progress, gather input, and align on priorities. * Collaborate internally with colleagues from a variety of backgrounds, including other FDEs, product teams, and strategy teams. * Work externally with clients, often on site, to understand and tackle their priorities. ### **What You’ll Bring:** * Ability to learn continuously, work independently, and make decisions with minimal direction. * Ability to collaborate in teams of technical and non\-technical individuals, and comfort working in a constantly evolving environment with dynamic objectives and iterative work with users. * An eagerness to creatively solve technical problems using data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front\-end frameworks, and other technical tools. * Interest in working with and using large\-scale data to solve valuable business problems. * Willingness and interest to travel as needed to client sites; travel of 25\-50% is expected, though requirements vary by team and location. ### **Qualifications:** * Degree completed by January 2027 preferably in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science. *May/June 2027 grads* *will not* *be considered for this role* * 0\-2 years of professional experience in engineering or technical roles * Advanced skills with one or more programming languages, such as Python, Java, C\+\+, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar. * **Anticipated start date:** January 2027\. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and available for full\-time employment, including required travel, as of their assigned January/February 2027 start date. This position is not eligible for employer\-sponsored work authorization, either at the time of hire or thereafter. The employer also does not provide employer participation or documentation required for STEM OPT extensions for this position. For applicants located in Pennsylvania, CrossCountry Consulting is required to include an estimate of the compensation range for this role. The following range takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to, skills, experience, education, licenses, certifications, business needs, and internal equity. An estimate of the current range is $90,000 \- $125,000 per year \+ annual bonus \+ additional benefits. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Use approved AI tools, with guidance, to improve the speed and quality of research, troubleshooting, and case documentation. * **Requirements** *Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:* * Excellent customer service skills * Ability to communicate and understand technical language * Strong interpersonal and communications skills * Problem solving capability * Collaborative team player * Ability to prioritize, manage time effectively and multitask * Technical aptitude and the ability to learn new software quickly * Demonstrated willingness and ability to use AI tools, with guidance, to improve the speed and quality of case resolution and documentation * Must comply with and pass initial background check and drug screening, as well as subsequent background checks, drug screenings and vaccine requirements as required by customer contracts * Ability to follow DI’s policies, procedures, and system usage practices * Must have unrestricted work authorization in the United States Available for up to 10% travel as needed * **Preferred skills and experience** In addition to the above requirements, the ideal employee/candidate will have experience with the following: * LIS (laboratory information system) software exposure * Familiarity with incident management, knowledgebase, and defect and escalation management practices Experience integrating AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving * **Education and/or Experience** Bachelor’s degree, OR a combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and skills are acquired. **Physical Requirements/Working Conditions:** Ability to remain in a stationary position (e.g., seated at a desk) for extended periods during the workday. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** -------------------- Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll be the technical lead for our Consent product, which shapes how people experience privacy on our customers' websites and apps. Reporting to the VP of engineering, you'll own Consent's architecture across a Ruby on Rails, React, and AWS stack and ship consent experiences that are fast, reliable, and easy for customers to deploy, and you'll help shape how our engineering team continues to advance adoption of AI tooling. Claude Code is part of how we work every day, and you'll set the workflows, standards, and guardrails that help the whole team move faster without lowering the bar on quality or security. In a year, you'll be able to point to products you helped launch and to an engineering practice you helped define. This is a chance to show what AI\-native engineering looks like at a company where getting trust and privacy right is the product. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Serve as technical advisor and architect for the Consent platform, setting the long\-term vision and reviewing significant design decisions across runtime, ingestion, analytics, web and mobile SDKs, supply\-chain controls, and regulatory frameworks like Google CMP and IAB TCF. * Set the architectural bar for how DataGrail exposes its platform to AI agents, from external tools like Claude, Codex, and Cursor to our own internal agents, owning authentication and authorization, agent\-facing tool patterns, safety annotations, observability, and rollback paths. * Drive solutions to complex, ambiguous problems that span multiple teams, establishing patterns and frameworks others can build on. * Build with Claude Code every day and set the standard for how the team plans, writes, tests, and reviews code with AI. * Establish shared AI engineering workflows, including project context files, reusable skills and commands, MCP integrations, and guardrails for security and sensitive data. * Mentor engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing, helping them get more out of AI tools while keeping quality high. * Partner with your VP of Engineering and Product Manager to scope milestone\-based plans and lead delivery of new features. * Partner with Staff Engineers across teams to shape our engineering principles and technical direction. * Provide hands\-on guidance on the highest\-leverage problems and lead resolution of high\-severity issues as part of the on\-call rotation. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Deep full stack experience building and operating production systems with Ruby on Rails, React with TypeScript, and Postgres or similar databases, including performant JavaScript that runs in the browser. * Hands\-on experience running services on AWS, with a strong grasp of scalability, reliability, and observability. * A track record of driving architecture for complex, cross\-team problems and seeing them through to delivery. * Daily, hands\-on experience shipping production code with Claude Code or a comparable agentic coding tool, and concrete examples of how it changed the way you work. * Experience building custom Claude Code skills, subagents, hooks, or MCP servers, or running AI agents in CI/CD. * Strong judgment about AI\-generated code, including how to give agents the right context, verify their output, and catch the correctness and security issues they introduce. * Experience raising the bar for a team through mentorship, technical standards, or tooling others adopted. * Clear written and verbal communication in a remote environment, including flagging cross\-team risks early and driving issues to resolution. ### **Bonus Points** * Familiarity with consent management, cookies and tracking technologies, or privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and CPRA. * Experience building LLM\-powered product features. * Familiarity with GitHub Actions and Terraform. * Experience with Python or similar languages. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- ### **Within 90 Days You'll:** * Ship your first Consent features end\-to\-end with Claude Code while learning our product, customers, architecture, and deployment process. * Bring cross\-domain universal consent to general availability. * Build cross\-device universal consent so every platform stays in sync and is treated as a first\-class experience. ### **Within 180 Days You'll:** * Lead the design and delivery of universal consent for TV and connected devices. * Reduce friction in how customers onboard and deploy Consent. * Build tooling and education that help engineers, Customer Success, and Solutions Architects self\-serve on Consent. * Help lead resolution of high\-severity issues as part of the on\-call rotation. ### **Within 365 Days You'll:** * Play a lead technical role in launching major new Consent capabilities. * Help grow AI tooling and adoption across the engineering team. * Mentor engineers and serve as the go\-to technical expert for Consent. Please note that the base compensation range below is a guideline and the final compensation will be based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, and competencies. Our compensation ranges apply to all US\-based job postings regardless of state. All full\-time regular employees are eligible for equity, health, dental \& vision insurance plans, remote\-first working environment, 401k savings plan, parental leave, wellness benefits, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a work from home stipend. Benefits are subject to change. Compensation Range $205,000 \- $240,000 USD **About Us:** ------------- DataGrail is the Agentic Data Privacy Platform. We help the world’s leading brands such as HubSpot, FanDuel, Dexcom, Major League Soccer, and Okta automate privacy and control risk with secure, human\-governed AI that scales. Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500\+ integrations and no\-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. DataGrail is rated 4\.8/5 stars on G2 and is a two\-time recognized privacy leader by IDC. *DataGrail provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a seed\-stage startup in New York City building a data marketplace, starting with alternative data for financial markets. The company is working closely with a group of design partners in the trading industry to launch its first data products. ### **About the Role** You'll join as a senior individual contributor for the first 6 to 12 months, reporting directly to the founder, with a clear path to tech lead as the team grows. This role is in person at the New York office, 5 days a week. ### **What You'll Own** * Build reliable data pipelines that turn web sources into high\-quality data feeds for trading customers * Build the trust and security layer that lets buyers verify data and keeps it private during evaluation, using modern confidential\-computing techniques * Shape core infrastructure from early on: cloud setup, Postgres architecture, and deployment * Ship LLM and agent features (inference only) that help buyers and sellers communicate on the marketplace * Work directly with design partners to scope and ship their first data feeds ### **Key Details** * **Location:** New York City, NY (in\-person, 5 days a week) * **Employment:** Full\-time * **Level:** Senior IC, with a path to tech lead * **Salary:** $150,000 – $215,000 USD per year * **Equity:** 0\.5% – 2\.5%, on top of cash * **Visa Sponsorship:** Not available ### **Benefits \& Perks** * 0\.5% – 2\.5% equity * Health insurance * Commuter benefits * Tech equipment * Gym stipend

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a pre\-seed fintech startup in San Francisco building payments and identity infrastructure for AI agents, so agents can transact with businesses safely on behalf of the people they act for. The company serves agent platforms, businesses that want to sell to agents, and end users. It is a small team with engineers from leading payments and big tech companies, and it plans to grow the team significantly over the coming months. ### **About the Role** As the Founding Product Engineer (Forward Deployed), you will be the engineer customers know by name. The split is roughly 60% building and 40% in front of customers: integration calls, live demos at events, and onboarding a customer or vendor on your own, including going into their office. Travel is mostly within the Bay Area, with about 10% outside it. This role is in person at the San Francisco office, roughly 6 days a week, with some weekend flexibility. ### **What You'll Do** * Own customer integrations from first call to live transactions: embed with their engineers, write the glue, and debug edge cases on both sides * Build features on the core user\-facing products to enterprise quality * Own developer experience: docs, quickstarts, and reference integrations that help customers use the company's APIs and SDKs, with time to first transaction as your metric * Build demos and pilots real enough to run in production * Turn repeated customer requests into roadmap items with evidence ### **Key Details** * **Location:** San Francisco, CA (in\-person, roughly 6 days a week, with weekend flexibility) * **Travel:** Mostly within the Bay Area; about 10% outside it * **Employment:** Full\-time * **Salary:** $140,000 – $300,000 USD per year, plus competitive equity * **Visa Sponsorship:** O\-1, OPT ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Competitive equity * Meals * Health, dental, and vision insurance ### **Required Candidate Questions** Please include answers to the following questions with your application: * Something you've built, run, or launched that you're proud of: a link or short description, and what you were responsible for. * Which area of this role would you most want to own, and why?

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a Series A physical AI company in San Francisco. The company combines hardware sensing with AI to help customers understand what is happening in the physical world, with the longer\-term goal of automating it. ### **About the Role** You will build the product that makes physical AI useful: interfaces that turn complex, real\-time sensor information into something people can understand and act on. You'll join the observability team as a full\-stack engineer. This role is based at the San Francisco office. ### **What You'll Own** * Own features end to end, from data model and API through a fast, polished UI * Work directly with customers, deployment strategy, and software teammates to decide what to build, then carry it into production * Make the experience trustworthy: design for real\-time data, clear permissions, and safe releases * Learn where customers get stuck and turn that friction into the next improvement ### **Key Details** * **Location:** San Francisco, CA (in\-person) * **Employment:** Full\-time * **Team:** Observability * **Salary:** $180,000 – $220,000 USD per year, plus competitive equity * **Visa Sponsorship:** Available (H\-1B, O\-1, OPT) ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Competitive equity * Health insurance, with dental and vision fully paid

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a well\-funded AI startup in New York City automating accounting and the financial close. Backed by top\-tier venture investors and experienced finance leaders, the company has grown quickly and is expanding from finance automation into accounting and strategic finance. Customers see meaningfully faster month\-end closes and much less manual finance work. The founding team brings deep enterprise software experience working with large organizations. ### **About the Role** You'll do backend\-heavy engineering, building AI agents for the accounting domain. You'll own one finance module end to end with a pod of 2 to 3 engineers, and you may lead that pod. This role is in person at the New York City office, 5 days a week. ### **What You'll Own** * The agents behind your module and the product around them, with decisions across the LLM pipeline, infrastructure, backend, and UX * Verification, guardrails, observability, and evaluation for non\-deterministic AI, so finance teams and auditors can trust the agents * The financial context your agents work from: transactions, ledgers, contracts, policies, and historical decisions * Ingesting, normalizing, and reconciling data from ERPs, banks, payroll, billing platforms, CRMs, and email * Long\-running, replay\-safe workflows across stateful enterprise systems, and idempotent, audit\-ready writebacks to systems of record * Time with controllers, accountants, and CFOs to learn their workflows before you build the system that replaces the manual process * Full\-stack work when the problem calls for it ### **How You'll Grow** * Every engineer is an individual contributor. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Platform
jobs.description: **About E2B** ============= E2B is a fast\-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 9\-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish. **About the role** ================== E2B has started billions of Firecracker sandboxes across regions on Google Cloud, AWS and Azure, for customers whose products stop when our sandboxes do. Reliability here is an engineering problem: the fixes for our hardest incidents land in code, not in configuration. Your job will be to build the reliability of the platform: defining what healthy means, building the observability and automation that keep it there, and making new capabilities work reliably in production. You'll work closely with our infrastructure and systems engineers, who build the platform, and with our sandbox team in Prague. Responsibilities include: * Defining SLOs and error budgets for the platform's core paths, such as sandbox start, resume and connect, and making them part of how we alert, release and prioritize * Building the observability and alerting that tells us the platform is healthy before customers do * Taking new platform capabilities from first release to working reliably in production * Building the automation that removes operational work, from release checks to routine fleet operations * Building the security and trust layers the platform's reliability depends on, such as service\-to\-service mutual TLS * Making our private cloud and enterprise deployments as reliable as our own regions * Running incident response, and improving how we handle incidents so a class of failure does not come back * Being on call, and helping shape the rotation for the rest of the platform team This role requires a high amount of ownership. You'll write the code and the design docs for the hardest changes in your area, and ship every day. If words like SLOs, error budgets, eBPF, Kubernetes, multi\-region, or noisy neighbor problem sound exciting rather than scary, we want to hear from you! **What we're looking for** ========================== * Experience operating large\-scale distributed systems in production across regions, and making their reliability measurable * Strong Go (Rust or C/C\+\+ also welcome): you take ownership of the services you build and proactively fix issues across the codebase, including in services you didn't originally write * Reliability engineering: you've defined SLOs and error budgets for a production service and held the platform to them * Incident response: you've been on call, fixed what paged you, and written post\-incident reviews that led to lasting fixes * Experience operating Kubernetes in production * Infrastructure as code and GitOps, for example Terraform and Argo CD, with deep experience on at least one of GCP, AWS or Azure; we run on all three, and you don't need to know them all * Solid Linux and networking fundamentals: enough to debug a host under load and reason about DNS, TCP and L4/L7 load balancing * Operating relational databases and caches in production, including performance diagnosis * Excited to work in person from San Francisco * Comfortable with our code and infrastructure being public We expect this experience will often come from around five or more years of relevant work, but the depth of what you've built matters more than a specific number. **Bonus points for:** ===================== * Running observability pipelines at scale, for example Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry * Kernel tracing and eBPF tooling * Capacity planning and cost efficiency across clouds * Chaos engineering or deterministic simulation testing * Familiarity with Firecracker, KVM or how VM workloads behave on shared hosts * Contributions to CNCF or similar open source projects **What it’s like to work at E2B** ================================= We’re a fast\-growing startup with in\-person (4 days on\-site, 1 day WFH) offices in **San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic**. We already generate 9\-figure revenue and work directly with top\-tier AI companies like Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, Artificial Analysis and other exciting teams pushing the frontier of AI. We offer healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, 401k, and a variety of perks for in\-office employees. Compensation Range: $250K \- $350K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Systems
jobs.description: **About E2B** ============= E2B is a fast\-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 9\-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish. **About the role** ================== E2B has started billions of Firecracker sandboxes across regions on Google Cloud, AWS and Azure. Every sandbox is a real virtual machine that has to start in well under a second, resume from a snapshot on a different host, and share a host with up to about 200 others without noticing them. Your job will be to build and own the Go service on every host that creates, pauses, resumes and tears down sandboxes, along with the Linux underneath it: host networking, memory and isolation. You'll work closely with our sandbox team in Prague, who own the Firecracker runtime, the guest kernel, sandbox storage and live migration, and with our infrastructure engineers, who put the platform together. We're hiring more than one engineer into this role, each with a different focus: some go deepest on Linux and how sandboxes run on the host, others on sandbox networking. Our runtime is open source at github.com/e2b\-dev/runtime, and the sandbox package is a good place to see what you'd work on. Responsibilities include: * Making sandboxes start fast and keeping them fast as the fleet grows to millions and later billions of sandboxes, with starts under 200ms * Evolving the architecture of the software that runs sandboxes on every host, so it can change without disrupting them * Making the sandbox lifecycle reliable under failure, so no sandbox is leaked or lost when a process or host dies * Keeping the host OS and kernel current across the fleet, rolling out upgrades without disrupting running sandboxes * Building the sandbox network: isolation, egress control and addressing for untrusted workloads * Enforcing resource isolation between sandboxes on shared hosts, so every sandbox gets the CPU, memory and I/O it was allocated * Building host\-level observability, so we understand what every sandbox costs the host it runs on * Being on call for the platform you build, alongside the rest of the platform team This role requires a high amount of ownership. You'll write the code and the design docs for the hardest changes in your area, and ship every day. If you aren't afraid of going deep into the Linux kernel when a problem needs it, and words like eBPF, cgroups, network namespaces, nftables, conntrack, or noisy neighbor problem sound exciting to you, we want to hear from you! **What we're looking for** ========================== * Experience building and operating systems software across a large production fleet: node agents, container or VM runtimes, schedulers, or similar * Strong Go, or strong Rust or C/C\+\+ and the willingness to pick up Go quickly; our services are in Go * Deep Linux knowledge: processes, CPU scheduling, memory management, cgroups and namespaces, and the network stack * Experience making software correct under failure: crash recovery, reconciling recorded state with what is actually running, and cleanup when a process or host dies * For a networking focus: Linux networking for multi\-tenant workloads, such as network namespaces, virtual interfaces, iptables/nftables and egress control * A performance mindset: you've shaved milliseconds off hot paths, profiled production systems under load, and treat p99 as a number you own * Excited to work in person from San Francisco * Comfortable with our code and infrastructure being public We expect this experience will often come from around five or more years of relevant work, but the depth of what you've built matters more than a specific number. **Bonus points for:** ===================== * Experience with VM or container runtimes such as Firecracker, KVM, gVisor or runc, including memory management and snapshot and restore * GPU or accelerator infrastructure, passthrough or GPU\-as\-a\-service * Kernel tracing and eBPF tooling * OS\-level hardening, such as seccomp and Linux security modules * Running workloads on Kubernetes, which our fleet runs on * Contributions to the Linux kernel, Firecracker, CNCF or similar open source projects **What it’s like to work at E2B** ================================= We’re a fast\-growing startup with in\-person (4 days on\-site, 1 day WFH) offices in **San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic**. We already generate 9\-figure revenue and work directly with top\-tier AI companies like Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, Artificial Analysis and other exciting teams pushing the frontier of AI. We offer healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, 401k, and a variety of perks for in\-office employees. Compensation Range: $250K \- $350K

jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist - Center for Responsible AI for Learning and Assessment
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Shift: First Shift **About ETS:** ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future\-ready. For more than 80 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, ACT solidifies our impact in higher Ed and Workskills while Edusoft enhances our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide. Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide. The ETS Research Institute's Center for Responsible AI for Learning and Assessment studies how AI can improve learning and assessment, and how we can validly measure what a person knows and can do when AI is part of the learning, the task, or the scoring. The Center's research includes AI\-enabled interactive assessments, the measurement of AI literacy, personalized assessment, and the responsible use of AI in scoring and test development. Our scientists include learning scientists, cognitive psychologists, statisticians, psychometricians, computational linguists, and research engineers. We are seeking a colleague whose expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, or statistics will complement theirs. We welcome applicants from a wide range of quantitative fields. Areas of particular interest include, but are not limited to, the following: * **AI for learning and assessment:** developing AI systems such as tutors, feedback tools, and conversational agents, with attention to how well they work and for whom. * **Evaluations and benchmarks of AI in education:** methods for evaluating AI systems used in teaching, learning, and assessment, including benchmark design, validation of automated judgments against human ratings, and analyses of reliability and fairness. * **Causal evidence and statistics:** experimental, quasi\-experimental, and statistical methods that estimate the effects of AI tools on learners and teachers, or that strengthen inferences from complex data. We do not expect applicants to work in all of these areas, and we encourage applications from people whose work in AI, machine learning, or statistics connects to learning and assessment in other ways. **Primary responsibilities** * Conduct and publish rigorous research on AI in learning and assessment, drawing on methods from machine learning, statistics, and measurement. * Collaborate with learning scientists, psychometricians, and research engineers on projects across the Center, contributing AI and statistical expertise to study design, analysis, and evaluation. * Contribute to the development and evaluation of AI\-enabled tools and assessments, including studies of how well they work in practice. * Participate in proposal development for federal, foundation, and philanthropic funding, and help build partnerships with universities and research organizations. * Mentor postdoctoral fellows, junior staff, and interns. * Share findings through peer\-reviewed publications, conference presentations, technical reports, and formats suited to practitioners and other non\-technical audiences. in the lab or at customer sites. * Collaborates with cross functional teams within US and in EMEA and APAC **This role could be the next step in your career if you demonstrate the following development. * Proven experience with high power electrical equipment testing. * Proven experience of safety requirements in high power electrical lab test environment. * Hands\-on working experience of typical power electronics measuring systems and applications such as oscilloscopes, power meters, surge testers, environmental chambers and data acquisition equipment. **You will set yourself apart accreditation NRTL agencies (like UL, INTERTEK, TUV) with electrical focus or, leading a company regulatory compliance program for power electronics. * Experience with power utility and/or with high power equipment at 480Vac 15KVA. * Knowledge of UPS, Power Conversion Equipment, and electrical distribution equipment safety and legal requirements. **Position Success Criteria:** standards and for regulatory compliance for products being manufactured in Eaton factories * Performs work with a sense of urgency and high attention to detail. * Communication \- discuss technical concepts and information to internal staff/peers and stakeholders, strong verbal and written documentation, and interpersonal communication skills. * Ability to demonstrate process management and figure out processes necessary to get things done. * Experience working with contractors and suppliers for test facilities, including commissioning and implementation of equipment * Ability to **Required Qualifications:** * Must have Bachelor of Science in Chemical, Mechanical Engineering * Must have at least 5 plus years of relevant industry experience. * Must have excellent written and jobs.title: New Grad - Engineering
jobs.description: **Join the Sleep Fitness Movement** ----------------------------------- At Eight Sleep, we’re on a mission to fuel human potential through optimal sleep. As the world’s first sleep fitness company, we’re redefining what it means to be well\-rested and building the most advanced hardware, software, and AI technology to make it possible. Our products power peak mental, physical, and emotional performance by transforming every night of sleep into a personalized, data\-driven recovery experience. We are trusted by high performers, professional athletes, and health\-conscious consumers in over 30 countries worldwide. Recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2019, 2022, and 2023, and twice named to TIME's “Best Inventions of the Year.” We operate like a high\-performance team: fast, focused, and motivated by impact. We don’t just ship; we iterate, refine, and obsess over the details that help our members sleep better and wake up stronger. Every role at Eight Sleep is a chance to create cutting\-edge technology, collaborate with world\-class talent, and help shape a future where sleep isn’t passive \- it’s a powerful tool for living better. If you’re tired of the ordinary and driven to build at the edge of what’s possible, this is your moment. Join us and lead the movement that’s transforming how the world sleeps and what we’re all capable of when we wake up. **High Standards. No Apologies.** --------------------------------- We operate with intensity because our mission demands it. At Eight Sleep, we bring the same mindset as the world’s top performers: focused, relentless, and always pushing to be in the top 1% of our craft. Think Kobe Bryant’s mamba mentality, applied to bold ideas, next\-gen tech, and flawless execution. This isn’t a 9\-to\-5\. Our team is deeply committed, often putting in 60\+ hours a week –not because we’re told to, but because we’re invested. We’re here to build fast, push limits, and deliver without compromise. If you thrive under pressure and want to do the most meaningful work of your career, you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for something easier –this isn’t it. **The Opportunity** ------------------- This is a general application for new graduates with an engineering background who want to start their career at Eight Sleep. We don't always have the perfect role posted at the perfect moment \- but we're always looking for exceptional people. If you believe you belong on this team, don't wait for the right opening to appear: tell us who you are, what you've built, and where you can make an impact. We hire new grad engineers across our hardware and software stack: software engineering (mobile, backend, web), firmware and embedded systems, hardware, and data and machine learning. In your application, tell us which area excites you most, or make the case for something we haven’t thought of. Whatever the function, the deal is the same: you'll own real work from day one. You won't be shadowing. You'll be shipping work that reaches members in over 30 countries, side by side with some of the best talent in the world, and learning from them every day. We're looking for hungry, proactive new graduates at the start of their career who treat their work like a craft, hold a high bar for quality, and thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment. **How you’ll contribute** ------------------------- * Own real projects from your first weeks, from first draft or prototype to shipped result \- no busywork, no waiting your turn * Move across the boundaries of your role: work with engineers, designers, operators, and marketers to get things over the line * Use AI tools to move faster: prototype quickly, automate the boring parts, and raise the bar on what one person can ship * Own problems, not just tickets: dig into the data, find the root cause, and follow through until the fix is live * Keep the quality bar high in everything you touch, from the details members see to the processes behind them * Bring ideas, not just execution: if you see a better way to do something, make the case and build it **What you need to succeed** ---------------------------- * Graduated in the last 12 months or graduating soon, with a strong academic record in your field * Evidence of initiative: side projects, open\-source contributions, hackathon wins, a startup you tried, a club you ran \- anything you built or led because you couldn't not do it * A high bar for quality: you notice the details others miss and you're not satisfied with "good enough" * Comfort using AI in your daily workflow: you use tools like Claude, Cursor, or ChatGPT to work faster and better, and you know when to trust them and when not to * A fast learner who thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment and asks for responsibility, not permission * English fluency * Legally authorized to work in the EU (for our Milan office) or the US (for our SF, NYC and Boston offices) * In your application, tell us the area where you'd have the most impact and show us the best thing you've ever made **Bonus points for** -------------------- * You're a builder: you've won hackathons, ship side projects for fun, or are active in student organizations (tech clubs, robotics teams, startup societies, student media) * Something live in the world we can try: an app on the App Store or Play Store, a website, a product, a community, a publication (include the link in your application) * Internship or working\-student experience at a startup or high\-performance team * A passion for health, sleep, fitness, or consumer hardware products * You already use the Pod, or you can tell us exactly why you want to **Why join Eight Sleep?** ------------------------- **Innovation in a culture of excellence** Join us in a workplace where innovation isn’t just encouraged \- it’s a standard. Our flagship product, the Pod, is a testament to our culture of excellence, beloved by hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Eight Sleep, you will be part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of technology in sleep fitness. **Immediate responsibility and accelerated career growth** From your first day, you’ll take on substantial responsibilities that have a direct impact on our core business and product success. We are a small team that empowers you to own your projects and see the tangible effects of your efforts, enhancing both your professional growth and our company’s trajectory. Your path will be challenging but rewarding, perfect for those who thrive in fast\-paced environments aiming for high standards. **Collaboration with exceptional talent** Work alongside other bright minds like you: at Eight Sleep exceptional intelligence and a passion for breakthroughs are the norms. Our team members are not only experts in their fields but also avid innovators who thrive in our dynamic, fast\-paced environment. **Equitable compensation and continuous equity investment** We extend equity participation to every full\-time team member, recognizing and rewarding your direct contributions to our success. This includes periodic equity refreshments based on performance, ensuring that as Eight Sleep grows and succeeds, so do you – perfectly aligning your achievements with the broader triumphs of the company. **Your own Pod \- and other great benefits** * Every Eight Sleep employee receives the very product that defines our mission: a Pod of their own. If you join us you’ll get your own Pod, along with\*: * Full access to health, vision, and dental insurance for you and your dependents * Supplemental life insurance * Flexible PTO * Commuter benefits to ease your daily commute * Paid parental leave * List of benefits may vary depending on your location At Eight Sleep we continually celebrate the diverse community different individuals cultivate. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our values by ensuring everyone feels they can flourish and grow. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.description: **Job Title:** ============== Substation Engineer \- Transformers**Location:** ============= Charlotte, NC, Remote/Home Based**Job Summary and Description:** ================================ The Substation Engineer is classified as a Technical Leader. In this role the Substation Engineer supports EPRI’s research efforts focused on the full life cycle of substation assets, including design, operation, maintenance, aging, and end‑of‑life considerations. **The ideal Substation Engineer candidate will have** * Strong technical background in power transformers and substation equipment, including design, application, operation, independently on technical activities without direct supervision. * Conduct technical searches and analyzes information in support of the project team. * Demonstrate responsibility for highly specialized technical objectives or problems where the relationships between cause and effect are difficult to establish and little or no precedence exists, and the use of creative and imaginative thinking is required. * Apply technical expertise, and has full knowledge of other related disciplines. * Develop technical solutions to complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity. **Additional Duties of the Substation Engineer consist of** * Develop relationships with primary advisors to a research area. * Provide assistance to the EPRI sales staff in Member Services and EPRI International. * Communicate strategies and results, written and verbal, to program members, potential members and external stakeholders through guidelines, reports, meetings, webcasts, workshops and conferences. * Communicate work across EPRI programs to make sure parallel work is informed. * May provide oversight of a project team to assure technical and financial milestones are met. * Organize external and interdepartmental activities ensuring completion of the project/product on schedule and within budget. * Support the planning and execution of complex project work within the technical department to meet member/client objectives; prepares and presents research reports. * Manage small or medium (less complex) projects including budgets and resources. jobs.title: Director, FDE
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Eliza is a technology services company and Advanced\-tier OpenAI partner that's dedicated to helping organizations build and deploy cutting\-edge AI solutions. From generative AI and custom LLM integrations to predictive analytics and intelligent automation, we work across industries to bring real\-world AI applications to life. Our projects combine deep technical expertise with hands\-on client collaboration to solve high\-impact problems. **The Shape of the Role** ========================= The Director, FDE is the consistent people manager for Forward Deployed Engineers in our Service Delivery organization, reporting to the COO and initially managing approximately 15 FDEs. You own coaching, performance management, career development and team cohesion as engineers move across client engagements. We are separating this work from engagement leadership so that people development receives dedicated attention rather than competing with billable delivery and project demands. This is a non\-billable, internally focused leadership role. You own formal people management. By contrast, the Field CTO, Deployment manages Lead FDEs and sets the standard for technical delivery quality; Lead FDEs retain ownership of project priorities, technical direction and immediate work\-based coaching. You partner closely with both, using firsthand engagement feedback to develop engineers and address performance gaps. Your impact comes through the people you lead, not through personally running client engagements. Two things to know before applying. First, we're an AI\-native firm and we work that way internally: this role is scoped for one person because we expect you to use AI tools aggressively across everything you do, from research and preparation to reporting and management workflows. If AI isn't already core to how you work, this role will feel impossible. Second, this is a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment. You'll get outcomes, not instructions. Priorities shift quickly, ambiguity is constant, and the bar is high. If you want a structured role with a predictable rhythm, this isn't it. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **1\. Own consistent people leadership** ---------------------------------------- * Run purposeful one\-on\-ones, set clear expectations and maintain individual development plans across changes in project assignment. * Coach FDEs on technical judgment, client communication, collaboration and professional growth, drawing on input from the people who observe their work. * Build trust, identify workload and team\-health concerns early, and address people issues with care, discretion and People Operations partnership. **2\. Make feedback and accountability routine** ------------------------------------------------ * Translate role scopes, competencies and KPIs into clear expectations for each engineer’s level and responsibilities. * Partner with Lead FDEs on timely feedback during engagements, at milestones and transitions, and promptly when concerns arise; turn specific examples into practical coaching and measurable improvement. * Own performance conversations, development follow\-through and review preparation. Address underperformance directly and fairly rather than letting difficult conversations drift. **3\. Develop capability and career progression** ------------------------------------------------- * Identify strengths, skill gaps and growth aspirations; work with learning and development partners to turn them into relevant practice and learning opportunities. * Build evidence\-based progression and promotion recommendations, distinguishing sustained performance from readiness for broader scope. * Partner with delivery operations on staffing decisions that balance client needs, demonstrated skills, development opportunities and sustainable workloads. * Own people\-management support through onboarding, ramp and engagement transitions, partnering with technical leaders to assess technical readiness and agree development needs. **4\. Run a disciplined management practice** --------------------------------------------- * Keep commitments, feedback and development actions organized; make owners, next steps and follow\-through clear. * Maintain a regular two\-way communication rhythm: explain decisions and priorities, surface patterns from the team, and close the loop on concerns. * Partner with the Field CTO, Lead FDEs and AI Deployment Managers without duplicating engagement ownership. When project priorities and people\-development needs conflict, work first with the relevant Lead FDE and technical leadership; escalate unresolved tradeoffs to the COO, involving the Operations Director and People as appropriate. * Calibrate expectations, performance and progression across Directors with the COO, Operations Director, People and technical leadership to support consistent decisions. * Track success through onboarding and transition readiness, progress against development plans, timely and actionable feedback, and team health; use these measures to improve the management practice. **5\. Shape hiring and capacity planning** ------------------------------------------ * Partner with Talent and FDE leadership to define hiring needs, shape selection criteria and interview processes, and assess candidates against the team’s technical and behavioral expectations. * Maintain a current view of team capacity, strengths, skill gaps and development opportunities, connecting what people can do today with the capabilities the business needs next. * Partner across delivery, operations, commercial and finance teams on capacity planning and hiring forecasts, balancing client demand, internal development and new hiring. **To be successful, we expect someone to have…** ================================================ * Experience directly managing technical professionals, with evidence of improving performance, developing talent and earning trust. * Effective communication: listens carefully, explains expectations clearly and adapts the message to the person and situation. * Intentional leadership: makes time for people, prepares for conversations and connects daily decisions to clear expectations and development goals. * Courage in crucial conversations: addresses performance, conflict and difficult feedback promptly, confidently and respectfully. * Strong organization and follow\-through: manages competing priorities, maintains useful records and delivers on commitments. * The ability to get results through others: delegates with clarity, coaches without taking over and holds people accountable for outcomes. * Technical and client\-delivery fluency sufficient to understand engagement feedback, ask sound questions and coach engineers in context. * Practical AI\-tool fluency in research, preparation, synthesis and management workflows, with sound judgment about confidentiality and human accountability. **And maybe…** ============== * Experience leading engineers in a consulting or professional services environment, where teams move across client engagements. * Experience building career\-development and performance\-management practices as a technical organization scales. * Experience partnering across Talent, delivery operations and finance on capacity planning and hiring. **What We Offer** ================= * Direct access to the COO and close partnership with technical, delivery and People leadership. * Dedicated ownership of people development, without a billable client\-delivery target competing for your attention. * A meaningful voice in how we hire, develop and grow our FDE organization. * The opportunity to shape a consistent management practice across performance, career progression and team health. * Full ownership from day one, with impact measured through the growth and results of the people you lead.

jobs.title: Design Engineer - Embedded Hardware, Software & AI (Robotics, Energy, IoT)
jobs.description: **The interesting problem right now is connecting AI to the physical world.** Not chatbots. Agents with their hands on real things: a power supply and a debug probe on the bench, a board under test, a radio mesh across a solar field, a fleet of devices reporting to the cloud. We already work this way. Our agents drive our lab benches, flash and test boards, read a live site's history from the cloud, and help operate field sites through their gateways, with an engineer reviewing every move. We use this on real client work in alternative energy, robotics, lighting, utilities and municipal services, and we are just getting started. If this is the thing you have wanted to work on, read the rest. **Who we are** Firia is a small engineering team in Madison doing commercial product development for clients nationwide. We design the hardware, write the firmware, build the cloud, and ship it. We also make our own products: the CodeBot robot, the CodeAIR drone, the CodeX handheld and the CodeSpace platform, used by students in classrooms across the country. **What the job is** You will move across the whole stack: * **Hardware.** Schematics, PCB layout, power, RF, bring\-up and debug. Hands on the bench. * **Firmware.** C, MicroPython, wireless mesh stacks, over\-the\-air updates. Code that survives in the field. * **Software and cloud.** Python services, web dashboards, device management, internal tools. * **AI systems.** MCP servers, skills and tools that put agents to work on the bench, in the design flow and in the field. * **Clients.** You sit in the room with them, executives included, and own the technical story. **Who we are looking for** * **Hardware fluency.** EE or Computer Engineering preferred. A CS degree works if you have real hands\-on hardware experience: you read schematics, you own a scope, you were building things before anyone paid you to. We have grown CS grads into strong embedded developers and circuit designers. We cannot grow someone who is not already curious about hardware. * **Real software ability.** Comfortable from a datasheet up to a cloud service. * **AI as a tool you already use.** You know what an MCP server is, you have written skills or tools for an agent, and you have a working sense of where AI multiplies your impact. If you have wired an agent into something physical, lead with that. * **You build things, think for yourself, and say so.** If the president is about to make a bad call, say so, with evidence. * **Organized, a clear communicator, with taste.** Writing and client meetings are core technical skills here. You can tell good design from bad in a circuit, a UI or a codebase. * **Confident and humble at once.** We hire across experience levels. A recent graduate with a portfolio of things they actually built is more interesting to us than fifteen years of maintaining someone else's program. **The honest part** The pace is fast and the expectations are high. You will be closer to customers and consequences than almost anywhere else in this market. If you want real ownership early and to look back in two years at shipped products with your fingerprints on them, this may be a good fit. **Benefits** * Medical and dental (Blue Cross Blue Shield), with Firia paying half the premium. * 401(k) with a 4% company contribution, and profit sharing. * Three weeks of vacation and eight paid holidays. **Logistics** On\-site in Madison, Alabama. Hands\-on hardware and a collaborative team, so this is in person, not hybrid or remote. **To apply** Send a resume and **tell us about something you built**: a robot, a board, a tool, an agent you taught to do something useful, a weird automation that only makes sense to you. A paragraph and a link or a photo is plenty. We're far more likely to consider your application if you provide this! If the Indeed platform doesn't provide an easy way to submit something, just email us using our info@ Firia address \- we'll get it. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.description: Requisition ID: 50934 Business Unit: Fitch Group Category: Information Technology Location: New York, NY, US Date Posted: Nov 17, 2026 As a leading, global financial information services provider, Fitch Group delivers vital credit and risk insights, robust data, and dynamic tools to champion more efficient, transparent financial markets. With over 100 years of experience and colleagues in over 30 countries, Fitch Group’s culture of credibility, independence, and transparency is embedded throughout its structure, which includes Fitch Ratings, one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, and Fitch Solutions, a leading provider of insights, data and analytics. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst. Fitch's Technology \& Data Team is a dynamic department where innovation meets impact. Our team includes the Chief Data Office, Chief Software Office, Chief Technology Office, Emerging Technology, Shared Technology Services, Technology, Risk and the Executive Program Management Office (EPMO). Driven by our investment in cutting\-edge technologies like AI and cloud solutions, we’re home to a diverse range of roles and backgrounds united by a shared passion for leveraging modern technology to drive projects that matter to our organization and clients. We are also proud to be recognized by Built In as a Best Place to Work in Technology 3 years in a row. Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/Technology\-and\-Data/?locale\=en\_US **Fitch Group is currently seeking a Senior Identity and Governance Administration (IGA) Engineer based out of our New York office.** Fitch is seeking a Senior IGA Engineer to drive the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of our privileged access management (PAM) and Identity and Governance Administration programs. This is a hands\-on technical role that bridges engineering and governance: the successful candidate will build and maintain integrations between our PAM platform (Delinea Secret Server / Delinea Platform), our IGA platform (SailPoint Identity Security Cloud), and the wider technology estate, design and implement lifecycle and access request workflows, and contribute to platform development using Python and modern tooling. business requirements into working solutions. **How You’ll Make an Impact:** * Build and maintain privileged\-access integrations with Delinea Secret Server / Delinea Platform, including vault configuration, secret lifecycle, and external\-secrets distribution. * Design, develop, and maintain integrations between SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, Delinea Platform and internal and external systems (HR platforms, cloud providers, SaaS applications, on\-premises directories), using connectors, REST APIs, and custom rules/scripts. * Govern privileged access across the estate: onboard privileged and administrative accounts into the PAM platform, enforce least\-privilege and just\-in\-time access patterns, and include privileged entitlements in access certification campaigns and break\-glass procedures. * Author Python scripts and automation to extend IGA platform capabilities: provisioning logic, aggregation customization, transformation rules, reporting pipelines, and operational tooling. * Design and implement joiner–mover–leaver (JML) workflows, access request workflows, and access certification campaigns within SailPoint, aligning them to business policy and control requirements. * Manage the full development lifecycle of IGA artefacts — version\-controlled in Git, containerized where appropriate using Docker, and deployed through structured change processes. * Operate and administer the IGA program: account onboarding, entitlement management, role engineering (RBAC), separation of duties, least\-privilege enforcement, and attestation cycles. * Maintain and develop the IGA operations portal and team\-facing tooling; Vue.js front\-end experience is a practical advantage when extending or customizing web\-based components. * Monitor platform health, integration performance, and connector status; raise and track issues with vendors or internal teams through timely resolution. * Evidence of IGA governance controls for audit engagements (e.g., SOX, Dodd Frank, SOC 2, internal audit), preparing walkthroughs, evidence packs, and remediation tracking. * Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, SOPs, and architecture diagrams; keep them current as integrations and workflows evolve. * Manage non\-human identities: service accounts, API credentials, certificates, and secrets — includ urity domains (e.g., SailPoint Certified IdentityNow Engineer, CISSP, CISM, CISA, Security\+) are beneficial but not mandatory. * Experience with Vue.js or a comparable JavaScript front\-end framework, particularly in the context of extending or building identity\-related web interfaces or portals. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code or CI/CD tooling in the context of deploying identity integrations and automation. * Experience contributing to identity program strategy, not just execution: connector roadmaps, lifecycle policy design, or IGA platform selection. * Experience using AI tools to improve engineering productivity, accelerate analysis, reduce repetitive work, and strengthen the quality and consistency of technical deliverables. * Hands\-on experience with AI coding assistants for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test creation, documentation, and code review, with appropriate human oversight and security controls. **Why Choose Fitch:** * **Hybrid Work Environment:** 2 to 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location * **A Culture of Learning \& Mobility:** Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity * **Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning, financial wellness and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long\-term goals * **Promoting Health \& Wellness:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that prioritize a healthy body \& mind * **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family\-first policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively * **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days and support for community engagement initiatives At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision\-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day\-to\-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI\-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.
