jobs.description: **10351 \- Network Engineer (Cisco ISE, Palo Alto, BGP/OSPF)** **Location: Irvine, CA 92614** (5 days on\-site) **COMPANY OVERVIEW** **Hyundai AutoEver America (HAEA)** is the dynamic IT powerhouse behind Hyundai Motor Corporation, a Fortune 500 global leader in the automotive industry. As a key affiliate, we provide cutting\-edge Professional and Managed IT Services and Support to top Hyundai affiliate brands including Kia, Genesis, Hyundai Translead, Hyundai Mobis, Hyundai Capital, and Glovis. At HAEA, we understand that IT is the cornerstone of today’s fast\-evolving digital world. By uniting all IT resources under one roof, we deliver consistent, top\-quality solutions while serving as the crucial information link between Hyundai’s Global Headquarters and North American operations. HAEA offers a truly global and collaborative environment. Here, you’ll drive innovation, boost operational efficiency, and help shape the future of mobility for the Hyundai Motor Group. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make a real impact at a world\-class company, Hyundai AutoEver America is the place to grow your career. Join us and be part of the transformation that’s driving the future of automotive innovation. **Website:** **http://www.haeaus.com** **Role Mission** **Transform infrastructure operations from reactive monitoring and troubleshooting into proactive, measurable reliability engineering by combining deep network expertise with observability, telemetry, automation, and operational intelligence.** **What you will be doing****:** The Core Network Engineer is a hands\-on engineering role focused on improving the reliability, observability, automation, and operational health of enterprise network infrastructure. The position combines deep traditional network engineering expertise with modern Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), telemetry, monitoring, and automation practices. The engineer will maintain strong technical ownership of routing, switching, firewalls, LAN/WAN, and network troubleshooting while helping establish a common observability model across Network, Cloud, and Infrastructure Engineering. The objective is to move infrastructure operations from reactive troubleshooting toward proactive, measurable reliability engineering. **Key Responsibilities** Network Engineering \& Reliability* Design, operate, troubleshoot, and improve enterprise LAN, WAN, routing, switching, and firewall infrastructure. * Provide hands\-on engineering support for Cisco routing/switching, Cisco ISE, Palo Alto firewalls, and related enterprise networking technologies. * Troubleshoot Layer 2 and Layer 3 connectivity, routing, performance, latency, packet loss, and availability issues. * Support and improve BGP, OSPF, VLAN, STP, VPN, DNS/DHCP, segmentation, and related network services. * Improve network resilience, redundancy, capacity management, fault detection, and service recoverability. * Participate in incident response, root\-cause analysis, problem management, and post\-incident corrective actions. * Identify recurring failure patterns and engineer durable solutions rather than repeated operational workarounds. **Observability \& Operational Intelligence*** Develop and mature infrastructure monitoring and observability across Network, Cloud, and Infrastructure environments. * Build actionable operational dashboards for availability, performance, capacity, latency, errors, utilization, and service health. * Improve telemetry collection through technologies such as SNMP, syslog, NetFlow/IPFIX, APIs, streaming telemetry, and infrastructure metrics. * Develop alerting strategies that prioritize actionable conditions, reduce alert fatigue, and improve mean time to detect and recover. * Establish infrastructure health indicators, service\-level indicators (SLIs), service\-level objectives (SLOs), and reliability metrics where appropriate. * Improve end\-to\-end visibility across network, compute, cloud, and application dependencies. * Partner with engineering teams to identify monitoring gaps, define instrumentation standards, and improve operational readiness. * Use observability data to identify performance trends, capacity risks, recurring faults, and opportunities for engineering improvement. **Automation \& Engineering*** Automate repetitive The role is accountable for improving service reliability, availability, observability, and operational efficiency in a fast\-paced enterprise environment. The ideal candidate combines hands\-on troubleshooting with automation, disciplined incident management, and effective cross\-functional collaboration.** **We are also embracing AI\-driven operations (AIOps) and are looking for candidates who can apply AI to make our production environment more predictive, automated, and self\-healing.** **What You'll Do:** * **Monitor production services and respond to incidents affecting business\-critical applications, integrations, and infrastructure, restoring service quickly and minimizing operational disruption.** * **Provide North America daytime operational coverage and participate in an on\-call or escalation rotation as assigned.** * **Support and improve application platforms and distributed systems, including Kubernetes, Nginx, MongoDB, integrations.** * **Support Java and Node.js runtime platforms and collaborate with development teams to troubleshoot application, middleware, database, and performance issues.** * **Build and improve monitoring, alerting, logging, and dashboards using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana.** * **Automate repetitive operational activities, health checks, deployments, recovery procedures, and environment validation using scripting and infrastructure automation practices.** * **Participate in incident, problem, and change management; lead root cause analysis and ensure corrective and preventive actions are documented and completed.** * **Define and track service reliability measures such as service\-level indicators, service\-level objectives, availability, latency, error rates, and recovery performance.** * **Create and maintain production runbooks, troubleshooting guides, architecture records, operating procedures, and knowledge articles.** * **Collaborate with business, development, infrastructure, security, network, database, and offshore teams to deliver platform upgrades and reliability improvements.** * **Identify capacity, resilience, security, and operational risks, then drive practical remediation and continuous improvement initiatives.** * Build and use AI\-assisted tools, including Large Language Model (LLM)\-based assistants, copilots and chatbots, to speed up troubleshooting, log analysis, root cause analysis and incident summaries. * Find opportunities for AI\-driven automation and self\-healing, such as automated triage, smart ticket routing and automated recovery steps, and deliver them within our change management controls. * Support the reliability, monitoring and security of AI\-enabled applications and services, including model or API integrations, as the company expands its use of AI. **What We're Looking For:** * + **Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.** * **Minimum of 2 years of experience in site reliability engineering, DevOps, systems administration, software development, platform support, or production operations.** * **Strong Linux troubleshooting skills and practical knowledge of networking, DNS, certificates, HTTP/S, load balancing, storage, and system performance.** * **Experience supporting containerized or distributed platforms, preferably Kubernetes and Docker.** * **Experience with monitoring, metrics, logging, and alerting solutions; hands\-on exposure to Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, or equivalent tools is preferred.** * **Experience with relational or NoSQL databases such as Sybase, MySQL, MongoDB, or equivalent platforms.** * **Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, Bash, Java, or JavaScript.** * **Understanding of incident response, root cause analysis, change management, capacity planning, high availability, and disaster recovery concepts.** * **Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to remain effective during high\-priority production incidents.** * **Strong communication, documentation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and across global teams.** * **Good judgment in defining procedures, prioritizing operational risk, and determining appropriate actions.** **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting ERP, supply chain, manufacturing, order processing, logistics, or other enterprise business platforms. * Familiarity with EDI standards such as X12 or EDIFACT, cloud platforms and cloud\-native operating practices. * Experience coordinating platform integration, migration, or upgrade projects. * Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description We are seeking a Forward Deployed Software Engineer to build technology solutions that help public health programs operate more effectively. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working directly with users, understanding complex operational problems, and turning them into reliable software that delivers measurable value. As an embedded member of a cross\-functional team, you will partner with program staff, technical assistance providers, product teams, engineers, and client stakeholders. You will help uncover needs, shape solutions, build and test them with users, and take successful capabilities into production. The role combines full\-stack software engineering, workflow automation, data integration, and applied AI in an environment where requirements evolve as teams learn. You will be successful if you are equally comfortable writing production code, talking with users, working through ambiguity, and making pragmatic technical decisions. **Responsibilities** ==================== **Discover and define:** Work directly with program teams, client stakeholders, and end users to understand operational challenges, identify opportunities for technology, and translate loosely defined problems into practical technical solutions. **Prototype and build:** Design and build across the full stack, including user experiences, application services, APIs, relational data models, integrations, workflows, dashboards, and reporting. Move quickly from problem definition to working prototypes and iterate with real user feedback. **Apply AI where it adds value:** Build AI\-assisted capabilities such as summarization, structured extraction, classification, and workflow support. Preserve appropriate human review and account for reliability, privacy, data governance, and responsible use. **Deploy and improve:** Move successful capabilities into reliable production environments with maintainability, security, error handling, traceability, testing, and operational support in mind. Observe usage, diagnose issues, and improve solutions based on feedback. **Scale what works:** Turn lessons from program\-specific implementations into reusable platform capabilities, technical patterns, and components. Surface gaps between platform capabilities and real\-world needs and feed those insights back to product and engineering teams. **Communicate clearly:** Explain technical options, feasibility, tradeoffs, and constraints to technical and non\-technical audiences. Support demonstrations, walkthroughs, and hands\-on sessions with users and stakeholders. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** * 3 years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful full\-stack development experience. **Additional Qualifications** * Strong programming skills and experience building modern web applications with JavaScript/TypeScript or comparable technologies. * Experience with relational databases, APIs, external services, and production software delivery. * Ability to work directly with users and stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into technical solutions. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and tradeoffs to non\-technical audiences. * Demonstrated ability to deliver iteratively when requirements are incomplete or changing. * Experience with version control, code review, testing, and collaborative software development practices. **Preferred** * Client\-facing, embedded, consulting, or Forward Deployed Engineering experience. * Experience integrating LLM capabilities into applications, including summarization, structured extraction, classification, evaluation, or AI\-enabled workflows. * Experience building multi\-step workflows, stateful applications, or human\-in\-the\-loop processes. * Experience with case management, workflow, grant management, or program management systems. * Cloud\-native development, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, or production operations experience. * Experience with government technology environments, sensitive data, data governance, privacy, or responsible AI. * Interest or experience in health, public health, rural health, or public\-sector program delivery. * Professional use of AI\-assisted software engineering tools. **How You’ll Work and What Success Looks Like** =============================================== This role sits at the intersection of engineering, users, and real\-world operations. You will not simply receive a backlog of fully defined requirements. You will work with stakeholders to understand what they are trying to accomplish, determine the right technical approach, and move from idea to working software. Some problems will require traditional engineering; others may benefit from workflow automation, data integration, or AI. In your first six months, success means developing a strong understanding of the program and its users, building trusted workin ities that address meaningful operational needs. Over your first year, you will help turn lessons from individual implementations into reusable capabilities and engineering patterns that make future delivery faster and more consistent. **Technology environment:** JavaScript/TypeScript\-based front\-end development, server\-side application development, relational databases, RESTful APIs, cloud services, workflow and state management, LLM\-enabled application patterns, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies matter more than matching every tool in the stack. **Working at ICF** ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting\-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future. We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. **Work Authorization and Sponsorship** All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H\-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements. **Reasonable Accommodations** Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email Candidateaccommodation@icf.com and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act. **Bot and Third\-Party Applications** Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance. **Candidate AI Usage Policy** At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed. **Pay Range** There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position. jobs.title: Software Engineer And Prototype Developer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are seeking a versatile and proactive Software Engineer to support and help lead software architecture development for a multi‑component prototype system integrating autonomy, sensing, command‑and‑control, and electromechanical subsystems. You will join a highly cross‑functional engineering team composed of mechanical, aerospace, explosives, and electrical engineers with embedded systems experience, and you’ll collaborate closely with this team but you *will* be the person who sets the tone for professional software practices and execution. This role is ideal for someone who is confident offering industry‑best software practices, comfortable guiding a team with gaps in modern software architecture, and excited to help build a first‑generation system. Your software will touch nearly every part of this system: autonomy behaviors, sensor gateways, launcher subsystems, mission control interfaces, and overall system integration. We are hiring for this specific role but have many other related opportunities at the company. While this role supports an immediate need on the project, IS4S offers a wide range of long‑term career opportunities across our expanding portfolio, and we are hiring with the intent to grow your career well beyond this project. **Key Responsibilities** * **Lead and help define the software architecture** across prototype subsystems, including autonomy hubs, sensors, launcher subsystem interfaces, mission planning tools, and command‑and‑control links. * **Develop and maintain software\-to\-hardware interfaces** spanning electromechanical systems, sensor gateways, launcher mechanisms, and obstacle‑box modules. * **Generate and contribute to system requirements, software requirements, and interface definitions.** * Draft and refine requirements for software components in alignment with the System Requirements Document (SRD), subsystem SRDs, and evolving program needs. * Create, update, and review ICDs (Interface Control Documents) that describe mechanical, electrical, and software interfaces across subsystems. * Support requirement traceability and help integrate software into the prototype system for test demonstration events. * **Support communications, data\-handling, and RF**‑**degraded**‑**environment behaviors**, including TAK/NGC2 plugins and mission‑status pathways. * **Collaborate across disciplines** to ensure seamless integration with autonomy, sensors, launcher mechanics, explosives/fuzing systems, and mission control software. * **Guide the team in modern software practices** — architecture patterns, interfaces, version control, documentation, testing, and scalability. * **Participate in prototype development, integration events, and testing**, including launcher subsystem demonstrations, autonomy hub evaluations, and obstacle\-block field tests. **Required Skills \& Experience** * 1–5 years experience as a software engineer. * Strong proficiency in systems‑level languages (C/C\+\+ preferred) or mission‑integration languages (Python, etc.). * Experience interfacing software with embedded or electromechanical hardware. * Understanding of networking, communications, or distributed system architecture. * Ability to create formal technical documentation — requirements, ICDs, design notes, interface definitions. * Strong communication skills and willingness to provide direction and teach industry‑standard practices. **Preferred Skills** * Background in computer engineering, robotics, autonomy, aerospace systems, or embedded systems. * Experience with TAK/NGC2, RF‑degraded comms concepts, sensor fusion, or C2 integration. * Exposure to MOSA architectures, DoD systems, or fuzing/arming constraints.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **Remote in USA – Regular Full\-Time** **The Role** We are seeking a Cloud Engineer with hands\-on Microsoft 365 and Azure experience to deploy and configure secure solutions for mid\-market and enterprise customers. Working from designs set by our Cloud Solution Architects, you will build, test, and hand off the solutions customers rely on, with a focus on identity, security, and governance. You will configure Microsoft Entra, Intune, Defender, and Purview, and help customers roll out Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI agents securely through Microsoft Agent 365\. You will also carry out migrations and modernization projects, troubleshoot issues as they come up, and document your work so customers and support teams can operate it with confidence. As a member of Inviso’s Microsoft Solutions Group (MSG), you will work closely with architects, project managers, and customer IT teams to deliver projects on time and to a high standard. This role is 100% remote and requires availability during US time\-zone work hours and the ability to work in English. **Key Activities** * Implement Microsoft Entra configurations, including Conditional Access, PIM, hybrid identity, and agent identity controls through Agent 365\. * Deploy and configure Intune, Microsoft Defender, and Purview policies, including device compliance, endpoint security, sensitivity labels, and DLP. * Configure data access and permissions to support secure Copilot and AI agent rollouts. * Build and maintain Azure infrastructure across networking, compute, storage, backup, and monitoring. * Execute migrations across Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Azure workloads. * Test and validate deployments, troubleshoot issues, and resolve escalations during projects. * Produce as\-built documentation, runbooks, and handoff materials, and provide status updates to project leads. **Key Qualities** * Ownership of delivery quality and attention to detail. * Clear communication with customers and internal teams. * Methodical approach to troubleshooting and problem\-solving. **Required Experience \& Skills** * 3\+ years implementing Microsoft cloud solutions in consulting, MSP, or enterprise IT environments. * Hands\-on expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, and Purview, including hybrid environments. * Experience deploying and supporting Azure infrastructure. * Working knowledge of Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams, plus migration experience. * Proficiency with PowerShell and scripting for automation and repeatable deployments. **Desired Qualifications** * Microsoft certifications in Azure, Microsoft 365, endpoint management, identity, or security. * Experience with Copilot or Agent 365 deployments. * Experience delivering Microsoft\-funded or time\-boxed engagements. * Success Criteria * Reliable, well\-documented deployments; on\-time, on\-budget delivery; high customer satisfaction; and achievement of utilization targets. **Compensation** At Inviso, we believe great talent should be rewarded with competitive pay, meaningful benefits, and room to grow. The salary for this role ranges from $70,000\-130,000 annually, reflecting the cost of labor across multiple US geographic markets. Beyond base pay, we offer a strong benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, annual training reimbursement, paid time off, paid holidays, and additional perks designed to support your well\-being and long\-term success. **Why You’ll Love Working at Inviso:** * **Do work that matters.** We are a global technology and business consulting firm that helps organizations implement AI, modern data platforms, and digital marketing strategies. * **Work somewhere people choose to stay.** Our low attrition, strong average tenure, and employees who have spent 10, 15, or even 20 years with Inviso speak volumes about our culture and how we care for our people. * **Bring your ideas and be heard**. You will join a collaborative, people\-first environment where ideas matter, contributions are recognized, and excellent work creates real opportunities for growth. * **Keep learning and growing**. Inviso invests in employees through continuous learning, mentorship, collaboration, and career development across a diverse global organization. * **Join a company with deep industry credibility.** Inviso has worked closely with Microsoft for more than 20 years and is proud to be a top\-rated supplier and Managed Partner with numerous credentials.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Jarrod Smart Construction (JSC) and Smart Commercial Construction (SCC) are building an AI capability that starts with their own information and repeatable work. The business decides what to automate and what success looks like. This role turns those requirements into working technology. You will work for both companies, so you need to be comfortable serving two teams with different platforms and a shared Microsoft 365 environment. **What****you****will****do** ============================= * Meet with each team to understand the process, the information it needs, and who reviews the output, then translate that into technical requirements and a build plan. * Build and maintain AI agents and automations for repeatable work such as proposals and estimates, selections tracking, schedule and daily\-log summaries, change orders, and billing and closeout. * Design, build, and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and connectors that let agents securely read from and, where approved, write to our systems: Microsoft 365, Ressio, JobTread, and Adaptive. * Integrate systems and data using APIs, exports, and workflow tools where MCP is not available, so agents work from accurate, current information. * Configure and administer Microsoft 365 Copilot, including permissions, data access, and separation between the two companies inside the shared tenant. * Organize and document our domain of knowledge: where key information lives, how clean it is, and how an agent can reach it safely. * Implement the governance the business sets: approved tools, access and privacy controls, human\-review steps in each workflow, usage and cost visibility, and a clear way to shut a workflow off. * Train staff on the tools you deliver, and keep documentation, prompts, and how\-to guides current. * Evaluate new AI tools and MCP\-enabled integrations and recommend what to adopt, wait on, or skip. **Required****qualifications** ============================== * 2 to 3 years of experience building automations, integrations, or AI\-enabled workflows in a business setting. * Hands\-on experience building or using MCP servers or comparable tool\-calling and agent integrations, and a solid understanding of how agents connect to business systems. * Experience with Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Power Automate) and with Copilot or a comparable AI assistant. * Comfort with APIs, webhooks, and data connectors, and scripting skill in Python or JavaScript (or Power Platform). * Practical experience with large language models: prompting, building agents, and knowing their failure modes, such as made\-up answers and data leakage. * Sound judgment on security, privacy, and permissions when systems and people overlap, especially two companies in one tenant. * Clear communicator who can gather requirements from non\-technical people and explain technical work in plain language. **Preferred** ============= * Experience in construction, design\-build, or another project\-based business. * Familiarity with construction or accounting platforms (JobTread, Ressio, Adaptive or similar). * Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, or similar low\-code and cloud tooling. * Background in analytics, data cleanup, or business systems administration. **Our****systems** ================== Microsoft 365 and Copilot (shared by both companies), Ressio (JSC), CoConstruct moving to JobTread (SCC), and Adaptive for accounts payable (both). **You****will****do****well****here****if****you** ================================================== * Start small, ship, then watch how it performs and grow it, rather than chase the biggest project. * Keep humans at the helm and treat AI like a smart intern: give it context, review everything, and have a person sign off. * Enjoy learning how the business actually runs and building what the teams need. **What****we****offer** ======================= We offer a good work environment with room to grow, competitive pay, paid holidays, paid time off, and a 401k with company match! In addition, we offer Health Insurance, Dental, Vision, Life/Accidental Death and Dismemberment, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Accident, and Critical Illness. *Compensation**and**details**will**be**discussed**with**candidates.* \#hc273721

jobs.title: Senior Performance Engineer
jobs.description: **Role :: Senior Performance Engineer** **Location :: Plano TX – Onsite – All 5Days** **Longterm\_Contract\_Role** **Final Inperson interview is required.** **Exp:: 10\+ year** **Job Description** Client is seeking an experienced Senior Performance Engineer to join its enterprise applications team. The successful candidate will lead performance engineering for a business\-critical enterprise application suite in preparation for its go\-live at a Sands property. The role is responsible for establishing performance baselines, validating that the application scales to production traffic volumes, and confirming that it operates within its sized capacity on production hardware. The application is hosted on Red Hat OpenShift running on on\-premises servers, across both non\-production and production environments. As this infrastructure has fixed capacity, and additional hardware requires significant procurement lead time, accurate measurement and forecasting are central to the position. The Senior Performance Engineer will work independently, conducting their own research and analysis, and will collaborate closely with development, database, platform engineering and vendor teams. **Key Responsibilities** * Establish, measure and maintain performance baselines for each release across API, service and user\-interface scenarios, weighted in proportion to actual usage. * Develop workload models, including transaction volumes, concurrent users, transactions per second and test durations, derived from production traffic data and agreed with business stakeholders and vendors. * Design, develop and maintain performance test scripts using JMeter, Artillery and Playwright, reusing existing test assets where appropriate. * Execute load and endurance tests throughout each release cycle in a dedicated performance environment. * Validate application scalability at and beyond production traffic volumes, assess utilization of CPU, memory, database and storage capacity, and report remaining headroom and capacity limits in time to inform hardware planning. * Analyze test results against baselines, identify regressions promptly, and determine root causes using platform, database and application metrics. * Partner with developers, database administrators and platform engineers to resolve performance issues, including query optimization, resource configuration, runtime tuning and scaling. * Prepare performance reports and present findings and recommendations to support formal release approval. * Work with platform engineering to ensure the performance environment remains representative of production and is managed through GitOps practices. * Identify and coordinate dependencies required for testing, including interface inventories, test accounts, test data and integration stubs. * Prepare and maintain production\-scale, anonymized test data sets. **Qualifications and Experience** * Minimum of seven years of experience in performance engineering or performance testing of enterprise web applications, including leading performance testing for major releases or system go\-lives and presenting capacity findings to senior leadership. * Demonstrated ability to work independently, including researching unfamiliar systems, forming and testing hypotheses, and drawing sound conclusions with minimal direction. * Experience in capacity planning for fixed, on\-premises infrastructure, including sizing workloads to available hardware, extrapolating results from non\-production to production environments, and forecasting future capacity requirements. * Hands\-on scripting experience with JMeter and at least one additional load testing tool such as Artillery, k6, Gatling or Locust. * Experience with user\-interface performance testing using Playwright or a comparable browser automation tool. * Strong understanding of load and endurance testing, workload modeling based on production traffic, and percentile\-based performance analysis. * Experience testing REST APIs and service\-to\-service communication in distributed systems. * Hands\-on expertise with Kubernetes, including configuring resource requests and limits, horizontal and vertical scaling, node scheduling, and analyzing pod, node and cluster\-level metrics and logs to diagnose performance issues. * Proficiency with Kubernetes tooling, including kubectl and the OpenShift CLI (oc), Helm and Kustomize, for deploying, inspecting and troubleshooting workloads. * Proficiency in interpreting monitoring data from tools such as Prometheus and Grafana to identify bottlenecks across application, database and infrastructure layers. * Strong SQL skills and familiarity with relational database performance, preferably PostgreSQL. * Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, JavaScript or Java. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and business audiences. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with on\-premises Red Hat OpenShift deployments, particularly on bare\-metal infrastructure. * Familiarity with GitOps practices and tools such as Argo CD or OpenShift GitOps. * Experience in Java and JVM performance tuning, including memory management, garbage collection and thread pool configuration. * Experience with application performance monitoring (APM) tools for distributed tracing. * Experience in regulated industries such as gaming, hospitality or financial services. * Knowledge of enterprise storage performance, including block and network file storage. * Experience establishing performance testing within a release process that includes formal approval gates. **Technical Environment** The role works with JMeter, Artillery and Playwright for test execution; Red Hat OpenShift on bare\-metal servers in Sands datacenters, across non\-production and production environments; a dedicated performance environment hosting the full application stack; GitOps\-based deployment; OpenShift monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana; and PostgreSQL databases. **Key Outcomes** Within the first three months, the successful candidate will be expected to: * Define and implement baseline test scenarios across API, service and user\-interface layers. * Deliver a capacity assessment of the application on production hardware at production traffic volumes, including available headroom and capacity limits. * Establish regular load testing within each release cycle, with results published after every run. * Implement scheduled endurance testing with no unexplained performance degradation. * Identify and resolve performance regressions before releases are promoted. Pay: $60\.00 \- $70\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Experience: * Performance Engineering: 8 years (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job description We are looking for a hands\-on senior software engineer to build and run the client\-facing data services of our Data Services team. You will design and deliver new services and APIs through which clients send and receive sensitive data securely, and you will own the existing Go\-based encrypted upload service in production. The role combines software engineering, security, production support and release quality, and works closely with clients, compliance, business stakeholders and engineering teams supporting financial crime and compliance programs. This is a remote role in the USA. Job requirements * Client\-facing services: Design and build new data services and APIs in Go for secure file exchange, data delivery and integrations with client systems. * Production ownership: Monitor, maintain and troubleshoot the existing encrypted upload service (Azure Blob Storage / ADLS Gen2\); resolve failed uploads, decryption errors and client delivery issues. * Security: Implement client authentication, end\-to\-end encryption, data separation between clients and access auditing; keep keys, secrets, managed identities and access policies in Azure Key Vault and Entra ID secure and rotated. * Client onboarding: Configure services, keys and access for new clients, write integration documentation and support client teams during integration. * Engineering: Deliver enhancements and bug fixes with unit and integration tests, and release through Git and CI/CD pipelines. * Reliability: Own monitoring, alerting and API versioning for externally exposed services; lead incident response and root\-cause analysis; write runbooks and post\-incident reports. * Quality assurance: Execute tests before release, verify fixes and run regression checks, investigate and clearly report defects, manage test data and test environments, and communicate release risk to the team and stakeholders. Job responsibilities * Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent is required. * Go: Building, maintaining and debugging production services and APIs; crypto packages; file and stream handling for large payloads; Go modules; unit and integration testing. * API and service design: REST APIs for external clients, authentication, versioning, rate limiting and client onboarding. * Encryption and security: Symmetric and asymmetric encryption (AES\-GCM, RSA) and envelope encryption; key management and rotation, ideally Azure Key Vault; secure data transfer, least\-privilege access, multi\-client data separation and handling of sensitive or regulated data. * Azure: Blob Storage / ADLS Gen2 (containers, SAS tokens, lifecycle policies); Entra ID, managed identities, service principals and RBAC. * Production support: Incident response, root\-cause analysis, end\-to\-end troubleshooting, monitoring and alerting, runbooks and documentation. * Testing and QA: Test execution, regression testing, defect reporting, and test data and environment management. * Engineering practices: Git and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions). * Domain: Exposure to financial crime and compliance data (AML, transaction monitoring, sanctions, KYC/KYB) in banking, payments, fintech or consulting. * Compliance: Familiarity with SOC 2 and GDPR requirements for handling encrypted and regulated data. * Communication: Clear written and verbal communication with clients, compliance professionals, business stakeholders and technical teams, including explaining technical issues to non\-technical audiences.

and NoSQL databases, data warehouses, cloud data platforms, APIs, applications, and analytics environments. * Integrate data security technologies with enterprise identity and access management (IAM), privileged access management (PAM), SIEM, SOAR, DLP, and security monitoring platforms. * Develop and maintain policies that enforce least\-privilege and role\- or attribute\-based access to sensitive configuration standards, operating procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation. * Support internal and external audits by providing evidence of data security controls and their effectiveness. * Evaluate new data security technologies and recommend improvements to the organization’s data protection architecture. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer discipline. * Experience administering or engineering enterprise security technologies. * Working knowledge of database technologies such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar platforms. * Understanding of data security concepts including encryption, tokenization, masking, access control, data classification, and database activity monitoring. * Knowledge of authentication **SecuPi** or comparable data security, database security, or data access governance platforms. * Experience with database activity monitoring (DAM), data security posture management (DSPM), DLP, platforms, data warehouses, or data lakes. * Experience integrating security technologies with SIEM/SOAR platforms and enterprise monitoring systems. * Experience implementing security controls for generative AI, AI agents, LLM applications, or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures. * Understanding of Zero Trust and data\-centric security principles. * Familiarity with regulatory and security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, or similar requirements. * Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Security\+, GIAC, cloud security certifications, or implementation playbooks. * Measure business impact: work with PS project manager and leadership to baseline and track time to value, configuration effort, PS hours per deployment, rework, adoption, AI operating cost and customer outcomes. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * Strong Python development experience * Hands\-on experience building applications with large language workflows **Nice to have** * Experience in enterprise software implementation, supply\-chain technology, professional services, solution architecture, enterprise SaaS or business\-process automation * Kinaxis Maestro experience is a plus but not required. We value a strong applied\-AI engineer who can learn Professional Services and Maestro quickly. **Who you are** * Builder\-oriented: you prefer shipping working solutions to producing strategy decks * Field\-oriented: you are comfortable observing consultants and customers to find the real problem * AI\-native and pragmatic: you build in evaluation, feedback loops and guardrails, and know when conventional software is the better answer * Product\-minded and collaborative: you turn one\-off solutions into reusable capabilities and work with experts rather than replacing them * Outcome\-driven: you measure success by customer quality, delivery speed and efficiency **What success looks like** In your first 90 days, you will learn the delivery lifecycle and current AI architecture, become productive in our common development environment, and take at least one use case from problem definition to a working prototype with a measurable baseline. jobs.title: Senior FPGA Engineer — VETi Platform
jobs.description: Kodiak Sciences (Nasdaq: KOD) is advancing vision science by integrating retinal biology, optics, artificial intelligence, medical imaging, and next\-generation wearable technologies. Our VETi™ — Visual Engagement Technology and Imager — platform is an AI\-enabled wearable system combining advanced LiDAR, Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), optically pumped magnetometer (OPM) brain sensors, embedded computing, machine learning, and AR/VR technologies. VETi is being developed for applications in retina care, brain imaging, digital health, identity security, cognitive science, and broader AI\-enabled vision technologies. We are looking for a Senior FPGA Engineer to build the real\-time processing foundation for Kodiak’s VETi platform, from early prototypes through production\-ready hardware. This role is well suited for an engineer with strong digital design and RTL fundamentals who enjoys high\-throughput signal processing and is excited to build FPGA systems for advanced medical imaging and wearable technologies. We are interested in strong FPGA engineers who are curious about medical imaging and motivated to work on advanced wearable technologies. **Responsibilities** * Own the architecture, RTL design, verification, and validation of FPGA designs for wearable imaging and sensing systems — from prototype through production. * Implement real\-time signal\- and image\-processing pipelines for OCT, LiDAR, and OPM sensor data, including FFT, filtering, resampling, and data reduction. * Accelerate AI inference and compute\-intensive algorithms on FPGA and adaptive SoC platforms, working closely with machine learning and software teams. * Design high\-speed data paths and sensor interfaces connecting data converters, memory, processors, and host systems. * Optimize designs for low power, size, and heat in battery\-powered wearables. * Develop precisely timed control and synchronization logic for MEMS scanners, lasers, motors, and closed\-loop motion systems. * Bring up designs on new hardware and debug timing, interface, and system\-level issues using ILA, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. * Collaborate with electrical, optics, mechanical, firmware, software, and systems engineering teams. **Education \& Qualifications** * B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional FPGA design experience developing complex, high\-performance systems. * Strong RTL design experience in Verilog/SystemVerilog or VHDL, including simulation, synthesis, place\-and\-route, and timing closure on AMD/Xilinx (Vivado) or Intel/Altera (Quartus) platforms. * Solid understanding of synchronous design, clocking, resets, clock\-domain crossing (CDC), and timing constraints. * Experience writing self\-checking testbenches and scripting in Python and Tcl for verification and build automation. * Experience implementing DSP algorithms in hardware — fixed\-point arithmetic, FFTs, digital filters, and high\-throughput streaming architectures. * Experience with high\-speed interfaces (ADC/DAC, JESD204B/C, LVDS, PCIe, DDR, multi\-gigabit transceivers) and sensor interfaces (I2C, SPI, MIPI). * Hands\-on lab experience bringing up and debugging FPGA designs on custom hardware. **Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable** * Experience with adaptive SoC platforms (Zynq UltraScale\+, Versal, Agilex SoC), including embedded C/C\+\+, Linux, and hardware/software co\-design. * Experience with FPGA\-based AI/ML inference (Vitis AI, hls4ml, HLS, or custom accelerators). * Experience with MATLAB modeling and automated FPGA builds with continuous integration (CI). * Experience with advanced verification methodologies (UVM, cocotb, or formal verification). * Experience with low\-power FPGA design techniques (clock gating, power\-aware architecture, power estimation) and tools such as Lattice Radiant. * Experience with OCT, LiDAR, imaging sensors, or biomedical instrumentation. * Familiarity with regulated medical\-device development (IEC 60601, ISO 13485, FDA), or willingness to learn.

jobs.title: Product Engineer 2 - AI/Data Science
jobs.description: **The group you’ll be a part of** --------------------------------- In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting\-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry. **The impact you’ll make** -------------------------- Join Lam as a Product Engineer with expertise in Data Science and Advanced Analytics, where you'll combine hands\-on semiconductor experimentation with modern analytical methods to solve complex process and hardware challenges. In this role, you will work directly with process development, technology development, product engineering, and customer escalations. You will design and execute experiments, develop advanced test vehicles, analyze data from multiple sources, and apply statistical and machine learning techniques to identify root causes, optimize processes, and uncover underlying physical mechanisms. Operating at the intersection of semiconductor engineering, experimental science, and data analytics, you will transform laboratory and field data into actionable insights that improve product performance, accelerate technology development, and support data\-driven engineering decisions. **What you’ll do** ------------------ This position is for a Product Engineer with Data Science specialization within the Selective Etch Product Group, part of the Global Products Group, based in Fremont, CA. **Process Development \& Engineering** * Perform process engineering research, development, characterization, and evaluation in support of Lam's semiconductor capital equipment and systems. * Support new technology development, product qualification, and customer deployment activities. * Design, execute, and analyze experiments to investigate process, hardware, and system\-level performance. * Develop advanced test vehicles and apply systematic problem\-solving methodologies to improve product capability and reliability. * Compile and evaluate experimental data to establish process understanding and engineering recommendations. **Customer Escalations \& Root Cause Analysis** * Lead technical investigations associated with customer escalations by combining engineering fundamentals, experimental observations, and advanced analytics. * Apply statistical analysis, engineering judgment, and structured root\-cause methodologies to identify failure mechanisms and drive corrective actions. * Partner with cross\-functional teams to rapidly resolve product and process issues impacting customer performance. **Data Science, AI \& Advanced Analytics** * Develop predictive models and data\-driven methodologies that improve understanding of process behavior and equipment performance. * Apply machine learning, artificial intelligence, statistical modeling, and advanced analytics techniques to laboratory, manufacturing, and field data sets. * Develop analytics tools, automated workflows, and visualization methods that enable engineers to efficiently analyze complex datasets. * Utilize data science methodologies to optimize experiments, improve process windows, accelerate root cause analysis, and support technology development. **Collaboration \& Communication** * Collaborate closely with process engineers, hardware engineers, systems engineers, field organizations, and customers to solve challenging technical problems. * Communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly to engineering teams, management, and customer stakeholders. * Contribute to building a culture of scientific rigor and data\-driven decision making across the organization. **Who we’re looking for** ------------------------- * PhD or Master's degree in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Engineering Physics, or a related engineering or scientific discipline. * Demonstrated expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Statistics, Scientific Computing, or Advanced Analytics. * Strong foundation in engineering fundamentals, experimental methods, and quantitative analysis. * Experience designing, executing, and interpreting laboratory, research, or engineering experiments. * Proven ability to apply statistical methods, machine learning, or AI techniques to scientific or engineering problems. * Programming experience with Python and commonly used scientific computing, machine learning, and data analytics libraries. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to audiences with varied levels of expertise. * Passion for solving real\-world engineering challenges through a combination of experimentation, data analysis, and scientific reasoning. **Candidates with advanced degrees in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative disciplines may also be considered if they have demonstrated experience applying data science techniques to experimental, scientific, manufacturing, semiconductor, or engineering problems.** **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Semiconductor process, equipment, product engineering, or technology development experience. * Experience with semiconductor plasma, etch, deposition, surface science, or related applications. * Experience applying AI and machine learning techniques to physical systems, manufacturing processes, or scientific data. * Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DOE), Statistical Process Control (SPC), multivariate statistics, regression analysis, and predictive modeling. * Experience developing predictive models, anomaly detection algorithms, or engineering analytics tools. * Laboratory experience involving physics, chemistry, materials characterization, or semiconductor process development. * Experience translating experimental observations into predictive models and actionable engineering recommendations. * Familiarity with root cause analysis methodologies and failure analysis techniques. * Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple technical projects simultaneously. * Excellent collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional and matrixed environments. **Our commitment** ------------------ We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non\-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. *Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on\-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On\-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On\-site Flex’ you’ll work 3\+ days per week on\-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1\-2 days per week on\-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.* *\#LI\-JK1* **Salary** CA San Francisco Bay Area Salary Range for this position: $73,000\.00 \- $159,000\.00\. The above salary range for this position is relevant to applicants that reside or work onsite in the California, San Francisco Bay Area only. Salary offers will depend on factors that include the location you work from, your level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience and comparison to other employees already in this role. Actual salary may vary from salary offered due to numerous factors including but not limited to unpaid time off, unpaid leave, company mandated shutdown, and other relevant factors. **Our Perks and Benefits** At Lam, our people make amazing things possible. That’s why we invest in you throughout the phases of your life with a comprehensive set of outstanding benefits.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Cabinet Manufacturing)
jobs.description: **Build the Future of Cabinet Manufacturing** --------------------------------------------- FSBR\-Leedo Cabinets Division is seeking a Product Engineer to support and advance our kitchen cabinet product line. This role is ideal for an engineering professional who enjoys combining product design, manufacturing, systems integration, and continuous improvement to bring innovative cabinetry solutions from concept to production. The Product Engineer will serve as a subject matter expert for our cabinetry products and engineering systems, supporting product development, engineering change management, manufacturing integration, and data engineering processes. This individual will work closely with manufacturing, operations, purchasing, and engineering teams to ensure products meet customer expectations, quality standards, and cost objectives. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Product Development \& Engineering** * Develop, maintain, and engineer Leedo's European frameless kitchen cabinet product line. * Lead product development initiatives, including new product introductions and product enhancements. * Create, review, and revise engineering drawings using established drawing standards. * Develop product specifications, engineering documentation, and technical standards. * Research and resolve product and component issues to ensure compliance with design specifications and manufacturing tolerances. * Support material and hardware selection efforts balancing quality, performance, and cost objectives. ### **Change Management \& Systems Integration** * Manage Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) and Engineering Change Orders (ECOs). * Lead cross\-functional Product Development Teams (PDTs) and Product Implementation Teams (PITs). * Implement product changes across order management, inventory management, pricing, costing, and manufacturing systems. * Become a super\-user and technical expert in engineering and order\-configuration systems. * Ensure engineering data accuracy across business and manufacturing systems. ### **Manufacturing Support** * Collaborate with Manufacturing and Manufacturing Engineering teams on product launches and changes. * Facilitate prototype development from order entry through final production. * Train production personnel on product specifications, requirements, and engineering changes. * Support CNC and panel\-processing operations through clear product requirements and documentation. * Assist with the development and implementation of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required Education \& Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Technology, Wood Products Engineering, or a related field preferred. * 2\-4 years of product engineering experience in a manufacturing environment. * Experience within wood products, cabinetry, furniture, millwork, or related industries strongly preferred. * Minimum 2 years of experience using AutoCAD 2D; AutoCAD 3D, Inventor, or comparable CAD platforms preferred. ### **Technical Skills** * Strong understanding of cabinet construction, particularly frameless cabinetry systems. * Working knowledge of woodworking manufacturing processes and product engineering methodologies. * Familiarity with CNC equipment, panel processing equipment, and manufacturing workflows. * Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word. * Experience interpreting and creating technical drawings and engineering documentation. * Ability to work effectively with both metric and imperial measurement systems. ### **Professional Competencies** * Strong analytical and mathematical capabilities. * Exceptional problem\-solving and root\-cause analysis skills. * Excellent project management and organizational abilities. * Effective written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to drive change and continuous improvement. * Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles and practices. * Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and capable of working independently or within a team environment. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- The successful candidate will: * Drive product innovation and continuous improvement. * Ensure engineering accuracy across systems and manufacturing operations. * Effectively lead and implement engineering changes. * Support efficient, high\-quality cabinet manufacturing processes. * Serve as a trusted technical resource for operations, engineering, and product teams. **Why Join Leedo?** ------------------- At Leedo, you'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on product innovation, manufacturing excellence, and customer satisfaction. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about engineering, continuous improvement, and developing industry\-leading cabinetry solutions. **Leedo Cabinets is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** *The statements herein describe the general nature and level of work being performed and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this position.* Shift: 1st Compensation: $90K to $115K

jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real\-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise. We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post\-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real\-world workflows. Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real\-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence. Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London. **About the Role:** Frontier AI companies are increasingly bottlenecked on expert judgment — capturing it reliably, validating it at scale, and turning it into durable model behavior. This role sits at the center of that problem. You'll build the ML systems that power Mercor's Frontier Data Products: the infrastructure that scores, validates, and improves complex work products where correctness is rarely binary and labels are often noisy, delayed, or disputed. A single job can stay live for days, interleaving model inference, automated checks, expert review, disagreement resolution, and feedback loops. Your work determines how models reason over ambiguous inputs, when they should defer to humans, how quality is measured, and how feedback compounds into better systems over time. This is applied ML product engineering under real production constraints — incomplete ground truth, shifting requirements, latency and cost tradeoffs, and workflows where a silent model failure corrupts the final output. It is not an offline benchmarks role. **What You'll Do** * Build ML systems that score, validate, and improve complex work products where correctness is nuanced and labels are imperfect. * Design evaluation frameworks for ambiguous tasks where ground truth is partial, delayed, or disputed. * Build feedback loops that turn review, disagreement, correction, and adjudication into measurable model and system improvements. * Own production ML behavior end\-to\-end: precision/recall tradeoffs, regression detection, drift, latency, cost, and explainability. * Improve model quality using the right tool for the job — prompting, fine\-tuning, retrieval, active learning, heuristics, and error analysis. * Partner with backend engineers to integrate inference into durable, long\-running workflows without sacrificing debuggability or human oversight. What Makes This Role Different * The architecture is not set — early engineers will define how quality is measured, how models and humans interact, where automation is trusted, and how the system compounds over time. * The feedback loop is short: shipping a model behavior change directly and visibly affects what customers receive. * You're working on a strategically central product area at Mercor at a moment when frontier AI companies have no good solution to the problem you're solving. **Day\-to\-Day** * Moving fast on a young, high\-ownership codebase where your decisions have long\-term architectural weight. * Operating across models, data, backend systems, and product surfaces — context switching is the default, not the exception. * Debugging production ML failures in live, long\-running workflows where silent errors matter. * Working closely with backend engineers on a stack of Python, Temporal, Postgres, AWS, and LiteLLM. * Balancing automation confidence with human review — knowing when to defer is as important as knowing when to ship. What We're Looking For * Track record of shipping ML systems that improved a real product, workflow, or business metric. * Strong instincts for model quality, evaluation design, error analysis, and production failure modes. * Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces where labels are imperfect and correctness evolves. * Sound judgment about when to reach for prompting, fine\-tuning, heuristics, retrieval, human review, or a simpler product constraint. * Solid engineering fundamentals across the full ML stack — not just modeling. * Familiarity with LLM applications, model\-assisted workflows, evaluation frameworks, or human\-in\-the\-loop ML is a strong plus. **You're likely someone who:** * Has 4\+ years of experience * Defaults to simple, inspectable ML systems that improve quickly and fail in understandable ways — not the most impressive architecture. * Gets uncomfortable when a model ships without a clear evaluation story. * Can hold ambiguity without paralysis and make reasonable bets with incomplete information. * Cares about the real\-world output of the system, not just the benchmark. **Benefits:** * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Unlimited paid vacation and sick days * Parental leave for birthing and non\-birthing parents * Free mental health services * $200 monthly wellness reimbursement * $1\.5K monthly meal stipend * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * Free Equinox membership * Up to $15K relocation bonus Mercor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Mercor does not discriminate based on actual or perceived race (including hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, creed, religion, national origin, ethnicity, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, alienage, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, pregnancy outcomes, childbirth, related medical conditions and lactation), reproductive health decision making (including sexual and reproductive health decisions), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, partnership status, familial status, caregiver status, military service and veteran status (including uniformed service), disability, height, weight, genetic information (including predisposing genetic characteristics), status as a victim of domestic violence, sex offenses, or stalking, arrest or conviction record (as provided by law), lawful off\-duty conduct, credit history (as provided by law), unemployment status, salary history (as provided by law), or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, New York, or local laws and ordinances. Further, Mercor prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation based on any combination of protected characteristics. This Policy applies to all areas of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, discipline, termination, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment. This Policy and the law prohibit employment discrimination against any employee or applicant based on any legally protected status. Compensation Range: $180K \- $500K
