jobs.title: Principal Security Engineer
jobs.description: BluOcean Cyber is seeking a forward\-deployed delivery leader and hands\-on AI and SaaS Security Architect to lead complex AI Workflow and SaaS Security engagements for technology\-driven and investment\-management clients. This is not a traditional project\-management role. The person must be able to set the engagement structure, manage client expectations, lead architects and engineers, and personally take ownership of technical work when needed. The right candidate combines delivery discipline, client judgment, technical credibility and an ownership mindset. You should be equally comfortable leading an executive steering meeting, resolving a delivery risk, reviewing an architecture, and securing AI workflows and SaaS ecosystem alongside the engineering team. About the Role You will own AI and SaaS security engagements valued at up to $500,000—from solution design and mobilization through hands\-on implementation, remediation and transition into managed operations. You will be accountable for scope, schedule, financial performance, team execution, client satisfaction and measurable security outcomes. You will work directly with CISOs, CTOs, security architects, product and platform engineers, risk leaders and business stakeholders. Many of our clients have engineering\-heavy cultures and high expectations for pace, clarity, technical depth and follow\-through. You must understand how to operate credibly in that environment. This role also helps shape solutions during pre\-sales, expands trusted client relationships, and hires and leads delivery teams across the United States and India. What You Will Own Engagement Delivery and Client Leadership ● Lead engagements of up to $500,000, establishing the delivery model, governance, workplan, milestones, decision rights, dependencies and success measures. ● Own client expectations from the beginning: clarify what will be delivered, by whom, by when, and what decisions or actions are required from the client. ● Manage scope, schedule, budget, margin, staffing, risks, issues, change control, quality and executive reporting. ● Own an auditable quality model across solution design, engineering, remediation and transition to operations—with clear quality gates, peer reviews, acceptance criteria and evidence of completion aligned with the client’s operating model. ● Create an operating rhythm that keeps engineering work moving: working sessions, status reviews, risk escalation, decisions, action tracking and evidence of completion. ● Identify delivery problems early, communicate them directly and drive resolution without waiting for the client or leadership team to intervene. ● Build trusted relationships with client executives while remaining close to the architects and engineers doing the work. Forward\-Deployed AI Workflow and SaaS Security Engineering ● Assess AI workflows, MCP tools, AI chatbots, AI companions, SaaS platforms, identify security and configuration risks, design the target state, prioritize remediation, and personally lead or execute critical parts of the solution. ● Personally take ownership of a technical workstream or application when needed—not simply review slides or coordinate others. ● Translate Ai security and SSPM findings and platform telemetry into validated risks, practical engineering actions, accountable owners and measurable closure. ● Design AI workflow and SaaS security architecture, controls, governance, operating procedures, monitoring, exception handling and incident\-response playbooks. ● Lead and facilitate technical discussions with AI and SaaS application owners to plan and execute remediation workflows. ● Work across platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft 365, Workday, ServiceNow, Google Workspace, GitHub, Slack, Snowflake, Box and similar enterprise SaaS applications. ● Assess APIs, OAuth integrations, AI copilots, agents and MCP\-connected workflows; design security controls and monitoring criteria for how data, identity and actions flow across SaaS applications. ● Use and help evolve BluOcean’s SNAPP platform, integrating SSPM and specialized AI and MCP security technologies to accelerate discovery, business\-risk prioritization, remediation and continuous monitoring. Solution Design and Account Growth ● Lead or support discovery, opportunity qualification, estimation, proposals, statements of work, staffing models and solution presentations. ● Shape solutions that are technically sound, commercially viable and realistic for the client's culture, maturity and engineering capacity. ● Recognize additional client needs, earn the right to expand the relationship, and convert strong delivery into follow\-on work. ● Protect delivery economics by managing scope, utilization, staffing mix, margin and changes transparently. Team Leadership ● Hire, lead and develop security engineers, senior security engineers and security architects across the United States and India. ● Set clear technical and delivery expectations, review work q quired Experience ● 8\+ years in cybersecurity, including meaningful experience in security architecture, cloud security, application security, product security or SaaS security. ● Demonstrated ownership of client\-facing security consulting and security engineering engagements, including engagements or programs approaching $500,000 in value. ● Strong hands\-on technical background. You must be capable of independently owning and delivering a defined SaaS security or architecture workstream. ● Strong experience working with wealth\-management, investment\-management, private\-equity, hedge\-fund, family\-office, fund\-administration or fintech clients. ● Understanding of the culture of investment firms: high trust, discretion, business urgency, lean technology teams, regulatory scrutiny and relationship\-driven decision\-making. ● Experience working directly with engineering\-heavy client teams and earning credibility with architects, platform owners and senior engineers. ● Experience managing engagement scope, schedules, budgets, margin, staffing, risks, change control and client expectations. ● Experience leading distributed US and India teams, including hiring, work allocation, quality review, coaching and accountability. ● Ability to communicate technical risk in clear business terms without oversimplifying the engineering reality. Preferred Experience ● Direct experience with AI workflow security, MCP security, SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), SaaS governance, identity, integrations or continuous monitoring. ● Deep architecture or administration experience in one or more major Cloud and SaaS platforms; Salesforce architecture or advanced Salesforce certifications are particularly valuable. ● Experience with AppOmni, Obsidian Security, Reco, Adaptive Shield, Falcon Shield or similar technologies, plus exposure to AI security platforms, copilots, agents, LLM integrations or MCP ecosystems. ● Familiarity with MITRE ATT\&CK and MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF or comparable frameworks for structuring SaaS and AI threat models, governance and control requirements. ● Practical involvement in cloud, SaaS or AI security incidents, including triage, containment, evidence preservation, remediation and post\-incident improvement. ● Pre\-sales solutioning, proposal development, estimation, account expansion and consulting practice development. ● CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, Salesforce, AWS, Azure or other relevant architecture and security certifications. How Success Will Be Measured ● Consistent delivery quality, with defects and deviations identified early, corrective actions driven to closure and evidence available for client review or audit. ● Engagements delivered on schedule, within scope, budget and margin expectations, with strong client satisfaction. ● Security risks validated, prioritized and remediated—not merely identified and reported. ● Clear client expectations, timely decisions, controlled changes and early resolution of delivery risks. ● Technical credibility and productive engagement with client architects, engineers and platform owners. ● Repeatable delivery methods, stronger US/India teams, expanded client relationships and follow\-on revenue. Our Ambition SaaS is where the modern enterprise runs. Increasingly, it is where AI runs—and existing security models were not built for either. BluOcean intends to define and own the AI Workflow and SaaS Security market. We are building SNAPP—the security platform for the AI\-powered SaaS enterprise—combining proprietary technology, an integrated ecosystem of AI and MCP security capabilities, forward\-deployed engineering and deep business context. We are starting with investment management and other sophisticated, SaaS\-dependent industries where trust and operational resilience are inseparable. Our ambition is to build the category\-defining company—and the exceptional team that makes it possible. Pay: From $135,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Great Falls, VA 22066

jobs.title: Engineer, Magnet Technology (Metrologist)
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** **MP Materials (NYSE: MP) is rebuilding American industrial capability for a new era of autonomy, robotics, and electrification.** We are the only U.S. company with a fully integrated rare earth supply chain—from mining and refining to advanced metal and magnet manufacturing. Our products include both the critical materials used to make permanent magnets and the finished magnets themselves—enabling next\-generation technologies in robotics, automation, aerospace, transportation, defense, and energy systems. These materials are the foundation of physical AI—the convergence of computation, movement, and control. We hire ambitious, mission\-driven people who want to tackle complex challenges and shape the future of strategic industries. Our culture is rooted in teamwork, resiliency, and integrity, with a deep commitment to operational excellence and national purpose. MP is rapidly evolving from a materials producer into a leading U.S. manufacturer—and our people are driving that transformation. **Position Overview:** The Industrial Metrologist will be responsible for developing, validating, and maintaining measurement systems and inspection methods that ensure the dimensional accuracy and quality of high\-volume manufactured magnets. This role serves as the facility subject matter expert for dimensional metrology, machine vision inspection, measurement system analysis, and calibration. The successful candidate will develop robust methods for measuring critical dimensions and geometric characteristics, while advancing automated inspection systems capable of detecting surface defects and other nonconformities according to customer and internal specifications. This is a rare opportunity to play a key role in returning an essential manufacturing capability to the USA. **Position Responsibilities:** * Develop, validate, optimize, and maintain methods for accurately and repeatably measuring dimensional, geometric, and mass characteristics of magnetic components within tight manufacturing tolerances. * Design and execute Measurement Systems Analyses (MSA), including Gauge R\&R, bias, linearity, stability, and uncertainty assessments to ensure the reliability of inspection methods. * Serve as the facility subject matter expert in dimensional metrology, measurement uncertainty, calibration, and statistical evaluation of measurement performance. * Develop and maintain automated optical inspection (AOI) systems for high\-volume manufacturing environments, utilizing commercially available platforms and custom software solutions. * Create algorithms and decision criteria for automated detection and classification of cracks, chips, edge defects, surface imperfections, and other geometric nonconformities. * Establish product acceptance and rejection criteria in collaboration with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering teams based on customer specification agreements. * Evaluate and implement new metrology technologies including machine vision, optical metrology, laser measurement systems, coordinate measuring machines (CMMs), and other advanced inspection tools. * Analyze inspection and manufacturing data to identify sources of variation, improve process capability, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. * Develop custom software tools and data analysis workflows using Python or similar programming languages to automate inspection, data processing, and reporting. * Calibrate, maintain, and verify measurement equipment and conduct correlation studies on similar equipment across multiple locations (including customers). * Train and mentor quality technicians, engineers, and operators on proper use of inspection systems, metrology principles, and data interpretation. * Support root cause investigations and corrective actions related to dimensional or visual quality issues. * Clearly document methods, validation studies, calibration procedures, standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and technical reports. * Collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Process Engineering, and R\&D to transition new inspection technologies into production. * Work closely with EHS to ensure all work is conducted in accordance with industry\-leading health, safety, and environmental standards. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Basic Qualifications:** * B.S. degree in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another quantitative technical discipline. * 3\-5 years of experience applying metrology principles in a manufacturing environment. * Strong understanding of dimensional metrology, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T), measurement uncertainty, and statistical analysis. * Experience developing or maintaining machine vision and automated optical inspection systems (e.g., Keyence, Cognex, Omron, or similar). * Experience performing Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA), Gauge R\&R studies, and statistical process control (SPC), and knowledge of problem solving tools (5 Whys, Fishbone diagram, 8D/5P Structure format) * Proficiency in Python or similar programming languages for data analysis, automation, and inspection algorithm development. * Experience with calibration and maintenance of precision measurement equipment. * Excellent written, verbal, and technical communication skills. **Desired Qualities:** * M.S. or Ph.D. in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Optical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 5\+ years of metrology experience in a high\-volume manufacturing environment. * Demonstrated experience developing and validating dimensional inspection methods for production applications. * Experience with machine learning, computer vision, or image processing techniques for automated defect detection. * Experience with coordinate measuring machines (CMMs), optical comparators, laser measurement systems, 3D scanning, or other advanced metrology platforms. * ASQ Certified Calibration Technician (CCT), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or similar certification. * Familiarity with ISO 9001 or specific industry standards (for example automotive IATF 16949, aerospace AS 9100, etc.) and/or ISO/IEC 17025 quality and calibration systems. * Proven track record of leading technical projects from concept through implementation in production. * Experience developing custom software packages or analytical tools for inspection and process monitoring. * Strong problem\-solving ability with demonstrated success in improving measurement capability and manufacturing quality. * Self\-motivated, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning and technical excellence **MP Materials is Proud to be an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Underrepresented groups/Women/Disabled/Veterans are encouraged to apply. Candidates whose disabilities make them unable to meet the position’s requirements will still be considered qualified if they can perform the essential functions of the job with reasonable accommodation. **Your Right to Work** – In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment verification document form upon hire. **For Assistance with Application** \- Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact Human Resources Department at 702\-844\-6111; dial 7 when prompted for HR; 1700 South Pavilion Center Dr. 8th Floor, Las Vegas, NV 89135 to discuss reasonable accommodation.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mytra:** We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry \- moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e\-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy. **About the role** ------------------ The orchestration team builds the backend software that manages all of the work that needs to happen in a Mytra system: what every bot should work on, when, how and in what sequence; in addition to tracking the current state of the system and all of the work requests. We are constantly solving dynamically changing multi\-agent path finding and task allocation problems against a live fleet. We are looking for someone smart, hungry, and genuinely excited by algorithmic and optimization problems, with solid backend fundamentals. This person will help define the behavior of our robotics fleet to make our system as optimized as possible. **Problems we solve:** ---------------------- * Multi\-agent path finding at fleet scale. Collision\-free, time\-feasible trajectories, where every bot's path may intersect and constrain every other's. * Task assignment under precedence constraints. Which bot does what, in what order, when the work has dependencies. * Storage and retrieval strategy. Where a payload should be stored based on a variety of metadata, and what to move out of the way to reach one that's buried. * Continuous replanning. Re\-prioritizing and adapting to new or canceled work without stalling the fleet. * State truth and reconciliation. Mapping where everything is in the physical world in our digital twin; automating recovery when the physical and digital worlds differ; recovery from spills, maintenance zones, network drops, and more unpredictable problems! * Observability. Making a planning cycle legible enough to debug. * WMS integration. Mapping a customer's model of their work onto our system \- and then using that data to optimize their deployment of the Mytra system. **Ideal Candidates** -------------------- * Genuinely like algorithmic and optimization problems. Search, scheduling, routing, constraint solving, graph problems; these are the kind of thing you choose to think about, and you have chased some of them down before. * You've written backend software that other people depended on: a service, an API, something with a database behind it. * You've worked directly with relational databases, particularly SQL or Postgres. * You can own a defined piece of work end to end from general direction rather than daily supervision. * You find answers on your own: you can identify ambiguity, know which questions to ask, and are proactive about getting answers quickly. * You learn fast, and you want to! * You are proficient in Go (or similar backend languages), or can be productive in it quickly. * You are adept at using AI tools to work more efficiently, but are aware of where those tools have shortcomings. You validate their output rather than trusting it inherently. * 2\+ years of production experience. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Helpful, not required: any exposure to multi\-agent path finding, task allocation, constraint problems, or other search based algorithms; Warehouse automation or AMR fleet management; working with a relational database at scale; experience with NATS or other message pub/sub tools; participated in an on call rotation for a live system with real customers **A Final Note:** ----------------- If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. The best outcomes come from diverse perspectives working together to build something meaningful and built to last **Benefits Include:** --------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity grants at a high\-growth company backed by top\-tier VCs * Fully subsidized health coverage, including medical (baseline plans), dental, and vision for employees and dependents * 401(k) plans and employer\-subsidized life insurance * Fully subsidized lunch and snacks at HQ—we eat and share stories together at the “long” table * Generous PTO and company\-paid holidays, including one week over the winter break so everyone can recharge together * Voluntary pet insurance, Voluntary Life Insurance, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity * Fully subsidized tax advisory services and education to help you understand your equity * Commuter benefits, including a up to $150 monthly commuter benefit * Lively, modern combined office and lab space where we rapidly iterate through design, build, and test phases * Fully equipped onsite gym and showers at headquarters **Pay Notice** -------------- Compensation for this position will be set based on the candidate's experience level and location. The posted salary band is applicable only to the San Francisco Bay Area and is subject to change. ***This role requires on\-site presence at our Brisbane, CA headquarters, for close collaboration with the other teams.*** ***Pay Range for this position is:*** $145,000 \- $175,000 USD

jobs.title: IT Application Developer
jobs.description: **At MacDonald\-Miller Facility Solutions** (“MacMiller”) we make buildings work better. As the Northwest’s leading mechanical contracting firm, we design, deliver and service HVAC, plumbing and automation system solutions for commercial buildings. With our 1,600 employees across 15 offices – there is a breadth and variety of work to keep you engaged and inspired. We enjoy a well\-respected history of exceeding our customers’ expectations and executing with distinction. Our clients trust their toughest projects with our integrated teams, including: * **New construction** – Engineering, fabrication and install of mechanical systems for new projects following lean construction practices * **Special projects** – Retrofits and mechanical repairs for existing buildings for new efficiencies * **Service** \- scheduled preventative maintenance ensuring tenant comfort, and 24/7 emergency response * **Building Performance** – Control systems, fault detection, energy services and remote monitoring * **Energy and Sustainable Solutions** – Acting as the Prime Contractor, we deliver design\-build energy\-efficient projects in the built environment for private and public sector clients People love to work at MacDonald\-Miller, and it’s because we all share the same Core Culture Values: * **Collaboration** **– Diverse players, one team, a common vision.** Collaboration is our foundation and critical to the success of the company. Every team member is valued and brings a diversity of strengths to help us meet our common vision. * **Dedication** **–** **We are dedicated to personal and professional excellence.** We execute with distinction by doing the right thing and following through on our commitments. * **Safety** **–** **Everyone deserves a safe workplace.** Safety is more than hardhats and boots, it’s an attitude and the environment we create. Every day, everyone goes home to their families. * **Community** **–** **We are proud to be part of MacDonald\-Miller.** We actively seek to build relationships and know each other as individuals. Together we create an environment that is welcoming, caring, and trusting. * **Innovation** **–** **We are committed to continuous,** **creative problem solving****.** Innovation is how we stay an industry leader. We always strive to challenge and better ourselves. * **Fun!** **– Take the work seriously, but never taking ourselves too seriously.** It’s possible to be both serious professionals and good\-natured people you enjoy working with. We strive to be both. **Requirements** **IT Application Developer —** ***This Is Where You Come In*** We’re looking for an **IT Application Developer** to build, enhance, and support applications that improve how MacDonald\-Miller works. You’ll contribute to our ERP implementation and partner with business and IT teams to turn operational needs into reliable software solutions. In return for delivering results, you’ll gain ownership, opportunities to grow, and the freedom to make a meaningful impact. **Top Deliverables in Your First Year to Be a Hero** * **Application Development** — Design, develop, test, and maintain applications that meet business needs. * **ERP Implementation Support** — Contribute to application changes and integrations that support our transition to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations. * **Business Partnership** — Translate requirements into practical solutions in collaboration with users, technical teams, and implementation partners. * **Quality and Reliability** — Troubleshoot issues, document solutions, and follow development, security, and release standards. * **Continuous Improvement** — Identify opportunities to simplify workflows and improve application performance through automation and thoughtful design. You’ll be part of a collaborative IT team working across departments to support our growing business. **Your Background: What Kind of Person Will Thrive in This Role?** **You should have:** * **3\+ years of software development experience required.** * Experience translating business requirements into tested, maintainable software. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and organizational skills. * The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nontechnical colleagues. * A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred. **Everyone you work with should describe you as:** * A curious problem\-solver who looks for better ways to work. * A collaborative teammate who welcomes feedback. * Detail\-oriented, dependable, and accountable for following through. * Adaptable and comfortable balancing competing priorities. **You should be motivated by:** * Learning independently and taking ownership of your work. * Building solutions that make employees’ jobs easier. * Working in a results\-oriented environment that values transparency, innovation, and teamwork. * Growing your skills and responsibilities alongside the business. **Benefits** **Compensation \-** *$90,000 to $117,000 Annually* **MacDonald\-Miller Facility Solutions presently provides employee coverage for:** * Medical, dental, vision for employees (coverage available for dependents for shared premium). * 401k retirement plan including Company matching. * Vacation and Sick Compensation (PTO), and Holiday Pay! * Disability income protection including short term and long\-term disability. * Employee and dependent life insurance. * Wellness Program. * Employee Assistance Program. **Where you will work** Our Seattle HQ office (17930 International Blvd, SeaTac, WA 98188\) has easy access to the SeaTac International Airport, ample secured parking, and newly renovated office facilities \- not to mention great views! Neighborhood amenities include an onsite deli, restaurants, and convenient freeway/airport access. **To Apply:** Please submit a cover letter introducing yourself and explaining your qualifications. **Interested in learning more?** If you’re ready for an adventure and are interested in being considered for this role, click apply to start the conversation! Or if you know someone who currently works at MacDonald\-Miller, reach out to them to get introduced to the team! *MacDonald\-Miller Facility Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This role is responsible for assessing user requirements, translating logical designs into effective technical solutions, designing and implementing system applications, and managing projects from conception through installation. Success in this role requires the ability to communicate effectively with diverse audiences, build strong customer relationships, and work collaboratively to achieve shared objectives. The Senior Programmer Analyst gains the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity while consistently achieving results, even under challenging circumstances. This position demands sound and timely decision\-making, the ability to analyze complex information, and a commitment to continuous learning through experimentation and professional development. **This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule following the probationary period.** ***Currently, this position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship or STEM OPT extensions.*** ### **Key Responsibilities** * Conduct analysis of defined computer\-oriented system problems and develop feasible solutions in accordance with industry standards. * Assess user requirements and translate logical designs into effective technical solutions. * Design application systems and develop detailed design specifications. * Perform difficult and specialized programming assignments. * Maintain systems and respond promptly to production issues and user concerns. * Diagnose, isolate, and correct application software problems to prevent future occurrences. * Develop detailed project plans using standard project management tools and methodologies. * Manage projects from concept through implementation and installation. * Utilize effective time management while managing multiple priorities and tasks. * Communicate proposed technical solutions clearly to non\-technical staff and stakeholders. * Perform structured testing and validation of applications prior to deployment. * Build strong customer relationships and work collaboratively with others to achieve shared objectives. **Minimum qualifications:** * Post\-secondary education in a computer\-related field with 2 years of experience **OR** 5 years of experience OR any combination of relevant education and experience. **Preferred qualifications:** * ORACLE development experience; experience with SQL or PL/SQL; MS Access/Word/Excel; UNIX **Salary****:**$76,599 up to $87,293\.00 if annualized (includes a 13% premium for this position) **Benefits:** We offer an **outstanding** benefit package including: * **Work\-Life Balance** – **13 paid holidays, 12 days of sick leave, 4 days of personal leave,** and **2\+ weeks of vacation leave** annually. * **Health Insurance Coverage** – MainePERS pays for **65%\-90%** of health insurance based on the employee’s annual salary and coverage level (dependent or employee) * **Dental Insurance** – **100%** **employer** **paid**for employees and their dependents * **Vision Insurance** – Employee paid * **Retirement Plans, Employer Contribution to your Pension, Deferred Compensation, Wellness Reimbursement ($300\), Flexible Spending Accounts, Public Service Student Loan Forgiveness, Parental leave** Monday through Friday, 7:30am\-4:00pm 40 hours per week/80 hours per 2\-week pay period

jobs.title: Associate Consultant, AI Transformation
jobs.description: #### **Who We Are** MAP \| WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. **About WPP** MAP is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. We are 12,000 experts across 40\+ markets, partnering with the platforms our clients run on: Adobe, AWS, Salesforce and the frontier AI labs. Most of our clients have already invested in agentic AI tooling but have yet to see the promised value gain. We're helping clients close that gap and realize the value of their AI stack. We are looking for an Associate Consultant to join our AI Transformation work: helping marketing, CRM and content teams find the use cases that matter, build solutions with the tools they own, and move from testing AI to scaling their work with it. You will contribute to the same journey across our global client portfolio and inside MAP, where we treat ourselves as client number one. **What will your day look like?** --------------------------------- In this role, you will build, measure and drive adoption of frontier AI for marketing teams at the world's biggest brands and for MAP itself. You will sit with teams such as CRM, campaign and content to understand how their work really gets done, then build the skills, MCPs or agents that help them reach their goals. You will be at the frontier of re\-designing work to fit the agentic era: you will help showcase where and how AI has an impact on time and quality and where we still need human judgement in the workflows of tomorrow. Your work will make a real difference to people's working lives, giving them time back to focus on more ambitious and creative work. You will be working in tandem with senior profiles from the team who will mentor you and hand you more ownership as you grow. * **Use\-case \& workflow discovery** – Sit alongside the people who do the work, in client teams and across MAP, such as campaign managers, CRM specialists and content producers, and learn their role in the marketing lifecycle. Help them redesign workflows with state\-of\-the\-art tools and spot where AI could change the cost or speed of a deliverable, while capturing it in use\-case templates and a prioritised backlog, and contribute to AI maturity assessments. * **Build with teams** – Recommend and build the skills, MCPs, agents and integrations that redesign how a team works, using frontier models, and test them with real users until the new workflow is theirs. * **Measure impact** – You will build simple value models for the identified use\-cases and shape the success criteria with the team as the work evolves. * **Demos for pitches** – Create quick, tailored demos showing how AI can address client challenges, and help present them in pitches and client discussions. * **Drive adoption** – Help client and MAP teams upskill with AI: run knowledge\-sharing sessions and office hours, write the playbooks teams use after you leave, support champion networks, and keep an adoption scorecard that shows leadership what is working. **Who are you going to work with?** ----------------------------------- You will join the AI Solutions Consulting team at MAP, and work alongside our team of AI engineers. Day to day you will work with senior AI consultants and with colleagues across WPP Enterprise Solutions, from experience strategy to client engagement. Your clients will include some of the world's biggest brands in industries such as FMCG, automotive, energy, food service and retail. **What do you bring to the table?** ----------------------------------- We hire for a mindset, not a background. Demoing work you have built matters more than where you built it. **What you must have** * **A relevant degree or early experience.** You have completed a degree in a relevant field such as digital innovation, strategy and technology, management, business analytics, philosophy, design or computer science, or up to 2 years' experience in consulting, marketing operations, CRM or a related role. * **You are AI\-native.** You work with the agent in the middle, and you regularly build things with LLM's: a workflow you automated, a skill others use, a tool you wired together. We will ask you to walk us through something you built, how and why, not just the output. * **You are fascinated by brands and the art of persuasion.** You want to understand how AI can transform and broaden the traditional marketing lifecycle, and you use what you know to improve how teams work, earning their trust as someone who makes their job better. * **You think like an experimenter.** You test and learn: set a baseline, measure what changed and decide what to do next, with the curiosity and discipline to grow and scale what works. * **A proactive and organized way of working.** You take a brief and come back with something real, you unblock yourself, and you keep several client threads moving at once without dropping one. * **You explain AI clearly.** You can make AI make sense to people who don't work with it every day, in writing and in the room. **What sets you apart** * Hands\-on experience in a marketing, CRM, customer experience or martech team, including familiarity with Adobe, Salesforce or Braze. * You have designed or run at least one workshop or training session for non\-technical teams. * You have been part of at least one change\-management, adoption or AI transformation programme, in any setting. * Experience building with AI engineering tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor – we do not expect you to be a software engineer. You are welcome to use AI to help with your application. Just tell us how you used it. **A leader in personalized customer experiences** ------------------------------------------------- VML MAP is a world\-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer\-centric. Together, we are 1000 \+ technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55\+ nationalities. **A global network** -------------------- We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150\+ offices in 60\+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. \#LI\-EMEA WPP (MAP/VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. When you click "Apply now" below, your information is sent to MAP/VML. To learn more about how we process your personal data during when you apply for a role with us, on how you can update your information or have the information removed please read our Privacy policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Automations Engineer
jobs.description: **Build the Intelligent Workflows of E\-Commerce • Fully Remote****About the company:** Marbill is a fast\-growing brand within the Luna Group, a global leader redefining the future of e\-commerce. Marbill empowers merchants worldwide and focuses on delivering cutting\-edge, AI\-driven solutions and seamless automations. We are an ambitious, agile team of professionals from 20 different countries. We thrive on challenges, move quickly, and value solution\-oriented thinking. We equip our team with the tools and support they need to succeed, fostering both professional and personal growth in a fully remote environment. **What we offer:** * **Fully Remote Position:** Work from anywhere in the world. * + **Flexible Working Hours:** Work when you're most productive. * **Referral Bonuses:** Get rewarded for bringing great talent on board. We are looking for a highly skilled **Automations Engineer** to join our team. In this role, you will be the mastermind behind our operational efficiency, connecting internal systems, cutting\-edge AI platforms (like Claude and ChatGPT), and third\-party tools through robust APIs and MCP integrations. Instead of just maintaining infrastructure, you will develop intelligent AI agents, automate critical workflows across departments like Marketing and Risk, and build AI\-powered dashboards that transform how we operate. This is a fully remote position, perfect for a developer who is self\-motivated, disciplined, and ready to make a significant impact. If you're looking to boost your career and love making systems talk to each other to eliminate manual work, now is the perfect opportunity! **What you'll do:** * **Workflow Automation:** Identify, automate and improve existing workflows across Marketing \& Monetization and Risk \& P\&L, reducing manual work and improving operational efficiency. * **AI\-Powered Visual Management:** Build and improve visual management boards, dashboards and internal tools using AI platforms such as Claude and ChatGPT to make business processes, KPIs and operational insights more accessible. * **AI Agents \& Integrations:** Develop and implement AI agents that connect to our existing systems, analyse data, execute tasks and automate business processes. * **API \& MCP Management:** Maintain, troubleshoot and improve existing API connections and MCP integrations. Build new integrations between internal systems, external platforms and AI tools to enable seamless data access and automation. * **Continuous Innovation:** Explore and implement new AI tools, technologies and automation opportunities to continuously improve how our departments operate. **What you’ll bring:** * **Automation Expertise:** Proven experience as a Backend or Automation Developer with a strong focus on building custom integrations, workflows, and cron jobs in Node.js. * **Integration Skills:** Deep expertise consuming and creating RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and handling Webhooks securely. Familiarity with workflow tools (like n8n, Make, or custom orchestration engines) is a major plus. * **Asynchronous Processing:** Hands\-on experience with Redis, message brokers (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS), and background job queues (e.g., BullMQ). * **Database Mastery:** Solid experience with MySQL at scale (query optimization, indexing) for logging and retrieving automation states. * **Applied AI:** Practical knowledge of triggering AI/LLM pipelines (OpenAI/Gemini) within automated workflows, including basic RAG concepts. * **Cloud \& DevOps:** Strong AWS experience, specifically with EKS and Helm, adhering to Git/CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Docker) for deploying your automations. * **SaaS Understanding:** Solid grasp of multi\-tenant architectures and data isolation strategies. **Why Marbill \& Luna Group?** We believe in empowering our people. Here, your ideas matter, and your growth is a priority. If you are looking for a challenging role where you can work with the latest technologies, automate complex problems away, and build impactful solutions, this is the perfect opportunity. **Apply now and let’s make an impact together!** By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy. Notice: This is a remote position based in United States.

jobs.title: Staff Electrical Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Maverick Tech is helping Symbotic find candidates in Wilmington, MA. **What we need** As a Staff Quality Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical leader and subject matter expert for electrical and electronic quality across Symbotic products. You will provide quality leadership throughout the design, development, industrialization, production, and field lifecycle of complex electrical and electronic systems, including electronic control units, power distribution systems, PCBAs, electrical assemblies, and related subsystems. In this role, you will partner closely with Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing, Test, Supply Chain, and Supplier Quality to identify and mitigate quality and reliability risks early in the product development lifecycle. You will provide technical guidance on electrical requirements, design risks, failure modes, manufacturing controls, validation strategies, and supplier quality to ensure robust product performance and production readiness. You will lead quality planning and risk management activities for new product introductions and production transfers while providing technical leadership for complex electrical quality issues affecting existing products. The Staff Quality Engineer will lead and influence APQP activities from early design and prototype development through production ramp and field performance, ensuring customer, regulatory, reliability, and internal engineering requirements are effectively addressed. This role will also analyze field performance data, electrical subsystem failures, robot health metrics, supplier defects, and site quality trends to identify systemic improvement opportunities and drive increased product reliability. **What we do** The Quality Engineering team ensures Symbotic products successfully transition from development into production and continue to perform reliably throughout their lifecycle. The team partners cross\-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, and Test to embed quality planning, risk management, defect prevention, and process validation into product development and production. Quality Engineering provides technical leadership from early product design through prototype builds, production ramp, and field deployment. By identifying risks early, challenging designs constructively, applying robust quality and reliability methods, and using manufacturing and field data to drive continuous improvement, the team helps ensure reliable product launches and consistent system performance. **What you’ll do** * Serve as the Quality Engineering subject matter expert for electrical and electronic systems, providing technical guidance across design, development, manufacturing, supplier, and field activities. * Lead quality planning and deliverables for new product introductions and production transfers, including APQP, DFMEA/PFMEA alignment, CTQ definition, Control Plans, validation, and production readiness. * Partner with Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing, Test, and Supplier Quality to identify and mitigate design, component, process, and reliability risks early in the product lifecycle. * Lead complex electrical and electronic failure investigations using structured root\-cause methodologies, drive corrective and preventive actions, and verify effectiveness. * Evaluate manufacturing and supplier readiness through process validation, capability studies, measurement system analysis, production controls, and appropriate part approval processes. * Analyze manufacturing, supplier, test, and field performance data to identify emerging quality and reliability risks and drive systemic product and process improvements. * Influence design\-for\-quality, manufacturability, testability, and reliability decisions by providing data\-driven technical recommendations to engineering and program teams. * Establish and improve quality standards, methods, and best practices for electrical and electronic products while driving lessons learned across product platforms. * Provide technical mentorship to Quality Engineers and act as a senior technical resource for cross\-functional teams. * Communicate significant quality risks, technical findings, and recommended actions to engineering, program, and senior leadership. * Ensure compliance with applicable internal quality systems, engineering requirements, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. * Other duties as assigned. **What you’ll need** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline is required. * Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in Quality Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field supporting complex products in a manufacturing environment. * Strong technical background in electrical and electronic systems, including experience with products such as PCBAs, ECUs, power distribution systems, power electronics, wiring/interconnects, sensors, or other electronic assemblies. * Demonstrated ability to assess electrical/electronic design and manufacturing risks, identify failure modes, and lead complex technical investigations from root cause through corrective action and verification. * Strong knowledge and practical application of quality engineering tools and methodologies, including APQP, DFMEA/PFMEA, Control Plans, PPAP, DOE, MSA/GR\&R, SPC, 8D, and structured root\-cause analysis. * Experience supporting new product development and production introduction, including design reviews, risk assessment, validation, engineering change management, supplier quality, and manufacturing readiness. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret manufacturing, test, supplier, and field data and translate findings into actionable technical recommendations. * Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, influence cross\-functional teams, and drive decisions and issue resolution without direct reporting authority. * Experience with statistical analysis tools such as Minitab, JMP, SAA, or equivalent, along with advanced Excel skills. * CQE, Six Sigma Black Belt, ISO 9001/AS9100 auditor certification, or relevant electrical/electronics industry experience and certifications are preferred. **Our Environment** * Up to 30% travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client, supplier, manufacturing, and other company locations. * Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued.

jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 24 Nov 2026 Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. jobs.title: Junior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role:** The Mercatus Center is looking for a Junior Cloud Engineer to support our existing AWS cloud infrastructure and on\-site network, to provide on\-site security analysis and triage, and to support in SaaS administration. The Junior Cloud Engineer manages our AWS infrastructure, supports the needs of contractors and scholars with their AWS projects, and ensures that the AWS accounts are following security best practices. This environment consists of many separate, but centrally\-managed accounts used by different units within the organization for providing hosted applications or to run projects including data analysis. Additionally, the role supports the local network infrastructure, manages part of our SaaS portfolio, and works with existing staff to manage security alerts and remediation using our SIEM and existing security playbooks. This will include monitoring and updating network infrastructure and design, managing SaaS permissions, and integrating SSO and identity management for those SAAS apps. On the security side, this role works with our existing security specialist in monitoring and updating the SIEM configuration, responding to security incidents, and updating security response playbooks. We are a small, dynamic IT team, and are seeking a generalist who is able to quickly pivot between systems, learn enough to achieve the required outcome, and move on. Additional duties will include providing backup for the on\-site end user support team and providing on\-call support once every four weeks. The ideal candidate will need to be a fast learner with good troubleshooting skills. Responsibilities will be approximately 20% AWS architecture and management, 10% on site networking, 20% security operations, 30% SaaS administration, 20% triage and remediation.**Specific Duties:*** Responds to and resolves security incidents. * Reviews AWS configurations, especially security configurations. * Works with contracted AWS developers to resolve security configuration issues. * Manages a 3rd party contractor overseeing security in the AWS environment. * Assists scholars and staff with new AWS project design. * Manages SaaS permissions and services. * Manages identity and permissions across the enterprise using identity management tools. * Assists with end user problem resolution. * Assists in help desk ticket triage and resolution. * Participates in on\-call rotation one out of every four weeks. **Required Qualifications**: * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and work experience. * Minimum of 1\-2 years experience managing cloud based compute and storage solutions like AWS or Azure. * Minimum of 1\-2 years experience with TCP/IP networking, including security and firewalls. * Familiarity with MDM and SSO tools like Okta and Jumpcloud. * Experience managing contractors, including scoping work, establishing clear communication protocols, evaluating outcomes, and ensuring alignment with organizational requirements. * Experience troubleshooting unfamiliar issues and finding and applying appropriate solutions. * Excellent communication skills relevant to the technical tools and solutions for non\-technical users or cross\-disciplinary experts. * Familiarity with triage and response to security incidents. * Ability to document processes and create playbooks. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Has built solutions using CloudFormation or other orchestration tools. * Experience with tools like AWS GuardDuty and Security Hub to identify and resolve potential issues with cloud resources. * Experience using IAM tools to manage permissions and roles for users within a cloud environment. * Experience using a trouble ticketing system. * Familiarity with SIEM concepts and usage. **Required certification:** * AWS Solutions Architect Associate **Preferred certifications:** * Network\+ * Security\+ * Okta Certified Professional * Jumpcloud Core Certification **How to Apply** Please submit your cover letter and resume. Your cover letter should indicate your interest in the Mercatus Center's mission. **About the Mercatus Center** The Mercatus Center at George Mason University is where top classical liberal scholars solve real\-world challenges. Grounded in the tradition of market\-oriented thinking and classical liberal ideas, we equip high\-agency talent to apply bold ideas that shape institutions, inform policy, and help people flourish. **Employee Benefits Review** Salary is competitive and will be commensurate with experience. In addition, Mercatus provides excellent benefits to all individual employees, including full health and dental coverage, unlimited paid time off, long\-term disability and life insurance, a 403(b) retirement savings program, parking/travel benefits, and twelve free credits per year at George Mason University. **EEO Statement** The Mercatus Center is an equal employment opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by law. **E\-Verify** The Mercatus Center participates in E\-Verify. Upon hire, Mercatus will provide the U.S. Social Security Administration and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security, with information from each new employee’s Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer II
jobs.description: **Why Merit?** At Merit Medical, our mission is to create innovative medical devices that improve lives. Our goal is to hire and develop people who want to build something special through hard work, team effort, and commitment. Together, we are making a difference in the lives of patients around the world. **WORK SHIFT** DAY (United States of America) **SUMMARY OF DUTIES** Provides routine and complex quality engineering work for specific product lines under broad supervision and guidelines. Responsibilities include: failure investigation, oversight/ determination of disposition of nonconforming materials, conducting and updating risk analysis documentation and processes, defining/refining quality inspection plans, performing data collection and trending for presentation of key metrics, identifying and addressing supplier quality issues, reviewing and generating validation/protocol data, and optimizing and improving quality systems and documentation. This position can be fully remote and may be based anywhere. Candidates must be able and willing to travel approximately 20% of the time to company sites in various countries. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS PERFORMED** 1\. Independently evaluates, selects, and applies standard engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria, using judgment in making minor adaptations and modifications. 2\. Works independently on standard projects while assistance is furnished on unusual problems. 3\. Receives instructions on specific assignment objectives, complex features and possible solutions. 4\. Responsible for risk management documentation for assigned product line(s) or processes; and identifying and updating failure modes and related process/product improvements by facilitating teams and implementing required changes. 5\. Reviews, approves and generates Engineering Change Notifications (ECNs) to update or generate: verification, validation, monitoring and inspection methods, procedures, and test protocols; specific to assigned product line(s) and processes and production control(s). 6\. Evaluates and participates in the selection of suppliers by monitoring supplier performance, through collection and trending of data and performing supplier quality audits, as required. 7\. Reviews nonconformance records (internal/external) to determine: disposition, root cause and need for corrective and preventive actions. 8\. Ensures containment (identification, segregation and reconciliation) of nonconforming product has been performed, to prevent unintended use. 9\. Identifies and implements any changes necessary to ensure and maintain the continued suitability and effectiveness of the quality management system through the use of: quality policy, quality objectives, audit results, analysis of data, etc. 10\. Evaluates the work environment, in which product is manufactured, is adequately environmentally controlled and monitored, with sufficient personnel and safety production controls. 11\. May participate in design and development activities. 12\. Performs other related duties and tasks as required. **ESSENTIAL PHYSICAL/ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS** • Lifting \- Not to exceed 50 lbs. – local practice may apply. * Writing * Sitting * Standing * Bending • Vision * Color perception * Depth perception * Reading * Field of vision/peripheral * Fine motor skills * Noise * Chemical vapors **SUMMARY OF MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** • Education and/or experience equivalent to a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related field with three years quality engineering experience * Strong interpersonal, organizational, and verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively as a team member. * Demonstrated working knowledge of 21 CFR 820 (Quality Systems Medical Devices), ISO 13485, ISO14791, and other medical device related standards. * Proven ability to work effectively in a team environment through conflict resolution and negotiations. * Working knowledge of statistical methodologies, quality control and manufacturing tools, such as applied statistics, lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, etc. * Demonstrated computer skills preferably spreadsheets, word processing, database and other applicable software programs. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** • Medical device experience or equivalent experience in a regulated industry. * Experience with SmartCAPA, Oracle and Crystal Reports. * Experience handling deviations, investigations and CAPAs. **COMPETENCIES** • Engineering techniques/evaluation/selection/application * Engineering variable analysis * Plans/surveys/structures/equipment * Supervisory assistance * Special projects/ECN's/prototype creation * NC causes/corrective actions/dispositions **COMMENTS** Infectious Control Risk Category II: The risk category explains whether or not employees are likely to come into contact with blood or body fluids while performing their jobs. Risk category II states employment and procedures that may require exposure. **As an eligible Merit employee, you can expect the following:** * Multiple Shifts and Hours to choose from: Days, Swing (Eve), and Nights * Medical/Dental \& Other Insurances (eligible the first of month after 30 days) * Low Cost Onsite Medical Clinic * Two (2\) Onsite Cafeterias * Employee Garden \| Gardening Classes * 3 Weeks' Vacation \| 1 Week Sick\-Time \| Paid Holidays * 401K \| Health Savings Account To see more on our culture, go to www.merit.com/careers . Military Veterans are encouraged to Apply. **Merit is a proud Utah Patriot Partner committed to hiring our Veterans.**

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Growth
jobs.description: ### **Who we are** The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort, and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive\-in, drive\-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn't coming; it's here, and we need builders, innovators, and problem solvers to help us create it. ### **Who you are** Metropolis is seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to build and scale our demand forecasting and dynamic pricing systems within the Advanced Technology Group. In this highly impactful role, you will design, deploy, and own end\-to\-end models that forecast demand, capture price\-demand relationships, and use causal inference and double ML to create actionable pricing strategies. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business teams to translate complex requirements into scalable machine learning solutions that directly drive key metrics such as revenue, utilization, and customer demand. ### **What you'll do** * Lead the innovation, design, and advancement of machine learning and mathematical optimization solutions to maximize revenue and improve business performance. * Be a technical thought leader on cutting\-edge pricing topics and closely follow industry and academic trends. * Drive technical best practices and raise the technical/operation bar for Metropolis Growth ML team. * Design and implement advanced frameworks, including constrained optimization, mixed\-integer programming, and stochastic optimization, to drive scalable pricing decisions * Architect and productionize scalable demand forecasting models optimized for business goals like visit volume, revenue maximization, and inventory availability * Build and deploy end\-to\-end data pipelines to support large\-scale production usage * Identify data issues including bias, leakage, and labeling inconsistencies, and drive solutions * Design and analyze experiments using A/B testing, switchback, and causal inference to validate pricing strategies * Deploy and monitor machine learning models in production to ensure reliability, scalability, and data quality * Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to translate requirements into scalable machine learning solutions * Mentor junior engineers and foster a culture of technical excellence within the machine learning organization ### **What we're looking for** * PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Operational Research, or a related STEM field with 6\+ years of relevant experience, or MS with 8\+ years experiences with equivalent publications. * Proven experience owning and leading projects from inception to production, successfully deploying models and driving measurable business impact * Solid understanding of causal inference and experimentation, with experience evaluating both short\-term and long\-term effects using A/B testing, DiD, Bandits and uplift modeling * Strong experience in machine learning modeling and statistics, specifically leveraging time series forecasting, probabilistic models, and deep learning models * Experience productionizing and supporting end\-to\-end solutions using forecasting, optimization, and decision\-making algorithms * Hands\-on experience with data pipeline development, including AWS data storage, data transformation, distributed processing with Spark, and workflow orchestration via Airflow. * Experience building agentic AI solutions for pricing jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
jobs.description: Miami Jewish Health is one of the largest providers of healthcare and living options for aging adults in the Southeast. We operate Florida PACE (Program of All\-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) Centers, the largest PACE program in Florida, which serves as health plan, healthcare provider, and social center designed for older adults with complex medical needs. We have four adult day health centers that serve participants in Miami\-Dade and Broward counties. Our careers are challenging, meaningful and rewarding. Join us now to do purposeful work in supporting our community’s seniors and their families. Job title: **Cybersecurity Analyst** Job Summary The Cybersecurity Analyst will operate and maintain the organization's existing Microsoft security platform and Fortinet network security environment. This is a hands\-on technical role: the engineer will run day\-to\-day security operations across Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune and Microsoft Purview, and will be responsible for managing all Fortinet firewalls, switches and related network security. Protects patient, resident and employee information in a regulated healthcare environment. They apply HIPAA Security Rule requirements through practical controls, respond to incidents when they occur, and work closely with the System Administration and Cybersecurity Manager and the wider IT team. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Reinforcement Learning Systems
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Palo Alto **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Science **About Mistral** ----------------- Mistral provides full\-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high\-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co\-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low\-ego and team\-spirited. As a Research Engineer on the RL Systems team, you will help build the agentic platform we use to train and evaluate our models. Orchestral is the system our researchers rely on to run training and evaluation at scale — from the rollout engine that powers agentic workflows to the infrastructure that keeps their workloads running reliably. What you build becomes the foundation the whole science team works on. Your work will span the platform's core: the library, tooling, abstractions and rollout engine — including new capabilities like long\-running tasks, subagents and RL features — and the machinery that runs data and jobs at scale, with a focus on resiliency, routing and request handling. You will own significant pieces end to end, from design to production. This is a software engineering role rather than an ML or infrastructure\-operations one: RL or PyTorch experience is not required, and you will spend your time building the platform, not operating it. You will be building a distributed RL system, with the scientists as your users. **What You Will Do** ==================== * Design and build the core of the Orchestral platform: the library, abstractions and tooling researchers use to train and evaluate models. * Build and evolve the rollout engine, shipping new capabilities such as long\-running tasks and subagents. * Run Orchestral as a production system: keep training and evaluation workloads reliable at scale. * Improve how data and jobs flow through the platform as usage grows — scheduling, routing and request handling. * Treat researchers as your users: understand their workflows and turn recurring needs into robust, shared tooling. * Raise the bar on engineering quality across the platform: testing, code review, CI/CD, observability and documentation. * Contribute to open\-source rollout\-engine and agent\-infrastructure projects where it benefits the platform. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * Experience directly building and debugging complex distributed systems at scale, with an emphasis on reliability and scalability. * Strong Python skills and solid software\-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD. * A builder mindset: you have constructed systems from the ground up, not just operated polished ones. * A track record in small teams running complex systems at scale — for example in finance, crypto or ad tech. * Self\-starter, low\-ego and collaborative, with a product mindset toward your users. * Curiosity about ML and RL — this experience is not required, but a desire to learn is. **Nice\-to\-haves** ------------------- * Hands\-on experience with Ray or similar distributed\-computing frameworks. * Open\-source contributions, especially to rollout\-engine or agent\-infrastructure projects such as SLIME, verl or PrimeRL. * Experience building or working with agentic workflows and environments. **What We Offer** ----------------- We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location\-specific perks. For the most up\-to\-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page. **Privacy Policy** ------------------ Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Lead Full-Stack Engineer

operations platform — document audit tooling, Claude\-backed knowledge assistants over MCP servers, and role\-based work queues — designed as one platform with shared identity, document pipeline, and services rather than four disconnected tools * Design for distributed work: explicit state, auditable handoffs between people, and notification that reaches someone rather than waiting to be checked * *(\~20%)* * Automate our 1035 exchange process end to end — exchange documents, internal e\-signature, mailing, tracking, and the exception paths when a receiving carrier pushes back * Replace the **Administer** *(\~15%)* * Own our Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Intune estate: conditional access, security group design for application access, device compliance, and endpoint data controls * Set the desktop and endpoint standard so workstation setup is repeatable, and direct our managed service provider rather than waiting on a quote for routine configuration **What We Require** * 8\+ years building and operating production software, including systems you personally supported after launch * Deep expertise in a modern typed front\-end framework — Angular preferred, strong React or Vue considered — plus real command of TypeScript * Strong server\-side development in at least one of PHP/Laravel, Node/TypeScript, Python, or C\#/.NET, and the ability to work in a second * Strong SQL and data modeling, plus REST API and integration experience including the unglamorous parts: authentication, retries, file\-based exchange, and partners whose documentation is wrong * Something real you have built on a large language model, with a clear account of where it failed and what you changed * Experience automating a multi\-step business process end to end — exception paths included, not jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The Data Engineer is responsible for building the backbone of how National Gypsum uses data. This role designs and maintains the pipelines and models that move data from SAP, plant systems, and enterprise applications into the Enterprise Data Warehouse, and keeps them fast, reliable, and well governed. This is a build\-heavy role spanning ingestion, modeling, and optimization. The Data Engineer contributes to the semantic layer behind enterprise reporting, delivers the data the AI and data science team depends on, and co\-builds the applications that put information in front of users when a dashboard is not enough. **Job Responsibilities (not all inclusive):** * **Build the Pipelines:** Design, build, and maintain ETL and ELT pipelines that ingest data from enterprise, operational, and third\-party sources, and automate workflows so they run reliably without manual intervention. * **Integrate Enterprise Sources:** Build and maintain integrations with SAP, Microsoft 365, plant systems, and other enterprise platforms, working through APIs, batch, and streaming patterns as the source requires. * **Model the Data:** Develop and maintain layered data models across raw, curated, and presentation zones, applying dimensional modeling, warehousing, and lakehouse design practices along with the team's naming and modeling standards. * **Build the Semantic Layer:** Contribute to the certified datasets, Power BI semantic models, and KPI definitions that reporting depends on, so business users work from a single trusted definition. * **Deliver AI\-Ready Data:** Build the feature pipelines, training datasets, and vector and search assets that models and agents consume, in partnership with the AI, Data Science \& Analytics team. * **Co\-Build Data Applications:** Build alongside the AI team on data applications in Streamlit, React, and other approved frameworks, and stand up the compute, deployment, and data access patterns they run on. * **Optimize Performance and Cost:** Tune SQL, warehouse sizing, partitioning, caching, and compression so the platform stays fast and spend stays predictable as volume grows. * **Safeguard Data Quality:** Build validation, anomaly detection, and reconciliation into ingestion pipelines, and maintain lineage and documentation in partnership with the Data Governance and Application Security team. * **Keep It Running:** Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot failures, drive root\-cause analysis, and apply CI/CD and environment promotion practices across dev, test, and production. * **Partner Across IT and the Business:** Work with application owners, plant systems teams, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and turn them into durable models and pipelines rather than one\-off extracts. * Other duties as assigned. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 3 to 6 years of hands\-on data engineering experience building and operating production pipelines on a cloud data platform. * Strong SQL, with hands\-on experience in Snowflake or a comparable modern cloud data platform. * Working proficiency in Python for data transformation, automation, and pipeline development. * Experience with ETL and ELT tooling and orchestration frameworks such as Azure Data Factory, dbt, or Airflow. * Solid grounding in data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas, and normalization. * Experience with Git\-based workflows and CI/CD practices for data pipelines. * Working knowledge of data quality, lineage, and access governance practices. * Clear communicator able to work with both technical teammates and business stakeholders. * Preferred: Experience integrating SAP source systems, particularly order\-to\-cash, master data, or finance and logistics structures. * Preferred: Databricks experience,
