jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities ● Design and build the production ETL pipelines and the dbt transformation layers: tested transformations in the operational PostgreSQL layer and analytical models in the Iceberg/Athena lakehouse. ● Reverse\-engineer undocumented business logic out of legacy schemas; encode and test every transformation instead of copying tables. ● Design and own the target PostgreSQL schema for the shared data layer that every Bronson product consumes. ● Build the identity\-resolution pipeline: deterministic and probabilistic matching, confidence scoring, a manual\-resolution queue, and measured false\-merge / false\-split rates. ● Build the data\-quality and lineage controls across both layers: schema\-change detection, freshness monitoring, and traceability from source records to product\-facing models. ● Own the parallel run: legacy systems and the new layer stay reconciled, with documented discrepancies, until the old side is switched off. Technical Environment Managed PostgreSQL as the transactional core, schema\-per\-domain with a transactional outbox; the analytics lakehouse on object storage with Iceberg tables, a SQL query engine, and dbt transformations; infrastructure as code (TypeScript) and GitHub Actions CI/CD; Python for data tooling; pipeline observability covering CDC lag, data freshness, transformation failures, reconciliation results, and backfill status, with OpenTelemetry used where applicable for tracing. Legacy sources: the firm's on\-prem SQL Server and MySQL. PostgreSQL, dbt, and the lakehouse approach are settled; the final cloud (AWS vs GCP) is being decided now, and the decisions you will own include the replacement change\-data\-capture architecture (the existing replication path is no longer reliable) and the migration approach. Environments: dev (synthetic data), staging (de\-identified), production — the only PHI environment. Technical Challenges ● The existing replication path is no longer reliable. You will choose the replacement change\-data\-capture architecture (DMS\-class vs Debezium\-class), defend the choice, and own it in production. ● A wrong identity merge is a legal problem, not a bug: matching ships with measured false\-merge and false\-split rates and a manual\-resolution queue. ● Every pipeline reconciles against its legacy source with documented discrepancies — reconciliation is part of the pipeline, not an afterthought. ● Backfills and replays must be safe: the same load run twice must never produce different results. Qualifications ● 5\+ years of professional data engineering experience. ● Has built and owned a dbt (or equivalent) transformation layer in production, including tests and CI for transformations, schema changes, and pipeline code. ● Has led a migration from legacy on\-prem databases to a modern platform with both systems running in parallel, with complete source\-to\-target reconciliation and documented, approved exceptions. ● Deep SQL and PostgreSQL; reads other people's schemas fluently. ● Change\-data\-capture experience (Debezium, DMS, or similar). ● Meticulous and patient: legacy data hides problem after problem — find, verify, rework, verify again. ● Communicates directly with product and business stakeholders: validates undocumented rules, resolves discrepancies, and documents source\-of\-truth decisions. Preferred Skills ● Entity resolution / record linkage with measured match quality. ● Lakehouse table formats and query engines (Iceberg / Athena class). ● SQL Server and MySQL internals; experience with regulated data (HIPAA / PHI). Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Referral program * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: 2027-2028 Computer Science & Robotics Engineering Teacher
jobs.description: **Start date: August 2027** **Mission** The mission of Neighborhood Charter Schools is to empower every scholar to discover their unique potential and develop the knowledge, character, and courage to shape a better future for themselves, their communities, and the world. Through an exceptional, rigorous, and inclusive K\-12 education, we cultivate scholars who lead with LIGHT, equipping them to think critically, embrace lifelong learning, and lead with purpose. We foster a community where every scholar, including autistic children and scholars with IEPs, belongs, every difference is celebrated, and every learner is empowered to thrive. *Every Learner. Every Pathway. Every Chance to Thrive.* **About Neighborhood Charter Schools** Neighborhood Charter Schools (NCS) is a public charter school network rooted in Harlem and the Bronx, serving students in an intentionally designed, inclusive learning community. NCS is built on a simple but powerful belief: every child deserves to be known, valued, and supported as their full self. Our schools operate as a true neighborhood model, grounded in deep relationships with families and a commitment to belonging for every student. What distinguishes NCS is an inclusive\-by\-design approach. Classrooms, schedules, and supports are intentionally built to serve high\-functioning autistic students, multilingual learners, students with IEPs, and general education students together. Inclusion is not a program or an add\-on—it is the foundation of how our schools function and how students experience learning every day. As NCS expands from a K–8 network to a K–12 system, the launch of its first high school marks a defining moment for the organization. The high school represents an opportunity to extend NCS’s inclusive, neighborhood\-based model through adolescence, creating continuity, care, and high expectations over time. The Founding High School Principal will play a central role in shaping this next chapter and bringing the NCS high school vision to life. To learn more about NCS, please visit https://ncschools.org/ncs\-high\-school/ **The Opportunity** NCS is launching its first high school, serving Harlem and the Bronx and opening in August 2027\. The Founding Computer Science \& Robotics Engineering Teacher builds the school's computing and engineering pathway from the ground up, starting with an introductory course for every 9th grader and growing into AP Computer Science Principles, AP Computer Science A, and hands\-on courses in artificial intelligence and robotics. This teacher ensures every scholar, including those with IEPs and autistic scholars, sees themselves as a technology creator and leaves NCSHS ready for college\-level computing and engineering. **Reporting Structure** This teacher reports to the Assistant Principal of Culture \& Electives (APC) and works closely with the AP of STEM, special education staff, the Light Leader for their grade team, and the Director of College \& Career Readiness (DCCR). Beginning in Year 3, day\-to\-day coaching shifts to the Electives Department Head. **The Founding Role: How It Grows From Year 1 to Year 4** NCSHS opens with 9th grade and adds a grade each year. The computer science program grows with it. * **Year 1 (SY 2027\-28\):** Teach an introductory computer science, AI, or robotics engineering course to all 9th graders. Set up the classroom, devices, robotics equipment, and platforms, and help design the four\-year course sequence. * **Year 2 (SY 2028\-29\):** Add a 10th grade course that builds toward AP readiness (for example, web design or programming foundations). Launch a computer science club or after\-school offering in partnership with the After\-School Coordinator. * **Year 3 (SY 2029\-30\):** Launch AP Computer Science Principles for 11th graders. Use data from Years 1 and 2 to place scholars and build AP supports, in partnership with the AP/Advanced Coursework Lead. * **Year 4 (SY 2030\-31\):** Launch AP Computer Science A and lead a full 9\-12 pathway, including connections to internships, summer programs, and college majors with the DCCR. **What You'll Do** *Duties below reflect the role at full build\-out in Year 4 (SY 2030\-31\).* **Curriculum and instruction** * Teach 6 sections, or 4 sections plus 1\-2 duties, using a rigorous, standards\-aligned curriculum, including AP Computer Science Principles, AP Computer Science A, and/or courses in artificial intelligence and robotics engineering * Build and refine unit plans, projects, and assessments aligned to the NYS Computer Science and Digital Fluency Standards and the College Board AP frameworks * Plan lessons that make computing accessible to every scholar, using accommodations, modifications, and universal design, in partnership with special education staff **Data and scholar achievement** * Design and give assessments that measure mastery, and use the data to adjust instruction and reteach * Own AP pass rates and course mastery for your sections, and keep the gradebook accurate and current * Flag scholars who are struggling academically or behaviorally and bring them to Light Team (MTSS) as needed **Culture and community** * Build a joyful, high\-expectations classroom using NCSHS culture systems and the Code of Conduct, with consistent recognition and consequences * Communicate regularly with families about progress, celebrations, and concerns * Participate in Grade Team meetings, school\-wide events, and NCSHS traditions **Program building and professional growth** * Maintain the classroom, devices, robotics equipment, and software accounts, and partner with Operations on technology needs * Grow scholar interest in computing and engineering through clubs, robotics competitions, and partnerships with organizations and colleges * Take part in weekly coaching, data meetings, and professional development, including summer PD before the school year begins * Other responsibilities as assigned **Who You Are** * A mission\-aligned builder, committed to the NCS inclusive model and energized by launching something new * Bachelor's degree required (Master's preferred); 2\+ years of teaching experience, ideally in an urban public or charter school * Strong command of computer science, artificial intelligence, or robotics engineering content, including programming in Python, Java, or a similar language; experience teaching AP Computer Science or robotics is highly desirable * NYS certification in Computer Science preferred. Candidates holding a CE, CEAS, or Standard Certification in Engineering Technology are encouraged to apply, as are candidates working toward certification * Experience supporting scholars with IEPs and autistic scholars, and a belief that every scholar can master rigorous content * Reflective, data\-driven, and eager for feedback **Compensation** * Competitive salary commensurate with experience, based on the NCS teacher salary schedule, with a range of $76,000\-$136,200 (SY 27\-28\). The starting salary for NYS\-**certified teachers is $82,000\.** * Comprehensive benefits, including medical, vision, and dental insurance, a competitive retirement plan, and parental leave. * Laptop provided KXCsWmu6NF

jobs.title: FDE-Greece
jobs.description: ENGINEER **Location: Remote \| Type: Contract** **About Newpage Solutions** =========================== Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real\-world health challenges. From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human\-centered practices. We are proud to be a ‘**Great Place to Work®’ certified** company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top **Glassdoor rating** and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people’s lives. **Your Mission** ================ We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built—not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in. You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end\-to\-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself. This is a builder\-first individual\-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python. **What You’ll Do** ================== **Problem / Opportunity Discovery** ----------------------------------- * Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable. * Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week. * Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships. * Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision. * Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques. **Build (fast) with AI** ------------------------ * When the brief is clear, head down and produce. * Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain\-driven design. * Create full stack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, Fast API, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono. * Architect and ship production\-grade agentic applications using Lang Graph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer. * Integrate frontier and self\-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open\-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors. * Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with Elasticsearch or Solr, and BM25 \+ similarity search. * Work across relational, document, key\-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event\-driven patterns where they fit, not by default. * Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub\-agents—with discipline and review. * Fine\-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it. **Test, Deploy, Productionize** ------------------------------- * Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users. * Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless—chosen for fit, not preference. * Treat evals as a first\-class discipline: hands\-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear\-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short. * Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins). * Own what you build end\-to\-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running. * Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices. **What You Bring** ================== * We are looking for overall 7\+ years into IT industry and 3\+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches—full stack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more. * Hands\-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi\-step using Lang Graph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration. * Active, structured use of AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub\-agents, skills, and innovative approaches. * Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12\-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You've built Next.js applications, Fast API services, and similar. * End\-to\-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses. * Cloud\-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel—with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions. * A no\-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost. * A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave—and where they break—and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost. * Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them. * A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions. * A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high\-impact technical challenges. * Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline. **Bonus Skills / Experience** ----------------------------- * Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI. * MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker). * Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue). * Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure. * AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications. **What We Offer** ================= At Newpage, we’re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer: * A people\-first culture \- Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging * Smart, purposeful collaboration \- Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges * Balance that lasts \- We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life * Room to grow \- Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you * Meaningful rewards \- Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential **Ready to Apply?** =================== Let’s build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to: *ramadevi.bhumireddy@newpage.io* #### **More about Newpage** Newpage is a digital health solutions company. We devote ourselves to advancing the quality of life by enhancing health and optimizing the longevity of people. We do this by, passionately building futuristic technologies for global organizations across the healthcare ecosystem. We partake at every stage from problem definition, strategy \& service design, user research, UX design, and agile software development – utilizing lean practices to deliver and validate highly innovative digital health solutions that drive user value and business transformation. Newpage is recognized by ‘CIO’s Review’ as “Top 50 Promising Healthcare Solution Providers” and Great Place to Work Certified (GPTW) 2023 \& 2024\.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: AI Solutions Engineer Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 2996 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. Realtor.com is looking for a Sr. AI Solutions Engineer to turn business challenges into practical AI solutions. You will collaborate with teams to uncover pain points, build rapid prototypes, and coach colleagues so they can extend what you start. Your work will span three of our internal AI tracks: Assist (knowledge copilots), Automate (workflow agents), and Compose (low\-code apps). If you thrive on analyzing problems, building hands\-on solutions, and teaching others, this role is for you. Join us as our newest Sr. AI Solutions Engineer, and help change the world of real estate, one home at a time. Top Reasons to Apply: * Pioneer a first\-of\-its\-kind role at Realtor.com – Shape the future of AI developer productivity by building the foundational systems, tools, and workflows from the ground up. * Drive AI adoption and learning across the company – Help design, teach, and scale AI best practices that will empower teams across Product, Engineering, and Ops. * Make a big impact while leveling up your own skills – Contribute meaningfully to Realtor.com's AI strategy and enjoy continuous learning opportunities in one of tech’s fastest\-moving spaces. What You'll Do: * Discover and design \- Interview stakeholders, map workflows, estimate impact, and choose whether Assist, Automate, or Compose is the right fit, using discovery templates in Miro. * Prototype Assist solutions \- Stand up knowledge copilots with Glean Search and Assistant, Gemini for Workspace, etc. including prompt libraries and retrieval configs. * Develop/Automate solutions \- Build agentic workflows with Google ADK, LangChain, CrewAI, n8n, etc. and harden the winners into production. * Create Compose solutions \- Create fullstack AI applications with integrations across various internal tools. Own and maintain the full lifecycle of these applications, from frontend and backend development, production implementation, cloud resource management, and hand off runbooks to business owners. * Teach and evangelize \- Produce AI flight\-school decks, hands\-on labs, prompt cheat sheets, and run office hours so PMs, analysts, and ops teams can build confidently. * Measure and iterate \- Track adoption, demo outcomes at town halls, and feed lessons into the next solution cycle. What You'll Bring: * Experienced in stakeholder discovery, process mapping, and turning requirements into clear AI use cases. * Hands\-on with Assist and knowledge retrieval tools such as Glean, Gemini, Windsurf, or Claude Code and be able to fine\-tune retrieval settings. * Comfortable with Automate tooling like Glean Agents, Vertex AI and can chain steps across APIs. * Experience with cloud\-based development, deployment, and architecture, including tools and technologies such as CircleCI, Kafka, Kubernetes, GraphQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS), and GCP * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment best practices * Exposure to monitoring systems, incident alerting, and service reliability practices to support SLAs * Skilled at crafting and refining LLM prompts, context engineering, MCPs, A2A protocol, Human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation and feedback, and explaining basics to newcomers. * 2\+ years of experience with data and APIs (SQL, REST, JSON, CSV), and able to integrate them into AI workflows. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related field or related experience * Natural educator who has led workshops or produced self\-serve guides that stick. * Iterative by nature, quick to test, learn, and refine without needing a formal CS degree. How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Apply Now

jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer (Remote US)
jobs.description: **Overview** As Senior AI Engineer, you will design, build and operate the AI systems behind Bible Gateway, from retrieval pipelines and model integrations to evaluations and guardrails. You will collaborate with product, UX, research, and engineering to evaluate and ship the AI experiences that serve users who want to encounter the Bible from a variety of perspectives. Your job is to understand where AI helps users (and where it doesn’t), and to build solutions that meet their needs, stay faithful to the text, respect license agreements, and hold up under heavy traffic. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain production AI services (RAG pipelines, tool calling, structured output, etc.) that power experiences for millions of users. * Manage and extend existing AI features on Bible Gateway to maximize their value to users while balancing business needs, including cost, latency, and performance. * Partner with product, UX, and research to identify potential features (both user\-facing and behind\-the\-scenes), assess their feasibility, prototype their implementation, and deploy them at scale. * Create and manage evals that assess AI performance both quantitatively and qualitatively on multiple dimensions, including accuracy, faithfulness to the text, tone, and safety. * Ensure guardrails appropriately enforce safety and theological constraints. * Analyze data using AI to uncover unmet needs and to size opportunities. * Streamline internal operations using AI where appropriate. **Qualifications** **Knowledge:** * Embedding models, vector databases, hybrid lexical and semantic search, and reranking. * RAG architectures and tradeoffs. * AI security risks: prompt injection, jailbreaks and data leakage. * Privacy regulations as they apply to AI **Areas of Exposure/Experience:** * Familiarity with Node.js a plus. * Familiarity with serving models through Amazon Bedrock a plus. * Familiarity with managing licensed content a plus. * Multilingual NLP, including tokenization and search issues in non\-Latin scripts, a plus. Work **Experience:** * 5\+ years of software engineering, including 2\+ years building and shipping ML or LLM\-powered features in production. * Hands\-on experience with retrieval\-augmented generation: embeddings, vector and hybrid search, chunking, reranking and prompt design. * Shipped AI features in a consumer\-facing product. * A track record of building evaluation pipelines and using them to decide what ships. HarperCollins Christian Publishing is a company full of people who are passionate about books. When you apply for a position, we want to know why you want to work here, and why you are interested in the job. **That’s why cover letters are strongly preferred.** The salary range for this position is $130,000\- $165,000 **.** We recognize that attracting the best talent is key to our strategy and success as a company. As a result, we aim for flexibility in structuring competitive compensation offers to ensure we are able to attract the best candidates. The quoted salary range represents our good faith estimate as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate's experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process. In addition to cash compensation, the company provides a comprehensive and highly competitive benefits package, with a variety of physical health, retirement and savings, caregiving, emotional wellbeing, transportation, and other benefits, including "elective" benefits employees may select to best fit the needs and personal situations of our diverse workforce. Visitour careers webpage (https://www.harpercollins.com/pages/careers) for more information. *HarperCollins Christian Publishing is an equal opportunity employer.* *HarperCollins Christian Publishing* is committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities, in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application, due to a disability, email us at TalentManagement@harpercollins.com . Note: we will only respond to accommodation requests. **Job Locations** *US* **Category** *Direct to Consumer (Bible Gateway)*

jobs.title: AI Perception Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Location:** United States, Remote **Type:** Full\-time **Travel:** Approximately 10%, including quarterly onsite meetings at a Nextpower California office and visits to solar farms or test sites **Reports to:** Senior Director, Robotics \& Autonomy **About Nextpower** =================== Nextpower is a global leader in intelligent solar tracker and software solutions, optimizing solar power plant performance worldwide. Our Robotics and Autonomy team develops and deploys robotic inspection systems for live and under\-construction solar sites. Construction environments can be busy, crowded, and constantly changing, with active equipment and people requiring careful coordination. Once a site is operating, it may be remote and quiet, with robots working for long periods in open, sun\-exposed conditions and little or no human presence. Our systems combine mobility, perception, embedded computing, autonomy, and cloud intelligence to increase inspection capacity, improve safety, and scale operations. We are seeking an AI Perception Engineer II to build, deploy, and own computer vision and perception software for robotic inspection. You will develop models for object detection, recognition, tracking, classification, segmentation, and fault detection, and own the robot\-side software nodes that run those models in deployed systems. You will also build cloud\-assisted workflows that use APIs to route compute\-intensive analysis to cloud services when appropriate. **Role Overview** ================= This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on building, deploying, testing, and improving AI models and perception software on real systems. You will own perception nodes running on the robot, optimize models for embedded or GPU\-based hardware, and connect robot\-side processing with cloud APIs for additional compute and analysis. When a model identifies a potential fault or uncertainty, you will work with the mission management system to trigger targeted data collection, such as additional images, viewpoints, or sensor measurements, so the system can improve the inspection result. You will work closely with the autonomy and reliability leads and the broader engineering team to deliver a working system and contribute to the inspection roadmap. You will visit test and operating sites to understand inspection conditions, observe how people work, collect representative data, and investigate system behavior. The perception system must perform across very different environments: dynamic construction sites with people, vehicles, and frequent changes, as well as remote, quiet operating sites exposed to sun and dust, where robots may work for long periods without nearby human support. The role combines computer vision and machine learning with strong software engineering and practical robotics integration. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Computer Vision and Model Development** * Develop, train, and evaluate computer vision models for object detection, recognition, tracking, classification, segmentation, and inspection fault detection. * Prepare datasets, review labels, identify data gaps, and work with inspection specialists to improve training data quality. * Build and maintain repeatable model training and evaluation pipelines, including model and dataset versioning. * Apply probability, statistics, and sound experimental methods to model development and evaluation. **Benchmarking and Testing** * Build benchmarks that measure model performance across fault classes, equipment, sites, and capture conditions. * Analyze false positives, false negatives, and other model errors to identify causes and prioritize improvements. * Test model and software changes as part of the release process. Document results, limitations, and release evidence. **Deployment and Field Validation** * Optimize and deploy models to embedded or GPU\-based hardware, and profile performance on target systems. * Own and maintain perception and inspection software nodes that run on the robot, including their interfaces, performance, health reporting, and integration with the wider system. * Build robot\-to\-cloud workflows that use cloud\-based APIs to route compute\-intensive inference or analysis when appropriate, while accounting for connectivity, latency, bandwidth, and degraded\-operation behavior. * Integrate model results with mission management so detected faults, low\-confidence results, or data gaps can trigger targeted collection of additional images, viewpoints, or sensor measurements. * Develop and evaluate sensor\-fusion approaches using vision, lidar, GPS, IMU, and, where applicable, multispectral data to improve inspection context and fault assessment. * Visit construction and operating sites to observe inspection workflows, collect representative data, and evaluate perception performance in busy, changing environments and remote, sun\-exposed sites. **Software Delivery and Team Execution** * Write mai ability, statistics, benchmarking, and model evaluation. * Experience developing maintainable software, writing automated tests, debugging deployed systems, and testing integrated software or model changes for release. * Experience using Git\-based workflows, including creating pull requests, participating in code reviews, and addressing review feedback. * Experience documenting technical work, breaking it into trackable tasks in Jira or a similar system, communicating progress, and presenting results clearly. * Ability and willingness to test systems on physical robots and travel to test or operating sites * Coachable and collaborative, with the ability to take technical feedback, apply it to your work, and contribute effectively on a fast\-moving engineering team. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience using cloud\-based APIs or distributed compute workflows to scale model inference, analysis, or training while coordinating with edge systems. * Experience developing software for mobile robots, including ROS or ROS2 nodes, sensor interfaces, and deployed robot workflows. * Experience with autonomy concepts such as motion planning, localization, and state estimation, and how perception outputs support those capabilities. * Experience with simulation, software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL), hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL), test\-driven development, or other rigorous methods for validating robotics and machine learning systems. * Experience with semi\-supervised learning that combines simulated and real\-world data. * Experience creating or using photorealistic simulation environments and log\-replay systems to generate, reproduce, and evaluate perception scenarios. * Experience jobs.title: Senior AI Perception Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Senior AI Perception Engineer **Location:** United States, Remote **Type:** Full\-time **Travel:** Approximately 10%, including quarterly onsite meetings at a Nextpower California office and visits to solar farms or test sites **Reports to:** Senior Director, Robotics \& Autonomy **About Nextpower** =================== Nextpower is a global leader in intelligent solar tracker and software solutions, optimizing solar power plant performance worldwide. Our Robotics and Autonomy team develops and deploys robotic inspection systems for live and under\-construction solar sites. Construction environments can be busy, crowded, and constantly changing, with active equipment and people requiring careful coordination. Once a site is operating, it may be remote and quiet, with robots working for long periods in open, sun\-exposed conditions and little or no human presence. Our systems combine mobility, perception, embedded computing, autonomy, and cloud intelligence to increase inspection capacity, improve safety, and scale operations. We are seeking a Senior AI Perception Engineer to provide hands\-on technical leadership for computer vision and perception systems used in robotic inspection. You will shape the technical direction, build and deploy models, and own the software and data workflows that take perception from development through field validation and release. You will help the team turn robot\-collected data and human inspection expertise into reliable, measurable improvements in automated inspection. **Role Overview** ================= This is a senior individual\-contributor role for an engineer who can move between model behavior, software architecture, and real system performance. You will lead the design and deployment of perception capabilities across robot\-side nodes and cloud\-assisted workflows, applying rigorous statistical methods to data, model evaluation, and fault assessment. You will work with mission management to close the loop between model results and targeted data collection, and you will set a high technical bar for testing, releases, and operational performance. You will work closely with the autonomy and reliability leads and the broader engineering team to deliver a working system and shape the inspection roadmap. You will visit test and operating sites to observe workflows, collect representative data, and investigate system behavior across busy construction environments and remote, sun\-exposed operating sites. This role combines deep computer vision and machine learning expertise with strong software engineering, system\-level judgment, and practical robotics experience. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Computer Vision and Model Development** * Set technical direction for perception and inspection models, including object detection, recognition, tracking, classification, segmentation, and fault detection. * Design, train, evaluate, and improve models for inspection tasks, balancing accuracy, confidence, latency, compute, and operational requirements. * Define dataset strategy and data quality practices; work with inspection specialists to identify labeling needs, data gaps, edge cases, and opportunities to learn from human decisions and demonstrations. * Build and maintain repeatable training and evaluation pipelines, including dataset, experiment, and model versioning. * Apply probability, statistics, and rigorous experimental methods to model development, uncertainty estimation, anomaly detection, and fault assessment, including statistical distance methods such as Mahalanobis distance where appropriate. * Lead the design and evaluation of sensor\-fusion approaches using vision, lidar, GPS, IMU, and, where applicable, multispectral data. **Benchmarking and Testing** * Define benchmarks, evaluation methodology, and performance criteria across fault classes, equipment, sites, environmental conditions, and data\-capture variations. * Analyze false positives, false negatives, uncertainty, and other model errors; identify root causes and drive prioritized improvements. * Establish repeatable validation using field data, simulation, and log replay to test expected behavior and difficult edge cases. * Ensure model and software changes are tested as part of the release process, with documented results, limitations, and release evidence. **Deployment and Field Validation** * Own the technical architecture and lifecycle of perception and inspection nodes running on the robot, including interfaces, performance, health reporting, deployment, and integration with the wider system. * Design robot\-to\-cloud workflows that use APIs and distributed compute for inference or analysis when appropriate, accounting for connectivity, latency, bandwidth, cost, and degraded\-operation behavior. * Integrate model results with mission management so detected faults, low\-confidence results, or data gaps can trigger targeted collection of additional images, viewpoin ed tests, debugging deployed systems, and testing integrated software or model changes for release. * Experience using Git\-based workflows, including creating pull requests, participating in code reviews, and addressing review feedback. * Experience using cloud\-based APIs or distributed compute workflows to scale model inference, analysis, or training while coordinating with edge systems. * Experience developing software for mobile robots, including ROS or ROS2 nodes, sensor interfaces, and deployed robot workflows. * Experience with simulation, software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL), hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL), test\-driven development, or other rigorous methods for validating robotics and machine learning systems. * Experience building learning pipelines from human demonstrations, observations, or inspection decisions. * Experience providing technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, shared engineering practices, and hands\-on problem solving. * Experience documenting technical work, breaking it into trackable tasks in Jira or a similar system, communicating progress and risks, and presenting results clearly. * Coachable and collaborative, with the ability to take technical feedback, apply it, and contribute effectively on a fast\-moving engineering team. * Ability and willingness to test systems on physical robots and travel to test or operating sites. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience with autonomy concepts such as motion planning, localization, and state estimation, and how perception outputs support those capabilities. * Experience with semi\-supervised learning that combines simulated and real\-world data. * Experience creating or using photorealistic simulation environments and log\-replay systems to generate, reproduce, and evaluate perception scenarios. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools, such as Cursor, Codex, or similar coding agents, to accelerate implementation, testing, and documentation while independently validating the output and maintaining ownership of code quality. * Experience with solar equipment, industrial inspection, construction, or other visual quality applications. **Join Us** jobs.title: Information Systems Security Specialist
jobs.description: Nightwing provides technically advanced full\-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. Our capabilities include cyber space operations, cyber defense and resiliency, vulnerability research, ubiquitous technical surveillance, data intelligence, lifecycle mission enablement, and software modernization. Nightwing brings disruptive technologies, agility, and competitive offerings to customers in the intelligence community, defense, civil, and commercial markets. We are seeking an Information Systems Security Specialist to implement and support Comply‑to‑Connect (C2C) capabilities that control device access to enterprise networks. In this role, you will deploy and configure C2C tools, integrate device discovery and posture assessment, enforce access policies, review compliance reports, and coordinate remediation of non‑compliant assets across mission‑critical environments. You will work closely with cybersecurity operations, systems engineering, and network infrastructure teams to ensure only trusted, compliant devices connect to accredited systems and networks, directly supporting continuous monitoring and information assurance requirements. **Key Responsibilities** **C2C Implementation \& Tooling** * Deploy, configure, and maintain Comply‑to‑Connect / NAC tools and related components. * Integrate device discovery, asset identification, and posture assessment into existing network and security infrastructure. * Ensure C2C solutions align with enterprise architecture, ATO/IA requirements, and configuration baselines. * Coordinate with engineering teams on C2C tool deployment, upgrades, and troubleshooting. **Network Access Control \& Policy Enforcement** * Implement and enforce network access policies based on device posture, compliance status, and mission needs. * Integrate C2C controls with authentication, authorization, and network segmentation mechanisms. * Support continuous monitoring by ensuring all connected assets are assessed against defined security baselines. * Work with SOC and defensive cyber teams to align C2C enforcement with detection and response activities. **Compliance Monitoring \& Reporting** * Monitor C2C dashboards and reports to identify non‑compliant, unmanaged, or rogue devices. * Produce routine compliance and posture reports for leadership, system owners, and IA staff. * Provide C2C evidence and reporting to support audits, inspections, and ATO/RMF activities. * Recommend policy or configuration adjustments based on observed compliance trends. **Remediation Coordination** * Coordinate remediation of non‑compliant assets with system owners, system administrators, and network teams. * Track remediation actions (patching, configuration changes, quarantine) and verify restored compliance. * Document exceptions, waivers, and risk‑acceptance decisions in accordance with program guidance. * Align C2C posture checks with vulnerability management and configuration management processes. **Mission \& Stakeholder Support** * Collaborate with cybersecurity, network operations, and systems engineering teams to ensure C2C supports mission operations. * Provide technical input on device access and posture requirements for new systems, services, and network changes. * Contribute to SOPs, playbooks, and run books for C2C operations and incident handling. **Required Qualifications** **Education \& Certification** * Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related STEM field; or equivalent combination of education and experience. * DoD 8570/8140 baseline certification (e.g., Security\+, CySA\+, SSCP) or ability to obtain within 6 months of hire. **Experience** * 3–5\+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, network security, or systems security administration. * Hands‑on experience with one or more of the following: + Network Access Control (NAC) or C2C platforms. + Enterprise network infrastructure (switches, routers, firewalls). + Endpoint security, configuration management, or asset management tools. * Experience working in DoD or Intelligence Community environments with IA or ATO/RMF requirements. * Experience collaborating with SOC, network operations, and systems engineering teams. **Technical Knowledge** * Understanding of Comply‑to‑Connect concepts, device posture assessment, and network access control. * Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, VLANs, routing, and network segmentation. * Familiarity with security baselines, configuration standards, and vulnerability remediation processes. * Ability to interpret compliance and posture data and translate it into actionable remediation steps. * Awareness of common security frameworks and controls (e.g., NIST 800‑53, RMF). **Preferred Qualifications** * Direct experience implementing or operating C2C solutions in DoD or IC environments. * Experience with major NAC/C2C platforms and integration with directory services, SIEM, and endpoint tools. * Familiarity with cloud or hybrid networks and associated access control mechanisms. * Advanced certifications such as CISSP, CASP\+, CySA\+, or GIAC security engineering certifications. **Why Nightwing** * Contribute directly to mission‑critical cybersecurity operations supporting the Intelligence Community and national security objectives. * Gain hands‑on experience with leading security monitoring, vulnerability management, and automated validation tools. * Work alongside experienced cyber operators and engineers who are committed to mentorship, professional growth, and operational excellence. * Engage in challenging, meaningful work where your analysis and attention to detail directly impact mission resilience and security outcomes. * Competitive compensation with opportunities for advancement as you develop deeper expertise in detection engineering, threat hunting, and automated security validation. **Salary \& Benefits** The salary associated with this position ($99,000\-$206,000\) is commensurate with the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, and demonstrated level of expertise. Compensation will be determined based on these factors to ensure alignment with skills, responsibilities, and market standards. Nightwing offers medical, vision and dental insurance coverage in addition to a 401k plan, PTO, Holidays, and additional insurances. *Nightwing is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.*

jobs.title: AI Operations
jobs.description: **About Northern Trust** As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 1\. Develop software, typically in Python, to independently acquire data from disparate sources (databases, files, APIs, etc.) and combine them into appropriate training, validation and testing datasets. 2\. Analyze raw datasets using descriptive statistics, working directly with domain experts to understand the meaning of data fields 3\. Have a deep understanding of Generative AI and LLMs, evaluation metrics and theory behind LLMs \& conversational AI, since Gen AI will be a core part of many solutions being developed at the Bank. 4\. Be able to explain the full pattern of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and make recommendations on which specifics technology and techniques to use when building solutions based on this pattern. In most cases the candidate will be developing and integrating Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems on Azure cloud. 5\. Leverage open\-source AI software like TensorFlow, PyTorch, HuggingFace, LangChain, AutoGen, LangGraph and LamaIndex for the solution development and evaluation. 6\. Evaluate various AI frameworks and services for efficacy and make recommendations on their inclusion as standardized tooling for AI development. 7\. Integrate these tools and software with Azure services for a seamless development and deployment experience. 8\. IAC and automation – leverage Terraform for automating cloud provisioning of resources and other infrastructure tasks. 9\. Build unit tests, data quality checks and data pipelines to ensure that algorithms use trusted data. 10\. Implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, ML Ops, Github Actions, TerraForms for the automated deployment of AI solutions. 11\. Utilize Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for managing and scaling containerized AI applications. 12\. Regularly update and maintain the AI models, ensuring their relevance and effectiveness using Azure Monitory tools. 13\. Enforce strict security measures and controls in Azure, including network security configurations and identity management, data encryption and privacy. 14\. Comply with industry standards, best practices and regulations for AI solutions. 16\. Work across multiple projects in a fluid environment where work is required across the full research lifecycle from forming a hypothesis, acquiring data, and developing ETL\-style software to presenting findings. 16\. Provide guidance to other software development teams as prototypes and frameworks are engineered for full production environments Knowledge: * IAC and automation concepts with various tools * Full stack Azure application development * Security related concepts and controls, particularly in the cloud environment: virtual networks, subnets, private endpoints, authentication mechanisms, identities and role based access. * Data protection and encryption techniques and tooling such as key vaults, encryption keys, masking and concepts such as BYOK. * DevOps including CI/CD techniques and tools particularly Azure based and Github repos * Develop and maintain an understanding of many algorithms across supervised learning, unsupervised learning and time series analysis * Propose and develop machine learning ensemble methods that exhibit the best out\-of\-sample characteristics possible given the input dataset * Utilize expertise in machine learning algorithms to tune algorithms using available hyper\-parameters and carefully select feature subsets * Discover biases or leakage in datasets and ensure that train/test splits reflect realistic expectations of real\-world performance * Run large scale (either in parallel and/or distributed) training and inference jobs on private or public cloud infrastructure * Present findings to internal and external customers using both data science language (F1 scores, regression error, statistical significance, etc.) as well as business domain specific language gained from experience analyzing the data in scope. * Plan and execute data science training sessions and hackathons * Work with external parties (vendors, universities, etc.) to incorporate new techniques and tools into the data science lab. * Developing open\-source software in a collaborative environment, desired but not required. Experience: * A Bachelor’s degrees in Computer Science or related field required. * Languages in Python, Common Python libraries (NumPy , Pandas, Sklearn, etc.), Linux based operating systems, and basic development tools (Python IDEs, source control, etc.) required. * Tools in advanced distributed machine learning frameworks (e.g. Keras, TF, etc.), Azure cloud infrastructure is preferred. * Certifications in Azure Security, DevOps, and Azure AI Engineer Associate or equivalent are preferred, but not required. Salary Range: $133,500 \- 226,900 USD*Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. Northern Trust provides a comprehensive benefits package including retirement benefits (401k and pension), health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, spending accounts and disability), paid time off, parental and caregiver leave, life \& accident insurance, and other voluntary and well\-being benefits. Northern Trust also provides a discretionary bonus program that may include an equity component.* **Work Authorization** Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. **Reasonable Accommodation** Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

If you're passionate about driving change and eager to impact the real estate and insurance market, Obie is the place for you. Our Chicago based employees are hybrid, and expected to be in office on Tuesdays and Thursdays. **Brief Summary of Role** Hard work, high standards, real impact. Obie is on a mission to redefine real estate insurance, and we need motivated full\-stack engineers (React, GraphQL, Node.js) to help us build. This isn’t just a coding job—it’s an opportunity to shape our product, our team, and our company from the ground up. The work will be fast, challenging, and deeply rewarding. If you're looking for a place where your code actually matters, read on. **How We Show Up as a Tech Team*** On the Obie Tech Team, we show up **for each other, in the quality of our work, and in the simplicity of our solutions.** * **Make an impact.** We’re growing fast, and this role offers the chance to influence key decisions and take on leadership opportunities. * **Move fast, ship faster.** We deploy multiple times per day and ship features in days, not months. If you love speed and iteration, you’ll thrive here. **What you'll Do*** **Build. Ship. Improve.** Write high\-quality, high\-performance, maintainable code. * **Own your work**—write tests, review code, and keep tech debt in check. * **Architect and develop** applications, databases, and APIs that drive our platform. * **Collaborate across teams** to solve real business challenges. * **Power our partnerships** by building and scaling APIs that turn archaic systems into elegant, real\-time integrations. * **Build dashboards** that our customers and agents rely on daily to make sense of their life and work. * **Automate** workflows so Obie employees can move faster and focus on high\-value work. * Help us go to market with new insurance products and state expansions in record time. **What you'll Bring*** Experience with **React, Node.js, TypeScript, relational databases, testing frameworks, and CICD tools**. * A **bias for action**—strong ability to prioritize, multitask, and deliver. * **Agile mindset**—comfortable with fast iterations and quick pivots. * **Clear, effective communication**, especially in a distributed team environment. * **2\+ years of experience** in software development. * **Degree in CS or related field preferred**—but talent and drive matter more. **This role is not for everyone.** It’s for builders, problem\-solvers, and engineers who want their work to **mean something**. If that’s you, let’s talk. **Interview Process** At Obie, transparency is core to our interview process. We focus on open communication and a positive experience; no trick questions—just honest conversations about your skills and aspirations. To help you prepare, please familiarize yourself with these resources before moving forward:* Our company’s blog to learn more about the market we serve and the information our customers value. * Check out our LinkedIn to see how people interact with our brand and product. * Press and podcast features like Inc. 5000, TechCrunch, Innovate State, Uncontested Investing Podcast, Insurtech Amplified Podcast * Meet us and get to know Obie You'll first talk to Kara on a 30\-minute call for a mutual fit conversation. We’ll talk about your experience, what you’re looking for, and answer any questions about Obie’s team, culture, and product. * Technical Discussion (45 minutes) Next, you’ll meet with one of our **Engineering leaders**, and another member of the team, for a deep dive into your technical skills. Expect a conversation about your experience, approach to problem\-solving, and key technologies. * Take\-Home Coding Challenge You’ll complete a **small application using React and Node.js**. * Live Pairing Session (90 minutes) You’ll walk through your coding challenge with a few engineers and tackle **additional technical concepts** not covered in the take\-home. This is also a chance to see how we work and collaborate. **Moving Forward with Obie** Obie is a leading insurance platform for real estate investors, combining proprietary technology with a modern insurance experience to simplify Home and Landlord insurance. Today, we serve customers nationwide through direct digital experiences, a growing network of insurance agents, and strategic partnerships with lenders, property management platforms, and real estate technology companies. As part of The Baldwin Group, one of the nation's leading insurance distribution platforms and a USA TODAY Top Workplace, we're combining the agility of a fast\-growing technology company with the scale, resources, and career opportunities of a larger organization as we shape the future of investment property insurance. **Obie has you Covered** Being in the insurance industry, we understand the importance of comprehensive benefits for you and your family. These are just some of the benefits and perks we provide:* Comprehensive health, dental, vision and life insurance * Flexible paid time off including 12 week Paid Parental Leave * Retirement savings plan with company match * Monthly stipends to support a healthy lifestyle and learning and development opportunities Obie values transparency and data driven decision making, enabling us to have a consistent and equitable approach to compensation. We are informed by a benchmarking tool which provides real time compensation data allowing us to regularly check our salary ranges against other venture backed companies and startups within our industry. We've provided the full base salary range for this role below, but please note that we typically target the mid point of the salary range to allow room for growth within the role. Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of relevant experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.* **Note: we’ll only be considering applications that include a video submission** of you walking through your resume and sharing why you’d be a good fit for this role. Please be sure to send your video submission to eng\-hiring@obieinsurance.com. No need to be on camera, a screenshare video will suffice! **The pay range for this role is:** 90,000 \- 150,000 USD per year(United States)

jobs.title: Director, Exposure Assessment & Evaluation

We believe environmental responsibility and human progress are interconnected, interwoven and international. Our scientists, engineers, field teams, consultants and professionals collaborate across disciplines and geographies, guiding industries and governments, ensuring that communities and environments thrive. When you join us, you’re not just forging a career, you’re joining a movement. A movement for better thinking, smarter solutions and lasting impact. Together, we will advance our way of life and protect the integrity of our environment every step of the way. **A Day in the Life** As a Director, Exposure Assessment \& Evaluation, you’ll be responsible for providing strategic, technical, and business development leadership in the fields of exposure science, complex industrial hygiene and field staffing sampling strategies, synergistically adding to the Health Sciences team’s current expertise in this area. You also serve as a touch point within Onterris for risk exposure assessment services and may act as a significant resource to other lines of business (i.e., emergency response, building sciences, etc.) connecting the Health Sciences technical expertise in the fields of toxicology to those projects where significant exposure evaluation and assessment is required. Ultimately, the successful applicant will play a multi\-faceted role of technical expert, team and business leader, and collaborator. The compensation range is commensurate with experience, skillset, and geographic location. To thrive in this role, you’ll be comfortable taking ownership of the following responsibilities: * Have the opportunity to complete a benchmarking review of Onterris’ Health Sciences Exposure Assessment and Evaluation offerings and develop key programs or initiatives to drive strategic growth. * Expand upon (or refine) the current service offerings of this LOB by working with the Sales \& Commercial Strategy Teams to achieve defined revenue growth goals. * Collaborate with the Talent Acquisition team to identify and on\-board 1\-2 key strategic scientific staff. As a leading financial service provider with over 80 years of experience serving 123,000\+ members, Orange County's Credit Union is currently $2\+ billion in assets \& growing. **Generous benefits include:*** Anthem HMO/PPO, Delta Dental, Unum options \- from day one * Life insurance at no cost to employees. * 401(k) – We match up to 6% of the employee’s contribution (dollar for dollar) * Vacation hours – 13 days per year and rolls over year to year, and increases with tenure * Sick hours – 7 days per year and paid holidays * Annual performance merit increases * Professional and personal development programs, including educational grants up to $1k per year, and step progression opportunities * Annual discretionary bonus * Professional, friendly work environment focused on achieving goals, recognizing successes, and excelling at member service. **POSITION SUMMARY:** Under minimal direction, the Enterprise Architect is responsible for designing cloud\-native solutions, deconstructing our legacy architecture, and defining clear, executable roadmaps to modernize OCFCU’s technology platforms. This role will work across core banking (Symitar/Episys), digital banking (e.g., Lumin), lending \& payments, data \& analytics, and integration platforms to move OCFCU from tightly coupled legacy systems to modern, scalable, secure, and observable architectures. This includes leveraging cloud services, APIs, event\-driven patterns, and AI/LLM capabilities where they make sense, and ensuring everything is properly documented and ready for handoff to Operations. This role will spend a significant portion of time embedded with teams reviewing designs, building reference implementations, prototyping, and helping teams ship better systems that can be operated reliably by OCFCU’s Infrastructure and Operations teams. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:****1\. Enterprise \& Solution Architecture (Hands\-On)*** Designs target\-state architecture for key OCFCU domains including: + Core banking \& surrounding ecosystem (Symitar, Jack Henry integrations, payments, statements, ancillary services). + Digital banking channels (online, mobile, APIs, third\-party fintech integrations). + Lending, onboarding, and back\-office platforms. * Creates end\-to\-end solution designs: context diagrams, sequence/flow diagrams, APIs, data models, non\-functional requirements (NFRs), and security patterns. * Develop reference architecture for: + Cloud\-native services (e.g., Azure/AWS), APIs, and integration layers. + Event\-driven workflows (e.g., member activity, transactions, alerts, service). * Builds and maintains a living architecture blueprint and application portfolio for OCFCU, including current state, target state, and interim milestones that align with the technology roadmap. **2\. Legacy Decomposition \& Modernization*** Deep\-dives into OCFCU’s existing legacy and vendor platforms: Symitar customizations, batch jobs, flat\-file/EDI interfaces, on\-prem services, and custom applications. * Documents current\-state architectures, dependencies, data flows, and technical debt in a form usable by engineers, operations, and leadership. * Defines pragmatic modernization strategies, such as: + Encapsulating legacy systems via APIs. + Strangler patterns to incrementally replace monolithic functionality. + Re\-platforming or re\-architecting high\-risk/high\-value components. * Prioritizes modernization efforts in partnership with the CIO, VP\-level leaders, and business/product owners based on **member impact, operational risk, and business value**. * Works closely with delivery teams to execute modernization iteratively, favoring measurable wins over “big bang” cutovers. **3\. Cloud\-Native \& AI/LLM Patterns for Financial Services*** Designs solutions that leverage cloud platforms (e.g., Azure/AWS) with a focus on: + Security and regulatory compliance (NCUA, FFIEC, GLBA). + Resiliency, performance, and cost optimization. + Observability (logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards). * Defines patterns for: + Containerization and/or serverless workloads. + API gateways, integration hubs, and secure connectivity to Symitar and other vendors. + Messaging/event\-driven architectures (e.g., for real\-time ale associates can perform the essential functions of the job.* * Performs other work\-related duties as assigned. * This position is currently hybrid\-eligible, with the expectation of three days pre\-assigned on\-site attendance. This role requires California residency and living within a 50\-mile commute of our headquarters. * May be a disaster recovery team member or take directives from a disaster team recovery member. **QUALIFICATIONS:****Experience / Training / Education:*** 8\+ years of experience in software engineering and architecture roles, with substantial hands\-on design and implementation work. * Education: Computer Science degree preferred. * Demonstrated experience designing and delivering **cloud\-native solutions** on a major cloud platform (Azure and/or AWS), including: + APIs and microservices. + Containerization and/or serverless. + Messaging/event\-driven architectures. + Observability and reliability patterns. * Proven experience **decomposing legacy or vendor\-centric environments** and delivering stepwise modernization in production (e.g., core banking, digital banking, or similar transactional systems). * Practical exposure to AI/ML/LLM\-enabled solutions, such as integrating cloud AI services, building AI\-backed features, or partnering with data science/analytics teams. * Experience producing operational documentation (runbooks, support models, monitoring/alerting requirements) that enables effective, stable handoffs to Operations. * Experience in financial services preferred, particularly banking or credit unions, with familiarity around NCUA, FFIEC, GLBA, and vendor risk considerations. * Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices (Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, deployment pipelines), data platforms (data warehouse/lake, analytics, BI), and API management platforms and/or service meshes preferred. * Prior participation in or ownership of enterprise architecture practices preferred (road mapping, standards, reference architecture) even without direct people management. **Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:*** Solid understanding of modern integration patterns: REST/GraphQL APIs, batch/EDI, messaging/streaming, and iPaaS/integration platforms. * Strong grasp of security\-by\-design and compliance expectations for financial institutions, including: + Authentication/authorization, secrets management, encryption, Python, or TypeScript/Node.js). * Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across technology, risk, and business teams. * Familiarity with core banking and digital banking platforms preferred (e.g., Symitar, Jack Henry ecosystem, digital banking providers, lending platforms). * Ability to speak and hear to give and receive instructions and information to others
