jobs.title: Founding Sales (Science)
jobs.description: Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products \- from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing. Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI\-automated hardware engineering with AI\-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real\-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products. We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams \- AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing. Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn. **Role Overview** ================= We're hiring Founding Sales (Science) to win and grow enterprise customers for CurieOS across the scientific sector. This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first conversation to signed enterprise license. You'll sell to a specific group of buyers: scientific R\&D organisations (chemicals, advanced materials, life sciences and energy). Most employ thousands of people. CurieOS is an operating system for science and engineering. Scientists and engineers give it multi\-step, goal\-driven instructions. CurieOS then runs literature review, atomistic simulation with Orb, data analysis, engineering design and hardware specification. BASF already licenses CurieOS for catalyst R\&D in automotive emissions. Timing matters. Large R\&D and engineering organisations are deciding now how agentic AI fits into their work, and interest in CurieOS from leading companies is strong. You'll convert this opportunity into enterprise contracts by building pipeline, developing strategic relationships and closing complex deals. You'll bring the experience to qualify, price, negotiate and grow enterprise platform partnerships. You'll be one of the first dedicated commercial hires for CurieOS. You'll work directly with the founders, GTM and Product teams, and our own scientists and engineers who use and build CurieOS every day. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Win New Enterprise Customers** * Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through technical evaluation, pilot and close * Convert inbound interest from the largest enterprises in our sectors, and build outbound pipeline into the next tier of target accounts * Close six\- and seven\-figure platform agreements, managing buying committees across R\&D, engineering, IT security, procurement and legal **Sell Across Key Customers** * Sell to scientific R\&D buyers: computational chemists, materials scientists and R\&D directors at chemicals, materials, life sciences and energy companies. * Open new customers with a focused first deployment in R\&D, then expand across the business to the engineering teams that turn those materials into products. * Show buyers clearly why an agentic operating system built for science and engineering does what general\-purpose AI assistants cannot **Run Technical Evaluations That Convert** * Agree pilot success criteria, owners and timelines with the customer before work begins * Lead technical discovery and demos yourself, and work with our forward\-deployed engineers and scientists on drive adoption * Clear security and data\-governance reviews, covering IP protection, data residency and model governance **Set the Standard for Enterprise Sales** * Bring the enterprise sales discipline a fast\-moving team needs: qualification, forecasting, pricing, contracting and pilot structure. Build the CurieOS sales playbook as you go * Expand first deployments into multi\-team and multi\-site enterprise licenses * Turn customer outcomes into references and case studies that shorten the next sales cycle **What We’re Looking For** ========================== * **You know the market for science technologies.** You've sold directly into scientific R\&D in chemicals, materials or life sciences. You know how each sector buys. You also know how large enterprises work: security review, procurement, legal, and the IP and data\-security demands that come with them. You already have a network among R\&D and engineering leaders at large enterprises. * **You've closed large, complex technical deals.** You've sold technical platforms to technical buyers. That could be scientific software, simulation and CAE, R\&D informatics, HPC or AI/ML. You've closed six\- and seven\-figure deals at revenue\-stage companies and hit quota consistently. We're hiring for proven experience, not potential. Experience selling AI or agentic products, or building a sales motion at an early\-stage company, is a plus. Nobody has sold CurieOS before, so you'll be winning new logos without a playbook. * **You build credibility with scientific audiences.** Senior scientists and engineering leaders take you seriously from the first meeting. You can run discovery with a computational chemist and an engineering lead in the same week. You use AI every day in your own work. A STEM degree or scientific background is strongly preferred. **Why Join Orbital Industries?** -------------------------------- * Competitive salary and equity package \- the ability to own part of Orbital Industries as we grow * Flexible and generous paid time off * Excellent health, dental and vision insurance plan * Regular company offsites to the USA and beyond * The chance to define the narrative for a new category — the AI Industrial — at a company where communications is a strategic function, not a support one *Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### ***About Orderful*** ### **Orderful is reinventing how businesses connect and trade. We modernize EDI \- the backbone of $5T\+ in global commerce \- so companies can click\-to\-trade with any partner fast. We’re Series C and among the fastest\-growing in supply\-chain tech. Our culture is high\-ownership, high\-tempo, and low\-ego; we iterate quickly, care deeply about customers and teammates, and love turning manual operations into products. If that sounds like you, let’s talk.** ### ***Our Core Company Values*** ### **As a team, we're guided by four core values. Our customers run mission\-critical orders, shipments, and invoices through Orderful, and we’re building toward a future where most new trading partnerships go live at the click of a button. This is a high\-impact role on a small, senior team, and you’ll help shape how modern software gets built at Orderful. **What you’ll do** * Lead the technical design of major platform initiatives, and write designs that weigh performance, reliability, and the business case from the start. * Turn ambiguous problems into clear specs that AI coding agents can build from, then test and review their work with a high bar. * Own quality as speed increases, from testing and evaluation to diagnosing the hardest bugs in production. * Decide where AI adds value, where deterministic software is the better choice, and where human judgment still matters. * Work with Product, and talk with customers regularly, to understand the problem before you build. * Mentor other engineers, and share what you learn about new models, agents, and workflows so the whole team gets better. **What we’re looking for** * 5\+ years building and running production backend systems, with a record of leading the design of complex systems. * Strong experience with TypeScript and Node.js, APIs, distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, and relational and non\-relational databases. * An AI\-first way of working, with real experience planning, building, and reviewing code at an accelerated pace with tools like Claude Code or Cursor. * A track record of shipping rapidly and owning what you ship, including reliability and on\-call. * Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to figure out what needs to happen without waiting for a plan. * Clear writing and opinions held with good reasoning, plus a collaborative, low\-ego attitude. **Bonus points** * Experience at a high\-growth startup or a company like Stripe, Shopify, Ramp, or Plaid, or experience building integrations, partner APIs, or AI agent evaluation systems. * Experience with EDI, supply chain, logistics, or commerce platforms. ### ***Why work at Orderful?*** * **Flexibility \& Balance:** Unlimited PTO, a full week off for the holidays, remote work options, and schedules that fit your life. * **Wellness \& Support:** Health, dental, vision, and life insurance, an EAP for when life gets tricky, weekly yoga, and paid parental leave. * **Growth \& Connection:** Take on meaningful projects, plan for your future with a 401(k), and build relationships at our twice\-yearly company\-wide offsites. * **Financial Upside:** Competitive pay and stock options that let you share in the company’s success. ### ***At Orderful, building a great community is at the heart of everything we do. We’re looking for team members who lead with empathy and bring a champion mentality to the challenges our industry faces.*** ### ***We believe the best work happens when people show up as their authentic selves and play to their unique strengths. By taking calculated risks and learning together, we’re building the infrastructure that keeps the global economy moving. If you’re ready to grow with a team that stays curious and stays bold, we’d love for you to join us.***

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: At Orion, we're building the intelligent infrastructure that powers modern financial advisory, unifying planning, investing, and client engagement for thousands of advisors and millions of investor accounts. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer who ships, not just experiments. This is a hands\-on, product\-facing role. You'll own the end\-to\-end delivery of AI\-powered features, from architecture to production — working alongside product managers, designers, and engineers to move fast and build things that matter. **Technical Skills:** * Hands\-on experience building and optimizing RAG systems and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Haystack. * Experience designing agentic pipelines and loop architectures, including multi\-step reasoning, tool use, and autonomous retrieval systems * Working knowledge of at least one vector database (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or similar) including indexing and query optimization * Experience building and maintaining data preprocessing, chunking, and vectorization pipelines * Ability to evaluate and select LLMs (GPT\-4o, Claude, LLaMA, Mistral, etc.) based on cost, latency, and real\-world performance * AWS infrastructure experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (Terraform) * Strong API design and service development skills. * Strong experience developing enterprise applications using **C\# and .NET**, with the ability to integrate AI/ML solutions into existing business systems. * Experience designing and maintaining **data pipelines and data architectures** that support AI, analytics, and machine learning workloads. * Ability to build scalable, production\-ready AI solutions while leveraging strong software engineering fundamentals across the Microsoft technology stack. **Responsibilities:** * Own AI features end\-to\-end: design, build, and ship to production * Architect and maintain RAG and agentic pipelines across internal and external data sources * Integrate LLMs and generative AI into products and workflows * Apply prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and custom embeddings to optimize performance in a financial services context * Instrument and monitor AI features in production: quality, latency, regressions, and user impact * Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS using Terraform to support reliable AI service deployment Most companies say they're serious about AI. At Orion, it's the expectation, built into how every engineer on our team works, at every level, every day. Not a tool you reach for occasionally. Not a line on your resume. A force multiplier embedded in the craft. Our CTO put it plainly: AI is not a trend to get ahead of. It is embedded at every level, expected of every engineer, every day. We measure by the leverage we create. At Orion, we build the technology that powers independent financial advisors — the professionals who help everyday people plan for retirement, protect their families, and build financial security. Our platform touches billions in assets under management, which means the software we ship must be fast, reliable, and always getting better. We're not a startup chasing hype. We're a scaled business deliberately building an engineering culture that will take us to the next level — and we're doing it now. Here's what people who've been here a while tend to say: they noticed the informality first and missed the intensity until it caught up with them. Both are real. Nobody is going to make you feel small for not knowing something. And we move fast, care deeply about outcomes, and hold each other to a high standard. The team works hard for each other, which means showing up and contributing at pace isn't just a performance expectation — it's a form of respect. You will own everything you commit. Full stop. Whether you wrote it line by line or shaped it with AI assistance, the standard is the same: you understand it, you can defend it, and it ships with your name on it. AI accelerates execution. It does not replace system design, architectural thinking, or the judgment required to build software that holds up under real load. We operate in fintech, which adds an important layer: client data is sacred and compliance guardrails are non\-negotiable. The engineers who cut corners here are not the engineers who last here. You are not threatened by change — you cause it. You ask "why not?" before you default to the familiar. You experiment, share what you learn, and close gaps fast. You are already using AI tools in your daily workflow. Not as a curiosity. As a practice. \#LI\-AP1 \#LI\-Onsite \#LI\-Hybrid **Recommended Skills:** Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Processing, Large Language Models (LLMs), Modeling Languages, Software Development, Standard ML (Programming Language)**Salary Range:** $140,935\.00 \- $226,905\.00 The pay listed in this posting indicates the estimated pay at the time of this posting; however, may vary depending on geographic location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, Orion offers a competitive benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, and disability coverage on day one, 401(k) plan with employer match, paid parental leave, pet benefits including pawternity leave and pet insurance, student loan repayment and more. **About Us** At Orion, we achieve our best work when we support one another, staying personally accountable to each other and the clients we serve. We create a welcoming environment where everyone is respected, valued, and heard. Our commitment to **create raving** **fans** ensures we consistently exceed client expectations. Thinking differently is in our DNA—we **innovate always**, push boundaries, and reject the status quo to deliver transformative outcomes. Together, we **support one another** and **see it through** to success, driving our collective achievements and those of our clients.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Guest App Platform
jobs.description: **About Owner** Owner is the AI\-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants. We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business. It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more. **Product philosophy** Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically. Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it. Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you. **Our vision** We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online. But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive. Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type. In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age. **Our traction** Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website. More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees. **Our team** Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe. We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth. **Where we work** Owner is a remote\-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in\-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location! **Role Overview** Owner is the leading all\-in\-one platform for independent restaurants. Guest App Platform is the distribution machine behind thousands of white\-labeled restaurant apps: it launches them, signs them, and keeps every one current on the App Store and Google Play at minimal cost. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be the technical lead for that platform as we scale to more and more restaurants. You'll work on problems that look very different from a typical mobile role: Temporal workflows that run across thousands of apps, CI/CD and build infrastructure, code signing and provisioning across Apple and Google accounts at scale, and automation (including AI) that removes manual steps while keeping a human fallback where it matters. This is a high\-ownership, hands\-on role. You'll be the technical anchor for the Guest App Platform team, setting strategy, keeping the team focused on its goals, and making the platform self\-serve so product teams and Launch Specialists can ship into the app without us. This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada. For San Francisco\-based candidates: we have a new HQ in the Presidio for optional in\-person collaboration. **Why we’re looking for you** The Guest App Platform team is responsible for launching and keeping thousands of white\-labeled apps up to date while keeping costs at a minimum. We don't build guest\-facing features. We build the distribution machine underneath every app, and the tooling that lets product teams and our Launch Specialists ship into it. If a restaurant joins Owner, our platform is how their app reaches the App Store and stays healthy. This is not a normal mobile role. Most mobile engineers keep a handful of apps up to date. We manage thousands, day in and day out, across Apple and Google ecosystems, and we automate everything we can, including with AI. **Our Tech Stack** * **Mobile:** React Native, Typescript, iOS and Android (universal binaries re\-skinned and re\-signed per brand) * **Orchestration:** Temporal, scheduled workers, Human\-in\-the\-loop systems * **Infrastructure \& Tooling:** CI/CD pipelines, IP proxies, Kubernetes, in\-house bulk deployment tooling * **Backend \& Internal Tools:** Node.js, TypeScript, Postgresql, Kubernetes, various AWS services. * **Automation \& AI:** Browser automation, AI\-assisted workflows **The impact you'll have** * **Lead the team technically**: set strategy and priorities, make architecture decisions, and keep the team focused on its goals * **Operate apps at fleet scale**: own how thousands of separately branded apps are built, signed, deployed and kept current. Design reliable, observable workflows for launches, releases, store submissions and account operations * **Own CI/CD and build infrastructure**: make builds faster, cheaper and more reliable for other developers. * **Build the tooling our internal customers need**: full\-stack tools for Launch Specialists and product teams so they can launch and maintain apps without minimal intervention for us. * **Delete manual steps**: find the work humans do repeatedly and automate it, using AI where it makes sense and keeping humans in the loop where it doesn't * **Navigate Apple and Google**: certificates, provisioning, agreements, App Store review and compliance, at scale * **Partner across the company**: work with product engineering, Launch Specialists and leadership, technical and non\-technical alike * **Build the team**: mentor engineers, interview candidates and raise the bar **What we’re looking for** * Staff\-level experience leading a team or area technically: setting strategy, driving alignment, and delivering through others * **Production experience with Temporal** or other similar orchestration tools (required) * **Strong CI/CD pipeline experience** (required): building, operating and optimizing pipelines and build infrastructure * Full\-stack ability: comfortable building web apps, APIs and database\-backed internal tools * Experience with mobile release engineering: signing, provisioning, store submission, and release management. Experience doing this across many apps, accounts or brands is a strong plus * Strong communicator who works well with both technical and non\-technical coworkers * A bias for automation: you'd rather delete a manual step than add a feature * Experience at a product\-focused startup, scale\-up or technology company * Ownership, and comfort with ambiguity and cross\-cutting problems * Past work experience in hospitality, retail, or IT is a plus **Compensation and benefits** * The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $240K\-$260K USD depending on level, location and experience, plus a generous pre\-IPO equity package * Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, work from anywhere (remote\-first workplace), unlimited PTO \- plus extra fun perks! **Notice \- Employment Scams** Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address. We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond. \#LI\-AB1

jobs.title: Senior Software Applications Engineer (AI/ML)
jobs.description: Overview: **Role Summary** We are seeking a **Senior Software Applications Engineer(AI/ML)** to join our team, focusing on the development of cutting\-edge machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions for the semiconductor industry. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in creating robust and scalable software, with a strong background in data analysis, machine learning, and containerization technologies. Responsibilities: * **Design and Implement ML/AI Algorithms:** Help develop and implement advanced machine learning and AI\-based algorithms for the automatic classification of defects in semiconductor inspection tools. * **Data Analysis:** Analyze large volumes of defect data to identify critical patterns, trends, and anomalies, using this analysis to inform model development. * **Training and Model Development:** Train, validate, and deploy defect classification models, ensuring they meet strict performance and accuracy requirements. * **System Optimization:** Continuously improves the accuracy, efficiency, and reliability of the defect classification system through iterative development and optimization. Qualifications:* + **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field. + **Machine Learning Expertise:** Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch specifically for computer vision tasks (CNNs, Transformers). + **Semiconductor Knowledge:** Familiarity with semiconductor manufacturing processes or inspection metrology is highly preferred. + **Data Proficiency:** Experience handling large datasets and using tools like Pandas, NumPy and SQL for data preprocessing and feature engineering. + **Problem Solving:** Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex manufacturing defects into actionable data models, data ingestion, analysis, and visualization. **Preferred Skills*** + Experience with Mismatched Data or Active Learning techniques to handle rare defect types. + Knowledge of ML Ops tools (ML Flow, zen Flow etc.) for model deployment and monitoring in a production environment. + Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross\-functional hardware and software teams. Pay Range: CAD $120,000\.00 \- CAD $160,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Mid-level)
jobs.description: At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth. #### **The Opportunity** Are you a C\# engineer who enjoys building reliable, high\-performance software and is excited about the possibilities of AI? We’re looking for a Software Engineer II – AI \& C\# to join our team and help build and enhance PDI’s market\-leading POS and back\-office solutions. This role is a great opportunity for an experienced software engineer who has strong C\#/.NET fundamentals and wants to expand their hands\-on experience with artificial intelligence. You do not need prior production AI experience. We’re looking for solid engineering skills, curiosity, and a desire to learn. You’ll work as part of an agile engineering team designing, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise software while helping introduce practical AI capabilities into our products. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, architects, product owners, UX, QA, SRE, and operations to deliver scalable solutions that solve real business problems. ### **What You'll Do** * Build C\#/.NET applications: Design, develop, test, and maintain features across our POS and back\-office applications, including APIs, services, and SQL\-backed data layers. * Bring AI into our products: Help integrate capabilities such as LLM\-powered assistants, intelligent search, and AI\-driven reporting and insights into existing platforms. * Develop your AI expertise: Gain practical experience working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), helping move successful prototypes into production. * Support AI quality and safety: Develop test cases, evaluate AI outputs, and help identify accuracy, privacy, security, and payment\-data considerations before solutions reach customers. * Use AI to engineer smarter: Leverage AI coding assistants responsibly to improve development productivity and code quality while sharing effective practices with the broader team. * Collaborate across teams: Partner with Product, UX, Architecture, QA, SRE, and Operations to translate retail and fuel workflows into scalable, maintainable technical solutions. * Own your work: Take features from design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. * Mentor others: Support junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.Contribute to the Agile team: Participate in Scrum ceremonies, planning, estimation, and continuous improvement efforts. * Keep learning: Stay current with evolving development frameworks, cloud technologies, and AI tools and apply what you learn to real customer problems. ### **What We're Looking For** * 3\+ years of software development experience in a software product development environment. * Strong hands\-on experience with C\# and .NET, including ASP.NET Core and Web APIs. * Working knowledge of SQL, preferably SQL Server. * Exposure to AI/ML concepts through professional experience, coursework, certifications, or personal projects. * Some experience experimenting with technologies such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or other LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or generative AI tools. Production AI experience is not required. * Experience with Git, Postman, Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar development tools. * Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile development practices. * Familiarity with at least one public cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.Comfortable working in both Windows and Linux environments, including PowerShell and bash. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an ability to work through complex technical challenges. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and a willingness to collaborate, mentor, and share knowledge. * A self\-motivated, curious mindset with the ability to learn new technologies quickly and deliver in a fast\-paced environment. ### **Nice to Have** Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required: * Angular or other modern JavaScript frameworks * Python * Delphi * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) * Embeddings and vector databases * AI evaluation or testing frameworks * Retail or convenience\-store technology * Point\-of\-sale (POS) systems * Payments, EMV, or PCI environments * Forecourt/fuel systems * Wholesale or logistics technologies This is an opportunity to build on your existing software engineering experience while developing skills in one of the fastest\-moving areas of technology. You’ll have the chance to experiment with AI, learn from experienced engineers and architects, and turn new ideas into features that solve real problems for PDI customers. You don’t need to come in as an AI expert. Bring your C\#/.NET expertise, engineering mindset, and curiosity. We’ll give you the opportunity to grow the rest. PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As an Data Engineer Senior within PNC's Technology organization, you will be based in Denver, CO; Birmingham, AL; Cleveland, OH; Dallas, TX or Pittsburgh, PA. Seeking a Senior Data Engineer with deep expertise in modern data platform architecture, large\-scale data processing, and AI\-assisted development. The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing and building data solutions using Apache Iceberg as a data storage and lakehouse platform, with hands\-on expertise leveraging Trino as a query and access layer for analytics and data consumption. Key technical requirements include advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and Apache Spark for data engineering, transformation, and pipeline development. Candidates should have practical experience using AI\-powered development tools, preferably GitHub Copilot, and be comfortable working with agentic AI solutions that generate, optimize, and automate code for data movement, transformation, and orchestration workflows. Required Skills: Apache Iceberg (data lakehouse/storage platform) SQL Python Apache Spark AI\-assisted software development (GitHub Copilot preferred) Agentic AI and AI\-driven coding automation Preferred Skills: Trino (distributed SQL query engine) Experience building AI agents that generate, maintain, or optimize data engineering code Modern cloud data platform and lakehouse architecture experience This role is ideal for a senior\-level engineer who can combine traditional data engineering expertise with emerging AI technologies to accelerate development, improve data pipelines, and support next\-generation data platform initiatives PNC is an in\-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals. PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.**Job Description** =================== * Leads in developing, supporting and implementing data solutions for multiple applications in order to meet business objectives and user requirements. Leverages technical knowledge and industry experience to design, build and maintain technology solutions. * Leads data requirement analysis and the data preparation process development for targeted data solutions. * Leads in designing and building data service infrastructure on multiple data platforms, according the workflow. * Oversees the development and implementation of data solutions for multiple applications to ensure its scalability, availability and maintainability. * Consults on data migration and transformation to ensure the accuracy and security of data solutions. PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be: * **Customer Focused** \- Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions. * **Managing Risk** \- Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework. **Qualifications** ================== Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- Big Data, Data Architecture Development, Database Management, Data Engineering, Data Governance, Data Migrations, Data Modeling, Data Pipelines, Data Warehousing (DW), Structured Query Language (SQL)**Competencies** ---------------- Application Delivery Process, Big Data Management and Analytics, Business Intelligence, Consulting, Data Analysis \- Software, Data Architecture, Database Structures, Problem Solving, Software Development Life Cycle**Work Experience** ------------------- Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 5\+ years of industry\-relevant experience. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Back End
jobs.description: Paradigm is a software company transforming the way that the residential, construction \& building product industries operate across the globe. We are building the future with modern software engineering, agent\-assisted systems, and mobile\-first experiences. We are powered by our parent company, Builders FirstSource (NYSE: BLDR). Our Software Engineering Team builds and supports cloud\-based applications in the Azure ecosystem. The InfoThinks team develops intelligent applications and services that combine modern backend engineering with AI capabilities to help users access, understand, and act on complex business and product information. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Back End with strong Python and API development experience and a practical understanding of AI application architecture. This engineer will build and maintain APIs and services that integrate large language models, enterprise data sources, search and retrieval systems, and other AI capabilities into production applications. **What You Will Do:** * Design, develop, enhance, and maintain backend APIs and services using Python, with an emphasis on scalable, maintainable, production\-quality systems. * Develop AI\-enabled backend services using LangChain and related technologies that orchestrate large language models, enterprise data, search/retrieval systems, and external APIs, while maintaining appropriate abstractions between the application and underlying models, providers, and data platforms. * Design and implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) workflows, including retrieval, context construction, prompt orchestration, and response generation. * Implement observability, logging, error handling, testing, and performance monitoring for both API operations and AI workflows, with appropriate consideration for security, scalability, data privacy, and responsible use of AI. * Evaluate and improve AI application behavior, including response quality, retrieval quality, latency, reliability, token consumption, and cost. * Investigate production issues and implement and test fixes across APIs, AI integrations, retrieval components, and supporting services. * Participate in peer code reviews, contribute to engineering standards and technical documentation, and recommend improvements to development processes and engineering tools. * Collaborate closely with front\-end engineers, Product Owners, QA, data engineers, UX, and other engineering teams to translate product requirements into robust backend solutions, working independently on complex problems while collaborating on architecture and implementation decisions. **What You Need to Succeed:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. * 4\+ years of professional software development experience, with significant experience developing backend applications, APIs, or distributed services. * Strong hands\-on development experience with Python and modern Python application development practices. * Experience designing and implementing REST APIs and backend services, with a strong understanding of software architecture and object\-oriented and/or functional design principles. * Practical experience with LangChain or comparable frameworks for developing LLM\-powered applications and integrating APIs and applications with LLM providers and AI services. * Strong understanding of large language models and generative AI concepts, including prompts, tokens, context windows, embeddings, and model limitations, and of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and how retrieval, context generation, and LLM responses relate. * Experience or working knowledge of semantic search, vector search, and retrieval strategies, and of common AI application patterns such as tool/function calling, structured outputs, agents, and multi\-step AI workflows. * Experience designing reliable production systems with appropriate authentication, authorization, error handling, logging, automated testing, and observability. * Strong problem\-solving skills, including troubleshooting complex issues that span application code, APIs, AI models, retrieval systems, and data sources, and evaluating when new AI technologies are appropriate for production use. * Proven teamwork, collaboration, and communication services, Azure OpenAI, or similar managed AI platforms. * Experience with Databricks and integrating Databricks APIs or data services into applications. * Experience with vector databases or vector\-enabled search platforms. * Experience with containerized applications and cloud deployment using Docker and Azure. * Familiarity with FastAPI or similar Python API frameworks. **Ready to Join? jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Growth Engineer (Staff+ Level)
jobs.description: **The Mission** --------------- More than 95% of drugs that pass animal testing fail in human trials. A single new drug takes about $2\.6 billion and 12\.5 years to develop, and most of that effort goes to candidates that were never going to work in people. AI was supposed to change this. But most AI for drug discovery is still trained on the same inputs that got us here: animal data, irreproducible papers, and cell lines that don’t respond like living tissue. A model can only learn the biology it’s shown, and no amount of scale or compute fixes bad data. What’s missing is data on how living human tissue responds to a drug, across the range of people who will actually take it. That data barely exists, because there has been no way to generate it at scale without putting patients at risk. Parallel Bio grows it. Our expert biologists build living human immune systems, called immune organoids, from a proprietary biobank spanning ages, sexes, ancestries and disease states. That means we can ask how a drug behaves in an older patient, a specific ancestry or an autoimmune background, not just in an average donor. We've already modeled immunotoxicology, immunogen stimulation and two autoimmune diseases, with more on the way. Our founders are world experts in scalable organoids. Robert is a Stanford\-trained immunologist. Juliana trained in the lab that invented the first organoid and later automated them at System1 Biosciences. We run these experiments in an AI\-driven robotic lab, and every experiment makes our world model smarter, which in turn chooses better experiments. We build every layer ourselves: the biology, the robotics, the data infrastructure, and the model that orchestrates it all. The whole lab is callable over API and MCP, so AI agents can design and run real biological experiments, within safety limits we set. For biologists, that means asking questions at a scale and pace no bench can match. For engineers, it means building AI that learns from real human biology instead of the literature. It's already working. Our platform is 87% concordant with clinical outcomes, compared with roughly 3% translational success for animal models. Five Fortune 500 companies use it to test drugs, and our data has informed a Phase 1 trial. We've raised \~$30M from AIX Ventures, Marc Benioff, Jeff Dean and Y Combinator. With the FDA Modernization Act 3\.0 and the FDA's March 2026 validation framework, regulation is moving our way. The opportunity is generational. We're building the first scaled engine for real human biological data, and using it to know which drugs will work in people before they ever reach a trial. **Your Skills** --------------- Must have experience in high\-scale B2C Growth (Acquisition, Activation, and Retention) and be able to design AI\-powered growth loops **Parallel Bio is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, or sexual orientation.**

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description: **Build the Path Forward** ========================== At Path Robotics, we're building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI\-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field\-ready AI that is risk\-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real\-world use. Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together. We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Robotics team. You'll use machine learning to improve how our robots plan, scan, and act. You'll frame real robot problems as well\-defined ML problems, train models on data that a fleet of production robotic cells generates every day, and ship them into a production stack where they work alongside classical planning and perception. Your models run on live robots doing real work for customers. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Frame open\-ended problems in planning, scanning, and robot behavior as well\-defined ML problems. * Train models that work with classical methods, such as initial guesses and learned costs for trajectory optimization, plan quality and feasibility predictors, and learned collision models. * Develop viewpoint planning policies that choose where and how to scan, and predict scan quality before the robot commits. * Apply imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and generative models such as diffusion and flow matching where they outperform classical baselines. * Build production ML pipelines: datasets from fleet logs and simulation, training, and metrics. * Evaluate models in the loop, with offline metrics that predict gains on the robot, failure\-mode analysis, and calibrated confidence that determines when the system falls back to classical methods. * Own your models end to end, from prototype to deployment on live robotic cells, with low\-latency inference and monitoring. **Who You Are** --------------- * An MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field. * 2\+ years of applied machine learning for robotics or autonomy, in research or industry. * Fluent in Python with PyTorch or JAX, and experienced training, evaluating, and deploying Define and enforce standards for Azure Policy, role\-based access control (RBAC), naming, tagging, configuration, security, and change management. * Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, and availability practices. financial management at enterprise scale. * Experience supporting application teams and transitioning repeatable cloud support work to Service Delivery. **Real Benefits for Real Life** jobs.title: Senior Director, Precision Engagement
jobs.description: **ROLE SUMMARY** Precision Engagement is the team that owns how Pfizer decides where, how, and when to engage each healthcare professional, and the predictive signals those decisions rest on. It owns the agentic reasoning layer that takes brand strategy, patient and customer signals, and the scored impact of every way to engage, and compiles them into a prioritized, sequenced plan for each HCP that is executed through field and digital channels and learns from what happened. The team consists of four teams: Engagement Planning (the reasoning layer) and the three AI/ML predictive teams (Predictive HCP Engagement, Predictive Patient Solutions, and Predictive Media Engagement). The solutions run on a shared production runtime, data contracts, and MLOps and AgentOps infrastructure built with Applied Intelligence. As Sr. Director, you are the senior technical authority for this stack and the leader accountable for its value. You lead a four\-Director organization and own its results: the measurable impact of the components of Precision Engagement on US Commercial brand performance, their adoption by brand, field, and digital teams, and the prioritization of headcount, capacity, external partners, and investment across them. You own the vision, architecture, and roadmap for Precision Engagement; you run and evolve the production solutions through hands\-on technical Directors; and you set and review the methodology for the advanced machine learning the team builds (counterfactual and uplift modeling, survival and event modeling, optimization under constraints) and the standards by which its agentic systems are built, evaluated, and audited. The design principle is yours to hold: what changes often (strategy, context, new signals) lives in reasoning, context, and skills under AgentOps with full traceability and explainability; machine learning is reserved for stable, well\-defined problems such as counterfactual scoring and patient prediction; and experimentation is how the system learns, designed into it rather than run beside it. You are accountable for both layers working together and for the business acting on the result. **ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Engagement Planning —** Own the vision, architecture, and roadmap for the reasoning layer: how brand strategy and context enter it, how signals and scores are reasoned over, how decisions are compiled into a plan per HCP with priority, window, and fallback, and how the plan is executed and learned from. Hold the design principles: the unit of decision is the unit of execution; if a rule can do it, it is a rule; models for stable problems, reasoning for what changes. * **Agentic systems \& AgentOps —** Set and enforce the standards for how Engagement Planning is built and run as an agentic system: grounding in model outputs, evaluation against baselines and against the models it draws on, guardrails, cost, traceability and explainability, human oversight, and the auditability a regulated environment requires. Own the AgentOps practice: versioned prompts, context, and skills; evaluation sets; release and rollback. * **Predictive HCP Engagement —** Own the HCP focused solutions (Dynamic Targeting and its successors): a stable, generalized counterfactual model of the incremental impact of each individually addressable way to engage an HCP (calls, emails, rep\-triggered actions, and other channels executed per HCP), with MLOps that decides when it retrains rather than a fixed refresh calendar, and the refactor from monolithic pipelines to modular, automated ones. * **Predictive Patient Solutions —** Own the patient\-level prediction solutions: journey and event modeling, predictive and survival AI/ML models on longitudinal claims and EHR data, and the agentic pull\-through that tells marketers and field teams which patient opportunities are emerging, where, and what is driving them. * **Predictive Media Engagement—** Own the models for channels bought as lists or audiences: NPI\-list media membership decisions, consumer audience and pathway models, and transparent, explainable allocation logic for digital and media channels, inside the budget envelopes brand strategy sets. Define the handshake with the teams that optimize within channels and with channel\-level measurement of investment impact, and extend toward consumer engagement as that scope is approved. * **Production platform \& standards —** Own the production standards the solutions run to (data contracts from upstream platforms to the channels that act, decision records that make every automateddecision auditable, replay, release safety, MLOps and AgentOps) and the requirements for the shared runtime they consume. Partner with Applied Intelligence, which builds and for now operates that runtime, so that solutions run on one platform. * **Experimentation \& learning —** Own the single experimentation system inside Engagement Planning: hypothesis\-driven tests, run with brand team agreement and measured against commercial organizations. Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact. **Other Job Details:** * Last Date to Apply for Job: **November 23, 2026\.** * Ability to travel based on business needs * This position is hybrid and requires working onsite 2 to 3 days per week The annual base salary for this position ranges from $230,900\.00 to $384,800\.00\. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 25\.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits \| (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility. **Sunshine Act** Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative. **EEO \& Employment Eligibility** Pfizer is committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status. Pfizer also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. Pfizer is an E\-Verify employer. This position requires permanent work authorization in the United States. Pfizer endeavors to make www.pfizer.com/careers accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process and/or interviewing, please email disabilityrecruitment@pfizer.com. jobs.title: ML Infra Engineer, Compute
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Physical Intelligence is bringing general\-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically\-actuated devices of the future. **The Team** ------------ The ML Infrastructure team supports and accelerates PI’s core modeling efforts by building the systems that make large\-scale training reliable, reproducible, and fast. You will work closely with ML Infra (training systems), data platform, and research teams to ensure compute scheduling is never the bottleneck. **About the Role** ------------------ Physical Intelligence builds general\-purpose AI for the physical world. Training our models requires orchestrating thousands of accelerators across a heterogeneous fleet of GPU and TPU clusters — spanning different hardware generations, cloud providers, and cluster topologies. Today, researchers often need to know which cluster to target, what resources are available, and how to configure their jobs accordingly. That doesn't scale. We need a scheduling and compute layer that makes the right placement decision automatically — routing jobs to the best cluster based on availability, hardware fit, cost, and priority — so researchers can focus entirely on the science. This role owns that problem end\-to\-end: the scheduling systems, the placement logic, the cluster management layer, and the operational tooling that keeps it all running. This is not cloud DevOps. It's not about standing up clusters and walking away. It's a systems role for people who care about intelligent resource allocation, utilization, fault tolerance, and making large\-scale distributed training seamless. **In This Role You Will** ------------------------- * Own Intelligent Job Scheduling and Placement: Design and build multi\-tenant scheduling systems that automatically place training jobs on the best available cluster based on hardware requirements, topology, availability, cost, and priority. Support fair resource sharing across teams and projects with quota management, priority tiers, and preemption policies. Abstract away cluster differences so researchers submit jobs without needing to know where they will land. * Scale Multi\-cluster Orchestration: Build the control plane that manages the job lifecycle across diverse clusters (mixed GPU/TPU, multi\-generation hardware, on\-prem/cloud) and enables seamless job migration, failover, and re\-scheduling. * Optimize Accelerator Utilization and Efficiency: Monitor and optimize GPU/TPU utilization across the entire fleet. Implement priority, preemption, queueing, and fairness policies that balance research velocity with cost efficiency. * Ensure Scaling and Stability: Implement fault detection, automatic recovery, and resilience for long\-running multi\-node training jobs. Manage health checking, node management, and scaling to thousands of accelerators. * Support Inference and Robot Deployment: Extend scheduling and orchestration to inference workloads, including deploying models to edge devices on physical robots. * Enhance Observability and Developer Experience: Build the dashboards, alerting, SLOs, and debugging tools necessary for researchers to understand job status and for the team to ensure high scheduling quality and cluster reliability. **What We Hope You'll Bring** ----------------------------- We’re intentionally flexible on exact background, but strong candidates usually have: * Strong software engineering fundamentals * Experience building or operating job scheduling / resource management systems at scale * Experience with large\-scale compute clusters (GPU and/or TPU) * Familiarity with schedulers and orchestration systems (SLURM, Kubernetes, GKE, K3S, or internal equivalents) * Comfort reasoning about resource allocation, bin\-packing, priority scheduling, and multi\-tenancy * Understanding of how ML training workloads behave — long\-running, multi\-node, sensitive to stragglers, topology\-dependent * A bias toward owning systems end\-to\-end, from design to operation * Enjoy working closely with researchers and unblocking fast\-moving projects **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Experience building multi\-cluster or federated scheduling systems * Experience with TPU infrastructure (GCP TPU slices, Multislice, GKE) * Background in cluster resource managers (Borg, YARN, Mesos, or custom schedulers) * Linux systems engineering, networking, and infrastructure\-as\-code * NCCL/collective communication and topology\-aware placement * Experience with capacity planning and cloud cost optimization at scale * Familiarity with JAX, PyTorch, or similar ML frameworks at the runtime/systems level Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions: **Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI\-generated and manipulated voice and video. **Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals. **Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals. Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose\-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI\-driven interactions. Pindrop protects billions of high\-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real\-world interactions annually and protected by 300\+ patents. Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG. ### **What you'll do** As a Senior Software Engineer on the BotStopper team, you will help build and scale the cloud\-native services and machine learning inference infrastructure powering Pindrop BotStopper™ our real\-time AI voice detection solution that helps enterprises distinguish human callers from automated interactions and recognize known registered AI voices. Built on Pindrop Pulse detection technology and supported by intelligence from the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC), BotStopper helps enterprises identify automated interactions, protect customer experiences, and respond to emerging AI\-driven challenges across contact centers. You will work at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, real\-time processing, and cybersecurity, developing highly reliable services that support detection decisions during live customer interactions. As BotStopper evolves, you'll help engineer the next generation of capabilities, including more sophisticated AI\-agent classification, expanded detection signals, and enterprise integrations. As a senior individual contributor, you'll bring strong backend engineering expertise, take end\-to\-end ownership of complex technical initiatives, and collaborate closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and SRE to transform emerging technologies into secure, scalable, production\-ready systems. This is a fast\-moving product environment where adaptability, technical curiosity, and the ability to navigate changing priorities are essential. *More specifically, you will:* * Architect, develop, test, deploy, and monitor high\-performance backend services and APIs supporting BotStopper's real\-time detection and scoring capabilities, optimizing for low latency, scalability, reliability, and efficient processing. * Independently drive platform features and improvements from ambiguous requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, production rollout, monitoring, and operational support. * Develop and enhance backend capabilities supporting known\-AI\-voice identification, including integration with the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC) infrastructure and Pindrop's broader voice intelligence capabilities. * Partner with Research and Research Engineering to integrate detection models, inference services, and ML\-driven signals into reliable, scalable production workflows, balancing detection effectiveness, latency, cost, and operational complexity. * Improve performance, concurrency, availability, fault tolerance, and infrastructure efficiency across high\-throughput services processing large volumes of real\-world voice interactions. * Help engineer the evolution from human\-versus\-machine detection toward more detailed AI\-caller classification, ensemble signal analysis, explainable scoring, and other emerging detection capabilities. * Design and develop backend services and APIs that support integrations with IVR, Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), telephony, and conversational AI platforms. * Contribute to architectural decisions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and partner across Engineering, Research, Product, and SRE to introduce new capabilities without disrupting live customer traffic. * Support production operations through incident response, troubleshooting, and continuous improvements to observability, alerting, deployment safety, and system reliability. After an initial onboarding period of approximately three months, participate in the team's established on\-call rotation. * Mentor engineers through thoughtful code reviews, design discussions, pairing, documentation, and knowledge sharing while encouraging strong software engineering practices. * Strategically leverage AI\-assisted development too rovement. * AI is changing both what we build and how we build it. You'll be encouraged to incorporate AI responsibly into your development workflow, experiment with emerging tools, and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality. * Senior engineers at Pindrop aren't simply handed requirements. You'll help shape design decisions, influence technical direction, recommend improvements, and translate complex challenges into scalable solutions. * Expand your expertise in architecture, technical decision\-making, mentorship, and cross\-functional collaboration, developing the capabilities needed for future Staff\-level impact. ### **What we offer** As a part of Pindrop, you'll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice\-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here's a snapshot of the benefits we offer: * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year, subject to manager approval and applicable company policies. * Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year * Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long\-term success. * While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in\-person moments through regular team on\-sites, company\-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success. * Generous health and welfare plans to choose from \- including one employer\-paid "employee\-only" plan! * Best\-in\-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution * Low\-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind. * Paid Parental Leave \- Including birth, adoptive \& foster parents * + One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It's our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family! * Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work. * Enhanced fertility and GLP\-1 benefits to support family\-building journeys and personalized health needs. * Annual Learning \& Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill\-building, certifications, and continued education. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-HB1 **Not sure if this is you?** ---------------------------- We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you're not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time. ### **AI \- A Transformative Force** At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting\-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine. Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed. ### **Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer** Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Plaud Inc.** Plaud is building the real\-world AI interface for professionals to amplify intelligence, elevate productivity and performance, loved by over 3,000,000 users worldwide since 2023\. With a mission to amplify human intelligence, Plaud captures, structures, and compounds the intelligence generated in conversations — so humans can think better, decide faster, and execute with clarity. Plaud Inc. is a Delaware\-incorporated, San Francisco\-based company. With GDPR, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and EN 18031 compliance, Plaud is committed to the highest standards of data security and privacy protection. To learn more about Plaud, please visit https://www.plaud.ai and follow along on Instagram, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube. **Why You Should Join Us** Plaud is building the next generation intelligence infrastructure and interfaces to capture, extract, and utilize intelligence from what people say, hear, see, and think. * Plaud is a bootstrapped, skyrocketing, profitable company with a $300M revenue run rate achieved in just three years. * Define the next\-gen paradigm for human\-AI interaction. * Gain exposure to cutting\-edge AI for Pro tools and play a direct role in our global expansion. * Work with passionate teammates who value innovation, collaboration, and customer success. * Grow your career in a culture that champions continuous learning and fast career development. * Market\-competitive compensation, global exposure, and a vibrant, creativity\-fueled work atmosphere. **What you will do** * Design and build the AI services that turn recordings into summaries and notes, from LLM orchestration and model routing to delivering results reliably to millions of users. * Build generation pipelines that adapt to each recording's content, context and user preferences, choosing the right models, strategies and level of detail for each one. * Solve hard scaling problems: keep AI generation highly available across multiple model providers, absorb large and spiky workloads, and keep results fast at any size. * Turn real\-world usage and evaluation signals into continuous, measurable quality gains, so that model, prompt and pipeline changes improve the product release after release without regressions. * Partner with AI research and evaluation teams to take new models and capabilities from experiment to production, and use AI tooling to speed up your own development. **Minimum Qualifications** * 5\+ years of backend engineering experience, with strong production skills in Python or Go. * Hands\-on experience building and running LLM\- or ML\-powered services in production, including model integration and graceful fallback across providers. Prototypes and internal tooling alone do not qualify. * Proven experience scaling high\-volume, asynchronous distributed systems for availability and performance. * Experience measuring and improving AI output quality with data, e.g. automated evaluation, judges calibrated against human ratings, or controlled experiments. * Strong judgment on tradeoffs between AI quality, latency and cost. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building systems that systematically optimize prompts, pipelines or model choices from evaluation and production feedback, e.g. programmatic prompt optimization or reflective optimizers. * Experience with speech or transcription systems (ASR, speaker identification, audio processing). * Experience serving and scaling models on GPUs. * Experience with personalization or adaptive generation driven by user context. * Experience with cloud\-native infrastructure and multi\-region deployment. **What we offer** * **Ownership \& Impact:** Build core AI services used by millions of professionals worldwide, with direct impact on product quality and cost at a fast\-growing company. * **Competitive Compensation:** $159K\-$239K base salary\+performance bonus\+Equity. * **Comprehensive Benefits:** Top\-tier healthcare for employees and dependents, including dental and vision, and a generous employer subsidy. * **Retirement Planning:** 401(k) plan for full time employees with company matching. * **Paid Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus 13 paid holidays. * **New Parent Leave:** 12 weeks of paid time off to spend time with your new family, regardless of gender. * **Hybrid Office:** Minimum of 3x in office per week. * **Gear:** New hires are equipped with their choice of new top\-of\-the\-line laptops and workstation setups. * **Perks:** Best office equipment. Annual offsites. Free office drinks and snacks. ***Disclaimer****: Plaud is and will continue to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*
