jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Data Acquisition, Instrumentation & Control
jobs.description: Overview: In this role you would serve as an Instrumentation \& Control Engineer working closely with researchers, engineers and technical staff to design, deploy and operate systems used for control, protection and diagnostics for plasma experiments at PPPL as well as both international and national collaborations. You will ensure that critical data is accurately captured, conditioned, and stored in complex and often noisy environments. This position will support the design, development, testing and operational phases of projects undertaken at PPPL, with a specific focus on facility user support including data acquisition, storage, and manipulation. It will require the successful candidate to work closely with scientific and other engineering and technical staff to develop novel solutions in support of such projects. A U.S. Department of Energy National Laboratory managed by Princeton University, the Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory (PPPL) is tackling the world’s toughest science and technology challenges using plasma, the fourth state of matter. With more than 70 years of history, PPPL is a leader in the science and engineering behind the development of fusion energy, a potentially limitless energy source. PPPL is also using its expertise to advance research in the areas of microelectronics, quantum sensors and devices, and sustainability sciences. Whether it be through science, engineering, technology or professional services, every team member has an opportunity to contribute to our mission and vision. Come join us! Responsibilities: **Core Duties:** Core duties for this role primarily focus on support for facility users. Duties include:* Configuration and integration of data acquisition hardware with consideration for channel counts, sampling rates, bandwidth capacity, and communication. 25% * Implementation and maintenance of data storage systems and supporting architecture. 25% * Deployment and maintenance of User Interfaces for data viewing, manipulation, and analysis. 25% * Documentation and testing of systems for performance validation. 20% * Performance of hands\-on prototyping, system verification, troubleshooting, and calibration using electronic laboratory equipment. 5% Qualifications: **Education and Experience:** BS or above in:* Electrical Engineering * Computer Engineering * Or a related discipline * Candidate should have 2\+ years of relevant work experience in a professional environment **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** The successful candidate has diversified knowledge of principles and practices in engineering instrumentation \& control systems. They must be familiar with the technology commonplace in the instrumentation and control space. This includes software, design tools and underlying operating systems like MS Windows and Linux. They must be a team player with the ability to communicate ideas effectively to others with varying levels of technical skills and work with a diverse set of scientists, engineers and technical staff with varying backgrounds. They communicate designs through presentations and are comfortable providing material for reviews. The successful candidate will have experience with the following:* Embedded controls/programming, including data acquisition, triggering and storage * Sampling theory and signal conditioning techniques * Database development and maintenance * Graphical User Interface development and maintenance * Software languages such as Python, C\+\+, Labview * Requirements definition, creation of hardware and software design documents, test design and system integration The ideal candidate would also have experience in the following areas:* Linux system environments * Test automation languages * SCADA programs such as EPICS * Database management and administration, eg SQL, HDF5 or MDSplus * Software CI/CD tools and techniques * cDAQ, D\-tAcq, and Struck digitizer systems * Developing FPGA code and test benches using tools such as verilog **Physical Requirements:*** Primarily office work and occasional hands\-on technical work. **Working Conditions:*** This position is on\-site at PPPL. * The University considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's qualifications, work experience, education/training, key skills, market, collective bargaining agreements as applicable, and organizational considerations when extending an offer. write clear prompts with context and know what to delegate to AI. + Systematically validate AI output for correctness and security, recognize hallucinations, and use AI\-assisted diagnostics while confirming findings. + Apply responsible\-AI practices, considering privacy, security, and cost. **YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE IF YOU:** * Are a proactive, friendly, and persuasive person who loves to move fast and juggle several projects at once * Enjoy ensuring every client has a completely positive experience * Can effectively troubleshoot in a remote environment **WHAT YOU'LL BRING:** * 2\+ years of experience in an IT support or IT engineering role. * Solid understanding of computer hardware (Mac, specifically), software, and networking concepts. * Proficiency with operating systems such as Windows and Linux. * Experience with basic troubleshooting and problem\-solving techniques in a remote environment. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills with an ability to explain technical issues to non\-technical users. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team, following instructions and procedures. * Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards. * Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) is a plus. * **(AI)** Hands\-on experience using AI assistants and AIOps tools in IT work. * **(AI)** Understanding of prompt engineering fundamentals and AI output validation. **IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAD:** * Familiarity working inside Notion * Experience working with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper\-V) * Knowledgeable on automating manual processes, utilizing AI and other resources for success. *If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in healthcare and are focused on hiring individuals with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to support us in doing good, what’s human, and making a difference.* **Benefits and Perks for Propelus Employees** --------------------------------------------- **US Employees:** * **Health Insurance:** We cover up to **100% of the premium** for employee medical insurance. Plans for spouses and children are made affordable through Propelus’ generous contribution + Employees can choose from HSA, FSA, and traditional insurance options for medical, dental, and vision coverage for themselves and dependents. + Dental and Vision plans, both including an option with **100% of the premium** covered for employees * **Generous PTO:** + **Accrual: (full\-time US):** h produce delivered to your door. Think of it as a bonus for the expenses and experiences you value most. * **Employee Assistance Programs:** provides **24/7/365 support** by phone and online — family clinical counseling, legal \& financial services, plus child and elder care referrals. * **Carrot Fertility \& Hormonal Support:** Inclusive hormonal health, fertility, and family\-building benefits with **funds toward eligible care**. * **Beyond Med:** A licensed **discount plan organization (DPO)** giving you access to elective care like acupuncture, dermatology, fertility, GLP\-1, and more — at discounted rates. * **Spot Pet Insurance:** A financial safety net for your furry family. We cover 100% of employee health insurance premiums. Our plans include national and international coverage, so you're protected no matter where you are. * **Propelus Flex Club**: Our flexible benefits platform gives you monthly points to redeem on what you need most. Plus, you'll get access to exclusive discounts just for being part of our team. (Details are country specific) * **Generous PTO:** + **National Holidays (Colombia):** 18 days + **National Holidays (Costa Rica):** 12 days + **Birthday Holiday**: Your birthday deserves celebrating! You get **1 paid day off during your birth month**, separate from your PTO. + **Volunteer Time Off:** 16 hours available to you, that allow you to make an impact on causes that are meaningful to you. + We've got you covered with a life insurance policy, paid 100% by the company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Part\-time positions are scheduled to work a maximum of 30 hours per week. Equipment, benefits, and perks are not provided to part\-time or temporary employees.* Compensation Range: $70K \- $90K

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: New York, NY **About Prove** =============== As the world moves to a mobile\-first economy, businesses need to modernize how they acquire, engage with and enable consumers. Prove’s phone\-centric identity tokenization and passive cryptographic authentication solutions reduce friction, enhance security and privacy across all digital channels, and accelerate revenues while reducing operating expenses and fraud losses. Over 1,000 enterprise customers use Prove’s platform to process 20 billion customer requests annually across industries, including banking, lending, healthcare, gaming, crypto, e\-commerce, marketplaces, and payments. For the latest updates from Prove, follow us on LinkedIn. Prove is driving the future of digital identity. We are looking for Provers who know how to make an impact. We’re talking self\-starting professionals who thrive in a fast\-paced environment, process information quickly, and make intelligent decisions. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together. Prove has big plans, and we’re excited about the future. If this sounds like the place for you – come join our team! **Department:** Data Science **Reports To:** Director of Informatics **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Location:** Hybrid \- New York, NY **Job Summary** As a Lead Data Engineer on Prove’s Data Science team, you will build the technical backbone that translates complex identity data into verified digital trust. Prove is fundamentally a data company: our identity solutions and analytical products are built on extracts spanning all tiers of data sophistication. In this role, every pipeline and architecture you design connects directly to revenue\-generating products that secure transactions and prevent fraud for more than 1,000 global enterprise customers. You will spearhead the development and maintenance of high\-throughput data pipelines that power our core inference systems, taking raw intelligence and refining it into reliable scientific statements. Acting as a bridge across disciplines, you will translate multi\-domain logic into resilient, highly performant directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), while proactively establishing data governance and ontology standards. This is an environment built for experimentation, offering you the autonomy to deploy modern paradigms and tools to solve intricate problems in identity resolution. **Key Responsibilities:** * Architect, build, and maintain resilient data pipelines that power real\-time and batch inference, moving data from raw intelligence to verifiable scientific statements. * Translate complex, multidisciplinary domain logic into efficient, maintainable, and modular directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and execution workflows. * Proactively implement and advocate for robust data governance frameworks, metadata management, and semantic data ontologies. * Partner closely with data science, informatics, and product engineering teams to serve high\-integrity data extracts that directly power revenue\-generating products. * Continuously evaluate, benchmark, and adopt cutting\-edge data engineering tools, frameworks, and storage paradigms. * Optimize distributed data processing pipelines for high availability, computational efficiency, and cost governance. * Champion engineering excellence across the team through code reviews, architectural discussions, automated testing, and CI/CD practices. * Promote, maintain and enhance our cultural values of humility, passion, inclusion, and leadership. ##### **Qualifications and Experience:** * Strong passion for learning about our products and markets through in\-house and external training. * 7\+ years of professional experience in data engineering or developing complex, data\-driven software products. * Deep, first\-principles understanding of data systems, distributed compute engines, data modeling, and modern pipeline architecture. * Demonstrated track record of collaborating across technical and scientific functions, with the ability to translate cross\-disciplinary logic into concrete data systems. * High intellectual curiosity and a proactive mindset toward experimentation and technological innovation. * Hands\-on experience with modern data orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) and large\-scale distributed frameworks. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Advanced degree (Master’s or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field. * Experience architecting creative solutions for identity resolution, graph data structures, or fraud prevention systems. * Fluent and terminal\-native in Linux/Unix environments, command\-line utilities, and shell scripting. * Experience in high\-growth/pre\-IPO Technology companies. The anticipated salary pay range for Metro 2 areas for this role is $175,000 \- $200,000 plus company bonus. Prove follows a market driven compensation philosophy based on geographic location and respective market rates. Job offers will be aligned to location. Please speak with your recruiter if you have questions. Prove defines: * Metro 2 \- NYC metro area, Seattle metro area, Los Angeles metro area, and the Miami metro area. * Metro 3 \- all other cities across the domestic United States, with the exception of the San Francisco Bay Area. **Benefits \& Perks for FTE Provers:** * Competitive salaries \& Bonus Plan (for eligible roles) and Equity Plan * Modern Health for financial, mental, and physical wellness * 401(k) Retirement Plan \& Match (US Offices) and Local Country Pension (International Offices) * Unlimited Vacation and Flexible hours * Comprehensive medical benefits for you and your family ❤️ * Emotional \& Physical Wellness – Access to wellness services (EAP \& Prove Well\-Being Reimbursement) * Bottomless snacks \& beverages for certain office locations * Daily GrubHub stipend for lunch if coming into the office (US Offices) * A great place to work and connect with other talented Provers like yourself! Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Prove we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Equal Opportunity Employment:** Prove is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people regardless of race, color, religion, gender or sexual orientation, age, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, disability, veteran status or other personal characteristics **Privacy \& Data Protection:** When you are applying for a job at Prove, we collect and use your personal information in the job application process. To understand more about how Prove uses your personal information, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy on our website. Create a Job Alert Interested in building your career at Prove? jobs.title: AI Engineering Lead
jobs.description: Provn is helping CampusEvolve recruit for the following role **About CampusEvolve:** CampusEvolve (campusevolve.ai) is a Seattle\-based, mission\-driven AI startup backed by the Gates Foundation, Schultz Family Foundation, and GitLab Foundation. Pathways is one tool for a person's whole pathway: from high school into a two\-year or four\-year program, a certificate, an apprenticeship, or the military, and on into work. People most often fall off a pathway in the gaps between programs, so Pathways is built to carry them across those gaps. Its retrieval layer covers more than 6,000 post\-secondary credential programs in Washington State, plus financial aid, career guidance, and basic\-needs resources like housing, food, and transportation. The north star is economic mobility, and at CampusEvolve, the mission is the culture. **About the role:** AI Engineering Lead builds Pathways, an AI\-native guide that helps people take real next steps toward education, careers, and economic security, and builds the team's ability to ship it with AI. This is a senior leadership role that's about 80% hands\-on building. You deliver the product rather than make sure it gets delivered, and you make engineering decisions, not recommendations. You'll lead three full\-time engineers, work closely with the Founder/CEO and CTO, and partner with a full\-time product manager and the VP of Community, who runs a network of 100\+ co\-design partners across K\-12, post\-secondary, and workforce programs. State agency partners are ready to roll out Pathways once it's engaging and safe, and you'll lead the engineering that gets it there. **What You'll Work On** Alongside the building, you keep engineering, product, partners, and leadership moving together, and you work directly with end users far more than most engineering leaders do. * Ship simple, mobile\-first AI experiences that turn real learner and job seeker problems into completed next steps, with deep context awareness, more agency for users, and handoffs to human advisors when they need one * Build AI\-native and multiply the team's output. Use coding agents yourself to ship working software fast, coach engineers in using them well, and help define the team's agentic development lifecycle: clear objectives and acceptance criteria, adversarial multi\-model passes on the spec, and a strong evaluation harness * Connect product analytics, AI evaluation, synthetic\-user tests, user research, and real task outcomes to fast release decisions, and show improvements with evidence * Create reusable conversation, planning, resource\-grounding, state, and action patterns that can be configured quickly for new personas, scenarios, localities, and partners * Take features through controlled production, owning architecture, data and state integrity, test automation, observability, performance, cloud cost, and release quality * Architect identity and access for learners, advisors, and partner institutions, including privacy\-preserving sign\-in, consent, delegated access, and role\-based authorization. Outside security and privacy specialists support hardening, reviews, and compliance, and you own integrating their work into the product * Be the technical voice with funders and state agency partners, including answering their hardest questions about safety and outcomes **What Success Looks Like** * Within the first months, Pathways reaches high school students after a few rapid cycles of engineering and hardening * Within six months, it serves thousands of high school users * Within twelve months, it's adapted for many personas, each tied to a real outcome such as enrolling in a post\-secondary program, starting an apprenticeship, or getting a job, on the way to about 100,000 users in Washington State * The team ships faster and with higher quality because of how you build and how you coach **Required Qualifications** We place more weight on what you've built, your impact on users, your production judgment, and your ability to raise the level of your teammates than on executive titles, pedigree, or years managing large teams. No degree required. * You've personally built and shipped LLM\-enabled applications used by real people, as a founder, founding engineer, staff or principal engineer, or deeply hands\-on engineering leader * Advanced fluency with multi\-model agentic development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar), plus the ability to inspect, test, debug, and improve AI\-generated code * Practical experience with LLM orchestration and tool calling, retrieval and grounding, persistent context, APIs, reliable application state, and full\-stack cloud deployments * Strong product instincts. You can design for teenagers and adults with different levels of experience, find the friction, simplify, and move users from exploring to finishing a real step * The judgment to make an early product secure and scalable without overengineering it, from trust boundaries, authorization, and logging to error handling, regression testing, monitoring, and the limits of LLM decision\-making * You've mentored a small engineering team and improved its speed and quality. You earn engineers' respect through your own work, give honest, constructive feedback, and adapt your coaching for senior, mid\-level, and early\-career engineers * Mission\-driven. You want your work to have a direct impact on people's economic mobility, and you're energized by working with students, partners, and end users **Nice to Have** * Leadership experience at a startup, or time at an engineering organization working at the cutting edge of AI development * Building products for schools, public sector agencies, or other institutional partners * Presenting a product to funders or senior stakeholders and answering hard questions on the spot * Experience with student data privacy and with identity and access for users under 18 **Location** This role is fully remote within the U.S., and CampusEvolve doesn't have an office. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. CampusEvolve is unable to sponsor visas or accept H\-1B transfers. **Benefits:** Health, dental, and vision insurance. Paid time off and holidays. Remote\-first, collaborative culture. Possible equity depending on experience and skills. **Estimated annual OTE:** $200k \- $275k.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer (Senior)
jobs.description: Provn is helping AZX recruit for the following role **About AZX:** Our mission is to accelerate positive impact in critical industries through AI transformation. We specialize in physics\-informed ML and enterprise AI solutions that directly address climate and sustainability challenges. We're growing quickly and already work with category\-leaders in real estate (CBRE), energy (LevelTen Energy), logistics (Flexe) and utilities. We're a public benefit corporation, founded in 2024, and have been profitable from inception. We work on challenges in clean energy, decarbonization, climate risk, energy systems, and global economics. We're building our company for long\-term success and aim to create the ultimate place to work for those passionate about AI and making a positive impact. **About the role:** We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join a team that scopes, builds, deploys, and measures AI systems inside client environments: utilities, commercial real estate, and logistics. Your software runs in the client's cloud, under their identity provider and toolchain, inside their compliance framework, integrated with their systems of record; you bring the right mix of models and tools for the job rather than working around it. The work is agentic AI with a correctness envelope: think document intelligence with deterministic, auditable validation where money or compliance is on the line, voice\-of\-customer AI, cognitive digital twins of a client's customers, and human\-in\-the\-loop agentic workflows, all measured against real before/after baselines rather than left as shelf\-ware. You won't be handed a finished spec. You'll sit with the client's operators and executives to find the real problem, design the solution with their architects, build it with your pod, and prove it worked with numbers both companies stand behind. You bring a strong area of expertise and expect to use it, and work closely with our team across DevOps, infrastructure, data pipelines, front end, and back end as the engagement requires. You are the engineering face of AZX. **Responsibilities** * Own your client's technical delivery end to end: discovery support, solution design, build, deployment into the client's environment, and a handover their team can actually run. * Build the trust machinery behind every system you ship: eval harnesses, replay loops, guardrails, cost/latency budgets, monitoring, and a defined "what happens when it's unsure" path. * Extract structured facts from messy documents (like contractor bids or engineering forms) and build the deterministic checks that gate money\- or compliance\-sensitive answers, making "cannot determine" fail closed rather than open. * Optimize pipelines for cost and quality, for example, moving a step from a frontier model to a fine\-tuned small model or a deterministic rule, then proving quality held with a replay harness. * Design and ship high\-stakes systems like after\-hours voicemail triage, defining the right autonomy boundary for the risk involved. * Agree on and track the measurement story with the client (KPIs, baselines, and instrumentation for cost, performance, and quality) in writing before deployment and validated after. * Maintain client\-facing engineering presence: working sessions with their IT/security teams, demos, POCs that derisk the next engagement, and a feedback loop that carries field\-learned requirements back to the platform team. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of deep, production experience with React/TypeScript: streaming UIs, high\-frequency updates, virtualization, and real state management, with informed, hands\-on opinions about React 19\. * Hands\-on experience with a streaming protocol end to end (SSE or WebSocket): chunk boundaries, reconnection semantics, abort propagation, including having personally debugged a raw byte stream. * True full\-stack ownership: you've shipped the backend half of your own front ends (Node/Fastify or Python/FastAPI), handling auth, idempotency, pagination, race conditions, and migrations. * Product taste backed by enterprise experience: accessibility you can defend to a screen\-reader user, thoughtful empty/error states, and localization that goes beyond a strings file. * An AI\-native working style: daily use of AI coding tools, driven by specs rather than vibes, with concrete examples of where you overrode a tool's output. * A strong sense of ownership: instrumentation, evals on AI\-dependent behavior, cost awareness, and on\-call are part of "done," not a later phase. * Practical depth in some of our core stack: TypeScript (strict), React 19, TanStack Query, Vite, Node/Fastify or Python/FastAPI, Postgres/Redis, and SSE/WebSocket streaming, with a track record of researching into unfamiliar parts of it. * Familiarity with the surrounding toolchain: zod\-validated wire contracts, sandboxed iframes/CSP/postMessage, Playwright/Vitest, WCAG 2\.2 AA, i18n frameworks, and OIDC/OAuth2 session mechanics. * Bachelor's Degree; Master's is a plus. **Additional Information** * Must be willing to travel to Seattle area for final interview and travel 2x/year for company summits * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. * We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time. * Please note that our interview process includes a written take\-home assignment followed by a live two\-hour technical session with our engineering team, so if that format isn't a good fit, we'd ask that you not apply. **Benefits:** Competitive early\-stage startup compensation (based on capabilities, experience, and location). Bonus eligibility and equity. Health insurance with meaningful coverage for dependents. Flexible PTO. Fully remote culture with a cluster of teammates in Seattle. Join a fast\-growing, profitable, mission\-driven company with industry\-leading clients leading AI transformation in critical industries. **Estimated annual OTE:** $140\-230k.

jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer
jobs.description: Provn is helping Envorso recruit for the following role **About Envorso:** Envorso Sports is building the platform that runs a professional sports team's entire fan\-facing business: ticketing, website, mobile app, and increasingly commerce, CRM, and marketing, from one system instead of six disconnected vendors. Today, most teams run a fragmented stack: a website vendor, a ticketing provider, a separate mobile app, CRM tools, marketing automation, and game\-day engagement solutions bolted together. Teams don't want to pay five vendors and contractors to stitch the data together. That creates a disconnected fan journey and leaves revenue on the table. Our platform is live today with the Seattle Seawolves of Major League Rugby, and the league itself is now on the platform, with individual teams onboarding through the season. Ticketing, website, and mobile app are shipped and in production with paying customers. CRM, marketing automation, personalization, and revenue operations are what we build next, AI\-native from the start. We want candidates to know exactly where the product stands before they join. **About the role:** You'll be our first in\-house engineer. This is a founding role: you'll own the fan data platform for the long term and help shape how we grow engineering, not ship one feature and move on. The problem is simple to state. Our teams and the league sit on a large fan database: ticket transactions, web and app activity, shop purchases, and email engagement. Today almost none of it is used. One salesperson calls season\-pass holders; one marketer sends a broadcast email and sees who bites. Your job is to turn that data into revenue: unify what we know about each fan across ticketing, web, app, shop, and email; decide which fans should get which offer; and deliver it through email and in\-app offers or push. Offers are concrete: a promo code for an abandoned cart, a season pass or match pass, a merch bundle, a seat upgrade. Getting the wrong offer to the wrong fan costs real money and real trust with a small, loyal fan base. You'll build for a three\-to\-five\-year horizon, not just this quarter. We need someone who thinks like an architect (data model, scale, failure handling, consent, cost) while still shipping something a team can use in weeks. You'll also be the engineer closest to our customers' front offices. Part of the job is understanding how a team's revenue and marketing operations actually work, and helping decide what we build first based on impact and effort. You'll report to Gopal Rao and work alongside our five\-engineer team in Argentina as one small group. jobs.description: Provn is helping Measure Well recruit for the following role **About Measure Well:** Measure Well helps cradle\-to\-career and place\-based partnerships use data and AI to see what is working and improve outcomes for children and families. Ballmer Group, which backs leaders working on economic mobility across the United States, funds our work. TechSoup, a global nonprofit that has connected mission\-driven organizations with technology for 30 years, is our fiscal sponsor. **About the role:** You will be the first technical teammate to join our Chief AI \& Data Officer (CAIDO), and you’ll report directly to them. An implementation partner is building our new data platform this winter. You will turn it into dashboards our staff and partners use every week and into AI tools our field can trust. Most of your time goes to building, with dashboards first and AI products close behind. You will also learn the platform well enough to keep it healthy after the handover. The role involves up to 25% travel. **What you will do** * Dashboards and data visualization (about 40%). Build and maintain Omni dashboards for staff and partner organizations, and agree what each number means before you chart it. * AI products (about 30%). Build features on Claude, run evaluation sets, review outputs with program staff, and ship improvements safely. * Analytics engineering and platform care (about 20%). Write and review dbt models, watch nightly loads, manage access, run approved syncs into HubSpot, and keep documentation current. * Working with people (about 10%). Mentor fellow team members and partners in building and using AI tools and dashboards. Help colleagues and partners understand what the data shows **Required Qualifications** **Must\-haves** * Five or more years building dashboards or data products that non\-technical people rely on, with examples to show. * At least one AI feature you shipped to real users, such as a retrieval tool, an agent or an LLM\-backed workflow, and a clear account of how you tested it. * Fluent SQL. You read and write dbt models (or similar) and review pull requests in Git. * A knack for explaining data to people who are not specialists, and commitment to the communities our partners serve. **Also a must\-have: enough pipeline engineering** * When a nightly sync fails, you find the failed step and either fix it or hand our partner a clear ticket the same day. * You read a dbt model and add a test to it. * You trace a dashboard number back to the warehouse and show that the two match. * You explain how row\-level security keeps one partner out of another's data, and prove it with a test user. * You run our runbook's failure drill from start to finish without help. **Nice\-to\-haves** * Backend data engineering, for example from full\-stack work at a small firm. We welcome it but do not require it. * Snowflake, Omni, Mixpanel, Census, Python, or analytics embedded for customers. * Nonprofit or public\-sector work, or experience with consent rules for personal data. **How we work** We are a small team where one person drives each decision and one person approves it. Our implementation partner builds the core platform and hands it to us. We check consent inside our data models, and nobody is on call overnight. Our tools: Fivetran, Snowflake, dbt Core, Omni, Mixpanel, Census, Claude, GitHub and HubSpot (similar experience counts). **Physical and work environment requirements** * Physical Requirements: High frequency of viewing a computer monitor, typing on a computer keyboard, checking mobile devices for communications. Requires travel of 25% for work. * Every team member will have an opportunity to set up their home or work office space to be a motivating and work/life friendly environment. **About TechSoup** We believe in using technology for the greater good. We're a fully remote, diverse team, working from all parts of the world. We invite you to join us in our mission to build a dynamic bridge that leverages technology to enable connections and innovative solutions for a more equitable planet. TechSoup is a global nonprofit social enterprise that connects NGOs with mission\-critical resources worldwide. For over 30 years, we've been building partnerships with individuals, corporations, nonprofits, and governments across the globe. Together, we are committed to helping organizations grow via our unifying technology platform, resources, and connections. Those organizations, in turn, build a brighter future for tens of millions of people. We serve both the smallest and largest nonprofits around the world through sustainable, low\-cost, self\-service offers delivered at scale. To date, we have enabled more than 1\.4 million organizations in over 230 countries and territories to receive technology tools, resources, and funding with a retail value of more than $19\.1 billion. We are constantly evolving. As technology and global needs change, so do we. We're creating new, community\-driven platforms and mobile apps and are enhancing our offerings so that nonprofits have the resources they need to build a brighter future for their communities. We're innovators, leaders, influencers, social entrepreneurs, and technologists drawn together by a shared vision: to make the world a better place through technology. Join our global team. TechSoup Global is the fiscal sponsor of the Measure Well venture. **Where we hire** For U.S. roles, TechSoup only hires from the following states: Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Missouri, Mississippi, Montana, North Carolina, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin. **Benefits:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, with optional HSA and FSA. Dependent care, pet insurance, and transportation benefits. Retirement savings plan and employee assistance program. Paid time off and national holidays. Onboarding stipend and yearly professional development opportunities (with manager approval). Home office setup support, so every team member can create a motivating, work\-life\-friendly environment. Office space available on request for team members in or near Kendall Square, Cambridge, MA. **Estimated annual OTE:** $113,100 \- $173,700\.

We specialize in physics\-informed ML and enterprise AI solutions that directly address climate and sustainability challenges. We're growing quickly and already work with category\-leaders in real estate (CBRE), energy (LevelTen Energy), logistics (Flexe) and utilities. We're a public benefit corporation, founded in 2024, and have been profitable from inception. We work on challenges in clean energy, decarbonization, climate risk, energy systems, and global economics. We're building our company for long\-term success and aim to create the ultimate place to work for those passionate about AI and making a positive impact. **About the role:** We're looking for a Backend Engineer you will build the services our products and client solutions run on. The center of gravity is LLM infrastructure: the layer that puts one governed front door over many models, hosted and self\-hosted, and answers the questions enterprises actually ask: who used which model, for what, at what cost, under whose rules. The platform's first customers are our own client\-facing engineers, the people delivering client outcomes with what you build, so requirements arrive concrete, feedback arrives same\-day, and the people you support are in the same meeting. **Responsibilities** * Own the LLM gateway: routing, metering, budgets, guardrail composition, and provider/backend adapters across hosted and self\-hosted models. * Manage the retrieval and knowledge service: connectors, chunking, hybrid search and reranking, grounded answers, and the MCP surface. * Build the eval harness that turns retrieval tuning from judgment into evidence, with confidence intervals and per\-segment breakdowns. * Own the async framework (its public API, rate\-limit algorithms, and admin tooling) and lead its evolution into durable execution for agent runs. * Design authorization across the whole surface: token hierarchies, capability grammars, and per\-tenant isolation tested as a regression, not asserted in a doc. * Own your own definition of done on everything you ship: evals, traces, cost accounting, and the dashboard that would wake you up. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of deep, production async Python: cancellation scopes, streaming lifecycle, and connection pooling. * Postgres as infrastructure: comfortable reasoning about MVCC, advisory locks, and vacuum discipline, with Redis/Dragonfly used (and not used) where it belongs; real distributed\-systems experience, not just familiarity. * Experience shipping API surfaces other engineers build on: versioning, idempotency, error vocabularies, migration discipline, and documentation to match. * Depth in at least one of LLM gateway concerns (routing, metering, guardrails, provider failover) or retrieval engineering (hybrid search, reranking, eval methodology, audit\-ready RAG), with credibility on the other. * A cost accounting and evals first mindset: you've shipped a gate or harness that caught a real regression, ideally one of your own. * Production depth in some modern stack, and the aptitude to ramp quickly on unfamiliar tools. * Practical familiarity with our core stack: Python 3\.12\+ (async, type\-strict, FastAPI/Starlette, Pydantic v2\), asyncpg/SQLAlchemy, Postgres (incl. pgvector), and Redis/Dragonfly with Lua, with willingness to research into the rest. * Exposure to the surrounding ecosystem: OpenTelemetry (incl. GenAI conventions), SSE/streaming lifecycles, OpenAI/Anthropic provider APIs, job frameworks (Celery/Dramatiq/Prefect\-class), rate\-limit algorithms (token bucket, GCRA), and integer\-cents money handling. * Past work in energy, real estate, utilities, climate or related fields is a plus. * Experience in both startup and enterprise environments is a plus. **Additional Information** * Must be willing to travel to Seattle area for final interview and travel 2x/year for company summits * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. * We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time. * Please only apply to a maximum of 2 roles at a time; any applicants who apply to more than 2 roles within a 6 month period will automatically be disqualified. **Benefits:** Competitive early\-stage startup compensation (based on capabilities, experience, and location). Bonus eligibility and equity. Health insurance with meaningful coverage for dependents. Flexible PTO. Fully remote culture with a cluster of teammates in Seattle. Join a fast\-growing, profitable, mission\-driven company with industry\-leading clients leading AI transformation in critical industries. **Estimated annual OTE:** $140\-230k.

disaggregation or load forecasting with abstention and monitoring built in) instead of reinventing them per engagement. * Own the simulation engine (Rust crates and Python bindings), including its validation methodology against the reference oracle and its performance, and use it to make city\-scale building stock tractable through representative\-archetype simulation. * Own the grid\-data toolkits: protocol codecs (IEEE C37\.118\-class), synthetic scenario generators, and verification utilities, including generating synthetic\-but\-believable meter data calibrated until domain experts can't tell. * Build the planning and dispatch support behind demand\-response programs, where acting on a wrong number carries real cost. * Own the publish path (versioned crates and Python packages), shipped with the evidence (evals, benchmarks) attached. * Own the feedback loop with client pods: track what the capability got wrong in the field, and turn that into what you build next. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of shipping applied ML on real\-world signals: forecasting, disaggregation, detection/classification on interval or sensor data, survival/reliability modeling, or an adjacent\-industry equivalent. * Strong numerical and scientific computing skills: feature engineering from raw interval data, solver\-level numerics when needed, and a healthy distrust of your own metrics. * Python plus a systems language: the models and tooling are Python, the engine is Rust; depth in one, working ability in the other, and the appetite to close the gap (Rust is teachable here; The second is our agent\-sandboxing platform: hardware\-isolated microVMs for running untrusted, agent\-generated code securely and compliantly by construction, where agents operate with least privilege, never see a credential, and a human gates anything that writes to a system of record. You'll write Rust in the morning, a Kubernetes controller after lunch, and a FastAPI control\-plane endpoint before you go home, building the fork engine, the guest agent, and the multi\-substrate model lifecycle. We're looking for individuals who've built this class of stack (an inference\-serving or serverless\-GPU platform), operated it hard at scale, or ideally both. **Responsibilities** * Manage the serving tier for open\-weight models: engine deployment and configuration, cold\-start strategy, per\-model SLOs, and upgrade/canary discipline. * Administer the Kubernetes layer for inference and sandbox workloads: operators and CRDs, autoscaling (KEDA/Karpenter\-class), GPU scheduling and sharing, and node lifecycle. * Own the stateful data plane end to end with restore procedures that are regularly tested. * Oversee the sandbox runtime and its host\-side control plane: lifecycle, exec, snapshot/fork, teardown, metering, and the threat model of the isolation boundary. * Direct the FastAPI control\-plane services, Terraform/OpenTofu, Bicep, and the dashboards. * Run the layer the backend services team builds on, expect to debug into their services, and expect them to read your dashboards. * Manage the open\-source posture: build to OSS standards and release as it matures, with reviewed PRs, real docs, and reproducible builds. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of shipping production systems in a systems language. Rust is the house language, but polyglots are welcome: deep Go, C/C\+\+, or Zig with genuine appetite for Rust counts. Async runtimes, memory\-safety discipline, and debugging at the syscall boundary should be familiar territory. * Operated Kubernetes workloads that other people depended on: controllers or operators, scheduling, autoscaling, node lifecycle. You've been paged, and the experience changed how you build. * Strong ability to threat\-model isolation boundaries (namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, hypervisors), including identifying what an untrusted guest could observe, forge, or exhaust, and applying security best practices for agentic execution: least privilege, no credentials in the sandbox, audit trails, and human approval on write actions. * Hands\-on experience deploying or operating open\-weight LLM serving infrastructure (vLLM/SGLang or similar), including packaging models into reliable, metered production endpoints. * Performance discipline in distributed systems: you measure before you optimize, and you can tell the story of a latency you killed with the numbers attached. * Practical depth in some of our core stack: Rust (tokio), Python/FastAPI, Kubernetes operators (controller\-runtime/Kubebuilder/CRDs), KEDA, Karpenter, GPU device plugins/DRA, with a genuine willingness to research your way into the rest. * Familiarity with isolation technology (Firecracker, Kata, gVisor, or comparable), secrets management and egress control (Vault/KMS\-class), and hosting stateful systems (vector stores like pgvector/Qdrant, graph stores like Neo4j) with backup and failover discipline. * Comfort operating across cloud and GPU substrates (AWS/Azure/GCP plus managed GPU clouds) using infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/OpenTofu, Bicep) and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry). * Bachelor's Degree; jobs.title: VP of AI Engineering
jobs.description: Provn is helping CampusEvolve recruit for the following role **About CampusEvolve:** CampusEvolve (campusevolve.ai) is a Seattle\-based, mission\-driven AI startup backed by the Gates Foundation, Schultz Family Foundation, and GitLab Foundation. Pathways is one tool for a person's whole pathway: from high school into a two\-year or four\-year program, a certificate, an apprenticeship, or the military, and on into work. People most often fall off a pathway in the gaps between programs, so Pathways is built to carry them across those gaps. Its retrieval layer covers more than 6,000 post\-secondary credential programs in Washington State, plus financial aid, career guidance, and basic\-needs resources like housing, food, and transportation. The north star is economic mobility, and at CampusEvolve, the mission is the culture. **About the role:** VP of AI Engineering builds Pathways, an AI\-native guide that helps people take real next steps toward education, careers, and economic security, and builds the team's ability to ship it with AI. This is a senior leadership role that's about 80% hands\-on building. You deliver the product rather than make sure it gets delivered, and you make engineering decisions, not recommendations. You'll lead three full\-time engineers, work closely with the Founder/CEO and CTO, and partner with a full\-time product manager and the VP of Community, who runs a network of 100\+ co\-design partners across K\-12, post\-secondary, and workforce programs. State agency partners are ready to roll out Pathways once it's engaging and safe, and you'll lead the engineering that gets it there. **What You'll Work On** Alongside the building, you keep engineering, product, partners, and leadership moving together, and you work directly with end users far more than most engineering leaders do. * Ship simple, mobile\-first AI experiences that turn real learner and job seeker problems into completed next steps, with deep context awareness, more agency for users, and handoffs to human advisors when they need one * Build AI\-native and multiply the team's output. Use coding agents yourself to ship working software fast, coach engineers in using them well, and help define the team's agentic development lifecycle: clear objectives and acceptance criteria, adversarial multi\-model passes on the spec, and a strong evaluation harness * Connect product analytics, AI evaluation, synthetic\-user tests, user research, and real task outcomes to fast release decisions, and show improvements with evidence * Create reusable conversation, planning, resource\-grounding, state, and action patterns that can be configured quickly for new personas, scenarios, localities, and partners * Take features through controlled production, owning architecture, data and state integrity, test automation, observability, performance, cloud cost, and release quality * Architect identity and access for learners, advisors, and partner institutions, including privacy\-preserving sign\-in, consent, delegated access, and role\-based authorization. Outside security and privacy specialists support hardening, reviews, and compliance, and you own integrating their work into the product * Be the technical voice with funders and state agency partners, including answering their hardest questions about safety and outcomes **What Success Looks Like** * Within the first months, Pathways reaches high school students after a few rapid cycles of engineering and hardening * Within six months, it serves thousands of high school users * Within twelve months, it's adapted for many personas, each tied to a real outcome such as enrolling in a post\-secondary program, starting an apprenticeship, or getting a job, on the way to about 100,000 users in Washington State * The team ships faster and with higher quality because of how you build and how you coach **Required Qualifications** We place more weight on what you've built, your impact on users, your production judgment, and your ability to raise the level of your teammates than on executive titles, pedigree, or years managing large teams. No degree required. * You've personally built and shipped LLM\-enabled applications used by real people, as a founder, founding engineer, staff or principal engineer, or deeply hands\-on engineering leader * Advanced fluency with multi\-model agentic development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar), plus the ability to inspect, test, debug, and improve AI\-generated code * Practical experience with LLM orchestration and tool calling, retrieval and grounding, persistent context, APIs, reliable application state, and full\-stack cloud deployments * Strong product instincts. You can design for teenagers and adults with different levels of experience, find the friction, simplify, and move users from exploring to finishing a real step * The judgment to make an early product secure and scalable without overengineering it, from trust boundaries, authorization, and logging to error handling, regression testing, monitoring, and the limits of LLM decision\-making * You've mentored a small engineering team and improved its speed and quality. You earn engineers' respect through your own work, give honest, constructive feedback, and adapt your coaching for senior, mid\-level, and early\-career engineers * Mission\-driven. You want your work to have a direct impact on people's economic mobility, and you're energized by working with students, partners, and end users **Nice to Have** * Leadership experience at a startup, or time at an engineering organization working at the cutting edge of AI development * Building products for schools, public sector agencies, or other institutional partners * Presenting a product to funders or senior stakeholders and answering hard questions on the spot * Experience with student data privacy and with identity and access for users under 18 **Location** This role is fully remote within the U.S., and CampusEvolve doesn't have an office. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. CampusEvolve is unable to sponsor visas or accept H\-1B transfers. **Benefits:** Health, dental, and vision insurance. Paid time off and holidays. Remote\-first, collaborative culture. Possible equity depending on experience and skills. **Estimated annual OTE:** $200k \- $275k.

jobs.title: Junior Developer, AI Team
jobs.description: Description: **Salary**: $60,000 **Job Type**: Full\-Time (Exempt) QuaverEd is a rapidly growing, innovative education technology company founded in 2009\. We are headquartered in historic Music Row in Nashville, Tennessee. Check out our website at QuaverEd.com. The AI team is small and builds fast. Requirements: * 0–2 years of professional development experience, or equivalent through a degree, bootcamp, or a solid portfolio of shipped projects; * Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript and at least one of React or Node.js; * Some Python, or the willingness to pick it up quickly; * Comfort with Git, pull requests, and reading code you didn't write; * Basic SQL and an understanding of how web apps talk to APIs and databases; * Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants, and the judgment to know when not to trust them; * Clear written communication; you can explain a fix to a non\-technical teammate; and * Follow\-through on unglamorous work. All employees must live within commuting distance of Music Row in Nashville. We are currently requiring all team members to work at minimum 3 days a week in the office on the QuaverEd campus and allowing 2 days remote. This requirement is subject to change at the discretion of the team member's Supervisor and company policies. *QuaverEd, Inc. offers an excellent benefits package including 80 hours of vacation per year with an increase after 3 years, 12 paid holidays, 60 hours of sick leave, subsidized health care up to $9,000 per year, a 401(k) program with no participation fees. The GDMS team is part of the Environmental Geospatial Data Management (EGDM) department. This position will provide guidance and lead collaboration on the overarching technical strategy, schema design, cross\-department data pipelines, technical management, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). A central priority will be working with the team to establish unified, standardized data structures and data management workflows across traditionally siloed departments—specifically bridging IT and Enterprise GIS. **Job Title:** Geospatial System Engineer **Location(s):** Grand Junction, CO **Status:** Full\-Time **FLSA:** Exempt **Hiring Range:** $80,000\.00 – 100,000\.00 per year. This position is required to travel less than 5% of the time. Essential Duties and Responsibilities * Translate multi\-departmental business requirements into actionable technical delivery plans, bridging IT and Enterprise GIS to establish standardized data workflows. * Partner with the Geospatial DBA to design schemas, normalize data, enforce advanced integrity rules (attribute rules, domains, subtypes, topologies), optimize performance (indexing, compression), and support backup/disaster recovery. * Support the System Administrator with the deployment, configuration, patching, multi\-tier upgrades, and tuning of ArcGIS Enterprise; monitor system performance using ArcGIS Monitor to resolve bottlenecks with IT. * Partner with IT Operations and Cybersecurity to align geospatial system configurations with organizational security policies and guide supporting infrastructure development. * Collaborate with the EGDM Data Engineer, administrators, and analysts to design, implement, and document automated data pipelines and cross\-cutting system integrations. * Review project requirements, recommend appropriate hardware/software configurations, and assist the GDMS Supervisor with capacity planning, budget management, and schedule adherence. * Lead architecture discussions with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, translate complex issues clearly, and author technical specifications, SOPs, proposals, and training materials. * Provide technical mentorship, support the GDMS Supervisor with hiring and onboarding, and upskill analysts and administrators across technical disciplines. * Stay current on emerging geospatial technologies and data trends, evaluating practical applications for DOE LM. * Perform related responsibilities as assigned in support of a dynamic operational environment. * Other duties as assigned. Required Skills and Abilities * Broad technical proficiency in core IT infrastructure, including networking, server deployment, load balancing, security protocols, scaling, and application support. * Proven capability in installing, configuring, tuning, and publishing services within enterprise\-scale ArcGIS environments. * Demonstrated experience in enterprise geodatabase schema design, branch versioning, attribute rules, and automated QA/QC frameworks. * Strong understanding of data science principles and their practical implementation within enterprise data systems. * Proven track record of guiding multidisciplinary teams (administrators, analysts, technicians), upskilling personnel, and driving consensus across siloed groups. * Superior written and verbal skills for developing clear SOPs, data dictionaries, technical standards, and stakeholder presentations. * Knowledge of GIS theory and data science and proven ability to apply concepts to enterprise GIS systems. * ArcGIS Enterprise 11\.x, ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Field Maps, Trimble Business Center (TBC), AutoCAD / Civil 3D, and ArcGIS Data Reviewer. * Safe Software FME, ArcGIS Data Interoperability extension, or custom Python\-based translation routines. * Advanced SQL, SQL Server Spatial; spatial indexing, schema design, and performance optimization. * Python (arcpy, arcgis.gis), Arcade, SQL scripts, and batch processing. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7\.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. **About the Role** ================== We're looking for builders and former founders who want to take big swings at Ramp. You'll tackle important, open\-ended problems, turn ideas into working products, and own what happens after launch. This is a backend engineering role for someone who wants to shape what we build, not just how we build it. Ramp's AI bets span products like Glass, an AI assistant for getting work done; Inspect, a platform for coding agents; and AI Spend Management, which helps businesses understand and manage their AI and token spend. These are examples of the problems that excite us: changing how people work, how software gets built, and how businesses put AI to use. You'll have the opportunity to build from 0–1 and scale from 1–100, bringing new AI products to life and turning early traction into lasting customer value. You'll work closely with product, design, and other engineers, stay close to users, and help find the next opportunities to accelerate Ramp's growth. jobs.title: AI Automation Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** We are seeking a highly motivated AI Automation Solutions Engineer to drive innovation, operational efficiency, and process transformation through intelligent automation and applied AI solutions. In this role, you will partner with business leaders, project teams, operations teams, engineering organizations, and external vendors to identify opportunities for automation, streamline workflows, and improve service delivery across the organization. You will serve as both a strategic advisor and hands\-on technical contributor, helping translate business challenges into scalable technology solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering and automation expertise with a consultative mindset, enabling them to identify opportunities, influence stakeholders, and deliver solutions that create measurable business value. **Job Description** ***Please note: This role is not eligible for Work Visa sponsorship, either currently or in the future*** ***This role is a hybrid workstyle:*** ***with the associate expected to work from a Raymond James office location at least three days per week, including either Monday or Friday.*** **Responsibilities** * Partner with business stakeholders, project teams, product owners, and technology leaders to identify automation and AI opportunities that improve operational efficiency and service delivery. * Participate in project planning, discovery sessions, and vendor engagements to evaluate business requirements and recommend scalable automation solutions. * Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities to eliminate manual effort through workflow automation and intelligent technologies. * Design, develop, implement, and maintain enterprise automation solutions, integrations, and orchestration workflows. * Build and support AI\-powered solutions including intelligent agents, knowledge retrieval systems, conversational experiences, and Generative AI use cases. * Develop integrations between enterprise platforms using APIs, web services, and automation frameworks. * Create reusable automation components, frameworks, and development standards to accelerate solution delivery. * Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to ensure solutions are secure, supportable, scalable, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards. * Monitor automation performance, troubleshoot issues, and continuously optimize existing solutions. * Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to identify new opportunities for automation, AI adoption, and process improvement. * Maintain technical documentation, governance standards, and operational procedures for automation platforms and AI solutions. Contribute to roadmap planning and strategic initiatives focused on digital transformation, intelligent automation, and operational excellence. * **Required Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience in software engineering, automation engineering, platform engineering, systems integration * Experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise\-scale automation solutions and workflows. * Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, PowerShell, Java, or Go. * Experience building APIs, system integrations, and automated business processes. * Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC), source control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and secure coding practices. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for business audiences. * Experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into practical technical solutions. Ability to manage multiple initiatives while working effectively across cross\-functional teams. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with prompt engineering, model evaluation, AI governance, guardrails, and responsible AI practices. * Experience with enterprise automation and orchestration platforms such as VMware vRealize Orchestrator, Microsoft System Center Orchestrator, Resolve, or similar technologies. * Experience developing or integrating Generative AI solutions, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, intelligent agents, or chatbot technologies. * ServiceNow development, administration, workflow design, or system integration experience. * Experience with cloud platforms and modern development architectures. * Understanding of DevOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation frameworks. * Experience supporting Digital Workplace, End User Computing, Infrastructure, or Enterprise Technology organizations. * Relevant certifications related to cloud technologies, AI, automation, software engineering, or DevOps. Experience evaluating third\-party technologies and collaborating with vendors to develop and implement technical solutions. * **Why Join Us** This position offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of intelligent automation and AI across the enterprise. You will work directly with business leaders, technical teams, and strategic partners to design innovative solutions that improve efficiency, enhance user experiences, and drive meaningful transformation at scale. **Education** High School (HS) \- Completed (Required) **Work Experience** General Experience \- 3 to 6 years **Certifications** **Travel** Less than 25% **Workstyle** Hybrid The total compensation for this position includes base salary or wages, and may include components such as additional compensation (cash or equity), discretionary bonuses, or commissions. This position is eligible for a benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; critical illness insurance and accident insurance; disability benefits; retirement savings; paid time off (including vacation, holidays, and sick leave); and parental leave. Eligibility for benefits and specific offerings may vary based on position and employment status. To view more details of the benefits offered, visit Myrjbenefits.com. At Raymond James our associates use five guiding behaviors (Develop, Collaborate, Decide, Deliver, Improve) to deliver on the firm's core values of client\-first, integrity, independence and a conservative, long\-term view. We expect our associates at all levels to: * Grow professionally and inspire others to do the same * Work with and through others to achieve desired outcomes * Make prompt, pragmatic choices and act with the client in mind * Take ownership and hold themselves and others accountable for delivering results that matter * Contribute to the continuous evolution of the firm At Raymond James – as part of our people\-first culture, we honor, value, and respect the uniqueness, experiences, and backgrounds of all of our Associates. When associates bring their best authentic selves, our organization, clients, and communities thrive. The Company is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs. \#LI\-TC1

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise Systems
jobs.description: **Description** Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. **About the Role: Fullstack Senior Software Engineer** You will be joining the Enterprise Systems tech community, the vital architectural backbone where Realtor.com's most ambitious strategic initiatives transform into reality. Our team doesn't just manage software; we build the high\-speed 'engine room' that powers the entire business lifecycle\-integrating complex sales, billing, inventory, and fulfillment platforms into a seamless, high\-scale ecosystem. At Realtor, you will be part of a forward\-thinking community dedicated to compressing the distance between business intent and execution. We research and deploy cutting\-edge autonomous workflow engines to ensure our customers and internal partners have a best\-in\-class, friction\-free experience. We strive to innovate by building self\-healing infrastructures and AI\-driven automation that make the transaction journey faster and more intelligent than ever before. Join us to push the boundaries of what's possible, turning traditional systems of record into dynamic engines of growth, while learning from world\-class talent in a culture that thrives on experimentation and impact. As a Fullstack Senior Developer, you will be the bridge between complex enterprise data and high\-performance user experiences. You will join the Enterprise Systems tech community to build the tools that empower our customers and partners to navigate the home\-buying lifecycle with unprecedented speed. You aren't just writing code; you are designing the digital workflows that ensure our sales, order, and fulfillment engines run at peak efficiency. **What You'll Do:** * Engineer End\-to\-End Solutions: Design and develop scalable, responsive web applications using React and Node.js/Python that simplify complex enterprise workflows. * Architect Micro\-Frontends: Implement modern frontend architectures that integrate seamlessly with our Salesforce ecosystem and internal microservices. * Optimize Data Pipelines: Build and maintain high\-throughput APIs and event\-driven services (using Kafka or AWS EventBridge) that power real\-time business dashboards. * Embed Intelligence: Integrate Generative AI and machine learning models directly into the UI to provide predictive insights and automated task suggestions for our users. * Champion Quality \& DevOps: Drive the adoption of "Shift\-Left" testing, CI/CD automation, and observability tools to ensure our enterprise tools are as resilient as our consumer\-facing products. * Collaborate \& Mentor: Partner with Product Managers and UX Designers to translate business requirements into technical reality, while mentoring mid\-level engineers through code reviews and pair programming. **What You'll Bring:** * Full Stack Mastery: 5\+ years of professional experience building and scaling production\-grade applications using modern frameworks like React/Next.js and Node.js, Go, Python or Java. * System Design Fluency: Deep understanding of distributed systems, REST/GraphQL API design, and how to optimize for performance across the entire stack. * Cloud\-Native Mindset: Hands\-on experience with AWS (Lambda, ECS, DynamoDB) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) in a CI/CD environment. * Database Expertise: Proficiency with both relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and NoSQL solutions, including experience handling large\-scale data migrations. * Modern Web Expertise: Strong command of CSS\-in\-JS, TypeScript, and state management libraries (Redux/Zustand), with a focus on accessibility and performance. * Agile Leadership: Proven ability to lead features from conception to deployment in an Agile/Scrum environment, making pragmatic trade\-offs between speed and technical debt. * Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field **How We Work:** We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. **How We Reward You:** Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you'll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you'll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you'll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we'll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** As an AI Engineer, you’ll build, evaluate, and deploy machine learning solutions that turn complex data into useful insights and products. You’ll partner with research and engineering teams to move AI models from experimentation into reliable applications. Your impact: By delivering well\-tested, scalable models, you help teams make informed decisions and provide users with more relevant, effective tools. **Duties** * Prepare data pipelines using extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes; support data mining, analytics, and database design across SQL databases and big data systems. * Develop and train machine learning models, including predictive models, unsupervised learning, natural language processing, and generative AI applications. * Evaluate model performance, conduct statistical modeling and analysis for research, and communicate findings to technical and nontechnical partners. * Implement and deploy AI models using machine learning frameworks, cloud services, and scalable platforms; contribute to Spark implementation and Hadoop\-based workflows. * Collaborate on AI implementation and machine learning/AI\-based analysis, applying linked data and quantum engineering concepts where relevant. **Skills** * **Core:** Python, SQL, machine learning, model training, model evaluation, AI models, statistical analysis, predictive modeling analysis, and data analytics. * **Platforms and tools:** AWS, TensorFlow, Spark, Hadoop, Talend, Looker, SAS, R, statistical analysis tools, and machine learning cloud services. * **Additional programming:** Java, C, VBA, and Bash (Unix shell); familiarity with big data, big data systems, and scalability. * **Preferred:** Experience with generative AI, natural language processing, unsupervised learning, linked data, and quantum engineering. Pay: $134,700\.00 \- $155,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Hybrid/Remote ***Job Overview*** Who We Are Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI‑powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high‑stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we’re deeply committed to expanding access to technology for academic institutions through Relativity Academic and supporting pro bono legal work through Justice for Change What We Do About AI and Data Science at Relativity Over the past two years, billions of documents have benefited from Relativity AI, and we are just beginning. We use AI to improve every user experience, product, matter, and investigation—helping users find the truth faster and act on data with confidence. At the same time, Relativity’s scale creates rich opportunities for data exploration, and our market reach helps turn insights into impact quickly. Our infrastructure makes data available for analysis while keeping it secure and protected, and we continue to invest in modern data\-pipeline and data\-lake technology. We prioritize algorithm excellence to deliver a robust, trusted experience. We are building a world\-class toolset to solve complex challenges quickly. We apply AI across discovery to improve case management and product operations. Our team values curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning. We test boldly, learn quickly, and improve every day. If you’re looking for a data\-rich, AI\-driven environment with large\-scale challenges and room to innovate, you’ll feel at home on Relativity’s AI team. Join us to help shape the culture, practices, and technical vision for machine learning at Relativity. What You’ll Do As a Senior AI Engineer at Relativity, you will design and build the AI/ML platforms and processes that support applied science and product engineering teams.
