This role requires close collaboration across teams to enable impactful machine learning solutions that improve user experiences and product performance. If you're eager to tackle technical challenges and drive innovation in ML Ops, this position is for you. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **Responsibilities** * **Technical Leadership.** Work with a team of engineers from a technical perspective, focused on data science enablement, automation, and model management. * **Solution Design.** Design AI/ML solutions with the appropriate delivery timelines, extensibility, performance, and scale. * **Planning.** Plan larger data science and machine learning efforts in conjunction with data scientists and product managers, minimizing risks and maximizing opportunities. * **Security \& Compliance.** Collaborate with Relativity's security team to ensure robust data protection and compliance. * **Cross\-Team Collaboration.** Collaborate with product managers, data engineers, and data scientists focused on innovation and new product development. * **ML Ops.** Design, communicate, and deploy our machine learning operations processes and platforms (i.e., ML Ops). * **Prototyping.** Prototype new machine learning technologies to find opportunities to reduce costs, gain efficiencies, unlock insights, or facilitate new product development. * **Hands\-On Contribution.** Contribute towards project work and model technical acumen via hands\-on contributions, coaching, code review, and system design review. * **Communication.** Communicate across the broader AI team, keeping the team aware of AI platform innovation, learning opportunities, and future areas of innovation. * **Deployment \& Monitoring.** Deploy and monitor highly available data science solutions via CI/CD with health and performance metrics. What We’re Looking For **Required** * **4\+ years** of experience engineering software systems. * **2\+ years** of industry experience in machine learning\-focused roles and big data environments. * Fluent in **C\#, Python, or Java** . * **3\+ years** of experience with **Docker** . * **2\+ years** of experience creating resources on **AWS, Azure, or GCP** using infrastructure as code (e.g., AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK, Terraform, CDKTF, Pulumi, etc.). * Experience with **Prefect, Airflow** , or an analogous workflow tool. * Experience with **Helm and Kubernetes** . * Ability and desire to mentor teammates in the use of applied data science and data processing technologies. * Prior experience owning and maintaining a major system within a business from a technical and architecture perspective. * Experience maintaining and monitoring deployed data science solutions for performance and algorithmic health. **Preferred** * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Artificial Intelligence. * Experience with Azure cloud environment and Azure's big data infrastructure, data processing, and data science toolset. * Experience building or deploying models using frameworks such as **TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch** . * Demonstrated deep experience in a particular area of data science (computer vision, NLP, etc.). * Experience with **MLflow** or **Kubeflow** . * Experience in a DevOps, infrastructure, or site reliability team or function. * Experience deploying solutions in big data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, EMR, and Kafka. * Experience tuning data processing engines such as Spark to optimize costs, resource consumption, and execution times. Why We Could Be A Great Fit * **Impactful Mission:** ***Organize Data, Discover the Truth and Act on It*** \- Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading law firms managing high\-stakes matters on our platform. * **Growth Path:** Engineers gain exposure across the stack, from distributed systems to AI\-enabled workflows, accelerating career growth. * **Engineering Culture:** Continuous delivery, strong observability, and end\-to\-end ownership. * **Inclusive Environment:** Diverse backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger. * **Community Impact:** Volunteer opportunities and company\-sponsored charitable programs. * **Compensation \& Benefits:** Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, two annual company breaks, home office stipend, and an equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer II
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Vehicle Software team develops the safety\-critical software that runs on Terran R. The work spans a distributed, real\-time control system operating under extreme conditions like Mach 5 atmospheric flight, with a deployment pace that allows you to see your code run on rocket engines daily. The team is building new system architecture from the ground up and just as importantly, testing, releasing, and deploying it. You don't need an aerospace background: what matters is experience with high\-reliability software for complex systems. This is a rare opportunity to shape the foundation of Terran R's software stack while directly influencing performance, reliability, and flight success. **About the Role:** Aerospace experience isn't required. We value driven engineers with strong computer science fundamental who collaborate well to solve meaningful problems. As a Flight Software Engineer II, you will be a technical leader within the team with a high level of autonomy tackling core flight software products that directly impact the Terran R program and be responsible for setting standards and best practices for the team along with mentoring junior engineers. Architect and deliver core flight software with a strong focus on meeting system and performance requirements such as latency, allowed jitter, and control frequency. Work closely with GNC engineers to integrate complex algorithms for vehicle ascent and re\-entry, descent and landing. Work closely with Embedded Software Engineers and Avionics to integrate vehicle sensor data such as GPS, IMU, Radar, and to control vehicle equipment such as valves, thrust vector controls, and landing grid fins. Develop telemetry system that prioritizes, filters, stores and forwards, and encodes/decodes telemetry to RF format, and routes that data through ground stations and to data centers. Support the development and integration of testing infrastructure such as HITL (Hardware\-In\-The\-Loop) and HOOTL (Hardware\-Out\-Of\-The\-Loop) and physics and fluid sims. Focus on maximizing the team's velocity by defining processes, best practices, integrating modern tools and technologies, and mentoring junior engineers. **About You:** * An undergraduate or graduate degree in a relevant engineering discipline (Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering) * 2\+ years experience of production development experience * Experience delivering production\-level and high reliability software * Expert in Rust, C\+\+, and/or other system languages, as well as algorithms and data structures * Expert in Linux Operating System concepts such as memory management, CPU shielding, scheduling, etc * Expert in networking concepts such as TCP/IP, UDP * Experience with software development processes including: source control, bug tracking, and CI/CD **Nice to haves but not required:** * Experience with systems\-level programming like synchronization primitives, memory management, etc. * Experience with different inter\-process communication methods * Experience with message passing protocol such as flatbuffer or protobuf **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.** ***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.*** ***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission \- via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee \- will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Hybrid
jobs.description: **About Us:** Rex Moore continues to be powered by amazing employees just like you for over 100 years. Together we are building a world that is safe, comfortable, and sustainable. Our diverse team of experts spreading to National territories create innovative, integrated solutions to make cities more connected, buildings more intelligent and environments more comfortable and secure. Watch Our Story: About Rex Moore Group, Inc. \- YouTube **Job Overview:** The Senior Data Engineer is the internal owner of Rex Moore’s enterprise Data Lakehouse platform, built on Microsoft Fabric with OneLake as the storage foundation. This role designs, builds, and operates the pipelines, data models, and semantic layer that consolidate information from ERP, project management, estimating, design coordination, document management, field operations, HR, and financial systems into a single governed enterprise data foundation supporting reporting, applications, workflow automation, and AI capabilities. This position inherits Rex Moore’s newly established enterprise Data Lakehouse and builds on that foundation. The Senior Data Engineer assumes full operational ownership of the platform, completes the transition from Rex Moore’s implementation partner, and continues to extend it with new data sources, models, and capabilities as the business grows. Over time, this role establishes the technical patterns, standards, and documentation on which Rex Moore’s data engineering practice is built. **Key Responsibilities and Essential Tasks** Data Lakehouse Architecture \& Platform Operations * Own the ongoing design and operation of the Microsoft Fabric Data Lakehouse, including OneLake storage, Lakehouse items, and Fabric workspaces across development, test, and production environments. * Build and maintain the medallion architecture (bronze, silver, gold) governing how raw source data is landed, refined, and published for enterprise consumption. * Manage deployment automation and environment promotion through Fabric deployment pipelines and Azure DevOps source control. * Monitor platform health, pipeline reliability, data freshness, and refresh performance against defined service levels. * Maintain Fabric capacity performance and evaluate capacity sizing based on actual workload rather than default scale\-up. * Administer the on\-premises data gateway and hybrid connectivity to on\-premises source systems. * Design and periodically test backup, recovery, and disaster recovery for platform data and configurations. Data Engineering \& Integration * Design, build, and operate ingestion and transformation pipelines using Fabric Data Factory, Dataflows, notebooks, and Spark. * Integrate enterprise source systems using supported APIs, vendor connectors, database replication, or secure file transfer, favoring repeatable patterns over one\-off integrations. * Build and maintain integrations with OAuth\-secured vendor APIs, handling authentication, rate limits, pagination, and incremental extraction where source systems lack reliable change tracking. * Ingest and model semi\-structured and document\-derived data, including document metadata, OCR\-extracted fields, drawing markups, and model coordination issues. * Develop incremental load, change data capture, and historical retention strategies appropriate to each source system. * Implement data quality validation and reconciliation to source across finance, job cost, and project data. * Onboard new source systems as the Rex Moore application portfolio evolves. Data Modeling, Semantic Layer \& Reporting Enablement * Develop and maintain dimensional models and conformed enterprise dimensions in the gold layer, including Company, Project, Period, Cost Code, Vendor, and Employee. * Build and tune Direct Lake semantic models supporting financial reporting and project/job cost reporting. * Implement and test row\-level and object\-level security in semantic models, including project\-scoped access for project and field roles. * Manage release and change control for shared models and conformed dimensions so changes are tested, communicated, and applied consistently across dependent reports. * Establish standardized enterprise business logic, KPIs, and measures in the semantic layer so calculations are defined once rather than recreated independently in each Power BI report. * Partner with business SMEs to define reporting requirements, identify authoritative data sources, and resolve conflicts where multiple systems contain similar information. * Support month\-end close data readiness and reconciliation, monitor report usage and adoption, and partner with business report champions to drive measurable value. * Support self\-service analytics and Power BI Copilot and natural\-language Q\&A readiness through model metadata and synonym preparation. * Prepare governed, certified gold\-layer data for Microsoft Foundry AI use cases, including AI Search indexing and retrieval patterns, in partnership with AI  , or equivalent work experience. Preferred Knowledge – Platform * Direct Microsoft Fabric and OneLake production experience, including Direct Lake semantic models. * Microsoft Purview or comparable enterprise data governance tooling. * Experience as the first or primary data engineer in an organization establishing the function. * Relevant Microsoft certifications (DP\-600, DP\-700, AZ\-305, AI\-102\). * Exposure to Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Search, or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) data patterns. Preferred Knowledge – Construction / AEC Industry (Architecture, Engineering \& Construction) * Experience supporting data, reporting, or systems within construction, engineering, architecture, specialty trade contracting, or another AEC or project\-based industry. * Familiarity with construction financial and operational concepts including job cost, work breakdown structure (WBS), cost codes and cost types, committed cost, change orders, percent\-complete revenue recognition, work\-in\-progress (WIP) reporting, and retention. * Understanding of how estimating, project management, field operations, procurement, and accounting data relate to one another across systems in a construction organization. * Exposure to construction and AEC platforms such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Build or Forma) for project management and documents, Trimble Accubid for electrical estimating, Bluebeam for drawing review and markups, and Revizto for 3D model coordination, or comparable project delivery and estimating systems. * Experience integrating supporting business platforms such as Paycom (HRIS and payroll), Expensify (expense reporting and corporate cards), or Hilti ON!Track (tool and equipment tracking). * Familiarity with construction workforce and field data including labor hours, crew and unit productivity, timekeeping, payroll integration, equipment and tool tracking, and prefabrication. * Awareness of the data considerations in document\-heavy environments such as drawings, submittals, RFIs, and contract documents, including metadata, retention, and governance implications. * Understanding of the reporting needs of project managers, field leadership, finance, and executives in a project\-driven business. Skills * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to trace a data issue from report back to source. * Strong documentation discipline, including the ability to produce diagrams, runbooks, and technical specifications others can follow. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to translate business questions into data requirements and explain technical constraints in business terms. * Ability to collaborate effectively with IT staff, business SMEs, executives, and external vendors. Abilities * Ability to operate independently and own a production platform end to end. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and reconciliation to source. * Ability to prioritize competing demands and work in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to establish standards and repeatable patterns rather than solving each problem uniquely. * Interest in growing the Rex Moore data engineering capability over time. **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to verbally communicate: convey detailed and accurate instructions and information. * Ability to hear with or without correction in order to receive and interpret detailed information. * Required to sit at a desk work station for long periods of time. * Push, pull, lift, carry at least 10 pounds and occasionally lift/move up to 35 pounds. * Occasionally required to walk and stand for short and long periods of time. * Required to have visual acuity with or without correction in order to read contract documents, analyze data, view a computer monitor, and proof\-read documents to identify errors. * Required to use fingers and hands: type using a computer keyboard, handle, feel, and reach. * May occasionally be required to stoop, kneel, and crouch.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. It's big, it's bold, and we're already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. If you're ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value. **THE WORK:** Ripple is building the Internet of Value: infrastructure that moves money as fast as information moves today. Every payment that flows across our network passes through real\-time financial crimes controls: sanctions screening, wallet risk analysis, transaction monitoring, and travel rule compliance. The Financial Crimes Engineering team builds and operates that layer. This is the engineering that determines whether payments clear or hold, whether Ripple meets its regulatory obligations across jurisdictions, and whether the network can scale without compromising on compliance. The problem space is genuinely hard: high\-throughput distributed systems, real\-time decisioning, multi\-source coordination across external compliance data providers, regulator\-grade audit trails, and resilience. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will set the multi\-year technical direction for the compliance control plane and drive its adoption beyond your own team. You will own the architecture of the vendor\-agnostic, resilient, provable system that lets Ripple move value without moving financial crime, and you will shape how compliance engineering works across the company. This is a role for someone who defines which problems the organization solves, not only how they get solved: you will set the technical strategy other teams build against, establish the patterns that become organizational standards, and serve as the senior\-most engineering voice on how regulatory obligations become durable infrastructure. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** * Own the multi\-year architectural vision for the compliance control plane: real\-time screening orchestration, the resilience and observability layer, vendor\-agnostic integration, and the decision and data plane, sequenced against where Ripple's products and regulatory surface will be in three years, not where they are today * Drive the hardest, highest\-ambiguity technical problems end to end: multi\-vendor failover, sub\-second decisioning under load, regulator\-grade auditability, and resilience across partial dependency failures * Set technical direction that extends beyond FinCrimes: define the integration contracts, resilience patterns, and compliance primitives that partner engineering teams adopt, and drive alignment across organizational boundaries where no single team owns the outcome * Translate evolving regulatory obligations and organizational goals into durable engineering primitives and a sequenced technical roadmap, and influence what the organization invests in to get there * Anticipate platform risks and scaling constraints years before they become incidents, and lead the initiatives that address them * Partner directly with executive leadership across Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Product to shape how regulatory requirements become engineering reality, and represent the platform's technical position to auditors, regulators, and external partners * Set standards for production ownership across the team and beyond: observability, alerting, incident response, and the reliability bar that other teams calibrate against * Multiply the technical capability of the organization: mentor staff and senior engineers, elevate design quality through architecture review, and raise the ceiling of what the team can take on **WHAT YOU'LL BRING:** * 12\+ years building production backend systems, with deep expertise in Java (or comparable JVM languages, Go, Rust) * A track record of owning architecture for complex distributed systems at scale across multiple teams or organizations, defining the designs that others build against and that outlast your involvement * Demonstrated ability to set technical direction at the organizational level and drive adoption of standards and patterns across team boundaries without formal authority * Strong resilience and distributed\-systems design instincts: failover, graceful degradation, idempotency, high\-throughput real\-time decisioning, and designing systems that survive the failure of dependencies you do not control * Excellent API design judgment (REST/gRPC) and a history of establishing patterns that become organizational defaults * Proven skill navigating ambiguity in a regulated environment, turning regulator findings, audit obligations, and partner asks into shippable, durable engineering plans, and defending those decisions to auditors and examiners * Working knowledge of Kubernetes, observability tooling (Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar), and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) * A track record of developing senior and staff engineers and measurably lifting the technical bar of an organization * Experience in fintech, payments, identity, or compliance technology is a strong plus, though exceptional systems architects from adjacent high\-stakes domains are welcome **WHY THIS ROLE:** * **Consequence**: your architecture decides whether real payments clear, in real time, for real customers. * **Ownership beyond the platform:** you are not owning a service or even a system, you are shaping the compliance control plane that every Ripple product depends on and the standards that partner teams build to. * **Building the next generation:** we are actively designing the vendor\-agnostic, resilient compliance platform built to scale across new jurisdictions and product surfaces. This is the person who leads that design and sets its direction for the next several years. * **Executive\-level influence:** you will work directly with senior leaders across Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Product. The job is technical, but the influence is organizational. * **Technical leadership without leaving the code:** the senior\-most IC voice on a team where the engineering genuinely matters. Other common names for this role: **WHO WE ARE:** Do Your Best Work * The opportunity to build in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with experienced industry leaders * A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning. * Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team. * In\-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10\+ days a month they come in. * Bi\-weekly all\-company meeting \- business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team * We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more! Take Control of Your Finances * Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity * Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support * Employee giving match * Mobile phone stipend Take Care of Yourself * R\&R days so you can rest and recharge * Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite \& virtual programming * Generous vacation policy \- work with your manager to take time off when you need it * Industry\-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits. * Catered lunches, fully\-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events *Benefits listed above are for full\-time employees.* *Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.* *Please find our California, UK/EU, Singapore, DIFC, ADGM, Australia, and Switzerland* *Applicant Privacy Notice* *for reference.*

This role sits within our AI Engineering organization and focuses on how agents remember, reason over, and share what the company knows. You will design and build a corporate knowledge graph that agents both draw from and contribute to, along with the agentic memory systems that let agents keep context across tasks, users, and time. You have a proven track record of modeling complex business domains, building production knowledge graphs or semantic layers, and connecting them to LLM\-based applications. This is a Hybrid role. You will report to the Director of Agentic AI. **Your Responsibilities** * Design, build, and evolve a knowledge graph that represents Rockwell's people, products, customers, processes, systems, and data, and serves as shared context for AI agents across functions. * Design write\-back patterns that let agents contribute new facts, relationships, and learnings to the knowledge graph safely, with provenance, confidence, validation, and human review where needed. * Architect agentic memory for our agent platform, including short\-term (working) memory, long\-term episodic and semantic memory, and shared organizational memory, with clear policies for retention, summarization, and forgetting. * Develop ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic models with business and data owners, and keep business definitions consistent across analytics, BI, and AI tools. * Build ingestion and extraction pipelines that turn structured and unstructured enterprise content (documents, tickets, ERP and CRM records, engineering data) into graph entities and relationships using LLM\-assisted entity and relation extraction. * Implement GraphRAG and hybrid retrieval (graph traversal combined with vector and keyword search) to ground agent responses and reduce hallucinations. * Expose the knowledge graph and memory services to agents through standard interfaces such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and APIs. * Establish governance for the knowledge graph, including access control, data lineage, quality checks, freshness, and alignment with enterprise data governance and security policies. * Partner with stakeholders across the enterprise to prioritize knowledge domains and measure the impact on agent accuracy and usefulness. **Key Technical Skill Expectations** **Knowledge Graphs \& Semantic Modeling:** Design ontologies and graph schemas using property graph (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB for Apache Gremlin) and/or RDF/OWL approaches, with query languages such as Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL. Apply entity resolution, schema alignment, and graph data quality techniques. **Agentic Memory:** Architect memory layers for AI agents, including working memory, episodic and semantic long\-term memory, memory consolidation and retrieval, and shared memory across multi\-agent systems, using frameworks such as LangGraph, Mem0, Zep/Graphiti, Hindsight, LLMWiki etc. **Corporate Knowledge Graph for Agents:** Build a living, agent\-writable knowledge graph with provenance, trust levels, versioning, and conflict resolution so that knowledge produced by agents can be reviewed, trusted, and reused across the enterprise. **GraphRAG \& Retrieval:** Implement retrieval pipelines that combine knowledge graph traversal with vector search (e.g., Azure AI Search, pgvector, Redis) and embeddings to deliver accurate, explainable context to LLMs. **Semantic Layer \& Open Standards:** Understand semantic layers and metric definitions, and how open standards keep business meaning consistent as it moves between AI agents, BI platforms, and data tools. **Agent Integration \& Security:** Expose knowledge and memory services through MCP servers and APIs, with fine\-grained access control, PII handling, and audit logging that comply with enterprise governance and security policies. **The Essentials \- You Will Have** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science, or a related field. * Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have** * Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience, including 3\+ years building knowledge graphs, semantic layers, or search and retrieval systems. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Knowledge Engineering, or a similar discipline. * Hands\-on experience building and operating a production knowledge graph in an enterprise setting. * Experience designing memory for LLM agents and multi\-agent systems in production. * Familiarity with Apache Ossie (incubating, formerly Open Semantic Interchange), the vendor\-neutral standard for exchanging semantic models and metric definitions across AI, BI, and analytics tools. * Familiarity with the Open Knowledge Format (OKF), the open specification for representing agent\- and human\-readable knowledge as markdown with YAML frontmatter, including its provenance, trust, and freshness conventions. * Experience with W3C semantic web standards (RDF, OWL, SHACL, SKOS) and industrial information models such as ISA\-95 or the Asset Administration Shell. * Proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with graph query languages (Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL). * Experience with LLM\-based information extraction, entity resolution, and evaluation of retrieval quality. * Experience with data catalogs and metadata platforms (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra, DataHub). * 3\+ years of experience with major cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Experience working and coordinating with a geographically jobs.description: **Please Note:** To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6\-month period. **Advancing the World's Technology Together** Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day\-including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you'll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what's possible and powering the future. We believe innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We're dedicated to empowering people to be their true selves. Together, we're building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities. The AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) Computing Lab is dedicated to solving the complex system\-level challenges posed by the growing demands of future AI/ML workloads. Our team is committed to designing and developing scalable platforms that can effectively handle the computational and memory requirements of these workloads while minimizing energy consumption and maximizing performance. To achieve this goal, we collaborate closely with both hardware and software engineers to identify and address the unique challenges posed by AI/ML workloads and to explore new computing abstractions that can provide a better balance between the hardware and software components of our systems. Additionally, we continuously conduct research and development in emerging technologies and trends across memory, computing, interconnect, and AI/ML, ensuring that our platforms are always equipped to handle the most demanding workloads of the future. By working together as a dedicated and passionate team, we aim to revolutionize the way AI/ML applications are deployed and executed, ultimately contributing to the advancement of AGI in an affordable and sustainable manner. Join us in our passion to shape the future of computing! As AI models scale, memory — its capacity, bandwidth, cost, and placement — has become the central architectural constraint. The question is no longer whether to rethink memory system design, but how. A broad solution space exists: GPU\-side shared memory architectures, DRAM and Flash as capacity tiers, fabric\-attached pooling and disaggregation, and new interconnect approaches all represent credible paths. Each carries different tradeoff profiles across workloads, deployment contexts, and cost structures. This role exists to bring rigor to that question. You will build workload\-grounded models that evaluate the full solution space, quantify where each approach wins and why, and translate those findings into architecture decisions that directly shape product strategy and investment. You will work closely with architects across compute, networking, storage, and software, and present directly to senior technical leadership. This is a principal individual contributor role: you personally build the models, own the conclusions, and drive the decisions. **Location:** Daily onsite presence at our San Jose, CA office / U.S. headquarters in alignment with our Flexible Work policy. **What You'll Do** * **Technical Coordination:** Act as a key technical point of contact for the infrastructure team; provide guidance on implementation and help coordinate efforts to ensure projects are completed successfully. * **Drive Project Execution:** Take ownership of infrastructure initiatives from concept to completion. high availability. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboratio erience operating self\-managed, on\-premises Linux\-based engineering infrastructure and troubleshooting issues across compute, storage, networking, and software environments. * Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining CI/CD systems using platforms such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent. * Strong programming and automation skills in Python and shell scripting, with an emphasis on creating maintainable and tested software. * Proficiency with Git\-based development workflows, automated testing, build systems, and artifact repositories. * Experience with reproducible environments, container technologies, and infrastructure/configuration automation. * A track record of improving infrastructure reliability, build/test performance, or developer productivity through measurable improvements. * The ability to take initiative, prioritize competing requirements, and collaborate effectively across software, hardware, and IT organizations. * A collaborative mindset, a desire to mentor others, and a curiosity about emerging technologies. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY** **The Senior Data Engineer focus on implementing data driven analytics culture by standardizing BI technologies, development lifecycle \& processes across The Mentor Network. They will work directly with stakeholders and team members to define, design and deliver actionable insights while working with ETL developers and BI developers in an agile environment.** **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS** ***To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function listed below.**** **Design, develop, implement, and support highly complex BI applications of strategic or functional importance including: integration with data sources; highly automated data refresh processes; best\-in\-class data visualizations, dashboards, and reports that communicate critical insights to drive decision making** * **Rich experience in understanding the Data warehouses/Data marts** * **Execute roadmap of business focused BI initiatives with a clear understanding of all deliverables and associated deadlines** * **Expert in designing, developing Power BI Dashboards** * **Develop and maintain data management standards, and documentation of current data sources, raw data, data marts, transformations, and report specifications** * **Oversee data quality including validation, cleansing/scrubbing, ETL methods, etc.** * **Participate in data integration, business intelligence (BI) and enterprise information management programs by rationalizing data processing to support reuse.** * **Ensure best possible performance and quality in ETL packages, Stored Procedures and SQL.** * **Performs additional duties and activities as required.** **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES** **N/A** **Minimum Knowledge and Skills required by the Job** ***The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities required to perform the job.*** We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer with approximately 7 years of experience in designing, developing, and supporting modern cloud\-based data platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF), Snowflake, dbt, Apache Airflow, SQL, and Azure DevOps CI/CD. The Senior Data Engineer will be responsible for building scalable and reliable data ingestion and transformation pipelines, developing enterprise data models, implementing data engineering best practices, and supporting end\-to\-end data orchestration and deployment. Data Engineering \& ETL/ELT * Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines using Azure Data Factory. * Develop metadata\-driven and reusable ADF pipelines for API, database, file, and cloud\-based data sources. * Implement data ingestion into Snowflake Raw, Staging, Data Warehouse, and Information Mart layers. * Develop robust data transformation processes using SQL and dbt. * Implement incremental loading, CDC, error handling, restart ability, logging, and operational monitoring. * Optimize data pipelines for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost. Snowflake Development * Design and develop Snowflake databases, schemas, tables, views, stored procedures, and tasks. * Develop scalable data warehouse models following enterprise data architecture standards. * Implement Snowflake security including RBAC, roles, warehouses, masking policies, and secure data access. * Perform SQL tuning and Snowflake performance optimization. * Monitor Snowflake workloads and identify opportunities for compute and storage optimization. * Develop data models supporting analytics, reporting, and downstream applications. dbt Development * Develop and maintain dbt models, macros, tests, sources, snapshots, and documentation. * Implement modular and reusable transformation frameworks using dbt. * Establish data quality checks and testing using dbt. * Implement incremental models and dependency management. * Follow best practices for dbt project structure, naming conventions, documentation, and model governance. * Work with Data Architects and Analytics teams to implement dimensional and analytical data models. jobs.description: **About Hivemind Forge** Hivemind Forge delivers the essential tools engineers need to build, train, evaluate, certify, and deploy cutting\-edge autonomous AI pilots. by tangible operational leverage: hours saved, data latency reduction, and pipeline conversion impact. * Partner with key stakeholders to ensure adoption of automations through user training, tuning practical work experience. * 4\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or technical RevOps/GTM engineering, including hands\-on pipeline building. * Experience standing up or working with cloud data warehouses and implementing automated pipelines to ingest, clean, and model SaaS data into analytics\-ready tables. * Strong SQL proficiency and hands\-on programming skills (e.g., Python or TypeScript) with practical experience writing scripts and connecting to third\-party REST APIs. * Hands\-on experience developing or connecting AI ingestion models to business systems. * Hands\-on experience building production applications with LLMs, including API integrations, agentic workflows, prompt design, tool/function calling, retrieval, and output validation. * A pragmatic builder mindset with a bias toward shipping, rapid iteration, and business outcomes over theoretical perfection — knowing how to establish testing guardrails, sandbox harnesses, and access controls while moving fast. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into plain business terms for senior leaders. **Other controls, data\-masking routines, and audit logging for applications handling sensitive customer data in regulated sectors (such as education, healthcare, or government). * Experience operating as a jobs.title: Sr. Full-Stack Engineer - GenAI
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE: Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high\-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand. ABOUT THE ROLE: Skechers IT division is transforming our engineering practice by embracing high\-performing, cloud native APIs and applications using a modern technology stack that includes serverless, microservices, containers, Boomi iPaaS, QA, and zero\-touch delivery pipelines. Additionally, Skechers is enabling our business with AI through the development and adoption of private, proprietary AI technologies. The Senior Generative AI Engineer is a key role within the Software Engineering and Architecture organization and will be central to continually developing and improving our Generative AI platform and technologies within Skechers. The Sr. Full\-Stack Engineer \- GenAI will help spearhead the development of Skechers’ proprietary Generative AI tools. This role is at the forefront of enhancing our private GenAI platform and Large Language Models (LLM) and is pivotal in enabling future GenAI use cases within our platform. The Senior GenAI Engineer will collaborate and work with high\-velocity software engineering teams and coordinate across various departments to bring our GenAI capabilities to new heights. The candidate should be an experienced and motivated technologist who possesses a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. WHAT YOU'LL DO: * Help lead the design, development, and deployment of Skechers’ Generative AI tools, including privately instanced LLMs, our private GenAI platform, and GenAI use cases. * Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including security, UI/UX, data integration, architecture, and several business units to integrate and refine our AI solutions. * Develop and maintain scalable AI pipelines using AWS services such as Bedrock, AgentCore, Lambda, EC2, and S3\. * Utilize Amazon Web Services (AWS), Claude LLM, Stable Diffusion, keyword vector search, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), and GDPR\-compliant practices in daily tasks. * Make use of Python and FastAPI for backend services along side Node.JS for microservices * Develop in React.JS and React Native for frontend applications (web and mobile) * Develop and deploy chatbots, business\-focused use cases, and additional GenAI tools, ensuring robust, functional, scalable, secure, and user\-friendly solutions. * Stay up to date with the latest advancements in generative AI and apply them to solve business problems. * Implement leading practices in AI model training, testing, and validation. * Execute against the product backlog efficiently, ensuring quick resolution of issues and leading practices in development and deployment. * Assist with QA to ensure all user test cases are defined and tested. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: * Proficiency in AWS services, including but not limited to Bedrock, AgentCore, Lambda, EC2, and S3\. * Strong command of generative AI models, including but not limited to Claude LLM, Stable Diffusion, Amazon Nova * Strong command of keyword vector search, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), and GDPR\-compliant data handling. * Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with AI frameworks such as LangChain and the Strands SDK. * Comfort in using frontend JavaScript Frameworks for UI (i.e. React or React Native – other frameworks like Vue.JS are acceptable) * Experience with agile methodologies and tools, specifically JIRA by Confluence. * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate across multiple teams. * Proficient in using SQL and NoSQL databases such as MySQL and CloudantDB or MongoDB, Redis is a plus * Proficient in using software developing tool including Git, Jenkins and Postman * Strong interpersonal and communication skills and able to mentor junior engineers * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, an independent worker with high degree of self\-motivation * Experience with Docker and container orchestration systems such as AWS ECS/EKS/Fargate is desired (but not a hard requirement) * Exposure to writing Terraform and setting up GitHub Actions * Prompt engineering expertise highly desired REQUIREMENTS: * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or equivalent or proven years of experience. * 8\+ years of experience in software development, including some experience with generative models. * 3\+ years of experience with backend server language Python. * 5\+ years of experience in developing REST APIs with JSON, HTTP protocol, Postman and/or curl * 5\+ years of experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and at least one JavaScript Frontend Framework (e.g. React or Vue). Familiarity with websockets required The pay range for this position is $160,000 \- $180,000/yr USD **About Skechers** Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e\-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Skechers is committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and respectful work environment. Skechers provides equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment without regard race, color, religion, gender, gender identification and expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic established by local, state or federal law. **Reasonable Accommodation** Applicants for employment who require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job should request appropriate accommodation by emailing benefits@skechers.com. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each job responsibility satisfactorily. The skills, abilities and physical demands described are representative of those duties that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities, who are otherwise qualified for the job position, to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Skiffra** ================= Skiffra is building the intelligence layer for operational decision\-making in physical industries. We're developing AI\-native orchestration systems that turn complex, high\-stakes operations into intelligent, adaptive workflows. We're starting with mining and natural resources, where decisions move people, equipment and capital, and where the consequences of getting them wrong are real. Our ambition extends well beyond mining. We're building a platform designed to change how physical industries make decisions. As a Founding AI Engineer, you will be the architect of our core intelligence. This is a role for a high\-leverage builder who can move fluidly between prompt engineering, backend systems, and model optimization. You will design the "brain" of Skiffra, moving agentic workflows from whiteboards to production\-grade systems that handle real enterprise data at scale. This is a founding\-level role for builders who value shipping over dogma and real\-world impact over demos. This is a full\-time role in our Los Angeles office. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Architect \& Build Agentic Systems: Design, prototype, and harden production\-grade orchestration frameworks that leverage LLMs, persistent memory, and tool\-integration to navigate complex, non\-linear enterprise tasks * Build the Data Flywheel: Implement sophisticated RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines, ensuring high\-fidelity context retrieval from fragmented data sources * Evaluate \& Iterate: Build internal benchmarking and evaluation suites to measure and improve model reliability, grounding, and latency * Strategic Modeling: Architect high\-performance intelligence stacks by making pragmatic trade\-offs between Frontier Reasoning Models for long\-horizon agentic planning, Fine\-tuned Open\-Weight Models for data sovereignty and low\-latency inference, and Deterministic Heuristics for reliable, cost\-efficient guardrails * Cross\-Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering to turn ambiguity into working software **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Systems Engineering: 7\+ years of experience and a deep background in building production software. You understand that "AI" is only as good as the infrastructure surrounding it * Modern AI Fluency: Deep practical experience with the transformer\-based stack: embeddings, vector databases, tool\-calling, and context window management * Production LLM Experience: 2\+ years shipping LLM\-based products to real users in production * Python Power\-User: You are comfortable building entire systems, not just experimenting in notebooks * Reliability Mindset: You have strong instincts for failure modes (hallucinations, API timeouts, "infinite loops" in agents) and how to build guardrails against them * Security Mindset: You treat access to enterprise data as part of the design, not an afterthought * Clear communicator with founder\-level ownership mindset **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience in building complex, multi\-step workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex or PydanticAI * Hands\-on experience with Fine\-tuning and PEFT (LoRA/QLoRA) to adapt open\-weight models for domain\-specific tasks * Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop workflows and enterprise identity (SSO, role\-based access) * A background in Enterprise Operations (Industrial, Logistics, Fintech, or CRM workflows). * Strong opinions on where AI creates value and where it's just expensive noise ### **How We Work** We value speed, clarity, and technical rigor. We favor simple systems over clever ones, prototypes over over\-planning, and ownership over handoffs. You’ll work directly with founders and ship things that matter quickly. ### **Location \& Work Model** This is a hybrid role requiring regular in\-person collaboration at the designated office location, as specified in the job posting (Los Angeles, San Francisco, Montreal, or Brisbane). We are not a fully remote company. ### **Work Authorization** Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where this role is based. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. ### **Benefits \& Eligibility** This position is eligible for Skiffra’s standard benefits, including health insurance and retirement plans, and may also qualify for participation in the Company’s bonus and incentive programs. ### **Equal Opportunity** Skiffra is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Compensation Range: $220K \- $250K

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Smart Commercial Construction (SCC) and Jarrod Smart Construction (JSC) are building an AI capability that starts with their own information and repeatable work. The business decides what to automate and what success looks like. This role turns those requirements into working technology. You will connect our systems and data, build and maintain AI agents and the MCP connections they depend on, and make sure the result is secure and usable. You will work for both companies, so you need to be comfortable serving two teams with different platforms and a shared Microsoft 365 environment. What you will do * Meet with each team to understand the process, the information it needs, and who reviews the output, then translate that into technical requirements and a build plan. * Build and maintain AI agents and automations for repeatable work such as proposals and estimates, selections tracking, schedule and daily\-log summaries, change orders, and billing and closeout. * Design, build, and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and connectors that let agents securely read from and, where approved, write to our systems: Microsoft 365, Ressio, JobTread, and Adaptive. * Integrate systems and data using APIs, exports, and workflow tools where MCP is not available, so agents work from accurate, current information. * Configure and administer Microsoft 365 Copilot, including permissions, data access, and separation between the two companies inside the shared tenant. * Organize and document our domain of knowledge: where key information lives, how clean it is, and how an agent can reach it safely. * Implement the governance the business sets: approved tools, access and privacy controls, human\-review steps in each workflow, usage and cost visibility, and a clear way to shut a workflow off. * Train staff on the tools you deliver, and keep documentation, prompts, and how\-to guides current. * Evaluate new AI tools and MCP\-enabled integrations and recommend what to adopt, wait on, or skip. Required qualifications * 2 to 3 years of experience building automations, integrations, or AI\-enabled workflows in a business setting. * Hands\-on experience building or using MCP servers or comparable tool\-calling and agent integrations, and a solid understanding of how agents connect to business systems. * Experience with Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Power Automate) and with Copilot or a comparable AI assistant. * Comfort with APIs, webhooks, and data connectors, and scripting skill in Python or JavaScript (or Power Platform). * Practical experience with large language models: prompting, building agents, and knowing their failure modes, such as made\-up answers and data leakage. * Sound judgment on security, privacy, and permissions when systems and people overlap, especially two companies in one tenant. * Clear communicator who can gather requirements from non\-technical people and explain technical work in plain language. Preferred * Experience in construction, design\-build, or another project\-based business. * Familiarity with construction or accounting platforms (JobTread, Ressio, Adaptive or similar). * Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, or similar low\-code and cloud tooling. * Background in analytics, data cleanup, or business systems administration. Our systems Microsoft 365 and Copilot (shared by both companies), JobTread (SCC), Ressio (JSC), and Adaptive for accounts payable (both). You will do well here if you * Start small, ship, then watch how it performs and grow it, rather than chase the biggest project. * Keep humans at the helm and treat AI like a smart intern: give it context, review everything, and have a person sign off. * Enjoy learning how the business actually runs and building what the teams need. What we offer We offer a good work environment with room to grow, competitive pay, paid holidays, paid time off, and a 401k with company match! In addition, we offer Health Insurance, Dental, Vision, Life/Accidental Death and Dismemberment, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Accident, and Critical Illness. \#hc274018

jobs.title: Firmware Validation Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Join a multibillion\-dollar global company that brings together amazing technology, people, and operational scale to become a powerhouse in the memory industry. Headquartered in Rancho Cordova, California, Solidigm combines elements of an established, successful technology company with the spirit, agility, and entrepreneurial mindset of a start\-up. In addition to the U.S. headquarters and other facilities in the U.S., the company has international presence in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Solidigm will continue to lead the world in innovating new Memory technologies with aspirations to be the \#1 NAND memory company in the world. At Solidigm, we view problems as opportunities to define innovative solutions that hold the power to change the world and unleash the potential technological needs that the future holds. At Solidigm, we are One Team that fosters a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture that embraces individual uniqueness and empowers us to bring our best selves to deliver excellence in support of Solidigm's vision and mission to be the go\-to partner for optimized data storage solutions. You can be part of the takeoff of an innovative business that develops cutting\-edge products, delivers strong business value for customers, provides an engaging workplace for its employees, and serves a greater impact on the world. This is a golden opportunity for the right applicant to join us and help design, build, and lead Solidigm. We want a diverse team of dedicated professionals who will not just be Solidigm team members but contribute to how we shape the future of the organization. We are seeking applicants who will grow and thrive in our culture; be customer inspired, trusting, innovative, team\-oriented, inclusive, results driven, collaborative, passionate, and flexible. **Job Description** In this position you will join the Firmware Integration \& Test (FIT) team validating firmware for Solidigm® Solid State Drives (SSD). You will contribute to firmware validation by understanding the firmware architecture and feature sets, developing test plans, tests implementation, tests execution, failure analysis, and results reporting for all products in an automated test environment. The Test Development team is the heartbeat of our test team and is responsible for ensuring that the firmware stack and hardware is fully validated to specifications and sets the firmware quality for our downstream validation partners and customers. **As a Firmware Validation Engineer your regular responsibilities include but are not limited to:** * **Develop, review, document, and maintain product test code in Python.** * **Analyze product requirements and develop feature test plans based on internal specifications and external customer requirements.** * **Perform feature\-level and system\-level testing, including failure analysis and debugging of product issues throughout the development and validation phases.** * **Develop and maintain test libraries, APIs, and test infrastructure in collaboration with the tools team.** * **Collaborate across multiple firmware disciplines to build expertise and contribute to validation across the entire SSD architecture.** * **Partner with project stakeholders to translate product requirements into actionable development and validation plans.** * **Actively participate in and promote an Agile/Kanban development culture that emphasizes product quality, team accountability, and continuous improvement.** * **Coordinate priorities and activities with cross\-functional engineering stakeholders to achieve committed milestones and deliverables.** **A successful candidate will demonstrate:** * **Relevant experience working in firmware (FW) and validation, and/or feature development across different stages of the product lifecycle.** * **Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, including analyzing FW failures, test logs, and error reports; triaging issues to identify root causes, assessing impact, and coordinating resolution with the appropriate teams.** * **Strong cross\-functional collaboration and coordination skills to support co\-development efforts, debug issues, align on implementation plans, and drive feature delivery to completion.** * **A proven track record of initiative and effective multitasking, with strong leadership, communication, and influencing skills.** * **A positive, can\-do mindset, with the ability to listen, understand partner concerns, respond professionally to questions and issues, and build trust through effective collaboration.** * **Excellent written communication and presentation skills.** **Qualifications** ***Qualifications*** **The candidate must have a bachelor’s degree or a master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Computer Science or a related field** **5\+ years of experience in the following areas:** * **Hands\-on experience in flash translation layer including address translation, garbage collection, wear leveling, bad block management, write amplification, read disturb, and error correction and caching** * **Hands\-on experience in flash interface layer including die/channel management plus latency optimization techniques like program suspend resume and so on** * **Hands\-on experience with power loss protection and diagnostic features like LED and telemetry** * **Hands\-on experience with power and thermal protection including power states, ASPM, and throttling** * **In\-depth understanding of NAND geometry and SLC, TLC, and QLC technologies.** * **Experience developing, reviewing, and implementing test plans and test cases.** * **Experience working with embedded firmware, including debugging and failure analysis.** * **Knowledge of software validation methodologies, test coverage analysis, and related tools.** * **5–8 years of relevant industry experience in firmware development, software validation, or SSD engineering.** * **Knowledge of C/C\+\+, Python, and AI technologies, with the ability to apply them to test development, automation, and validation efficiency.** ***Preferred Requirements:*** **10\+ years of experience in the following areas:** * **Storage industry experience with firmware development/validation (SSDs, HDDs)** * **Validation techniques utilizing hardware and firmware tools in an automated test environment** * **Structured software development and practices, analytical problem solving, innovation and a mindset of continuous improvement** * **Experience with storage interface protocols (e.g., SATA, SAS, PCIe, and NVMe)** * **Experience performing root cause analysis on PCIe, NVMe, firmware, and platform\-related failures** * **Familiarity with qualification methodologies, reliability testing, and failure mode analysis.** * **Knowledge of AI\-assisted debugging, Machine Learning applications, and advanced analytics techniques** **Additional Information** This position is also eligible to participate in Solidigm's restricted stock unit (RSU), restricted cash unit (RCU), and cash bonus programs. In addition, Solidigm offers a benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, supplemental life and AD\&D insurance; short\- and long\-term disability; healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts, and a company match on eligible 401(k) plan contributions. *Powered by SmartRecruiters \-* *Candidate Privacy Policy*

jobs.title: Data Engineer II, JVM
jobs.description: **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. You are self\-motivated and thrive in a distributed team environment \- comfortable taking initiative, handling your own work, and collaborating effectively across time zones and communication computer science or software engineering. #### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and one or more front\-end frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js). * Strong experience with back\-end frameworks. * Expertise in designing and working with RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL. * Hands\-on experience with SQL databases. * Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, jobs.title: IT Support Engineer Level 1 Healthcare
jobs.description: Starling Oncology (NASDAQ: STLN) is advancing oncology by delivering highly specialized, value\-based cancer care in the community setting. Formerly known as The Oncology Institute, Starling Oncology offers cutting\-edge, evidence\-based cancer care to a population of approximately 2\.1 million patients, including clinical trials, transfusions, and other care delivery models traditionally associated with the most advanced care delivery organizations. With more than 400 employed and network clinicians and over 100 clinics and network locations of care across five states and growing, Starling Oncology is changing oncology for the better. For more information, visit www.starlingoncology.com. Join an oncology practice where your technical expertise directly supports compassionate, life\-changing patient care. As an IT Coordinator, you will play a vital role in keeping critical systems secure, reliable, and efficient so clinicians and staff can focus on delivering exceptional cancer care. In return, we offer meaningful work with real impact, close collaboration with healthcare professionals, opportunities to grow your skills in a highly specialized environment, and the chance to help advance innovation in a mission\-driven organization. **JOB PURPOSE AND SUMMARY:** ---------------------------- The IT Support Engineer I provides secure, reliable support for endpoints, identity, connectivity, Microsoft 365, and business and clinical applications. The role resolves incidents, protects PHI, documents work, and supports service improvement, automation, cloud operations, and security within approved controls. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** ------------------------------------------ * Provide Level 1 and developing Level 2 technical and customer support through approved ticketing, phone, chat, remote, and onsite channels. * Research, diagnose, resolve, document, and escalate hardware, software, account, application, and connectivity issues. * Set up, secure, maintain, and retire Windows workstations, mobile devices, printers, peripherals, and conferencing equipment. * Support Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, groups, licensing, and authorized account lifecycle tasks. * Provide first\-line support for assigned business and clinical applications while following privacy, downtime, and patient\-safety procedures. * Document and track incidents, requests, assets, troubleshooting history, customer communication, and resolution details. * Create and maintain knowledge articles, user guides, SOPs, and runbooks. * Perform approved entry\-level Azure, monitoring, backup, security, remediation, reporting, scripting, automation, and data\-quality tasks. * Protect PHI, PII, credentials, and confidential information; recognize and escalate security or privacy events. * Assist with projects, implementations, migrations, clinic openings, go\-lives, planned maintenance, vendor coordination, disaster recovery, and business continuity activities. * Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve service, controls, standardization, and automation. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** ------------------------------------- * Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoints, identity, Microsoft 365, connectivity, applications, and user workflows. * Working knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune concepts, MFA, role\-based access, networking, and secure remote support. * Ability to use logs and diagnostic tools, document findings, and distinguish symptoms from probable root causes. * Foundational knowledge of Azure, cloud operations, monitoring, backup, scripting, automation, APIs, JSON, and cybersecurity principles. * Understanding of HIPAA\-aligned PHI handling, least privilege, secure sharing, auditability, and healthcare downtime procedures. * Clear communication, sound prioritization, accountability, teamwork, and willingness to learn. **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND/OR TRAINING:** --------------------------------------------------- * High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree in IT, cybersecurity, cloud computing, health informatics, or a related field preferred. * Two or more years of IT service desk, desktop support, or technical support experience; relevant internships, military experience, labs, or applied projects may be considered. * Experience with ticketing systems, Windows, Microsoft 365, user accounts, endpoints, peripherals, connectivity, and defined escalation and change procedures. * Ability to support scheduled onsite, implementation, maintenance, go\-live, or after\-hours activities as needed. Relevant certifications or applied experience in service management, Microsoft 365, networking, endpoint management, identity, cloud, security, automation, or healthcare IT are preferred. **PHYSICAL WORKING REQUIREMENTS:** ---------------------------------- The position involves prolonged periods of sitting at a desk, extensive computer use, and phone or virtual interaction. The role may require travel between supported locations and occasional lifting, moving, or installation of office technology equipment weighing up to 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the position.

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Starr, a global leader in commercial insurance with over a century of expertise. We empower our employees to innovate, make impactful decisions, and build lasting client relationships worldwide. At Starr, you'll work in an entrepreneurial culture alongside accessible leaders, leveraging our financial strength and vast industry experience to deliver solutions for our clients, no matter how complex. Grow your career with a rapidly growing company that invests in its people and their ability to drive real progress.** Join the Starr Enterprise Data and Artificial Intelligence Organization and start reimagining the future of insurance. The Data and AI team at Starr builds first\-of\-a\-kind capabilities that advance the insurance practice and scale across the entire enterprise. The team’s ultimate mission is to develop cutting\-edge data and AI capabilities that drive profit growth for Starr. The Senior AI/ML engineer is an important, integral part of the Data \& AI team. This position is responsible for uncovering meaningful data patterns and transforming them into actionable insights by leveraging predictive modeling, data mining, machine learning algorithms, and foundational models. This individual will be responsible for developing scalable solutions to provide data\-driven and optimization insights. He/she should have vast experience in machine learning/AI algorithms and demonstrated ability to innovate and customize when necessary. We are looking for somebody who will be passionate about learning and deploying leading technologies in the AI space specific to the business needs to drive results and identify opportunities. As a Senior AI/ML Engineer this person will drive business impact by solving unique problems through analytics and machine learning, continuous improvement in methodologies, and change management in a fast\-paced environment. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML solutions with best practices in statistics, machine learning, deep learning, and foundational models to improve the profitability for Starr. Example includes classification models, forecasting, propensity and uplift modeling, foundational model fine\-tuning, evaluation, and implementation, etc. * Identify growth opportunities in underwriting, claims processing, risk assessment, and/or customer service through AI/ML augmentation. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with business, IT, and Transformation to drive scalability and impact of the AI/ML solutions. * Communicate complex AI/ML concepts and findings to business leaders in a clear and concise manner. * Conduct research and stay up\-to\-date with the latest advancements in AI/ML to continuously improve our AI capabilities. **Required Professional** **and Technical Expertise:** * Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operational Research, or related disciplines. * 5\+ years' experience with data science/machine learning techniques (e.g., logistic regression, hierarchical regression, decision tree, random forest, neural networks, etc.) and 2\+ years of experience working with LLM. * Expertise in Python, SQL and with data science and data analytics packages working on structured and unstructured data. * Experience with developing and industrializing scalable AI solutions from ideation to delivery. * Expertise working in Azure, AWS or other cloud service using big data solutions. * Proven ability to understand, cleanse, and integrate massive disparate data sets and demonstrated familiarity with data modeling workflow. * Recognized for analytical rigor and ability to identify actionable insights from ambiguous and sometimes limited information. * Strong communication, ability to effectively connect/translate complex analytics findings to business insights and recommendations. **Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:** * Ph.D. in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operational Research, or related disciplines. * Natural language processing and natural language understanding expertise. * Ability to gain consensus, to lead change and transformation. * Passionate about data science and self\-motivated to stay abreast of advances in data science techniques. * Desire to work in a team based dynamic and fast\-paced business culture. * Experience leading projects for one or more business units. * Experience in the insurance industry, particularly in underwriting, claims processing, or risk management. * Knowledge of actuarial science and insurance\-specific data sets. For individuals assigned and/or hired to work in New York, Starr Insurance Companies is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets: experience and training: licensure and certifications: and other business and organizational needs. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $180,000\-$200,000\. \#LI\-EP1 Starr is an equal opportunity employer, which means we'll consider all suitably qualified applicants regardless of gender identity or expression, ethnic origin, nationality, religion or beliefs, age, sexual orientation, disability status or any other protected characteristic. We recruit and develop our people based on merit and we're committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We offer first class training and development opportunities to all employees. Our aim is to grow our own talent and bring out the best in people.
