jobs.title: AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: **Sophisticated Work. In a Great City. Making a Difference.** The State of Wisconsin Investment Board (SWIB) manages more than $178 billion in assets, including those of the fully\-funded Wisconsin Retirement System (WRS). SWIB operates at a level more often seen in top\-tier global asset managers than in typical public pension funds. SWIB is a home for top talent. Approximately 61 percent of SWIB’s investment professionals are Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) charterholders. The City of Madison, the state capitol and home of Wisconsin’s flagship university, makes regular appearances on lists of best places to live, eat, and play. SWIB offers a modern workspace, hybrid work options, and competitive compensation and benefits. Serving over 703,000 WRS beneficiaries, SWIB is driven by a clear mission: securing the financial future of those who serve Wisconsin. When you work at SWIB, you know your work matters. **Job Description:** **Position Overview:** We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled AI Enablement Engineer to join our team. The engineer will play a key role in advancing SWIB’s adoption of artificial intelligence by partnering with investment and operational teams to identify, develop, and deploy innovative AI solutions that improve business processes, increase efficiency, and enhance decision\-making. The engineer will report to the Data Services and Engineering Director and work directly with teams throughout the organization to translate complex business needs into prototypes, AI\-powered workflows, and production\-ready solutions. This role requires strong software engineering and data integration capabilities, hands\-on experience with generative AI technologies, and the ability to balance innovation with enterprise security, architecture, and governance standards. **Essential activities:** * Partner directly with front\-office and operations teams to identify AI opportunities, understand business processes, gather requirements, and deliver solutions aligned with investment and operational priorities. * Design, prototype, develop, and deploy AI\-powered applications, assistants, and agentic workflows using platforms such as OpenAI Agent Workspace, Claude Cowork, and other emerging enterprise AI technologies. * Design, develop, and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) solutions that securely connect AI capabilities with enterprise data, applications, APIs, and business processes. * Develop reusable AI engineering patterns, frameworks, and integrations that accelerate solution delivery, promote consistency, and enable adoption across the organization. * Leverage programming languages such as Python and SQL to build AI applications, automate workflows, integrate enterprise data, and extend the capabilities of AI platforms. * Develop and implement AI evaluation, testing, observability, and monitoring capabilities to ensure solution accuracy, reliability, performance, and ongoing effectiveness. * Establish appropriate security controls, access management, human oversight, and risk mitigation practices for AI\-enabled solutions in alignment with enterprise architecture and governance standards. * Evaluate emerging AI platforms, models, tools, and capabilities. Conduct proofs of concept, assess technical feasibility, and recommend solutions based on business value, scalability, security, and maintainability. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical challenges involving AI applications, model behavior, data integration, API connectivity, and workflow execution. * Promote responsible AI adoption by providing technical guidance, training, demonstrations, and knowledge transfer to business and technology teams. * Maintain comprehensive documentation of AI solutions, technical designs, integrations, evaluation results, operational procedures, and supporting architecture. * Support automated testing, version control, deployment, and Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices to improve the reliability and maintainability of AI solutions. Collaborate with technology, architecture, information security, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions comply with organizational standards and approved implementation practices. * **The ideal candidate:** * Demonstrates a proactive, innovative, and business\-focused approach to identifying opportunities where AI can deliver measurable value. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for technical and non\-technical audiences. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. * 6\+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, application development, or related technical disciplines. * Hands\-on experience developing solutions using generative AI, large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and AI\-enabled workflow automation. * Experience with enterprise AI platforms and tools such as OpenAI Agent Workspace, Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Enterprise, or comparable technologies. * Experience developing and integrating solutions using Model Context Protocol (MCP), APIs, and enterprise data services. * Strong programming experience with Python, SQL, and API\-based application development. Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript is a plus. * Experience designing and implementing AI solutions using techniques such as retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, prompt engineering, and agent orchestration. * Experience implementing AI evaluation frameworks, automated testing, observability, and monitoring to assess model outputs, solution quality, and operational reliability. * Strong understanding of AI security, data privacy, access controls, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and responsible AI development practices. * Experience integrating applications with enterprise data platforms, databases, and cloud\-based services. * Experience developing, deploying, and supporting production applications using cloud providers such as Azure. * Experience with software development lifecycle principles, version control, CI/CD, and production support practices. * Ability to independently evaluate emerging technologies, rapidly develop prototypes, and transition successful solutions into maintainable production capabilities. * Ability to work directly with business stakeholders, understand complex workflows, and identify practical opportunities for AI\-driven improvements. * General knowledge of and interest in the investment industry. * Direct experience in financial services, investment management, or asset management is a plus. Experience with Snowflake, Azure AI services, and enterprise AI governance frameworks is a plus. * SWIB Offers: * Competitive total cash compensation, based on AON (formerly McLagan) industry benchmarks * Comprehensive benefits package * Educational and training opportunities * Tuition reimbursement * Challenging work in a professional environment Hybrid work environment * The position requires U.S. work authorization. Pursuant to our Hybrid Remote Work Policy, all staff have the flexibility to work remotely but are required to have a weekly presence in our offices, the frequency of which is dependent on their distance from office or the job position. Staff are not required to reside locally; however, we offer relocation reimbursement to the Dane County area per our policy. All SWIB employees are subject to SWIB’s Ethics Policy and Personal Trade Approvals Policy. These policies include restrictions on outside business activities and employment and have limits on personal trading. You may request copies of these policies from SWIB’s talent acquisition team and any questions can be answered by SWIB’s compliance team.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **Subsidiary** -------------- New Millennium **Overview** ------------ **Sales Engineer**\| Salem, Virginia At New Millennium, a Steel Dynamics company, you'll be part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement while helping you grow your career, make a lasting impact, and gain experience toward P.E. licensure. jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Job ID: 2022966 Career Area: Engineering Position Type: Salaried Location: Headquarters \& Technology Center – Auburn Hills 48326, US Date Posted: November 16, 2026 Brand: FCA Group **Role Summary:** ----------------- You are the delivery anchor for this team: you own the team’s commitments and their production health, take the hardest solutions yourself, set the technical bar, and raise the craft of the engineers around you. jobs.title: Software Engineer (Front End)
jobs.description: **Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.** **Why you'll love this role** Our Technology Team is on a mission to build the next\-generation e\-commerce platform for the next generation of customers. We create world\-class, innovative experiences and products that give our users access to the world's most\-coveted products and unlock economic opportunities by turning reselling into a business for anyone. Our team uses cutting\-edge technologies that handle massive scales globally. Supply Chain Engineering builds the systems that get products from sellers to buyers: tracking, logistics, and the verification workflows that make sure every item meets StockX standards. We're looking for a frontend engineer to build the interfaces that power these experiences, from delivery tracking to the tools our operations and verification teams use every day. You'll be primarily focused on the frontend (React, TypeScript, Next.js), but our team owns its services end to end. You'll also have the chance to debug, troubleshoot, and contribute to our Node.js/TypeScript backend services when the work calls for it. We think this makes our frontend engineers better, and we'll support you in getting up to speed. In this role, you'll make our supply chain experiences a delight for our users across the world and help make our supply chain more efficient. You'll have room to take on more ownership as experience grows. Our technical stack comprises various systems and services built on AWS. On the frontend, we use TypeScript, React, and Next.js. On the backend, we use Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, GraphQL, CircleCI, Harness, Kubernetes, Kafka, DynamoDB, and Aurora DB (Postgres). **What you'll do** * Build and ship complex, data\-heavy user interfaces in React, TypeScript, and Next.js for customers and internal operations teams. * Partner with product, design, program managers, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, recommend technical approaches, and push back on scope when it's the right call. * Break down features into well\-scoped components and contribute to design discussions, with growing ownership of the design as you build experience. * Write and maintain automated tests, and help improve our CI/CD pipelines and release practices. * Integrate with REST and GraphQL services, and when issues cross the frontend/backend boundary, dig in: trace them, debug them, and contribute fixes to our Node.js services. * Help keep what we ship healthy in production: willingness to take part in our regular on\-call rotation, monitor production health (we use Datadog), and respond to production issues with urgency. * Contribute to team standards, share what you learn, and keep stakeholders informed when issues arise. **About you** * 3\-5 years of professional software engineering experience, with most of it on the frontend. * Strong experience with React and TypeScript, including state management (such as Zustand or Redux) and building complex UIs. * Solid grounding in web fundamentals: performance, accessibility, security, and internationalization. * Experience integrating with REST and/or GraphQL APIs. * Hands\-on experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. We use GitHub, Kubernetes, Harness, and LaunchDarkly. * Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain tradeoffs and challenge scope constructively. * Comfort reading and debugging backend code (JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js, or a similar language like Java, C\#, or PHP) and a willingness to contribute to it. * Experience with AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) in your development workflows. **Nice to have** * Experience with using Datadog (APM, RUM, metrics) or similar observability tools. * Experience with AWS or another cloud provider and with data storage, particularly Postgres, Redis, and DynamoDB. * Experience in Supply Chain domains (warehouse or transportation management systems, carrier integrations, brand protection). *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.* *Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $120,000 to $130,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary.* **About StockX** StockX is proud to be a Detroit\-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high\-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real\-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off\-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry\-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com. *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. However, this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position. StockX reserves the right to amend this job description at any time.* *StockX may utilize AI to rank job applicant submissions against the position requirements to assist in determining candidate alignment.*

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer

healthcare datasets * Develop datasets supporting future machine learning and AI use cases, including feature development, historical analysis, training and evaluation datasets, and model outputs * governance, and HIPAA compliance * Establish analytics engineering standards and modeling conventions that can scale with the organization **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * 3\+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, healthcare informatics, analytics, or a related technical role * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Clinical Informatics, Data deployment * Strong understanding of analytical data modeling, including model grain, joins, fact and dimension concepts, and aggregation behavior * Working proficiency in Python for data analysis, validation, and automation * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure * Experience with modern data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift * Experience defining jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **How You'll Make An Impact** At Strive Health, patients come first. We're on a mission to transform chronic conditions by identifying risk earlier, coordinating thoughtful care, and supporting people through every stage of their health journey. Our work reduces emergency visits, improves outcomes, and helps patients live fuller lives. Strive's platform, grounded in our business objectives and long\-term product vision. * Design and deliver end\-to\-end solutions for complex, cross\-team initiatives, from problem framing and architecture through implementation, rollout, and production operation. * Stay hands\-on in the code, writing high\-quality, well\-tested, observable software, especially where complexity, risk, or ambiguity calls for senior engineering leadership. * Make pragmatic architectural tradeoffs that balance scalability, reliability, security, compliance, delivery speed, cost, and long\-term maintainability, while keeping the platform simple for other engineers to build on. * Design and evolve the APIs, services, data models, integrations, and distributed systems that support Strive's measures of success. * Identify systemic technical risks, architectural limitations, performance bottlenecks, and technical debt, and lead the work to address them. * Establish reusable architectural patterns, reference implementations, and engineering standards that help teams build consistently and effectively. * Drive platform\-wide improvements in developer experience, reliability, observability, security posture, and performance that measurably improve how engineering delivers value. * Provide technical leadership across teams by facilitating design and architecture reviews, guiding major engineering decisions, and unblocking teams through hands\-on help. * Participate in production support and incident response, helping teams find root causes and turn operational lessons into better architecture, tooling, and practices. * Collaborate with Security and Compliance to ensure systems protect sensitive healthcare information and meet regulatory and organizational requirements. * Mentor and coach engineers and tech leads through design discussions, code reviews, pairing, and day\-to\-day work, helping them strengthen their technical judgment and grow as owners of their domains. * Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted engineering tools, and identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering effectiveness. * Co xperience building them into application and system design. * Strong experience designing and scaling distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, and data pipelines on AWS or a similar cloud platform. * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, clinical data, electronic health records, or standards such as FHIR and HL7\. * Experience with relational and non\-relational data stores and systems processing significant volumes of operational or clinical data. * Experience influencing engineering strategy beyond a single team, such as setting technical direction or establishing architecture, testing, observability, and operational standards across teams. * Experience leading modernization efforts involving legacy systems, architecture evolution, or significant technical debt. * Experience with AI\-assisted software development tools, and with evaluating new technologies through prototypes, reference implementations, and incremental adoption. * Exposure to kidney care, value\-based care, or other complex clinical workflows. **About You** * You are a builder who enjoys designing systems, writing code, solving hard problems, and seeing your work run successfully in production. * You are energized by ambiguous, high\-impact problems and can turn loosely defined challenges into clear technical approaches, even where process and systems don't yet exist. * You pair broad knowledge of software engineering with deep expertise in one or more areas, and you use that breadth to weigh the organizational impact of technical choices. * You have strong technical judgment and know that the best solution isn't always the most complex one, or when a long\-term platform investment is worth it versus a simpler approach. * You balance short\-term needs with long\-term architectural investments and keep a clear view of tradeoffs and sequencing over time. * You are an excellent systems thinker and communicator who explains decisions and the reasoning behind them, and proactively shares risks, tradeoffs, and progress. * You raise engineering standards through influence, collaboration, and example rather than authority, and you enjoy helping others grow their skills and autonomy. * You challenge assumptions constructively while staying open to different perspectives and new information. * You take ownership of outcomes, including the reliability and maintainability of software long after it ships. * You approach privacy, security, and risk thoughtfully because the systems you build support patients and clinicians, and you handle sensitive information with integrity and discretion. * You are collaborative, low\-ego, and motivated by the success of the broader team rather than ownership boundaries. * You are outcome\-driven and curious, using data, experimentation, and feedback loops, as well as thoughtful adoption of AI and other new capabilities, to keep improving the platform and how engineering works. **Annual Salary Range: $130,000 \- $163,000\. jobs.title: Application Engineer III
jobs.description: SUMMARY Application Engineer III – Oracle EBS Platform is an advanced professional role responsible for delivering reliable, secure, and maintainable software solutions for Subaru of America’s Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) supply chain environment. The position contributes across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, implementation, documentation, and production support. It combines business analysis, application development, quality testing, and operational support, focusing on Oracle EBS supply chain modules and continuous business process improvement. WORK ENVIRONMENT \& SCHEDULE * Office Location: Camden, NJ apart of the Greater Philadelphia Area (Philly) * Hybrid Role: Remote work 2 days per week (after 90 days) \[Wednesdays \& Fridays] * Required Travel: 10% Domestic * Hours: 37\.5 hour work week MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES * Application Software Development: Analyze business needs and existing applications to identify opportunities for modification, refactoring, and improvement; design, develop, and implement new application functionality and software components for projects and enhancements. * Application Software Maintenance: Monitor, diagnose, and correct complex software defects; provide day\-to\-day Oracle EBS supply chain production support and off\-hours support when required; prioritize and resolve issues to maintain reliable, fully functioning applications. * Application Software Roadmap: Define and maintain an application development roadmap; assess options, dependencies, and business value to prioritize development and enhancement work against business requirements. * SDLC Documentation: Create and maintain complex, high\-quality documentation for each SDLC phase, including business requirements, functional specifications, technical specifications, test plans, test results, implementation materials, and user or support documentation and backs up files to ensure instant recovery if problems occur. * Testing and Performance: Design, execute, and report on system and service tests to confirm applications meet requirements; coordinate QA activities, investigate performance issues, and ensure implementations meet quality standards. * Technology Horizon Scanning: Evaluate external technology developments, tools, or emerging issues and assess their potential value or impact on the organization. REQUIRED SKILLS \& ABILITIES * Experience in a software development position covering requirements definition, technical design, coding, testing, and implementation. * Specific platform experience should include Oracle EBS 12\.1 or 12\.2 in a supply chain environment, with experience in Order Management, Inventory, Purchasing, Advanced Pricing, and Shipping modules * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, verbal communication, and written communication skills. * Ability to work independently on most non\-standard situations, manage multiple assignments, and remain accountable for milestones and delivery of a quality product. * Motivation to continue learning new technologies and expanding knowledge of existing skills * Oracle Database: Strong background in Oracle database technology, including SQL and PL/SQL. * Oracle E\-Business Suite: Strong background with Oracle EBS, particularly Order Management, Inventory, Purchasing, Advanced Pricing, Bill of Materials, and Shipping modules. * Supply Chain Applications: Knowledge of supply chain tools, solutions, and methodologies; jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** Symbotic is seeking a hands\-on Field Engineer to serve as the technical lead for installation quality and problem\-solving across Symbotic sites in an assigned region. Reporting to the Regional Field Engineering Manager, you will remove installation blockers, drive engineering issues to resolution, and lead the quality buy\-off that confirms contractor work meets Symbotic standards before hand\-off. This is both a problem\-solving role and an improvement role. Rather than inspecting work against checklists, you will build quality into drawings and contractor scopes of work, verify it in the field, and turn what you learn on site into the standards that help Symbotic deliver every system faster, at higher quality, and with less labor on site. **What we do** Our Field Engineering team, part of Installation Services, is the hub for solving technical problems in the field and for confirming that installations meet quality standards before hand\-off. They serve as a key link between site teams, contractors, and Engineering, ensuring that issues are resolved quickly, fixes are captured upstream, and lessons learned shape how Symbotic moves toward shorter, more predictable installations. **What you’ll do** * Serve as the primary technical contact for site teams and contractors on structure, adapter cell, and system installation questions. * Diagnose field issues, identify root causes, and drive fixes in partnership with Engineering, Project Management, and Supply Chain. * Own the regional Installation Top 5 Field Blockers list, ensuring every action has a clear owner and due date. * Write clear, complete RFIs and track each one through the RFI, ECR, ECN, and bulletin process, pushing for fixes to be incorporated into IFC drawings rather than supplemental documents. * Lead standard quality buy\-offs at key milestones, verifying contractor work against Final Quality Artifacts (FQAs) such as MLC Certification. * Coach contractors on FQA requirements so they own their quality and pass buy\-off the first time. * Record buy\-off results, nonconformances, and corrective actions in the system of record, and help retire legacy checklists by moving each check into drawings or contractor scopes of work. * Support field trials of new installation methods and report results to Installation Standards. * Capture lessons learned throughout every project and lead or support post\-mortems within 30 days of project completion. * Apply structured problem\-solving tools such as 5 Whys, fishbone diagrams, and FMEA to prevent recurring issues. * Champion a culture of safety by following and modeling Symbotic and customer site safety rules, stopping work when conditions are unsafe, and escalating immediately. **What you’ll need** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, civil, electrical, or industrial engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * Minimum 3 years of experience in field engineering, construction, or installation of automation, material handling, or industrial equipment. * Ability to read and interpret structural, mechanical, and electrical drawings, including IFC packages. * Experience with quality inspection, nonconformance reporting, and corrective action. * Experience writing RFIs and working through engineering change processes. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with contractors, site teams, and engineers. * OSHA 30 certification, or the ability to obtain it within 90 days of hire. * Background in warehouse automation, robotics, or conveyor system installation is preferred. * Prior quality engineering or quality inspection experience on large capital projects is preferred. * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or experience with DMAIC, FMEA, and root cause analysis is a plus. * Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, or Navisworks is preferred; experience managing or auditing contractor scopes of work is a plus. **Our Environment** * Remote, field\-based position within an assigned region; home base should be near a major airport. Travel is required up to 75% of the time, primarily to active installation sites. * Employee must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. \#LI\-JC1 \#LI\-Remote **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. The base range for this position in the posted location is $79,500\.00 \- $116,600\.00 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, 401K, PTO and/or other benefits.

jobs.title: Contract Full-Stack Developer – Short-Term Project
jobs.description: Contract Full\-Stack Developer – Code Cleanup \& Maintenance (Short\-Term Project) **Company:** Synergy Insurance Affiliates (SIA) **Job Type:** Contract / Temporary **Experience Level:** Mid\-to\-Senior **Project Duration:** Short\-term engagement (approximately a few weeks) **Job Overview** Synergy Insurance Affiliates is seeking an experienced Mid\-to\-Senior Full\-Stack Developer for a short\-term contract project focused on code cleanup, optimization of code quality, and improving the maintainability of an existing production platform. Our internal platform is a live system used daily by our agents to manage offices, customers, policies, and dialer/lead workflows. This engagement is strictly focused on improving the quality and maintainability of the existing codebase. This is not a platform rebuild, redesign, or new feature development project. All existing functionality and system behavior must remain unchanged. We are looking for a detail\-oriented developer who can work carefully within an established codebase, follow existing development processes, and communicate effectively with our current development team. Key Responsibilities * Review and evaluate the existing codebase to identify opportunities for cleanup and improved maintainability. * Remove unnecessary console.log statements, debug logs, and commented\-out experimental or debugging code. * Identify and remove unused code, imports, and other unnecessary elements. * Replace loosely defined any types with stricter, more appropriate TypeScript types wherever it is safe to do so. * Develop and implement tests that document and verify the platform's current behavior. * Ensure all cleanup work preserves existing functionality without introducing unintended changes. * Identify potential bugs, inconsistencies, or areas of concern and communicate findings to the existing developer before taking action. * Document any areas intentionally left unchanged, including the reasoning behind those decisions. **Technical Requirements** Candidates should have experience working with production applications and familiarity with the following technologies: **Frontend** * React 18 * Vite * Apollo Client * TanStack Query **Backend** * NestJS microservices * Apollo Federation GraphQL Gateway * REST APIs alongside GraphQL **Database** * MongoDB Atlas **Infrastructure – Familiarity Only** General awareness of the following AWS services and infrastructure is beneficial. No infrastructure modifications are required as part of this engagement. * AWS Region: us\-east\-2 * Amazon Cognito * Amazon ECS/ECR * AWS Lambda * Amazon SQS * AWS Amplify * Traefik Development Workflow \& Expectations To maintain the stability and integrity of our live production platform, all development work must follow our established review and approval process. * All work must be completed on dedicated feature branches. * Every pull request will be personally reviewed by our existing developer. * No changes may be merged into the main branch without explicit approval. * All proposed modifications must remain within the agreed\-upon scope of code cleanup and maintenance. * Any potential bugs or concerns must be communicated and reviewed before changes are made. Project Deliverables Upon completion of the engagement, the developer will be expected to provide: * A cleaned\-up codebase with unnecessary console.log statements and commented\-out debugging code removed. * Removal of unused code and imports. * Replacement of any types with stricter TypeScript types where appropriate and safe. * Tests verifying that existing platform functionality and behavior remain unchanged. * A brief written summary identifying any areas intentionally left untouched, along with the reasoning behind those decisions. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a mid\-to\-senior full\-stack developer who has experience maintaining and improving established production applications. We are particularly interested in someone who: * Has strong attention to detail and takes a careful, methodical approach to code maintenance. * Is comfortable navigating and working within an existing, complex codebase. * Understands the importance of preserving functionality in a live production environment. * Can distinguish between necessary code cleanup and changes that would affect product behavior. * Respects established development processes, code review requirements, and project boundaries. * Communicates clearly and proactively when encountering potential issues or decisions requiring additional input. * Can work independently while collaborating effectively with an existing developer. About the Opportunity This is a **short\-term contract opportunity** intended for an experienced developer who can efficiently improve code quality and maintainability without disrupting a live production system. The project has a clearly defined scope, an established technical environment, and an existing developer responsible for reviewing and approving all changes. Pay: From $40\.00 per hour Expected hours: 24\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Systems Integration & Automation Engineer (IT & AI)
jobs.description: *Des Moines, IA (100% On\-Site) \| Pay: $75,000 – $90,000 / year \+ Benefits* **If your idea of a great tech job is sitting in an ivory tower writing code while a separate team handles the messy reality of physical infrastructure, keep scrolling. You’d hate it here.** We are a growing, $10M\+ multi\-entity blue\-collar business that runs on real\-world execution. In a business our size, you don't get to live in just one narrow lane. You are the technical utility player. That means you will reset a password, provision a new workstation, and fix a dropped router \- *and* you will use that same day to build automated data pipelines, connect APIs, and deploy internal AI tools. You manage the guts, and you build the future. **What You’ll Actually Be Doing** **1\. Managing the Guts: IT Infrastructure \& Support (40%)** * Yes, you own the fundamentals. When an employee forgets their password, a branch router drops offline, or a new hire needs a workstation imaged, you are the one who fixes it. * You administer and secure our cloud environments (Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace) across multiple legal entities, manage user permissions, and configure DNS/email deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) so our comms don't break. * You keep the digital house running smoothly so our field crews and back\-office teams can work without friction. **2\. Building the Future: Automations \& Integrations (40%)** * You live in tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, and custom webhooks. When data needs to move between our ERP, CRM, and accounting software, you build the pipeline so nobody has to type it twice. * You look at manual, repetitive administrative tasks across our regional branches and think, *"I can automate that by Friday."* Then you build it, test it, and deploy it. **3\. Pushing the Frontier: Practical AI Tools (20%)** * You experiment with LLMs, prompt engineering, and document parsers to build smart internal tools—like automated estimate parsers, scheduling assistants, and internal knowledge bases tied directly to company data. **Who You Actually Are** * **A True Utility Player:** You don't think basic IT tasks are "below you." You understand that keeping the network stable and building advanced automations are two sides of the same coin. * **A Pragmatic Builder:** You have a trail of messy, brilliant side projects, automations, or small\-business tech setups where you forced disparate software tools to work together. * **Zero Corporate Ego:** You measure your success by how much friction you remove from our team's day—whether that means fixing a printer, unblocking an email queue, or deploying a custom integration. * **Plainspoken:** You can explain technical setups to field crews and operations managers without hiding behind IT jargon or corporate red tape. **Why Join Us?** * **Total Ownership:** You aren't a cog in a massive help\-desk queue. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** Texas Windstorm Insurance Associationis seeking a **DevOps Engineer** who is a developer first. You will write code to automate, integrate, and stabilize how we deliver software. This is not a role centered on building cloud infrastructure. Our core business systems run on Guidewire, a vendor\-hosted cloud platform on AWS that we control through REST APIs. We do not manage the underlying cloud infrastructure. We do own the work of automating application configuration, environment provisioning, integrations, and releases through the APIs the vendor provides. You will stitch those APIs together with scripts and pipelines, make our environments consistent and stable, surface problems before customers report them, and move changes reliably from Development to Production. The role is roughly 70% development and 30% operations. A mix of Dev and Ops skills is welcome, as long as you lean clearly toward the Dev side. **What You Will Solve** * Changes that do not move reliably from Development to QA to UAT to Production, such as Auth0 identity tenant changes * Environments that drift apart, with settings, secrets, and deployments changed by anyone * Developers spend days setting up backend systems before they can start working * A hand\-built pipeline for each application, so a single new security check takes weeks * Basic bugs reaching QA, and a QA backlog that stretches for weeks * Production changes that break a critical customer site without anyone noticing for hours * Releases that are rare, manual, weekend events with lengthy rollbacks * Customers finding outages before we do **What You Bring** * A developer's mindset: you write and maintain code to solve operational problems * Scripting in at least one general\-purpose language (Groovy, Python, or Java preferred), plus comfort with PowerShell and shell scripting * Experience building and maintaining Jenkins pipelines, including Groovy and shared pipeline libraries * Experience calling, chaining, and automating REST APIs to orchestrate work across systems * Git and release practices: branching strategy, merging, and versioning * Experience turning manual, multi\-step processes into reliable, repeatable automation * Experience designing monitoring and observability: deciding what to measure, alert on, and log * Experience managing configuration and secrets across many environments * A collaborative style: you work alongside developers and QA in sprints and suggest improvements rather than waiting for tickets **Nice to Have** * Docker for consistent build and test environments * General familiarity with AWS (deep networking is not required) * Exposure to Kubernetes, Helm, or Terraform * Experience with Guidewire Insurance Suite or other insurance or financial systems * Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0 or Okta * Automated testing frameworks and security scanning in pipelines **What "Lead" Means Here** "Lead" reflects ownership and long\-term accountability for our DevOps ecosystem. It does not require people management or prior formal leadership. We are looking for a capable, development\-oriented engineer with sound judgment, initiative, and a willingness to grow into broader ownership of the function.

jobs.description: **Job Title:** Senior Product Engineer. **Department:** Engineering. **Type: Full\-Time** **Reports To:** Head of Engineering. **Hours:** 40/week. **Location:** Remote **Company Overview** -------------------- Do you enjoy making a difference in a child's life, transforming education, and evolving learning? Come join Teachstone, the interaction company! Teachstone® was founded in 2008 to deliver the Classroom Assessment Scoring System® (CLASS®) nationwide and around the globe. Developed through years of research, the CLASS observation tool measures the interactions between teachers and children, which have been shown to drive learning and lifelong achievement. Teachstone helps organizations conduct classroom observations and provides professional development so that teachers improve, and children learn more. Our online subscription service, myTeachstone, simplifies CLASS implementation by combining observation data with a robust library of CLASS resources and professional development. At Teachstone, everything we do is about improving the ways teachers interact with their students. We train coaches and observers, build and deliver online support programs, and design professional development—all grounded in one proven fact: the interactions teachers have with students have a lasting impact on their academic and developmental success. By helping educators describe, measure, and improve their interactions and relationships with students, Teachstone is transforming education nationwide, one interaction at a time. **Role Overview** ----------------- Teachstone is seeking an experienced, hands\-on engineer to help shape and deliver the next generation of our technology platform. This role prioritizes product **opportunities from** initial problem definition through design, development, and production, with a particular emphasis on building AI\-enabled capabilities as an integral part of the product experience. Working across frontend, backend, APIs, data models, and infrastructure, this individual will translate evolving business and customer needs into scalable, secure, and reliable solutions. In addition to delivering high\-impact technical work, this role will help strengthen engineering team capabilities by mentoring colleagues in AI\-assisted development and responsible AI implementation. **Role Responsibilities** ------------------------- * Deliver Full\-Stack Product Capabilities: Design, develop, and ship end\-to\-end features across the technology stack, from data models and backend services to polished, accessible user interfaces. * Support Platform Integration: Integrate Teachstone's next\-generation platform with existing systems while maintaining clearly defined boundaries, reliable data flows, and sustainable architectural patterns. * Drive Solutions from Concept to Production: Translate loosely defined customer needs and business opportunities into technical solutions, taking ownership of design, implementation, testing, and deployment without requiring fully developed specifications. * Build Scalable and Reliable Systems: Work across APIs, application architecture, data models, backend services, and infrastructure to deliver secure, maintainable, and production\-ready capabilities. * Advance AI\-Enabled Development: Incorporate AI and agentic coding tools into development workflows, applying sound judgment about their strengths, limitations, and appropriate use cases. * Mentor and Elevate the Engineering Team: Coach teammates, build AI literacy across the team, and promote responsible practices for developing, evaluating, and verifying AI\-enabled systems. **Role Qualifications** ----------------------- * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated experience delivering production software. * Strong full\-stack engineering capabilities, including the ability to work hands\-on across application code, infrastructure, and unfamiliar technology systems. * Demonstrated ability to translate loosely defined business problems and customer requirements into technical solutions and shipped products without relying on fully documented specifications. * Hands\-on experience using agentic coding tools and AI\-assisted development workflows, with the ability to evaluate their strengths, limitations, and appropriate applications. * Experience building or implementing evaluation and verification infrastructure, such as automated test harnesses, continuous integration systems, evaluation pipelines, or performance benchmarks. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience building and integrating AI\-enabled product capabilities using large language models (LLMs), AI services, or cloud\-based AI platforms. * Experience working with modern cloud infrastructure, infrastructure\-as\-code, and scalable application architectures. * Experience integrating new technology platforms with established legacy applications and systems. * Experience mentoring engineers, sharing technical knowledge, and influencing engineering practices across a team. * Familiarity with Teachstone's technology ecosystem or comparable tools and frameworks. ### **Technology Stack** **Our engineering environment includes the following technologies and tools:** * Languages \& Frameworks: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Ruby on Rails * Cloud \& Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform * Data \& Storage: PostgreSQL, Amazon S3, Snowflake * AI \& Machine Learning: AWS Bedrock, Gemini, Claude * Development \& Collaboration Tools: GitHub, Slack, Jira, Figma, CircleCI **What We Offer** ----------------- Fair, Competitive Pay: We ensure equal pay for equal work, using consistent salary bands based on market benchmarks, reviewed annually. Prior salaries, negotiation skills, or fear of conflict don't influence your pay. Salary Range: $160,000 – $180,000, determined by your experience, skills, and internal equity. Comprehensive Benefits: We offer an inclusive, well\-rounded benefits package to support your overall well\-being. This includes medical and dental insurance, 401(k), paid time off, insurance \\ coverage, and professional development opportunities. Additional details will be provided at the time of offer. Benefit eligibility depends on your role and employment status. **Ready to Make a Difference?** ------------------------------- At Teachstone, we believe that every interaction shapes a brighter future. If you're passionate about transforming education and want to be part of a team that's committed to meaningful impact, we want to hear from you. Apply today and help us create classrooms where every child thrives! We strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. The strongest candidates we meet rarely do, so don't exclude yourself prematurely. We're rethinking how humans interact with AI, and doing that well demands diversity of perspective and experience. We're committed to a fair and accessible interview process. If you need any accommodations or adjustments, please let us know. We encourage all individuals to apply and bring their unique perspectives to our team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We value the different experiences and ideas our team members bring and believe they are essential to solving complex challenges and driving our mission forward.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Commercial
jobs.description: **About Temporal** ================== Distributed systems fail in ordinary ways: services crash, networks drop, and long\-running processes get cut off halfway. Engineers end up writing retries, state tracking, and recovery code instead of building their product. Temporal removes that work. With Durable Execution, code runs to completion through any failure, so teams ship reliable applications faster. The need is growing fastest in AI, where agents run for hours or days and depend on services that fail. That’s why OpenAI, Cursor, Lovable, Stripe, and Snap run critical workloads on Temporal, and why we raised a Series E at a $12\.55B valuation. Our founders, Maxim Fateev and Samar Abbas, built AWS Simple Workflow Service and the foundation of Azure Durable Functions, then co\-created Cadence at Uber before starting Temporal. **Summary** =========== We’re hiring two Senior Solutions Architects for our Commercial team: one focused on new logo acquisition, one on growth and expansion within our existing customer base. * **New Logo.** You thrive in the early stages of a sales cycle. You’re energized by discovery, whiteboarding with skeptical engineers, and earning technical trust in competitive deals. You turn “we’ve never heard of Temporal” into “we’re building on Temporal.” * **Growth and Expansion.** You’re at your best once a customer is live. You understand their architecture, spot where Temporal can go deeper, and partner with the account team to unlock new workloads, teams, and use cases. You turn one workflow into an enterprise\-wide standard. In either role, you’re the technical lead on your deals, partnering with Account Executives and working with developers, architects, and engineering leaders at fast\-moving companies. Temporal Cloud is consumption\-based, so we succeed when customers grow their adoption of Temporal Cloud, and your primary goal is driving that consumption. This is a sales role for technical people: you love solving customer problems, and you want the deal to close. **What you’ll do** ================== * Partner with AEs to qualify opportunities and run technical evaluations, from discovery through proof of concept to a decision * Lead technical conversations with developers, architects, and engineering leaders to understand their systems, constraints, and goals * Find and win new workloads, teams, and use cases inside existing customers * Build focused demos and proofs of concept, including orchestration of AI and agent workloads * Help customer engineering teams adopt and expand their Temporal usage * Build tools, automations, and reference implementations that elevate the team around you * Keep changing how we work: automate research, notes, and follow\-ups, and share what works * Teach AEs Temporal fundamentals and how to spot a strong opportunity * Bring field insight back to Product and Engineering **What you’ll bring** ===================== * **New Logo**: San Francisco Bay Area or Pacific time zone preferred * **Growth and Expansion:** Open to all US time zones * **Customer\-facing engineering experience.** You’ve been a solutions architect, or you’re a software engineer ready to work directly with customers * **Strong software engineering fundamentals.** You can build a working proof of concept yourself in Go, Java, TypeScript, or Python * **Deep distributed systems knowledge.** You understand failure modes, retries, idempotency, state, and observability * **A hunger to win deals.** You qualify hard and measure yourself by outcomes * **Strong communicator and collaborator.** You’re the glue between customers and our internal teams, keeping Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support aligned * **Trusted technical advisor.** You earn credibility with engineers, including telling them when Temporal may not be the right fit * **Understanding of AI agents and LLMs.** You know how agents and LLM pipelines fail in production, and why that matters for orchestration, or you can learn it fast * **Comfort building in a hyper\-growth company.** Where structure is thin, you create it * **A drive to reinvent how we work.** You use AI tools to automate and streamline your own work, and you share what’s working with the team **Nice to haves** ================= * Experience with Temporal or other workflow and orchestration tools * Experience selling a commercial product with an open source alternative (eg: Redis, Confluent, or Databricks) Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity. Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist. Compensation Range: $140,000 \- $183,750

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: *At TerraFirma, we’re redefining how the world moves earth for construction. Founded by former SpaceX engineers and backed by Kleiner Perkins and Bain Capital Ventures, TerraFirma is automating construction to make it faster, cheaper, and safer.* **Our Story \& Mission** At SpaceX, we were part of the teams that built the largest rocket in human history, launched the largest constellation of satellites ever made, and delivered connectivity to millions of people worldwide. What we learned was simple: infrastructure is everything. At Starbase, the biggest barrier to launching missions to Mars was not building the rocket. It was how slow, expensive, and complex it was to build the infrastructure around it. We lacked buildings, roads, water, power, communications, and waste management, and constructing them took far more time and resources than it should have. From a first\-principles perspective, that doesn't make sense. It shouldn't be this hard or costly to create the foundations for progress. That’s when we realized something important: the same engineering mindset that enabled us to tackle space exploration and mass manufacturing could be applied to infrastructure. By bringing the principles of simplification, iteration, acceleration, and automation to construction, we can unlock a new era in how the world builds. Accelerating infrastructure unlocks progress across every domain, creating a self\-sustaining engine for tackling humanity’s toughest challenges. The innovations we develop on Earth will lay the groundwork for the technologies that one day make settlement on Mars possible. **Job Overview** In this role, you’ll work across the full stack to build intuitive, high\-performance interfaces for real\-time remote control of heavy machinery via novel user interfaces. It requires strong frontend skills for seamless user experiences and backend expertise to ensure a secure, scalable architecture. Daily tasks include prototyping data\-rich visualizations, building pipelines for complex sensor data (e.g., LiDAR, geospatial, 3D), and optimizing user interactions. Rapid prototyping and iteration with users will be key. jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Purpose** The Solutions Engineer is responsible for technical implementation, integration, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and ongoing optimization of healthcare technology solutions supporting TRC and its customers. The position requires a strong foundation in information technology, with practical experience across multiple disciplines such as systems administration, networking, infrastructure, application support, systems integration, and technical troubleshooting. The Solutions Engineer works with the CTO, operations, project and program management, internal IT and clinical teams, customers, hospitals, technology partners, and vendors to deliver reliable solutions. The position requires strong technical aptitude, independent problem\-solving, and the ability to understand how applications, networks, infrastructure, and data exchange systems interact. Previous healthcare IT or radiology experience is beneficial but not required. TRC will provide on\-the\-job training in specialized technologies and workflows, including DICOM, HL7, PACS, RIS, clinical systems integration, and radiology workflows. The Solutions Engineer is expected to apply an established IT foundation to learn, configure, troubleshoot, and support these systems. **Essential Functions** * Execute assigned technical implementation activities for new customers, facilities, and integrations from discovery through go\-live and stabilization. * Participate in technical discovery to assess customer systems, clinical workflows, interface requirements, connectivity, dependencies, and implementation constraints. * Configure and maintain applications, endpoints, interfaces, DICOM routers, interface engines, orchestration platforms, and supporting infrastructure. * Coordinate VPN tunnels, firewall rules, network ports, and connectivity requirements with internal IT, customer IT teams, and vendors. * Design, configure, implement, test, and support healthcare integrations using HL7, DICOM, and related interoperability standards. * Configure and maintain ADT, ORM, ORU, and other HL7 messaging workflows, including routing, filtering, field mapping, transformations, and delivery rules. * Configure DICOM routing, image transfers, destinations, and enterprise imaging workflows between customer systems and the TRC platform. * Integrate PACS, RIS, EMR/EHR, radiology reporting systems, and related clinical applications. * Perform technical testing, interface validation, acceptance testing, production readiness checks, and post\-go\-live verification. * Monitor application services, traffic, message queues, transactions, and system performance; investigate failed, delayed, or incomplete exchanges. * Analyze HL7 messages, DICOM transactions, application and system logs, database information, and network errors to identify and resolve technical issues. * Troubleshoot interface failures, message delivery issues, mapping discrepancies, connectivity failures, and application configuration problems. * Serve as an escalation resource for technical issues identified by Tier 1 and Tier 2 Support and Clinical Operations. * Coordinate troubleshooting and incident resolution with internal IT, clinical teams, customers, and technology vendors; communicate findings and progress during high\-priority clinical disruptions. * Assess technical risks, blockers, and alternative solutions; implement corrective actions within assigned authority and escalate significant issues appropriately. * Provide technical estimates, implementation dependencies, task status, and progress updates to the project or program manager. * Maintain assigned engineering tasks, milestones, technical deliverables, and implementation updates in TRC’s project management platform. * Participate in customer technical meetings, coordinate technical activities with vendors and customer IT teams, and explain issues to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Support upgrades, maintenance, deployments, and configuration changes in accordance with established change\-control and testing procedures. * Maintain appropriate separation of test and production environments and follow applicable security, deployment, and operational procedures. * Document interface configurations, routing logic, system dependencies, technical architecture, runbooks, validation results, and troubleshooting procedures. * Serve as a system administrator for TRC’s Zoho enterprise platform as assigned, supporting configuration, maintenance, and operational needs. * Protect patient information and comply with HIPAA, organizational security requirements, and applicable policies. * Identify and recommend improvements to system reliability, scalability, implementation consistency, clinical workflow efficiency, and support processes. * Perform other duties consistent with the responsibilities of the position. **Required Knowledge \& Skills** * Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. * Four or more years of professional IT experience in systems administration, networking, infrastructure, application support, systems integration, or related technical disciplines. * Strong foundational knowledge across multiple areas of information technology and an understanding of how systems, applications, networks, and infrastructure interact. * Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, ports, firewalls, VPNs, Windows Server, application services, and related IT infrastructure. * Demonstrated ability to investigate complex issues spanning multiple systems, identify root causes, evaluate options, and implement practical solutions. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, technical documentation, communication, and organizational skills; ability to manage assigned technical work independently. * Ability to coordinate with internal teams, customers, vendors, and technical and nontechnical stakeholders while meeting implementation commitments. * Ability and willingness to learn specialized healthcare technologies, interoperability standards, and clinical workflows through structured training and hands\-on experience. * Occasional travel may be required, typically 2 to 4 trips per year. **Preferred Knowledge \& Skills** * Previous experience in healthcare IT, radiology, medical imaging, or clinical technology environments. * Knowledge of DICOM, HL7 (including ADT, ORM, and ORU), healthcare interoperability, and clinical systems integration. * Experience with PACS, RIS, EHR/EMR, radiology reporting platforms, enterprise imaging, or interface engines such as Silverback, Corepoint, Rhapsody, or Mirth Connect. * Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, C\#, PowerShell, or integration scripting. * Familiarity with DICOM networking, routing, image transfers, and clinical imaging workflows. * Experience with Zoho Projects, Zoho Desk, or comparable enterprise and project management applications. * Experience supporting hospital, imaging center, radiology practice, or teleradiology implementations. **Physical Work Demands** * Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods. * Ability to stoop, kneel, bend at the waist, and reach as necessary. * Ability to perform general office administrative activities, including copying, filing, telephone use, and handling documents or equipment. * Ability to lift and move up to 25 pounds when required. * Normal or correctable vision and hearing sufficient to perform the essential functions of the position. **Other Work Demands** * Regular and timely attendance. * Strong communication skills. * Strong organizational, analytical, and time\-management skills. * Ability to manage multiple concurrent technical assignments and competing business priorities. * Occasional travel within the region and to other locations as required. **Core Expectations** The Solutions Engineer is expected to bring broad, practical IT knowledge to assigned technical work, understand the status of deliverables, determine next steps, investigate obstacles, and resolve issues independently when appropriate. The engineer must be able to connect knowledge across infrastructure, networking, applications, and integration technologies while recognizing when escalation is required. This is a hands\-on engineering position focused on implementation quality, reliable interoperability, and operational support. TRC will train qualified IT professionals in DICOM, HL7, clinical IT systems, and radiology workflows. The Solutions Engineer is expected to apply that training, develop proficiency in TRC’s platform, maintain accurate documentation, and deliver dependable technical solutions for customers and clinical teams. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Work from home Work Location: Hybrid remote in Tuscaloosa, AL 35406

When those solutions go live, you make sure they stay reliable, secure and fast, and you decide how the rest of the organization will run them. At Threekit, GRIT is more than just an acronym; it is the driving force behind our success and growth. **What You'll Do** * Build and update configurator front ends, configuration rules, and pricing logic using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and the Threekit APIs, working from specs written by Solution Architects. * Join discovery calls, demo work in progress, and communicate status, risks, and trade\-offs to customers in plain language. * Deliver project work on schedule, promote changes from development through production, and flag risks and scope changes to your Technical Project Manager early. * Troubleshoot customer\-reported issues and document root cause, fixes, and handoff notes. * Pass client friction and edge cases back to Forward Deployed Engineers and Engineering to improve the core product. * Track time accurately against client projects. **What Catches Our Eye** * 0–2 years of professional software development; internships, co\-ops, and substantial project work count. * Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS, including REST APIs and Git. * A consultative mindset and clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical audiences, including on customer calls. * Willingness to travel to client sites as required (approx. 15%). **Preferred Skills** * Client\-facing experience in consulting, an agency, professional services, or customer support. * Building with AI\-assisted IDEs such as Cursor or Copilot, or with LLM APIs. * Exposure to 3D on the web (Three.js, WebGL) or to eCommerce and CPQ platforms (Salesforce, Shopify, SAP). **Education** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred** * Coursework or projects in web development, 3D graphics, or UX design. **Who You'll Report To** This role will report directly to the Senior Manager, Consulting. **What You Can Expect From Threekit** * A transparent recruitment process that includes an initial Cognitive Assessment, conversations with key stakeholders, and a live technical exercise. Looking to move quickly? So are we! * A comprehensive insurance package including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance. * FSA, Dependent Care FSA, and commuter benefits. * A 401(k) with employer match and long\-term incentives (e.g., stock options) for your long\-term future. * An unlimited PTO policy and paid holidays so you can relax and recharge when needed. * A hybrid work model, with in\-office lunches and snacks, plus a home Wi\-Fi stipend. * Reimbursement for approved tuition and training. * A positive culture that embraces employee input. * *Threekit's salary ranges are determined based on market data for our industry and company size, and take into account work location, skills, experience, and education/certifications.* We use AI\-powered tools, such as Metaview, Fireflies.ai, and ChatGPT, to support certain administrative aspects of our recruitment process, including interview note\-taking, transcription, and summarization. These tools are used to improve efficiency and consistency. A qualified recruiting professional reviews all AI\-generated outputs, and all hiring decisions are made by humans. We do not use AI for selection, but we do use AI\-powered search tools, including Metaview and Google, to help identify candidates.

jobs.description: As a Senior Engineer within the Digital Advisor Experience (DAX) organization, you will help build a new digital experience that enables financial advisors to capture, understand, and maintain the client and household information used to drive financial planning. This is a full\-stack engineering position. You will design and deliver capabilities across both front\-end and back\-end systems, working with technologies including Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, React, and Next.js. You will collaborate closely with product, design, architecture, and other engineers to translate advisor and client needs into secure, scalable, resilient, and intuitive digital experiences. In addition to delivering user stories, you will provide technical leadership through solution design, code reviews, engineering standards, mentoring, and the decomposition of complex product capabilities into maintainable software. This Senior Engineer brings strong depth in one or more areas of software engineering while demonstrating the ability to contribute across the full application stack. **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Building the Digital Advisor Experience** * Design and deliver full\-stack capabilities that help advisors capture and maintain client and household information used throughout financial planning. * Develop advisor\-facing user experiences using React and Next.js. * Build secure, scalable services and APIs using Java and Spring Boot. * Design and evolve data models in MongoDB to support complex client, household, and financial\-planning information. * Work across both front\-end and back\-end user stories based on product and team priorities. * Partner with product owners, designers, architects, and engineers to translate advisor workflows into intuitive, maintainable digital solutions. * Apply appropriate security, privacy, auditability, and data\-quality practices when working with sensitive client financial information. * Contribute to automated testing, observability, CI/CD, production support, and the ongoing reliability of the product. **Designing Solutions** * Apply technical knowledge to drive outcomes for customers * Ability to work and problem solve independently on initiatives that align to the broader engineering strategy **Implementing Solutions** * Work independently and collaboratively with the team to develop core technology solutions that deliver measurable product and client outcomes. * Consistently deliver core technology solutions that meet the team’s expectations for stability, scalability, resilience, security, and maintainability. **Learning and Applying New Techniques** * Shares new ideas and techniques with team * Encourage engineers to invest in continuous learning as part of their role. **Collaborating within the Team** * Participate in team collaboration sessions, providing technical expertise to solve problems and remove technical roadblocks. * Participate in product planning and implementation, helping the team understand and decompose work. **Defining Engineering Standards and Patterns** * Contribute to the knowledge on focus subsystems. **Coaching Engineers** * Mentor engineers at earlier career stages as they build foundational engineering skills. * Provide technical expertise and help the team solve other engineers grow their skills and contribute effectively to the team. **Recruiting/Building Talent** * Participate in interviewing and other talent\-building activities that strengthen the engineering organization. * Model Thrivent’s leadership competencies * Support and/or develops an environment in which Thrivent employees and colleagues are focused on continuous improvement, exceptional employee engagement, and an unwavering commitment to our clients. * Shape and/or supports a culture that represents the Thrivent purpose, promise and values, ensuring that Thrivent’s trust and reputation remain strong with its clients. **QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS:** ***Required:*** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or another technical field, or equivalent work experience. * 7\+ years of experience in engineering environments, taking abstract concepts and ideas and formulating a detailed software engineering plan to deliver * Sound knowledge of industry standard Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices * Sound knowledge of version and revision control practices and procedures * Sound knowledge of systems design concepts that provide security and stability * Expertise in debugging code and/or complex log files for troubleshooting and analysis of product defects * Experience designing data models and implementing application data\-access patterns using MongoDB or comparable document and NoSQL databases. * Provide thoughtful code reviews and help maintain team engineering standards. * Demonstrated experience delivering production software across both front\-end and back\-end systems. * Strong experience with Java and Spring Boot. * Experience building modern web applications with React; experience with Next.js is preferred. * Experience designing and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs. * Experience with MongoDB or another document\-oriented database. * Experience with automated unit, integration, API, and user\-interface testing. * Experience building secure applications that handle sensitive or regulated data. * Ability to investigate application and data issues using logs, telemetry, API traces, and database queries. ***Preferred:*** *
