jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Customer Deployments
jobs.description: **ABOUT TITAN** Titan is building the AI workforce for IT. We deploy AI agents across our portfolio of Managed Service Providers and enterprise customers: agents that monitor, triage, and resolve work across the service desk, infrastructure, security, identity, endpoint, and application operations. The result is faster resolutions, better uptime, and more proactive, personalized support, delivered 24/7\. We've raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market\-leading MSPs like RFA, and put agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K\+ tickets across 800\+ customers. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Amazon, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT. Joining Titan means helping redefine how work gets done in IT services, and building a $100B company. **ABOUT THE TEAM** Customer Deployments is Titan's central AI deployment team. We sit at the holding company level and partner with our MSPs to bring applied AI into production for the businesses they serve. Those clients span every industry: private equity, venture and hedge funds, family offices, biotech and pharma, insurance, accounting firms, healthcare, manufacturing, law. Inside each one we work across functions like finance, investor relations, compliance, operations, HR and client service. Working alongside the MSP that already supports each client means every deployment fits how the business runs, and has a team behind it long after launch. Most companies know AI should change how they work. Very few have someone who can walk in, learn the business in a week, find the work that matters, and ship something people actually use. That's this team. **ABOUT THE ROLE** Forward Deployed Engineers on Customer Deployments own a deployment end to end. You'll sit with a client's leadership and the people doing the work, learn how their business really runs, find where AI changes the outcome, design the solution, build it, ship it to production, and stay until it's adopted. One month you might be working with a private equity firm to build AI into its value creation plan and deploy it across its portfolio companies; the next, learning how a biotech runs its regulatory submissions or how an insurer handles claims intake. This is a high\-trust, high\-autonomy role for someone who is part architect, part engineer and part operator. You build with agentic coding tools and move fast, but your edge is judgment: which problem to solve, how to make an agent safe and reliable, and when it's ready for users. What you learn in the field shapes Titan's platform, and the patterns you build become the playbook for every deployment after yours. **IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL** * Get up to speed quickly on a new business and its workflows, sit with the people doing the work, and find the highest\-leverage opportunities for AI * Architect solutions across models, agents, data and integrations, and decide when an off\-the\-shelf platform beats a custom build * Build with agentic coding tools: prototype in days and ship to production in weeks, connected to the systems clients run (CRMs, ERPs, fund admin and portfolio systems, document stores, data warehouses, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace) * Put agents into production properly, with guardrails, evals, observability, human review where it matters, and the access controls and documentation regulated clients expect * Lead onboarding, training and change management so deployments get used, and measure their impact against a baseline * Be the technical voice in front of executives: explain tradeoffs, push back on weak use cases, and earn the next project * Turn what works into reusable components, templates, evals and playbooks, and bring what you learn in the field back to Product and Engineering * Partner with MSP leadership to find and shape new deployment opportunities across their client base **YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU** * Love learning how businesses work: you can get up to speed on a PE fund's deal process, an insurer's underwriting workflow or an accounting firm's close in days, and talk about it credibly with the people who run it * Bring 5\+ years in solutions architecture, forward deployed engineering, technical consulting or software engineering, with significant customer\-facing work * Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and similar) as your daily way of building, and write solid Python or TypeScript * Have a solid grounding in applied AI: you've built LLM\-powered tools, agents or workflows, and you understand what it takes to run them reliably in production (evals, guardrails, failure modes, cost and latency) * Can run a room with a business leader, turn a vague ambition into a concrete scope, and say no to the wrong project * Thrive in ambiguity: a new industry, a new stack and a new set of stakeholders every few months sounds fun to you * Would rather put a working system in front of 10 users in three weeks than a perfect one in front of none in three months * Take extreme ownership of outcomes and treat client data with a security mindset **BONUS** * Have shipped LLM agents to production for real users, with evals and guardrails you designed * Forward deployed, solutions or software engineering experience at an AI, SaaS or consulting company * Domain depth in financial services (PE, VC, hedge funds, family offices), life sciences, insurance or professional services * Experience in or alongside MSPs and IT services **LOGISTICS** * Location: New York City or San Francisco * Travel: Up to 25%, for on\-site discovery, launches and client workshops * Compensation: $150,000–$250,000 base \+ generous equity package

Design, develop, and deploy AI agents and automated workflows using low\-code/no\-code platforms to solve business problems, streamline operations, and enhance user experiences without traditional programming. DESCRIPTION Essential Functions, Duties, and Responsibilities Describe what the role will be directly responsible for. Examples below. * Agent Design and Development * Build conversational AI agents, chatbots, and virtual assistants using platforms like Voice flow, Bot press, Microsoft Power Virtual Agents, or similar tools * Design agent conversation flows, decision trees, and logic pathways to handle user interactions effectively * Configure agent integrations with APIs, databases, CRM systems, and third\-party applications * Test and iterate on agent performance based on user feedback and analytics * Workflow Automation * Create automated workflows using tools like Zapier, make (Integromat), Power Automate, or n8n * Connect multiple applications and services to eliminate manual tasks and data entry * Design trigger\-based automations that respond to business events and conditions * Monitor workflow requirements into technical specifications for low\-code implementation * Evaluate which processes are suitable for automation or agent\-based solutions * Create documentation including flow diagrams, user guides, and technical specifications * Testing \& Quality Assurance * Conduct thorough testing of agents and workflows across various scenarios and edge cases * Perform user acceptance testing with stakeholders * Debug issues and optimize agent responses for accuracy and user satisfaction * Ensure data security and privacy compliance in all implementations * Maintenance \& Optimization * Monitor agent performance metrics including response accuracy, completion rates, and user satisfaction * Analyze usage patterns and conversation logs to identify improvement opportunities * Update agents with new capabilities, improved responses, and expanded functionality * Maintain version control and documentation for all deployments * Training \& Support * Provide training to team members on using and maintaining deployed agents * Create user documentation and knowledge base articles * Offer ongoing support for agent\-related issues and questions * Share best practices and lessons learned across the organization Qualifications and Education Requirements * 2\+ years of experience building solutions on low\-code/no\-code platforms * Demonstrated experience creating AI agents, chatbots, or automated workflows * Strong understanding of user experience and conversation design * Strong understanding of user experience and conversation design * Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects * Background in business analysis, process improvement, or software development * Certifications in relevant platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Power Platform) * Experience with prompt engineering and LLM integration * Familiarity with Agile methodologies Skills, Abilities, and Knowledge * Proficiency with low\-code/no\-code platforms (e.g., Bubble, Webflow, OutSystems, Mendix) * Experience with AI agent builders and chatbot platforms * Understanding of API integrations and webhooks * Familiarity with data structures, databases, and basic logic operations * Knowledge of natural language processing concepts * Process mapping and workflow optimization * Requirements analysis and documentation * Data analysis and interpretation * Problem\-solving and critical thinking * Understanding of business operations and common pain points * Clear communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Adaptability to new platforms and technologies * Success Metrics: Number of agents deployed and maintained, Reduction in manual processing time through automation, User satisfaction scores for deployed agents, Agent accuracy and task completion rates Work Environment and Physical Requirements * Working on\-site at assigned office location. * Regular and punctual attendance adhering to schedule established by leadership. * Flexibility to work occasionally adjusted work schedules, overtime, and evening and/or weekend hours to meet deadlines or as business needs demand. * Working in a cubicle hub, maintaining focus on jobs.title: Senior PHP Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior PHP Engineer – CATS Platform \& AI Features** Top Echelon Software is seeking a Senior PHP Engineer to help own and evolve CATS, our established SaaS applicant tracking system running in AWS. This is a hands\-on role combining production ownership, thoughtful modernization, and practical AI development. You’ll maintain a product customers depend on, improve how we build and deliver software, and develop AI\-enabled features that help recruiters work more effectively. This is a full\-time role based in Canton, OH. U.S. work authorization required. **About the role** CATS is a mature, revenue\-generating product with an established customer base and a substantial codebase. We’re looking for an engineer who enjoys understanding complex systems, making sound technical decisions, and delivering improvements incrementally. You’ll take primary engineering responsibility for application health and contribute directly to its evolution. That includes resolving production issues, improving performance and maintainability, using AI coding assistants effectively, and turning promising AI capabilities into reliable product features. Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, Vue, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST and GraphQL APIs, Redis\-compatible caching and queues, OpenSearch, Docker, and AWS infrastructure. The application combines established legacy code with newer components, including integrations for embeddings and vector search. **What you’ll do** * Own application reliability, maintenance, and targeted enhancements. * Diagnose production issues across application code, database queries, background jobs, integrations, and deployment infrastructure. * Modernize selected areas of the codebase while preserving customer workflows and backward compatibility. * Improve automated tests, static analysis, observability, CI/CD, and operational documentation. * Use AI coding assistants for code exploration, implementation, debugging, and testing, while remaining accountable for correctness and security. * Develop repeatable AI\-assisted engineering workflows that produce small, tested, reviewable changes. * Build and extend AI\-enabled capabilities such as semantic search, summarization, information extraction, and recruiter workflow assistance. * Evaluate AI features for usefulness, accuracy, latency, cost, and reliable behavior when dependencies fail. * Protect customer and candidate data through appropriate access controls, tenant isolation, and careful handling of data sent to AI services. * Help prioritize technical debt and provide clear input on roadmap feasibility, tradeoffs, and risk. **Required experience** * Substantial professional software development experience, typically 7\+ years, with deep PHP expertise. * Experience maintaining and improving a complex, long\-lived application. * Strong MySQL/SQL skills, including query optimization, indexing, and safe data changes. * Experience operating production SaaS systems and diagnosing issues across multiple layers. * Experience with APIs, third\-party integrations, and asynchronous or background processing. * Working proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and an ability to contribute to an existing frontend. * Experience with Docker, automated testing, and CI/CD. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants on real development work, including reviewing generated code and validating changes. * Practical experience integrating LLMs or other AI services into an application, with an understanding of evaluation, failure handling, and data privacy. * Ability to work independently, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and carry changes through deployment and follow\-up. **Preferred experience** * Vue, particularly maintaining or modernizing Vue 2 applications. * AWS services such as EKS, RDS, EC2, and S3; Kubernetes deployment and troubleshooting. * OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Redis/Valkey, and search relevance tuning. * Embeddings, vector search, retrieval\-augmented generation, and structured model outputs. * Shipping and operating customer\-facing AI features. * Building agent\-assisted development pipelines or “software factories”: repeatable workflows connecting specifications, implementation, tests, review, and release controls. * Technical ownership of a mature SaaS product or experience working on a small engineering team. * Recruiting, applicant tracking, or other workflow\-intensive business software. **What success looks like** * Customers can depend on CATS, and recurring production problems become less frequent. * Improvements ship in manageable increments with appropriate testing and clear rollback options. * AI\-assisted development improves delivery speed without sacrificing quality. * AI features solve measurable customer problems and behave reliably in production. * Documentation and tooling make the platform easier for others to understand and support. **Benefits** Competitive salary, PTO and flexible floating holidays, 401(k) match, health benefits, and an education stipend.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a hands\-on Lead Software Engineer to drive end\-to\-end solution delivery for major retail platforms, and to make AI\-augmented engineering the way our teams build. In this role, you will own hands\-on implementation (feature development, technical design, code reviews), engagement leadership (client\-facing technical lead, trade\-off decisions, mentoring), and operational ownership (delivery sign\-off, post\-release support) of high\-impact solutions, translating business requirements into working software you help build. You will also be the engineering authority on how AI is used across the delivery lifecycle: designing agentic workflows, setting guardrails, measuring impact, and bringing the team along. You will drive Dual\-Track Agile processes, using AI to compress the Discovery Track (rapid prototyping and feasibility validation) and to raise quality, traceability, and measurable outcomes in the Delivery Track. The ideal candidate is a senior software engineer who codes daily and treats AI agents as a core part of their toolchain. You have moved beyond personal use of AI assistants to building repeatable, governed, measurable AI workflows that other engineers adopt, from analysis and design to testing, documentation, and code generation, while bringing the technical leadership to drive client engagements forward. You will mentor teams, make critical technical trade\-offs, and take full accountability for delivery sign\-off and post\-release support. This role requires strong retail platform domain knowledge (POS systems, store operations), cloud\-native development experience, and deep fluency with generative and agentic AI tools to accelerate delivery while preserving code quality and architectural integrity. You will have the judgment to know when AI output can be trusted and when it cannot, and you will be a key driver of engineering excellence, ensuring solutions are both innovative and operationally robust. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and operate AI/agentic workflows across the software lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, prototyping, code generation, test\-case creation, specification drafting, code review, documentation, and automated validation, and use them in your own daily development. * Define team standards for AI\-assisted development: prompt and context practices, reusable agent skills and instructions, repository conventions, and review expectations for AI\-generated code. * Establish guardrails for responsible AI use, including IP and licensing, secrets and data handling, security review of generated code, and client contractual constraints, and ensure ethical compliance across the team. * Build evaluation and validation around AI output (automated tests, specification conformance, static analysis, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints) so that speed gains do not erode quality. * Define and report metrics on AI impact, such as cycle time, review turnaround, defect escape rate, test coverage, rework, and cost per outcome, and use them to decide where AI helps and where it does not. * Evaluate, pilot, and recommend AI tools, models, and integrations (IDE assistants, CLI agents, MCP servers, internal automation), considering cost, security, and vendor risk. * Build internal tooling and automation on LLM APIs where it removes recurring toil, such as PR summarization, test generation, release notes, and defect triage. * Own end\-to\-end solution delivery across Discovery and Delivery Tracks, personally building validated prototypes, contributing to formal designs, decomposing work into deliverables, and shipping accepted technical implementations. * Drive the Discovery Track under Dual\-Track Agile by writing AI\-accelerated working prototypes and demoing solutions to validate feasibility and align stakeholders before full implementation. * Translate discovery outcomes into delivery backlog items and partner with implementation teams to ensure design intent, code quality standards, and non\-functional requirements are preserved throughout delivery. * Contribute to technical design across products and integrations: produce ADRs, OpenAPI interface contracts, data models, sequencing diagrams, migration/rollback plans, and traceability matrices that serve as implementation inputs for both engineers and AI agents, partnering with architects on broader governance. * Serve as the primary technical lead in client engagements: facilitate workshops, present technical solutions, make trade\-off jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Transflo is a leading provider of mobile, telematics, and business process automation software for the transportation and logistics industry. Our solutions help freight carriers, brokers, and shippers automate and streamline their operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency. We are on a mission to drive innovation in the industry by providing cutting\-edge SaaS and AI solutions that enable seamless communication and collaboration across the supply chain. **DESCRIPTION:** ================ Transflo is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to build our enterprise data platform — from raw ingestion through curated, analytics\-ready data products. You will be a key engineer designing our data warehouse, data pipeline infrastructure, and the bronze\-silver\-gold medallion architecture that serves internal analytics teams, operational reporting, and our growing Transflo Intelligence Suite. This role demands both deep technical expertise and a strategic mindset. You will work across a wide range of internal and external data sources including APIs, relational databases, NoSQL stores, file\-based feeds, and streaming data. The work will include normalizing and modeling data into reliable, governed, and high\-performance analytical assets. You will build and scale systems designed for near real\-time data environments supporting high\-traffic, mission\-critical workloads in the transportation and logistics industry. **CORE AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:** ================================= * Architect, build, and evolve a scalable enterprise data warehouse on Amazon Redshift, applying industry\-standard concepts including star schemas, snowflake schemas, and normalization. * Design and implement bronze, silver, and gold data layer architecture (medallion architecture): raw ingestion, cleansed and standardized intermediate layers, and curated analytics products. * Develop dimensional data models, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions (SCDs), and aggregate structures that support BI tooling, ad\-hoc analytics, and other downstream systems. * Build, own, and maintain robust batch and streaming data pipelines that ingest data from disparate source systems including APIs, flat files, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, Amazon DynamoDB, etc. * Implement real\-time and near real\-time data streaming architectures using AWS\-native services such as Kinesis Data Streams, Kinesis Firehose, MSK (Managed Kafka), and EventBridge. * Design pipeline frameworks for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL/ELT) using tools such as AWS Glue, dbt, Apache Airflow, or equivalent orchestration platforms * Ensure pipeline reliability, idempotency, fault tolerance, and automated recovery; build alerting and observability into every data workflow from day one * Own data quality: design and implement automated profiling, cleansing, deduplication, standardization, and validation frameworks that enforce data integrity * Build and continuously evolve tooling and processes to support data governance including data cataloging, lineage tracking, metadata management, access controls, and data classification * Define and enforce data contracts between source systems and the warehouse, establishing clear SLAs for freshness, completeness, and accuracy * Partner with data consumers (*e.g.,* Data scientists, Data analytics engineers, BI developers, and product managers) to understand consumption patterns and ensure data products meet quality and performance expectations * Contribute to the data platform infrastructure using infrastructure\-as\-code practices (Terraform), ensuring all data infrastructure is version\-controlled, reproducible, and auditable * Design for scale: apply partitioning strategies, workload management (WLM) tuning, concurrency scaling, and caching patterns to sustain performance under high\-traffic workloads * Champion security and compliance best practices across the data platform: column\-level security, row\-level access controls, encryption, and audit logging * Collaborate with software engineers, mobile platform teams, and DevOps to ensure upstream application data is well\-structured, well\-documented, and reliably delivered to the data platform * Leverage AI\-assisted development practices and tooling to accelerate pipeline development, automate data quality checks, and improve engineering velocity **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:** ======================== * 5\+ years of professional data engineering experience with a track record of building and operating production\-grade data warehouses and pipeline infrastructure * Expert\-level experience with Amazon Redshift including cluster sizing, WLM configuration, distribution and sort key optimization, vacuuming, and query plan analysis * Deep proficiency in SQL for complex analytical queries, window functions, CTEs, stored procedures, and performance tuning across Redshift and ANSI\-compatible engines * Hands\-on experience ingesting data from source systems: APIs, IBM DB2, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, Amazon DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, and file\-based sources (CSV, JSON, Parquet, Avro, etc.) * Proven experience designing and implementing medallion or equivalent layered data architectures * Strong working knowledge of star schema and snowflake schema design, dimensional modeling theory, slowly changing dimensions, and fact table granularity decisions * Proficiency with ETL/ELT tools such as AWS Glue, dbt, Apache Airflow, or AWS Step Functions * Demonstrated experience implementing data governance practices: data catalogs (AWS Glue Data Catalog or equivalent), lineage, metadata tagging, and access control frameworks * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience (ideally Terraform) for provisioning and managing infrastructure * Strong Python skills for pipeline development, data transformation logic, and automation scripting * Deep understanding of data reliability engineering: idempotency, exactly\-once processing, late\-arriving data handling, schema evolution, and SLA\-driven pipeline design **ADDITIONAL SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:** ================================= * Experience building real\-time data pipelines using streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka * Experience in the transportation, logistics, trucking, or fleet management industry * Knowledge of columnar storage formats (Parquet, ORC) and lakehouse patterns using Amazon S3 as a data lake layer in conjunction with Redshift Spectrum, Amazon Athena, and/or AWS Glue * Familiarity with BI and analytics consumption tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Amazon QuickSight. * Experience working in fully remote, distributed engineering teams

jobs.description: **Who Are We?** Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it. **Compensation Overview** The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance\-based cash incentive awards. **Salary Range** $157,500\.00 \- $259,900\.00**Target Openings** 1**What Is the Opportunity?** As a member of Enterprise AI Products \& Emerging Tech, you'll be joining a strategic and collaborative team that is passionate about transforming our business and technology capabilities and paving the way for best\-in\-class technology, data and analytics. Travelers is seeking a Senior Director, Applied AI to join Enterprise AI Products \& Emerging Tech as we grow and transform our Technology landscape. Individual will lead and manage teams of AI\-native engineers who deliver production AI solutions with and for Lines of Business. Individual will also plan and execute at a strategic level, lead and influence outcomes across multiple teams and business partners, lead the design, development and implementation of significantly complex, unscoped AI solutions that extend beyond the confines of a team, and establish AI\-native engineering best practices and standards.**What Will You Do?** * Lead teams of AI\-native engineers and emerging leaders while role modeling Travelers' leadership behaviors. * Lead Applied AI engagements, from sustained strategic initiatives requiring deep discovery and architecture ownership to rapid field engagements embedded with Lines of Business that validate feasibility through working prototypes. * Partner with Line of Business leaders to identify, prioritize and shape high\-value AI use cases, taking business problems directly to a scoped written intent with clear production intent, and align work with business and engineering priorities to realize meaningful impact. * Set direction for when to apply non\-deterministic, AI\-enabled design patterns versus traditional deterministic approaches, based on risk tolerance. * Establish AI\-native engineering practices across teams, including spec and plan workflows, autonomy matched to risk, guardrails, evaluation before changes ship, and accountability standards so engineers own AI\-assisted output as the accountable author. * Drive a systems thinking approach and efficiencies across the delivery lifecycle, using emerging tools and practices to optimize flow of value and remove systemic impediments. * Provide strategic direction into overall quality needs and expand automation, including testing, proactive alerting, and resiliency/reliability, and ensure operational resilience through vulnerability management, monitoring, disaster recovery and incident response. * Build AI\-native capabilities across multiple teams, assess skill gaps, drive an AI learning strategy, and set the learning example for others. * Build collaborative relationships with key leaders and peers across the organization (i.e. Team Leaders, CoEs) to ensure the best use of overall resources, and present recommendations that influence executive decisions on AI investment and technology direction. * Develop a robust talent and leadership pipeline, providing technical leadership, mentorship, feedback and unique development opportunities to each team member. * Perform other duties as assigned. Ideal Candidate Competencies * Eight years of related work experience plus four years of team leadership experience. * AI\-Native Engineering \- Experience establishing AI\-native practices at an organizational level, including spec\-and\-plan workflows, context engineering, deterministic guardrails, evaluation suites that gate changes, living convention files and skills that encode policy, and parallel work streams sized to what one person can review. * Delivery \- Advanced delivery skills including the ability to take AI solutions into production with evaluation, monitoring and human review, assess engineering strategies across an organization, and ensure the quality, production readiness and continued health of systems that meet nonfunctional requirements. * Domain Expertise \- Demonstrated track record of applied AI and machine learning expertise, combining traditional ML with LLM\-based approaches, consulting on business priorities, and t p. Required Skills and Experience * Proficiency in Python, with experience in additional languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, or Java. * Hands\-on experience across front\-end, mid\-tier, back\-end and systems layers, with enough depth to review and challenge designs. * Hands\-on experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services, containerization and orchestration including Kubernetes, RESTful APIs and microservices, and CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. * Production experience leading the design and delivery of agentic workflows, LLM integrations, or AI\-powered automations, including evaluation, monitoring and human review of AI outputs. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding agents and agentic development tools as the accountable author, with complete ownership of outputs. * Applied machine learning experience including model selection, fine\-tuning, and evaluation in production environments. Preferred Skills and Experience * Experience with Terraform, MongoDB or comparable NoSQL data stores, and Temporal or comparable workflow orchestration tools. * Experience with LLM evaluation methods, including designing evaluation datasets and measuring model performance in production. * Experience with prompt engineering, context engineering, or RAG architectures. * Exposure to MCP server configurations or multi\-agent frameworks. * Experience with ML observability, drift detection, observability tooling or distributed tracing in production environments. * Familiarity with zero\-trust security principles or secure\-by\-design development practices in enterprise AI systems. **What is a Must Have?** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience. * 7 additional years of software engineering experience. * 2 years of technical leadership experience. **What Is in It for You?** * **Health Insurance**: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment. * **Retirement:** Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar\-for\-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers. * **Paid Time Off:** Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays. * **Wellness Program:** The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs. * **Volunteer Encouragement:** We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice. **Employment Practices** Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions. If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you. Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life\-at\-travelers/benefits/.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full\-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance. TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR. **Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium\-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.** **A Brief Overview** The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, testing and release of our organization's web and mobile applications. As a senior member of the team, you will own large\-scope projects from concept to production, set the bar for engineering quality, and mentor other engineers. **What you will do** * Lead the design and development of new solutions, as well as enhancements and updates to existing solutions, owning large\-scope projects from concept through release * Work across the stack (Next.js, Node.js GraphQL API, PostgreSQL and background workers) to deliver complex products and infrastructure end to end * Partner with product, design and stakeholders to understand customer problems and help shape what we build * Drive the software development life cycle, including development, testing, troubleshooting and debugging, and lead the resolution of complex production issues * Set and uphold best coding practices; lead code reviews, merges and releases * Make sound architecture and trade\-off decisions, knowing when to move fast and when to slow down to build something robust and scalable * Develop unit and automation test scripts under the test\-driven development lifecycle and champion test quality across the team * Mentor and support junior and mid\-level engineers, raising the technical bar for the team * Leverage AI coding assistants for code generation, review, and test creation, and help the team adopt them effectively * Build rapid prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) to validate new ideas and solutions **Education Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science/engineering or related field or equivalent experience preferred **Experience Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including leading large\-scope projects in a fast\-paced engineering environment **Skills and Abilities** * Deep understanding of all phases of the software development life cycle, with a track record of taking projects from design through production * Strong experience building UIs with React (component architecture, hooks, state management, forms, performance) * Strong JavaScript or TypeScript skills, including designing and building server\-side APIs with Node.js * Strong SQL and relational database skills (schema design, query optimization, migrations). PostgreSQL preferred. * Experience designing microservice architecture and end\-to\-end UI/API integration, with API protocols like REST and GraphQL * Experience building complex products or infrastructure end to end * Experience writing and championing automated tests (Jest, React Testing Library or similar) * Hands\-on, proficient use of AI\-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex or similar) * Ability to mentor other engineers and give constructive, high\-quality code review feedback * Attention to detail and pride in craftsmanship, whether in a user\-facing flow or a code abstraction * Intellectually curious, with the ability to debate without ego, question assumptions and think from first principles * Strong communication skills, able to explain technical trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical partners * Coming from Java, C\#, Python or another stack? We welcome it. Show us the TypeScript or JavaScript you've written and how you've ramped up on new stacks. **Tools we use** * You'll work in a TypeScript codebase: Next.js on the front end, a Node.js GraphQL API on the back end, and PostgreSQL underneath, with background workers on queues. Most features touch all three layers. * Slack, Asana, VS Code, Cursor, Claude, GitHub, PostgreSQL, Datadog, Microsoft 365/Google Workspace. **Travel Requirements** * Minimal **Work Environment** * You will be working out of the TriNet Atlanta (120 High St \#300, Dunwoody, GA 30346\) office. The preferred location for this role is Atlanta, GA and the salary range for this location is $100,800\.00 to $189,000\.00\. All qualified external applicants will be considered for an in\-office role, based in Atlanta. All qualified internal candidates are encouraged to apply and consider relocation to Atlanta and may be considered remote hire at the company’s discretion. The candidate’s final salary offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, education, work location and experience. A candidate’s compensation may also include bonuses consistent with TriNet’s corporate bonus plan. Additionally, subject to applicable eligibility requirements, TriNet offers permanent full\-time employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, life and disability insurance, a 401(K) savings plan, an employee stock purchase plan, eleven (11\) Company observed holidays, PTO and a comprehensive leave program. Please click the following link for detailed information about our benefits offerings: https://www.trinet.com/documents/blt5b61a1040aae1904 Please Note: TriNet reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing. Position functions and qualifications may vary depending on business necessity. TriNet is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, religion, color, disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), age, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics. Any applicant with a mental or physical disability who requires accommodation during the application process should contact recruiting@trinet.com to request such accommodation.

jobs.title: Data Engineer (SETA)
jobs.description: Location Chantilly, Virginia Category Engineering, Technology, \& Science Job Type Full time Job Id R3001616 Posted Date 11/17/2026 JOB DESCRIPTION **Title:** Data Engineer (SETA) At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value\-added services, and long\-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results. Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin\-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027\. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest\-priority national security and space missions. Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. *Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin\-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment.* The Data Engineer will provide Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA) support to government customers mission set. This position supports the assessment, integration, and modernization of data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, databases, and analytic environments used to enable mission operations and decision\-making. The individual will work with government and contractor teams to evaluate technical implementations, monitor development progress, and identify risks associated with data architecture and system integration efforts. The role requires an understanding of how data moves across complex systems, how cloud\-hosted environments are architected and secured, and how application interfaces support operational mission requirements. The successful candidate will support technical reviews, architecture assessments, Agile development activities, and program oversight across a diverse portfolio of mission\-critical capabilities. **Roles and Responsibilities** * Assess ETL pipelines, data ingestion processes, and end\-to\-end data workflows to evaluate implementation status, performance, dependencies, and technical risks. * Analyze relational and non\-relational database architectures and provide technical recommendations regarding data storage, management, access, and scalability. * Support oversight of cloud\-hosted infrastructure, databases, and application environments across development, test, and operational deployments. * Evaluate AWS cloud implementations, including infrastructure provisioning, network architectures, connectivity solutions, and security configurations. * Assess cloud networking components such as VPCs, subnets, routing tables, gateways, and network security controls. * Review API designs and system integration approaches to ensure effective data exchange across mission systems and external interfaces. * Analyze Python\-based software applications, prototypes, and data engineering solutions to support technical evaluations and implementation planning. * Monitor contractor technical progress and provide government stakeholders with objective assessments of engineering activities, architectural decisions, and integration efforts. * Support Agile development processes by participating in sprint reviews, backlog discussions, technical interchange meetings, and program reviews. * Develop technical documentation, architecture assessments, briefings, and engineering recommendations to support government decision\-making. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline. * Experience with ETL pipelines, data integration architectures, or data engineering workflows. * Knowledge of relational and non\-relational database technologies and core database management concepts. * Experience working with AWS or other cloud computing platforms, including cloud infrastructure, networking concepts, and security controls. * Experience developing, maintaining, or evaluating Python\-based applications, data processing solutions, or automation capabilities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience administering and securing Linux and/or Windows server environments, including identity and access management and command\-line administration. * Experience developing automation, deployment, or system administration scripts using Bash and/or PowerShell. * Familiarity with Measurement and Signature Intelligence (MASINT), space domain awareness, counterspace missions, or other national security space programs. **Work Environment:** * Location: Chantilly VA * Travel Requirements: CONUS and OCONUS travel may be required (10%) * Working Hours: Standard 40 hours weeks **Basic Compensation:** $160k to $200k The offered rate will be based on the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, and/or experience and in consideration of internal parity. Additional Compensation: KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of a sign\-on bonus, relocation benefits, short\-term incentives, long\-term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together. KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Programmer Analyst 1
jobs.description: **PRIMARY PURPOSE:** ==================== Under general supervision of the Systems Project Supervisor, the Programmer Analyst will work with the organization to propose, create, and assist in the implementation of new applications. **PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**: * Consults with customer to identify requirements of application and program objectives * Arranges project requirements in programming sequence by analyzing requirements; following a defined Software Development Methodology * Creates a timeline for events and meets regularly with the customer to provides updates and discuss issues or changes that the customer might require * Creates the application by encoding project requirements in computer language; entering coded information into the computer * Confirms program operation by creating testing protocols and conducting those tests. Modifies program sequence and/or codes when required based on testing feedback * Provides reference for use of server and personal computers by writing and maintaining user documentation and manuals relating to the application * Maintains programming guidelines by writing and updating policies and procedures. * Reads manuals, periodicals, and technical reports to learn ways to develop programs that meet user requirements. Conveys this information to other team members involved in the project * May train end users in the created application and provide support after updates * Reviews current applications for possible enhancements or efficiency upgrades * Other duties as required **QUALIFICATIONS:** Minimum: * Requires a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience in computer science, minimum 5 years hands on experience in same or similar position * Solid working knowledge of coding languages: .NET, SQL, JAVA etc. * Working knowledge of Windows O/S * Basic understanding of computer hardware and peripherals. * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Proficient in Microsoft Office suite of products – Excel, PowerPoint, etc. **QUALIFICATIONS (continued):** Preferred: * Advanced training or certification on specific systems and languages * System Project management from inception to completion * Experience directing small groups (1\-2 individuals) on projects

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description: **This role is located in Somerville, MA \- We are a hybrid work environment and are in the office 3\+ days/per week.** Tulip, the leader in AI\-native frontline operations, is helping companies around the world equip their workforce with composable, connected apps, leading to higher quality work, improved efficiency, and end\-to\-end traceability across operations. Tulip's cloud\-native, no\-code platform, powered by embedded AI, is driving the digital transformation of industrial environments through composable, human\-centric solutions that go beyond disrupting the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) category. A spinoff out of MIT, Tulip is headquartered in Somerville, MA, with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, and Israel. Tulip has been recognized as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast award winner, one of Energage's Top Workplaces USA, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work" and "Best Midsize Places to Work." The Group Product Manager leads a team of product managers and partners closely with an engineering group to shape the product our customers use every day. Build owns the core Apps, Automations, AI Copilot, and Access capabilities that customers use most. Platform provides the foundation that the rest of the product is built on. **About You:** * You care deeply about the platform, its quality, performance, and ease of use, and you make product decisions by asking what makes it better for everyone who builds on it. * You move easily between the technical depth of an architecture discussion and the customer detail of a workflow, and you're ideally a former software engineer who made the move into product. * You're a player\-coach, ready to lead product managers, who stays close to the product and the work while growing the people around you. * You're entrepreneurial and mission\-first, with a get\-it\-done mindset in a fast\-paced, fast\-changing environment. **What skills do I need?** * 6\+ years of product management experience building and scaling large SaaS products and complex technical platforms * 3\+ years of product management experience at a SaaS company, including mentoring or leading other product managers * Strong technical background, ideally including experience as a software engineer, with the ability to lead architecture and tradeoff discussions with engineers * Experience with platform or infrastructure products, including products used by internal teams as well as customers * Experience balancing new features against platform investment to maintain performance at enterprise scale * Experience using customer feedback, analytical thinking, and experimentation to make product decisions * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to non\-technical audiences * Bachelor's degree or equivalent working experience **Key Responsibilities:** * Lead, hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers, while staying hands\-on as a player\-coach * Own the product strategy and roadmap for Platform, aligned with engineering and company goals * Partner with engineering leadership on architecture and tradeoffs, balancing customer needs with platform health and technical quality * Act as the voice of the customer, including the internal teams who build on Platform, bringing user needs into roadmap decisions and championing the end\-user experience * Define and track key success metrics, and use data to inform roadmap and prioritization decisions * Drive cross\-functional delivery with Engineering, Design, and other partners, and keep leadership aligned on priorities across the company **Key Collaborators:** * Engineering Leadership * Product Managers * Product Operations * Product Design * Product Marketing * Commercial Teams **Working At Tulip** We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don't match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. We're building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well\-being. Benefits of working with us include: * Direct impact on product and culture * Company equity * Competitive benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision, Short\-term Disability, Long\-term Disability, Life Insurance, AD\&D Insurance, Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Commuter Benefits, Parental Leave, and 401(K) * Flexible work schedule and unlimited vacation policy * Learning \& Development program * Virtual company events and happy hours * Fitness subsidies * An inclusive, dog\-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues We are an equal opportunity employer. At Tulip, we celebrate all. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Help us build an inclusive community that will transform frontline operations. The compensation information displayed on each job posting reflects the range for new hire pay rates for the position across all US locations. Within the range posted, actual compensation will be determined depending on multiple factors including job\-related knowledge \& skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, market compensation data, and internal equity. Expected compensation ranges for this role may change over time. The salary range for this position is $155,000\-190,000 per year. jobs.title: Software Engineer (L2)
jobs.description: **Who we are** At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote\-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . **Hiring and how we work** We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote\-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad\-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off\-sites or customer meetings. . **See yourself at Twilio** Join the team as Twilio's next Software Engineer for Stytch, where you'll shape the next generation of identity products. **About the job** This position is needed to help build and scale Stytch’s core product as we bring Stytch capabilities to Twilio’s full customer base, delivering secure, developer\-first identity experiences. Join the Stytch team at Twilio to shape the next generation of identity products. You’ll build backend systems that power authentication, authorization, and emerging agentic and non\-human identity use cases. You’ll partner closely with product and engineering leadershp to design and deliver high\-impact, customer\-facing features, and evolve our platform for Twilio scale. This is a rare chance to operate like a startup within Twilio: you’ll work in a high\-ownership environment with startup speed, backed by Twilio’s reach and scale. **Responsibilities** In this role, you’ll: * Build backend product capabilities for Stytch’s identity platform on Twilio—shipping new API surfaces and core authentication flows, including agentic and non\-human identity use cases. * Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to set direction, translate customer needs into product capabilities, and deliver high\-impact roadmap features. * Collaborate across Twilio and Stytch teams to align on architecture, integrate platform capabilities, and unblock cross\-team initiatives. * Operate with deep technical ownership: author design docs, drive key technical decisions, review code, and stay close to the systems you ship. * Build in ambiguity—break down complex problems, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and design developer experiences that delight our customers. * Improve production quality and resilience through strong observability, incident response and remediation. * Mentor and support other engineers through pairing, feedback, and knowledge\-sharing, helping raise the team’s technical bar and culture. **Qualifications** Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. jobs.description: **About the Role** Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high\-velocity team of multi\-disciplinary experts to turn real\-world operations into high\-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real\-world, long\-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real\-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match. As a Senior Staff ML Engineer, you will be at the forefront of Physical AI, building advanced autonomy algorithms and models to add rich semantics to our massive driving data. You will set the technical direction for developing state\-of\-the\-art machine learning that enables better data mining, deep scene understanding, and causal modeling of ego vehicle behavior. You aren't just solving known problems; you are architecting the intelligence behind our L4 data and evaluation engine. You will collaborate with engineers across big data, compute, and cloud engineering to build platforms that harness scale and real\-world complexity to reimagine how the world moves. **What the Candidate Will Do** * **Advanced Semantic Modeling:** Architect and build the cutting\-edge autonomy algorithms and foundation models necessary to extract high\-fidelity semantic meaning from complex urban edge cases, directly enriching our L4 data lake. * **Scene Understanding \& Behavioral Causality:** Lead the hands\-on development of multi\-modal perception and prediction models. You will pioneer algorithms to extract and model the causality behind ego vehicle behaviors from logged data, understanding the 'why' behind driving decisions in complex scenarios. * **Data Engine Taxonomy:** Translate complex algorithmic outputs into a comprehensive, highly structured taxonomy for our autonomous database. Your work will directly create the ultimate data mining engine, empowering partners to query and extract precise, long\-tail edge cases. * **L4 Evaluation Architecture:** Design and deploy the robust, large\-scale ML pipelines that form the core of our L4 evaluation engine, relentlessly optimizing models to process massive streams of upstream sensor data efficiently. * **Technical Leadership \& Execution:** Serve as a domain expert and hands\-on technical lead. You will drive the architecture and execution of critical ML systems, mentor Staff and Senior engineers, and establish a culture of rigorous experimentation and engineering excellence. **Basic Qualifications** * 8\+ years of working experience in the ML, Robotics, or Autonomous Systems industry. * Proven track record of architecting and delivering complex, large\-scale ML systems from conception to production. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields. * Expert\-level proficiency in Python, C\+\+, and Linux environments. * Deep, hands\-on expertise in modern AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow). **Preferred Qualifications** * PhD degree in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a closely related field. * Extensive experience optimizing large\-scale models and algorithms for massive offline datasets and distributed compute clusters. * Deep understanding of autonomous system architectures, sensor data pipelines, and offline evaluation simulation (as opposed to embedded on\-car execution). * Hands\-on experience building, training, and scaling "Foundation Models" for physical world interaction, multi\-modal scene representation, or causal behavior modeling. * Recognized technical contributions in the field (e.g., strong publication record, relevant patents, or significant open\-source contributions). jobs.description: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Marketplace Planning \& Intelligence About the Role How should Uber price trips and invest in promotions and incentives, in hundreds of cities every week, to hit its growth and revenue goals while keeping the marketplace healthy? That is the question our team answers. We build the planning system behind Uber Rides pricing and incentives. It forecasts how the marketplace will respond to different pricing and incentive choices, optimizes the plan against business targets and constraints, deploys it to real time pricing systems, and corrects course as actual results come in. Its decisions directly move gross bookings and net revenue for Uber's global Mobility business. We are moving from a world where Tech recommends plans to one where Tech runs pricing and incentive planning autonomously for entire markets. That only works if our forecasts and simulators predict real outcomes with high fidelity. As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will set the technical direction for those models, define what they need from the data and ML platforms underneath them, and lead a mixed team of ML engineers, backend engineers, and scientists to deliver it. The challenges go beyond building a more accurate model. How do we predict the causal effect of a price change, not just its correlation with outcomes? How do we keep a plan on target when the marketplace shifts mid week? How do we make sure the metrics our models predict are the same metrics the business measures? How do we shape data foundations so that a better model actually turns into a better business outcome? You will answer these questions through hands\-on modeling, technical leadership, and influence across teams. What You Will Do * **Lead the modeling vision:** Set the technical direction for large scale production forecasting models and marketplace simulators that predict, with high fidelity, how trips, revenue, and spend respond to pricing and incentive decisions across hundreds of cities. These models are the foundation every plan is built on, and you will define where they go next. * **Push the frontier of predictive and causal accuracy:** Advance our models on two fronts at once: forecasting what will happen with high predictive accuracy, and estimating what would happen under different pricing and incentive choices with high causal accuracy. Draw on causal inference, deep learning, time series, and sequence modeling so that both the baseline forecast and the simulated "what if" outcomes hold up when plans go live. Set the standard for how we prove it, through backtesting, forecast versus actual tracking, causal validation against experiments, and explainability that lets the business trust and act on the predictions. * **Turn predictions into decisions:** Partner on the optimization, pacing, and control layers that consume your models, so that every gain in model fidelity becomes a better plan that stays on target as the marketplace shifts. * **Shape the data foundations that make models land:** Define what modeling needs from the data and ML platforms, including feature coverage, historical reconstruction for backtesting, and business metric definitions that match what Finance measures. Influence platform strategy so that better models translate into better business outcomes. * **Lead and multiply:** Lead a mixed team of ML engineers, backend engineers, and scientists from mathematical formulation through production and experimentation. Partner with Product, Operations, Finance, and Science to shape priorities, and mentor engineers to raise the modeling bar across the organization. Basic Qualifications * MS/BS or PhD in Computer Science, Operations Research, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field. * 8\+ years of industry experience building and shipping ML or optimization systems (or 6\+ years with a PhD). * Deep expertise in machine learning modeling and optimization algorithms, with a track record of deploying them in production at scale. * Solid understanding of the data and ML platforms behind production models, such as data pipelines, feature stores, and training and evaluation infrastructure, and a track record of driving data or ML platform strategy as the modeling lead to improve model outcomes. * Proficiency in one or more languages such as Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+, and experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch. * Fluency working with AI coding agents and LLM tools as part of daily engineering, using them to accelerate modeling, experimentation, and analysis, with the judgment to verify their output and hold it to production standards. * Demonstrated technical leadership: setting direction for a multi engineer effort spanning multiple quarters and teams. * Strong communication skills and the ability to influence cross functional partners and senior leadership. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with marketplace, pricing, revenue management, ads bidding, or budget allocation problems. * Experience with time series forecasting at scale, causal inference, and experimental design. * Experience with mathematical programming (for example mixed integer or nonlinear optimization), budget pacing, or control theory (for example PID controllers). * Experience with reinforcement learning or sequence models applied to sequential decision making. * Experience partnering with platform teams on feature store, data quality, lineage, or metric governance strategy for ML. * Familiarity with large scale data and compute technologies such as Spark, Hive, and Ray. * Experience building evaluation, monitoring, and root cause tooling for production ML systems. * Experience building agentic workflows that automate parts of the ML lifecycle, such as data exploration, experiment analysis, model diagnostics, or root cause investigation, and that raise the productivity of the whole team. For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $232,000 per year \- USD $258,000 per year. For Sunnyvale, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $232,000 per year \- USD $258,000 per year. For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer: iOS (Core Build)
jobs.description: **About the Role and Team** Core Build is Uber’s centralized build platform team. We own the common build substrate—Bazel, Gazelle, build rules, client\-side remote build caching and execution, and the shared build/test CI pipelines—across Uber’s Java, Android, iOS monorepos. Our vision is simple: make builds fast with less friction. Because the stack is shared, an improvement we make once can benefit engineers across Uber. We work across three pillars: * **Velocity**: Make builds faster everywhere with fewer resources—in CI, in remote development environments, and on laptops—through caching, remote execution, sharding, and build\-graph optimization. * **Reliability \& Diagnosability**: A build failure should never leave an engineer stranded. Every failure should say what failed, how to fix it, and who can help. * **Modernization, Unification \& Scale**: Keep the platform on the latest Bazel, maximize CI fleet utilization with smart test selection and build\-graph pruning, and apply GenAI/ML to automate diagnosis and optimization. Our next step\-change is to stop compiling the same code thousands of times: make mobile builds remote\-first so developers reuse cached build outputs wherever possible, and run only the tests a change can actually affect. As the Staff iOS engineer on the team, you will be the technical owner for the iOS side of that roadmap. As a Staff Software Engineer you will lead the design, development, and evolution of the build systems and CI infrastructure that every iOS engineer at Uber depends on. Every change to Uber’s iOS apps—Rider, Driver, Uber Eats, and more—flows through the build. In this role, you will own the iOS build end to end: the Bazel build graph and rules, Apple toolchains, remote caching, and the CI pipelines that verify every change before it lands. You will set the technical direction for making iOS builds faster, more reliable, and cheaper at monorepo scale, and lead the cross\-team work to get there. **What You’ll Do** * Own the iOS build end to end: the Bazel build graph, Starlark rules and toolchains for Swift, Objective\-C, and Apple platforms, and dependency management across a large, multi\-app iOS monorepo. * Drive down CI and local build latency through remote build caching, remote execution on macOS workers, build\-graph optimization, critical\-path parallelism, and cost\-aware CI sharding. * Improve local and CI consistency through aligned Xcode, SDK, compiler, and test configurations, so developers can reliably reproduce CI checks locally. * Make every build failure actionable: eliminate flakiness and cache\-correctness issues, add per\-target telemetry and smarter retry policies, and ensure engineers and AI coding agents know what failed, how to fix it, and who to contact. * Keep the iOS build modern: lead Bazel and Swift toolchain upgrades, along with build\-rule and dependency\-automation improvements, as coordinated campaigns that minimize disruption. * Improve the Xcode development workflow, including project generation, indexing, debugging, and simulator integration, in partnership with iOS Platform. * Partner on smart test selection over the shared Bazel graph so each change runs only the tests it can affect, without sacrificing quality. * Define and track build health—latency, success rate, cache hit rate, flakiness, and resource utilization—and catch regressions before developers feel them. * Lead through influence: write design docs, set standards, mentor engineers, lead build incident response, and partner with iOS Platform, CI Platform, and product teams to land changes across the organization. **Basic Qualifications** * A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of full\-time software engineering experience. * A systematic approach to problem\-solving and knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis. * Strong understanding of iOS development, Swift, and the Apple development ecosystem. **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep, hands\-on experience with Bazel or Buck for iOS builds, including build\-graph design and dependency management; experience with Bazel’s Starlark rules, rules\_apple, and rules\_swift is a plus. * Remote build caching and remote execution, including the Remote Execution API, macOS worker infrastructure, and cache correctness across Xcode and SDK versions. * iOS build internals: Xcode build systems, Swift and Clang compilation, Swift/Objective\-C interoperability, module dependencies, linking, resource processing, app bundling, and code signing. * Optimizing Swift compilation, incremental builds, module boundaries, and dependency graphs in large codebases. * Xcode project generation and developer workflows, including indexing, debugging, and simulator support for Bazel\-based projects. * CI systems at scale, such as Buildkite: macOS fleet utilization, sharding, test orchestration, and flaky\-test management. * iOS test infrastructure: XCTest, XCUITest, snapshot testing, and simulator lifecycle management at scale. * Build performance analysis and observability using Bazel profiles, Build Event Protocol, compiler timing data, metrics, and regression dashboards. * Leading large\-scale build migrations or upgrades, such as Buck/Xcode to Bazel, Bazel major versions, Bzlmod adoption, or Xcode and Swift upgrades. * Experience building developer tools in Swift, Go, or Python; familiarity with Objective\-C and mixed\-language iOS codebases. * Applying LLMs and AI agents to developer tooling, such as automated build\-failure diagnosis.
