jobs.description: **Initial Posting Date:** 11/16/2026**Application Deadline:** 11/23/2026**Agency:** Department of Justice**Salary Range:** $6,182 \- $9,361**Position Type:** Employee**Position Title:** Software Developer (Information Systems Specialist 6\)**Job Description:** The Oregon Department of Justice (DOJ), Information Services Section is seeking an experienced Java software developer to join our team as a **Software Developer (Information Systems Specialist 6\)**. This senior\-level role will lead and support the development of the Origin system, the primary application used by the Child Support Program, across the state for the delivery of program services. The primary responsibility of this role as a Java Developer includes designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise solutions for time\-sensitive, highly regulated areas such as Establishment, Enforcement, and Customer Service modules. This position works closely with internal and external partners to create cost\-effective systems that meet state and federal standards, ensure accurate financial transactions, and protect the health and safety of citizens. **This position may require on\-call or after\-hours support** for the Origin batch process, as well as the ability to adapt across all functional coding areas when needed. As a mentor to junior team members, you will help us to develop and build our diverse work family. **This role is a hybrid of remote work and in\-office work. Remote work is embraced to the fullest extent possible without interfering with business. There is an expectation of reporting to the Salem office once a month for scheduled team meetings. The finalist must reside in the state of Oregon by the time of appointment. Apply today!** **Primary Job Duties (In Part)** * **Develop and Modify Software:** Contribute to the design, development, and architecture of DOJ applications and for the Establishment and Forms of the Origin system using Java, JavaScript, Angular, HTML, XML, CSS, SQL, DB2, and IBM WebSphere. Integrate with external partners to share data and application interfaces securely and efficiently. * **Implement New Architectures:** Implement application deployment architectures to support a broad range of user needs as they apply to the Establishment and Forms of the Origin system. Integrate approved technologies that maximize business value and meet security standards. * **Adhere to Software Standards:** Adhere to the development of standards for Child Support Technology Services and for the Origin system. Work with other IS staff in architecture, development, maintenance, and troubleshooting for the Origin system. * **Address Performance and Version Issues:** Analyze performance bottlenecks and version inconsistencies for the Establishment and Forms of the Origin system. Develop resolution strategies that consider system impact and stability. Document modifications ensuring version control protocols are followed. * **Construct and Maintain Data Solutions:** Build, normalize, and maintain code structures according to established data dictionaries and schemas for the Establishment and Forms of the Origin system. Keep documentation current and consistent with modification histories, ensuring robust data integrity. * **Maintain Software and Data Operations:** Support distributed systems and interfaces for federal, state, and local partners. Ensure version compatibility for new releases, address vendor escalations, and coordinate resolution of system issues for the Establishment and Forms of the Origin system. Work with security and middleware team on security and performance metrics and adjust configurations and code to meet DOJ standards, federal compliance requirements, and industry best practices. * **Monitor and Coordinate Batch Operations:** Perform rotational batch cycle duties, including after\-hours or shift modifications required to support the Origin system. Validate job completions, troubleshoot failures, and communicate status updates to ensure continuity of service. * **Ensure Data Integrity:** Leverage relational databases for internal and external partners, maintaining referential and data integrity through monitoring of constraints, linked tables, and consistency checks. Address data\-level security concerns during testing and production support as it applies to Establishment and Forms of the Origin system. * **Provide Software Customer Assistance:** Managed and respond to critical system stoppages that affect internal and external partners. Diagnose and resolve application issues (internally developed or COTS) by troubleshooting and providing time\-sensitive solutions. Collaborate with relevant stakeholders when child support collections are affected. * **Configuration plannings:** Assess and Plan Software Requirements. Determine Configuration Changes and Impact. * **Research and Skill Development:** Stay current with emerging technologies. Stay current with emerging technologies. Expand skill sets for future p ate’s Degree (or 2\-year vocational training) \= Two (2\) Years * Bachelor's Degree \= Four (4\) Years * Master's Degree \= Six (6\) Years **AND** * 2\+ years of comprehensive knowledge and experience in information services designing, developing, and supporting solutions using Java. * Finalists must pass a comprehensive employment reference check and fingerprint\-based criminal background check. A driver history check will be included for positions requiring state vehicle driving privileges. Adverse findings will be evaluated to determine eligibility for the position. **Both a resume and a cover letter are required to be considered for this recruitment.** **Our Ideal Candidate Will Have:** * Experience with Angular, Spring, EJBs, and Hibernate Frameworks. * Experience with Major Relational Database Management Servers and Web Application Servers such as DB2 and WebSphere Application Server. * Experience participating in Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) activities, including requirements, design, development, unit/regression testing, deployment, and maintenance. * Demonstrated ability to coordinate conflicting needs and resolutions. * Demonstrated ability to adapt to rapid changes in business process. * Experience trouble shooting, identifying issuing, and working toward solutions independently. **What’s In It For You** * **Permanent, full\-time, and stable employment without the need to bounce between contract assignments.** * **Equal pay in accordance with Oregon Pay Equity Laws; we will ensure you are paid well and equitable to your peers.** * Work where individual contribution matters and is recognized, where creativity and accomplishment are rewarded. * Vacation, sick leave, 11 paid holidays a year, and special days off. * Excellent medical, dental, and vision benefits. * Pension and retirement programs. * Representation and support by the Service Employees International Union (SEIU). * Advancement opportunity within DOJ and other State agencies. * Opportunity to expand your technical and professional skills. This includes any selection related processes through the recruitment process including assessments and interviews. Drag and drop both resume and cover letter into Workday when prompted to upload your resume. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** **Position Summary** As a Senior Software Engineer on our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Agile product engineering team, you will focus on end\-to\-end IAM capabilities, delivering secure, reliable, and scalable identity solutions across our enterprise ecosystem. In this role, you will solve complex technical challenges bridging legacy systems and modern product development using Microsoft .NET full stack architectures, cloud engineering, and modern DevOps delivery practices. A key engineering focus will be driving new UI development using React and TypeScript while actively supporting the modernization and migration of existing server\-rendered ASP.NET MVC/Razor and Web Forms applications. Working across the full engineering lifecycle, you will leverage modern developer productivity tools and approved generative AI assistants to streamline automation, enhance testability, and deliver high\-impact customer experiences. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world. **Software Engineer — Publishing Platform** Downtown Music Publishing is looking for a driven individual to join us as a **Software Engineer** to help build our next\-generation music publishing platform from the ground up. You'll help in shaping the architecture, tooling, and engineering culture of a catalog management platform that powers musical work registration, rights tracking, and royalty collection for publishers worldwide. Currently seeking candidates local to the Nashville Area. **What you'll do** * Build a new platform from first principles — data model, API design, and infrastructure — rather than maintaining legacy systems, while making pragmatic decisions that hold up at production scale. * Design and implement a schema\-first GraphQL API (Apollo Server) over PostgreSQL, including multi\-tenant data isolation (row\-level security), type\-safe query layers, and performance patterns like DataLoader batching. * Develop React/TypeScript (Next.js) interfaces used by both internal teams and clients to manage catalogs, registrations, and data\-quality workflows. * Build AI\-native features as a core part of the product: AI\-assisted data ingestion and matching, agent\-accessible APIs via Model Context Protocol (MCP), and LLM\-powered workflows using the Vercel AI SDK and Amazon Bedrock. * Work in an AI\-augmented, spec\-driven development workflow — architecture specs, agent\-assisted implementation, and rigorous automated review are how the team ships, not an experiment on the side. * Own components end\-to\-end: design, implementation, integration testing against real databases, deployment (AWS CDK), and operational responsibility. * Model and implement music publishing domain logic — works, writers, shares, agreements, and society registration formats (e.g., CWR) — with the precision that financial and rights data demands. **You are / have** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software development, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience developing web\-based software solutions. * Experience architecting new systems or services from scratch — you're comfortable with ambiguity, and you document the "why" behind decisions, not just the "what." * Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js across the full stack. * Solid relational database fundamentals: schema design, migrations, transactions, and query performance in PostgreSQL (or similar). * Experience with both traditional software development lifecycle and agentic software development — including spec\-driven development, AI\-augmented engineering, and working effectively with coding agents. * Interest in the music industry — prior experience with rights management, royalties, or metadata standards (CWR, DDEX, ISWC/ISRC) is a plus, not a requirement. **Ideally, significant experience with some of the following technologies or similar tools:** **Backend:** Node.js, GraphQL (Apollo Server, schema\-first), PostgreSQL, etc. **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, modern state management (e.g., Zustand) **AI/Agents:** Vercel AI SDK, SpecKit, CodeX, Amazon Bedrock, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM tool design. **Infrastructure:** AWS (including CDK), Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions **Testing:** Vitest, Testcontainers (integration testing against real databases), Playwright **Observability:** Datadog, Sentry, structured logging **Perks Playlist:** Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer): * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Including 100% coverage for out\-patient in\-network mental health services * Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants * Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year) * Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement * **401(k) with 100% immediate vesting** on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution A variety of ways to prioritize much\-needed time away from work including: * Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees * 3\-weeks PTO for non\-exempt employees * 2\-weeks paid Winter Break * 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day) * Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day) * Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent Check out our full overview of benefits on the Perks Playlist page of the career site. **Disclaimer: This job description only provides an overview of job responsibilities that are subject to change.** **Universal Music Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer** We are an E\-Verify employer in Alabama, Arizona, Georgia, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Utah. Please note, UMG is not enrolled in E\-Verify in California and New York, and cannot support employment of candidates whose employer must enroll in E\-Verify, for example candidates on STEM\-OPT. jobs.description: **Job Description** **The eScience Institute has an outstanding opportunity for an AI Engineer to join their team.** **About this Opportunity** As part of the university’s AI@UW Initiative, the eScience Institute has an outstanding opportunity for an AI Research Engineer with strengths in research applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI). As a member of the newly formed UW AI Corps within our broader eScience Institute team and the AI@UW initiative, the AI Research Engineer will participate in expanding campus\-wide opportunities at the intersection of AI, data science, and disciplinary domains through collaborative research, consultation, support of curriculum development, development of AI training programs and community building initiatives. As the hub of data\-intensive discovery on campus, we lead a community of innovators in the techniques, technologies, and best practices of data science and AI. Evaluate the effectiveness of educational offerings and iterate based on participant feedback and learning outcomes. * **Organizational Service (10%)** * Participate actively in core team meetings, planning activities, and Institute\-wide initiatives. * Provide weekly office hours open to the campus community Serve on standing and ad hoc committees contributing to shared governance and institutional health. * **Ongoing skill development (10%)** Dedicate time to independent study and hands\-on experimentation with emerging AI tools, models, and research methods relevant to the Institute's work. * **Required Qualifications** To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Why does a role centered on supporting others’ research and learning appeal to you compared with a role focused on your own research agenda? * **Visa Sponsorship** This recruitment is open to applicants who will require employer sponsorship for an H\-1B or E\-3 visa. **Compensation, Benefits and Position Details** **Pay Range Minimum:** $102,000\.00 annual **Pay Range Maximum:** $144,000\.00 annual **Other Compensation:** * **Benefits:** For information about benefits for this position, visit https://www.washington.edu/jobs/benefits\-for\-uw\-staff/ **Shift:** First Shift (United States of America) **Temporary or Regular?** This is a regular position **FTE (Full\-Time Equivalent):** 100\.00% **Union/Bargaining Unit:** UAW Research **About the UW** Working at the University of Washington provides a unique opportunity to change lives – on our campuses, in our state and around the world. Appropriate college coursework or vocational/technical training may substitute at an equivalent rate for the required *experience* but does not negate the minimum degree requirement(s). **Job Description:** UF Information Technology (UFIT) is seeking a professional\-level Research Software Engineer to join Research Computing, a unit within UFIT. The applicant is expected to work at locations across the campus to work closely with faculty and their research teams on software engineering in computational, data processing, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) projects in research and education. The final applicant will be considered at the level for which they qualify. UF Information Technology (UFIT) enables teaching, learning, research, and service on campus and across the region with state\-of\-the\-art enterprise IT systems, including SEC and SUS universities, and the opportunity to teach using HiPerGator. UF has been operating HiPerGator for close to a decade. It is the fastest supercomputer owned and operated by a university in the USA. HiPerGator has become a critical service for UF because of the growth of the community of researchers, faculty, students, and collaborators that UF Research Computing serves, not only in size but also in the breadth of research domains. The workloads running on HiPerGator cover a wide range of research disciplines, from physical science and engineering to medicine and drug discovery, as well as business, law, arts and humanities. The demand for HiPerGator’s computing power to carry out research in foundational and agentic AI has also dramatically increased with UF’s AI Initiative in all aspects of human activity. The University of Florida is seeking people who are looking for an exciting career supporting the research performed by world\-class faculty and their students and collaborators in their quest to solve the most challenging problems facing the world today. The people in these positions are part of a collaborative team that values innovative ideas and viewpoints, and they will be expected to work closely in faculty\-led teams on software engineering projects. This position will involve constant learning and professional development. If you think this environment is a match for you or an exciting challenge, you are encouraged to use the cover letter to explain why you are a good fit. Some key responsibilities and characteristics of this position are: * Learn through independent study, reading textbooks and research papers, and online learning materials about problem domains in which work is needed. * Design, program, document, debug, test, deploy, and maintain software for specific projects in diverse scientific and scholarly domains. * Follow best practices for software engineering and data science, large\-scale computing, AI, digital twin, and cybersecurity. * Often, software to be developed will be open source, new, or a contribution to an existing tool, library, or framework. * Act as a consultant and mentor on software engineering principles for the project team you are part of for a given project. * Contribute to papers and documentation to be produced as deliverables of the assigned project. * Optimize code for performance and maintainability. * Keep updated on new developments in software engineering techniques and tools that could improve research outcomes. Professional development opportunities: * Learn the underlying science for the software you are developing with the project team. * Access a community of professionals who are committed to providing excellent research computing support. * Take training through various options ranging from workshops and online training certif y\-building collaboration for our state, our nation, and our world. UF is in Gainesville, a city of approximately 150,000 residents in North\-Central Florida, 50 miles from Florida’s West Coast, 67 miles from the Atlantic Ocean, and within a 2\-hour drive to large metropolitan areas (Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville). The beautiful climate and extensive nearby parks and recreational areas afford year\-round outdoor activities, including hiking, biking, and nature photography. UF’s large college sports programs, museums, and performing arts center support various activities and cultural events for residents to enjoy. Learn more about what Gainesville has to offer at Visit Gainesville. **Exceptional Benefits** UF provides various leave programs based on an employee’s salary plan, including vacation, sick leave, holidays, personal leave days, and paid family leave. In addition to paid time off, the University of Florida offers a very competitive benefits package. **Expected Salary:** RSE III: $90,000\-$110,000; commensurate based on education and experience. RES IV: $110,000\-$130,000; commensurate based on education and experience. **Required Qualifications:** **RSE Level III:** A Bachelor’s Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and five years of experience; Master’s Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and three years of experience; Doctoral Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and one year of experience. **RSE Level IV:** A Bachelor’s Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and seven years of experience; Master’s Degree in computer or physical science, software engineering, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and five years of experience; Doctoral Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and three years of experience. Applicants will be considered at the level for which they qualify. Appropriate college coursework or vocational/technical training may substitute at an equivalent rate for the required *experience* but does not negate the minimum degree requirement(s). **Preferred:** The ideal candidate will possess the following education, experience, and skills: * AI frameworks, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and MLOps platforms, etc * Building digital twins using NVIDIA Omniverse and one or more digital content creation software tools, such as Unreal, Unity, Maya, etc. * Physics\-based modeling using chemistry or materials codes, weather simulations, environment studies, etc. * Statistical modeling and data visualization * Parallel software design with MPI, OpenMP, pthreads, or CUDA * GPU computing environment * Deep Learning, image processing, natural language processing, generative AI, AI agent creation and deployment, and large AI models * For level III, applicants must have at least 3 years of software engineering experience, including at least one software project as lead engineer * For level IV, applicants must have at least 4 years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 software projects as lead engineer **Special Instructions to Applicants:** **Work visa sponsorship is not available for this position.** **This is not a remote work position and is located in Gainesville, FL.** A Level 2 Criminal Background Screening is required. Applicants are required to submit the following with their application: * Cover Letter * Resume * List of professional references with contact information (Minimum of 3, with one from a previous or current supervisor) The application must be submitted by 11:55 p.m. on the posting end date. **Health Assessment Required:** No **Advertised:** 18 Nov 2026 Eastern Standard Time **Applications close:** 02 Dec 2026 Eastern Standard Time

jobs.description: Posting Information **Department** Computer Science \- 318400 **Career Area** Research Professionals **Posting Open Date** 11/17/2026 **Application Deadline** 11/20/2026 **Position Type** Temporary Staff (SHRA) **Position Title** Research Software Engineer **Position Number** 20011957 **Vacancy ID** S028276 **Full\-time/Part\-time** Full\-Time Temporary **Hours per week** 40 **Work Schedule** Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 12:30 PM **Position Location** North Carolina, US **Hiring Range** $70\.00 per hour **Proposed Start Date** 11/30/2026 **Estimated Duration of Appointment** 6 months or longer Position Information **Be a Tar Heel!** A global higher education leader in innovative teaching, research and public service, the **University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill** consistently ranks as **one of the nation’s top public universities**. Known for its beautiful campus, world\-class medical care, commitment to the arts and top athletic programs, Carolina is an ideal place to teach, work and learn. One of the best college towns and best places to live in the United States, Chapel Hill has diverse social, cultural, recreation and professional opportunities that span the campus and community. University employees can choose from a wide range of **professional training opportunities** for career growth, skill development and lifelong learning and enjoy **exclusive perks** that include numerous retail and restaurant discounts, savings on local child care centers and special rates for performing arts events. **Primary Purpose of Organizational Unit** The Department of Computer Science is a major teaching department at UNC Chapel Hill with over 30 tenured/tenure track faculty, four teaching track faculty, eight research faculty, and 18 adjunct faculty, who serve more than a thousand undergraduate students and hundreds of graduate students and postdoctoral fellows. Teaching and research activities are currently assisted by nearly 200 graduate students. Twenty\-four SHRA positions and eight EHRA\-NF positions, including technical and administrative personnel, support the infrastructure of the department. The Department’s driving research ideal is collaboration – as it has been since the founding of the department in 1964\. We believe that computer science’s greatest purpose is in working with other scientists to solve problems in their own disciplines. Therefore, we actively seek opportunities to generate new research with our colleagues and with scientists in other departments across campus, including in science, medicine, and the humanities. Numerous computer science faculty members have adjunct or joint appointments in other departments, lead large interdisciplinary research groups, and collaborate with colleagues from multiple universities across the Research Triangle, the United States, and even the world. **Position Summary** This Research Software Engineer position will develop software solutions for ongoing research projects for the Operating Systems, Security, Concurrency and Architecture Research (OSCAR) Lab in the UNC Computer Science Department. The OSCAR Lab investigates experimental system designs, primarily focused on operating systems, but past work has ranged from experimental hardware designs to mobile and wearable user interface design. The lab has a track record of building large prototype systems for realistic studies, as well as technology transfer through open source and commercialization of successful projects. This role will be primarily writing C and Rust code for the open\-source Gramine library OS. This position requires the specialized skills of low\-level kernel programming in C, x86 assembly, and Rust. An ideal candidate has experience working on hardware\-level trusted execution environments (TEEs), such as Intel’s SGX or AMD’s SEV\-SNP technologies; experience with writing hardware device drivers or file systems may also be transferrable. This position also requires interacting with scientists and engineers in other organizations, in support of technology transfer to the open\-source user community of Gramine. **Minimum Education and Experience Requirements** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or closely related degree from an appropriately accredited institution and three years of experience in operations analysis and design, systems programming, or closely related area; or a * Bachelor’s degree from an appropriately accredited institution and four years of experience in operations analysis and design, systems programming or closely related area; or an Associate’s degree in Computer Information Technology, Computer Engineering Technology, or Networking Technology from an appropriately accredited institution and five years of experience in operations analysis and design, systems programming, or closely related area; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Journey level requires an additional one year of education or experience. * Advanced level requires an additional two years of education or experience. **Management Preferences** * Experience with Rust, C\+\+ and/or x86 assembly programming * Experience with device driver programming or other low\-level hardware features (Intel VT, SGX) * Experience with Open Source community building * Experience with mentoring students or junior engineers **Special Physical/Mental Requirements** **Campus Security Authority Responsibilities** Not Applicable.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer II
jobs.description: Job Summary Systems Engineer II is an intermediate level technical position providing departmental or campus wide support to ensure optimum performance and connectivity of IT systems that may include hardware, software, databases, storage, and network components. The Emerging Technology Lab at the Center for BrainHealth builds digital tools that make brain health measurable, trainable, and accessible. The lab runs the BrainHealth Platform, which delivers cognitive assessments, training, and coaching to a large and growing population of participants across research, military and veteran, corporate, and education partners. The lab uses machine learning to make assessment scoring faster and more scalable, and is building AI tools that support coaches and, in the future, participants directly. This position will help build, maintain, and improve production machine learning models and AI services built on large language models. The AI/ML Engineer works with and under the guidance of senior machine learning and AI engineers, alongside backend and data engineers, researchers, and clinicians. Minimum Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree and two (2\) years of related experience or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be considered. Preferred Education and Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Computational Linguistics, or a closely related field. Two or more years of experience building machine learning or natural language processing systems in Python, including at least one model or AI service used in production, or equivalent research, internship, or graduate project experience. Hands\-on experience with AWS cloud services, including Amazon SageMaker and Amazon Bedrock. Other Qualifications To the extent this position requires the holder to research, work on, or have access to critical infrastructure as defined in Section 117\.001(2\) of the Texas Business and Commerce Code, the ability to maintain the security or integrity of the critical infrastructure is a minimum qualification to be hired and to continue to be employed in the position. Essential Duties and Responsibilities **Production Machine Learning** * Train, evaluate, and improve NLP models that support assessment scoring * Maintain Amazon SageMaker training pipelines and inference endpoints following MLOps best practices, including versioning, traceability, testing, and safe deployment * Work with backend engineers to integrate models into the platform **AI and** **LLM** **Services*** Build and maintain LLM\-based services on Amazon Bedrock that support coaches * Maintain data and retrieval pipelines that feed AI services * Write, version, and evaluate prompts; help validate model upgrades * Implement safety controls and data protection standards across AI features, in alignment with institutional security and privacy policies * Contribute to future participant\-facing AI tools **Collaboration, Operations, and Documentation*** Work with engineers, researchers, clinicians, and coaches on the design, testing, and release of models and AI services; help define acceptance criteria * Review data schemas and system designs to identify quality issues early * Monitor production systems in Amazon CloudWatch, maintain deployments and infrastructure, respond to incidents, and maintain runbooks * Participate in code reviews and document models, pipelines, evaluations, and design decisions * Perform other duties as assigned to support departmental and institutional goals Physical Demands and Working Conditions Physical Activities Working Conditions Additional Information **Remote Work Notice**: This role may be eligible for a hybrid (partly remote/partly in office) work schedule, subject to business need and manager approval. Must be located within the DFW Area and have the ability to be on campus with 24 hours of notice. A UT Dallas Remote Work Agreement will be required within 14 days after approval. **What We Can Offer** UT Dallas is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We offer an employee\-friendly work environment with a comprehensive benefits package including: * Competitive Salary * Tuition Benefits * BCBS PPO Medical Insurance Options – including 100% paid employee medical coverage for full\-time employees * AD\&D Insurance * Dental \& Vision Plan Options * Optional Long and Short\-term Disability * TRS Retirement Plan * Fertility Benefits * Paid time off All UT Dallas employees have access to various professional development opportunities, including a membership to Academic Impressions, LinkedIn Learning, and UT Dallas Bright Leaders Program. Visit https: **https://hr.utdallas.edu/employees/benefits/** for more information. **About Us** UT Dallas is a top public research university located in one of the nation’s fastest\-growing metropolitan regions. Our seven schools offer more than 140 undergraduate and graduate programs, plus professional certificates and fast\-track programs. Our student body is 31,000 strong, reflecting students from over 100 countries and a multiplicity of identities and experiences. UT Dallas is committed to graduating well\-rounded members of the global community whose education has prepared them for rewarding lives and productive careers in a constantly changing world. technical elegance alone. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field \- or equivalent practical experience \- plus 8 or more years rapidly scaling or changing organization where architecture had to evolve alongside the business. **Position location** Remote **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your jobs.description: Professional Engineer – Utilities (Structural \& Tubular Steel) About Us V\&S Schuler Utilities Group is a trusted leader in structural and tubular steel manufacturing, with locations in Ohio, Oklahoma, New Jersey, and Georgia. We combine a proud legacy of craftsmanship with an innovative, forward\-looking approach to deliver high\-quality, durable products that power critical industries. Our team is known for its commitment to quality, safety, and a customer\-first mindset. We offer a supportive, team\-oriented environment where hard work is recognized, growth is encouraged, and your contributions make a real impact. Position Overview We are looking for a proactive and skilled Professional Engineer to join our team. In this full\-time salaried position, you will be responsible for designing and analyzing tubular and structural steel structures used in electrical substations and transmission applications. Responsibilities will include the design of transmission structures, substation structures, foundations, overhead wire systems, and associated structural components. You will ensure that all designs comply with applicable codes, industry standards, customer specifications, and project requirements while collaborating with customer representatives and internal Project Management, Engineering, Detailing, and Manufacturing Teams. This position will play an important role in translating customer requirements and engineering specifications into practical, cost\-effective designs that can be efficiently fabricated and delivered. The successful candidate will work closely with our manufacturing facilities to ensure designs consider structural performance, material efficiency, fabrication requirements, and overall product quality. Key Responsibilities * Design and interpret drawings for transmission and substation structures and foundations per customer specifications and applicable design codes. * Perform structural analysis and engineering calculations for tubular and structural steel components, including poles, frames, support structures, equipment supports, platforms, and other utility infrastructure. * Evaluate structural loading conditions, including wind, ice, dead loads, and other applicable environmental and operational loading requirements. * Develop and review structural designs, connection details, and material specifications to ensure structural integrity, constructability, and compliance with applicable standards. * Review internal drawings to ensure compliance with specifications and codes. * Utilize PLS\-Pole software for modeling and analysis of structures. * Utilize structural engineering software to analyze and optimize steel structures, including tubular and fabricated steel assemblies. * Problem\-solve issues related to design, construction, and compliance. * Create and verify material list descriptions for transmission lines. * Prepare and review engineering calculations, design documentation, and technical reports to support customer approvals and manufacturing requirements. * Collaborate with detailing and drafting personnel to ensure engineering designs are accurately translated into fabrication and construction drawings. * Work closely with manufacturing and fabrication teams to identify opportunities to improve manufacturability, material utilization, product quality, and production efficiency. * Provide engineering support during fabrication, including resolving design questions, reviewing proposed modifications, and addressing manufacturing\-related technical issues. * Participate in customer design reviews and technical discussions as required to clarify specifications, resolve engineering issues, and develop solutions that meet project requirements. * Review applicable industry codes and standards and maintain awareness of changes affecting utility structural steel design. * Travel periodically to different company locations. Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in civil, structural or mechanical engineering. * 3 to 5 years of experience in the Electrical Substation and Transmission Lines Industry. * PE License preferred, but at a minimum, an EIT studying for the PE is required. * Knowledge of PLS, RISA 3D, Mathcad, or other structural software. * Knowledge of AutoCAD or other relevant drafting software. * Some experience in steel and concrete structural design. * Familiarity with industry standards. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team. **Additional Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience designing tubular steel structures, transmission poles, substation structures, and fabricated structural steel assemblies. * Working knowledge of structural steel design, including member sizing, connection design, bolted and welded connections, and material specifications. * Familiarity with applicable industry codes and standards, such as AISC, ASCE 7, ACI, NESC, and relevant IEEE standards. * Understanding of steel fabrication processes, including welding, cutting, drilling, forming, and assembly. * Ability to interpret customer specifications, engineering drawings, structural calculations, and fabrication drawings. * Experience working with manufacturing, detailing, and project management teams in an engineered\-to\-order or custom manufacturing environment. * Experience with PLS\-CADD, PLS\-POLE, RISA 3D, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, or similar structural analysis software is a plus. * Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple engineering projects and priorities simultaneously. Benefits (Eligible after 60 days) * Medical, prescription, dental, and vision coverage * Life insurance, short\- \& long\-term disability * Flexible spending accounts * Critical illness, cancer, and accident coverage * 401(k) retirement plan * Bi\-Weekly pay * Vacation \& PTO * Referral bonus program

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: **About Venn** -------------- Venn is the sovereign AI platform for real estate. We turn each company's data, knowledge and way of operating into its own Company Brain, then build bespoke applications and AI agents on top of it to grow revenue, reduce costs and improve performance. The intelligence stays the customer's proprietary asset and compounds over time. Our platform is approaching one million apartments units, and our contracted revenue has more than quadrupled in the past year. Venn has raised over $140 million from investors including Group 11 and NOA, and recently acquired a16z\-backed Zuma to accelerate our AI agents. Our mission is to make sure AI sharpens what makes a real estate company different, instead of erasing it. Come build it with us. **Building a modern, agentic GTM** ---------------------------------- Venn is hiring a GTM Engineer to build the systems, data pipelines and agents that run the full customer lifecycle, from first touch to renewal and invoice. This is a hands\-on builder role: you will spend most of your time shipping workflows, not managing them. You will report to the SVP of Operations and partner daily with Sales, Marketing, Account Management, Onboarding, Finance, Support, Product, and Leadership more broadly. The traditional RevOps job was to keep the CRM clean and report on what happened. Here, your job is to build a system that tells every seller and account manager what to do next, and increasingly does the work for them so they can invest the majority of their time into customer interactions that truly matter. **Build the context layer** * Unify everything we know about an account into one living picture: CRM records, call recordings and transcripts, email and meeting activity, product usage, support history, billing and contract data, intent and engagement signals, and third\-party enrichment. * Structure that context so agents can reason over it: clean entities and relationships, consistent definitions, and qualification data (pain, impact, critical events, decision process) captured from conversations rather than typed by hand. * Keep it fresh and trustworthy, with clear ownership of every source, automated enrichment, and guardrails on what agents may write back. **Feed it into a system of action** * Turn context into prioritized work: a ranked daily list of the highest\-value moves for each seller and account manager, with the why, the recommended action and the draft ready to send. * Surface risk and opportunity before people have to look for it: deals going quiet, missed next steps, renewal and expansion signals, buyers showing intent, and gaps against stage gates. * Close the loop: every action taken, skipped or snoozed feeds back into the context layer, so prioritization gets sharper over time. **Put agents to work across the lifecycle** * Deploy agents for research, meeting prep, follow\-up drafting, call scoring and coaching, record updates, enrichment and hygiene, and much more, so humans spend their time adding value with customers. * Design human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints where judgment, relationships or money are at stake. * Measure agent impact the way you measure reps: time returned to selling and servicing, conversion lift, forecast accuracy and data quality. **What this looks like in practice** A seller or account manager starts the day with three moves that matter most, each with context and a ready draft. Calls are scored against our qualification framework automatically, and coaching lands in their inbox the same day. Account managers see expansion and churn signals across their book without building a report. Leadership sees a forecast built on evidence, not opinion. **Cross\-functional partnership** --------------------------------- You work hand in hand with every team that touches revenue, turning their problems into shipped workflows and keeping shared definitions consistent in the system. **Team** **Where you partner** Sales Pipeline and forecast data, call scoring and coaching agents, qualification capture, seller productivity Account Management Renewal and expansion motions, account health, retention and NRR, book\-of\-business prioritization Marketing Lifecycle stages, routing, attribution, intent and engagement signals, funnel conversion Onboarding and Implementation Closed\-won handoff, launch and go\-live tracking, time to value Finance Billing integration, ARR data, CRM\-to\-billing reconciliation, planning models Support Account health signals, escalation visibility, feedback to AM and Product Product and Engineering Revenue\-weighted feature requests, usage signals, integrations and data access Leadership Data and dashboards for operating reviews, with numbers that trace to source **Core competencies** --------------------- **Competency** **What it looks like** Systems thinking You see the GTM stack as one system, design data models that hold up as the business changes, and configure tools yourself Data fluency You write code, build models, trace any number to its source, and know when a metric is lying AI and automation You build agentic workflows yourself, with prompts, APIs, webhooks, and scripts, and know where to keep a human in the loop Commercial acumen You understand our business and can run a world\-class account review with a seller. You'll also understand how contracts and billing shape revenue, and can work through a reconciliation with Finance. Bias for action You prototype in days, put it in front of users, and iterate in production rather than waiting for a perfect spec Service\-oriented You understand your role is to empower the GTM teams, and get Sales, AM and Finance aligned on a definition before you encode it Product mindset You run RevOps like a product: backlog, prioritization, releases, adoption and measured impact Clear communication You write crisp specs and release notes, and explain how a workflow works to reps and managers **Compensation** ---------------- This position has an estimated annual base salary of $165,000 to $180,000, plus bonus, benefits, and opportunities for equity. Actual compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate—including skill set, experience, and certifications. We're happy to discuss details transparently in our first conversation. We take care of our team. Some of our benefits include: * Unlimited vacation days and 14 paid holidays. * 401k plan with a company match. * Stock options. * Generous company coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance plans. * Company\-paid short\-term disability insurance and life insurance. * Paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. * Citibike membership in NYC. * A focus on wellness with One Medical, Kindbody, Talkspace, Teladoc and Health Advocate memberships. * Weekly Doordash lunch budget. * The newest equipment \- Mac or PC laptops, dual monitors, standing desks, and more. * A collaborative, supportive, creative team that cares deeply about each other and building something truly special. * Unmatched professional growth that comes with helping to build a growth\-stage company.

jobs.title: ML scientist - Atmospheric Sciences

Join Verisk Catastrophe and Risk Solutions and help build the next generation of cutting\-edge machine learning and statistical models for climate risk, improving our predictions of weather extremes and sharpening the risk insights we deliver to clients. As an AI/ML Scientist, you will play a critical role in expanding our modeling capabilities. You will build, deploy, and validate machine learning algorithms that solve real\-world climate problems, and contribute to the development of stochastic event catalogs for perils such as winter storms, storm surge, tropical cyclones, and other natural hazards. This role is a perfect blend of machine learning and climate science, and your work will directly impact how insurers, reinsurers, and governments prepare for and respond to catastrophic events. **About the Day to Day Responsibilities of the Role** * Design, build, deploy, and maintain ML models to achieve research and business objectives. * Collaborate with and provide support to other research groups to develop new machine learning tools and enhance existing models. * Evaluate model performance and uncertainty on real\-world data and present findings to stakeholders. * Prepare, clean, process, and quality\-control data used in modeling workflows. * Collaborate with meteorologists, hydrologists, and engineers to integrate physical insights into ML models. **About You and How You Can Excel in This Role** * Ph.D. degree (completed or close to completion) in computer science, statistics, physics, engineering, atmospheric sciences, or a related field. * Strong background in machine learning and statistical modeling for spatio\-temporal data and physical processes. * Theoretical understanding of fluid dynamics and climate processes, including weather and climate extremes. climate model outputs such as CMIP). * Familiarity with geospatial data processing and visualization tools (e.g., xarray, NetCDF, pandas). * High degree of comfort working with large datasets and deploying machine learning models in HPC our cloud environments. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to convey technical ideas to a non\-technical audience. * Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself and a better tomorrow for future generations. **Verisk Businesses** Underwriting Solutions — provides underwriting and rating solutions for auto and property, general liability, and excess and surplus to assess and price risk with speed and precision Claims Solutions — supports end\-to\-end claims handling with analytic and automation tools that streamline workflow, improve claims management, and support better customer experiences Property and Restoration Solutions — offers property estimation software and tools for professionals in estimating all phases of building and repair to make day\-to\-day workflows the most efficient Specialty Business Solutions — provides an integrated suite of software for full end\-to\-end management of insurance and reinsurance business, helping companies manage their businesses through efficiency, flexibility, and data governance Catastrophe and Risk Solutions — provides risk modeling solutions to help individuals, businesses, and society become more resilient to catastrophic events. Verisk Maplecroft — provides intelligence on sustainability, resilience, and ESG, helping people, business, and societies become stronger Verisk Analytics is an equal opportunity employer. Verisk invests in a benefits package for all employees that includes the following: Health Insurance, a Retirement Plan, Disability benefits, and a Paid Time Off program. jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you’ll be doing...** As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer within Verizon’s Transformation Command Center (TCC), you will embed directly into the frontline of Verizon’s core Business Units to solve our most critical, ambiguous, and high\-stakes operational challenges. Operating with technical ownership, you will help to architect, build, and deploy production\-grade agentic systems, enterprise RAG engines, full\-stack microservices, and decision systems into live operations. You are a technical anchor; you pair deep systems craftsmanship with a product mindset, cutting through operational ambiguity to design production architectures, implement custom orchestration layers (via LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines), and enforce context management strategies that scale into enterprise assets. Beyond shipping point solutions, you will run workloads reliably on Domino, Airflow, and Kubernetes, abstracting bespoke code into reusable SDKs, shared libraries, and architectural playbooks that scale company\-wide. Key Responsibilities include: * End\-to\-End Architectural Understanding: Utilizing the full\-stack architecture for embedded AI initiatives, including multi\-agent orchestration, state machines, latency/cost budgets, security boundaries, and enterprise back\-end integrations. * Agentic Orchestration Engineering, Workflow Automation and Governance: Implementing stateful agent workflows complying with established agentic governance rules, using tools like LangGraph, Temporal, or event\-driven state machines, establishing strict protocols for tool calling, execution sandboxing, and deterministic fallback logic. * Context \& Retrieval Systems: Designing production RAG infrastructure incorporating hybrid search, re\-ranking algorithms, metadata filtering, and semantic caching, directly informing and scaling Verizon’s context architecture. * Runtime \& Cloud Deployment: Deploying production agent services and scheduled workflows to target runtimes (e.g., Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes microservices, and serverless compute across AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Evaluation Harness Design: Architecting offline and online evaluation frameworks (e.g., LLM\-as\-a\-judge, synthetic test generation, human\-in\-the\-loop review queues, live A/B rollouts) to measure model drift, context hallucination rates, and task completion metrics. * Platform Codification: Generalizing custom domain deployments into reusable internal SDKs, API primitives, and modular UI components. * Strategic Discovery \& Scoping: Embed alongside BU leadership to map intricate operational processes, cut through organizational noise, and isolate the highest\-leverage intervention points where applied AI delivers measurable uplift. * Executive Translation: Serving as a technical engineer in the room with Directors and above, demystifying algorithmic behaviors, failure modes, and performance trade\-offs. **What we’re looking for...** You’ll need to have: * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience. * Extensive hands\-on experience leveraging frontier LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) and agentic developer frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build scalable solutions and achieve core business milestones. * A strong foundation in statistics and machine learning, applied to problems such as forecasting, prioritization, or optimization. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern TypeScript/Node.js for full\-stack API integration and backend orchestration. * Experience with containerized deployments (Docker), API design, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Proven track record implementing both offline evaluation benchmarks and online evaluation/observability pipelines (latency, token costs, hallucination tracking, eval\-driven development). * Proven experience deploying containerized services and data workflows across enterprise platforms such as Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), and hyperscaler cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure). * Proven track record designing offline/online eval harnesses, guardrail frameworks, and observability systems (latency, token optimization, tracing). * Demonstrated ability to interface directly   layer platforms. * Three or more years shipping production software and/or demonstrated experience deploying LLM applications, agentic workflows, or autonomous tool\-calling pipelines into production. * Demonstrated ability to independently scope ambiguous technical initiatives and present architectural designs to senior executive stakeholders. * Prior forward\-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience in top\-tier technology firms or hyperscalers. * Record of turning one\-off operational builds into enterprise\-wide shared libraries, with associated technical publications or filed patents. * Domain knowledge in telecommunications, network capacity optimization, capital planning, or large\-scale customer care operations. * Deep expertise in retrieval and context architectures: designing production RAG pipelines, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, Pinecone), hybrid search (dense \+ sparse/lexical), and dynamic context management. * Advanced full\-stack programming mastery in Python, SQL, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript stacks. * Demonstrated experience designing, building, validating, and deploying machine learning models for time series forecasting and analysis, including statistical methods (ARIMA/SARIMA, exponential smoothing, Prophet) and ML/deep learning approaches (gradient boosting such as XGBoost/LightGBM, LSTM, or transformer\-based models). * Proficient in time series feature engineering (lags, rolling windows, seasonality, holiday and event effects), handling missing data, outliers, and structural breaks, and applying backtesting and cross\-validation methods suited to temporal data. * Able to quantify forecast uncertainty with prediction intervals and scenario ranges, evaluate accuracy using metrics such as MAPE, RMSE, and MASE, and monitor deployed models for drift. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Vestmark is building the AI\-native future of wealth management technology. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and run AI\-driven systems in production, and to help set the standards our engineers use to build them. You'll move across projects as priorities change. Experience with quantitative or optimization\-heavy systems is a strong plus. Vestmark is a leading provider of wealth management solutions and services that enable financial advisors and institutions to efficiently manage and trade their clients' portfolios using a purpose\-built SaaS ecosystem. With over $2 trillion in assets and 5\+ million accounts, we are a trusted partner to some of the largest and most respected players across the wealth management industry. **What You'll Do** * Design and implement secure, reliable, scalable, and cost\-efficient systems, from AI\-built bespoke applications to agentic workflows, and own the security of everything you build, including client data * Own features and services end to end, from problem framing and architecture through deployment, operation, and iteration * Decide which parts of a system should be AI\-driven and which must stay deterministic and verifiable * Use AI\-assisted development tools every day, including code generation, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks, and help your squad use them well * Enhance and recommend team standards for AI systems covering state management, observability, non\-determinism, evaluation, guardrails, and inference cost, and recommend which new tools and models to adopt * Build test and validation approaches for systems whose behavior is not fully deterministic, including evaluation datasets, regression checks, and production monitoring * Build components and interfaces other engineers and squads can reuse, and pay down technical debt that slows the team * Apply the principle "fix the process, don't automate the broken one," and push back when automation would only speed up a flawed workflow * Review code with direct, specific feedback, lead design reviews, and mentor early career engineers * Work with product managers and business stakeholders on requirements, and support production operations in your area * Model our core values: We Before Me, Positive Energy, Knowledge Explorer, and Own It **What We're Looking For** * Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, system design, and distributed systems, including how production systems fail and recover * Deep proficiency in at least one major language (such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript), and the ability to pick up others as needed * Experience designing APIs and services on AWS or a similar cloud, with CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, and observability * Professional experience building with LLM APIs, agentic frameworks, or workflow orchestration tools * Daily use of AI\-assisted development tools, with specific opinions about where they help and where they fail in production code * Working knowledge of what makes AI systems hard to run: non\-determinism, evaluation, prompt and context design, latency, cost, and safety * A track record of taking ambiguous problems, framing them, and delivering working solutions with limited direction * Sound judgment on trade\-offs between speed, quality, cost, and risk, and the ability to explain them to non\-technical audiences * Experience leading multi\-engineer efforts, mentoring engineers, and influencing decisions without formal authority * A history of moving between projects, domains, or technologies and becoming productive quickly * A habit of asking why before how, and of treating requirements as the starting point for understanding a problem **Preferred Skills: Quantitative and Optimization** * Experience building numerical or optimization\-heavy production systems, including working knowledge of mathematical optimization (for example, quadratic programming) and its practical challenges, such as numerical stability and problems with no feasible solution * Hands\-on experience integrating and tuning a commercial or open\-source optimization solver, such as Gurobi * Experience with optimization problems that involve whole\-number or yes/no decisions (integer programming), such as minimum trade sizes or limits on the number of trades * Solid numerical linear algebra skills, including working with covariance matrices supplied as optimizer inputs and handling near\-singular or non\-positive semidefinite matrices * Familiarity with portfolio construction, rebalancing, tracking error, and tax\-lot accounting, including using factor risk models as optimizer inputs **What Will Help You Stand Out** * Agentic or LLM\-powered systems you have run in production, and how you evaluated and monitored them * Experience at an asset manager, wealth platform, broker\-dealer, or fintech, especially on portfolio, rebalancing, or trading systems * Engineering standards or shared platforms you built that other teams adopted * A system you can walk us through in detail: what you designed, what broke, what you changed, and what you would do differently **Education and Experience** * B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. An M.S. or other graduate degree is a plus. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems * We weigh demonstrated AI tool fluency, technical leadership, and adaptability more heavily than years of experience *Vestmark is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Vestmark prohibits employment discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability status, protected military or veteran status, and genetic information. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. \#LI\-TG1 \#LI\-Hybrid*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Simulator Platform
jobs.description: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self\-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo's fully autonomous ride\-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider\-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15\+ U.S. states. Software Engineering builds the brains of Waymo's fully autonomous driving technology. Our software allows the Waymo Driver to perceive the world around it, make the right decision for every situation, and deliver people safely to their destinations. We think deeply and solve complex technical challenges in areas like robotics, perception, decision\-making and deep learning, while collaborating with hardware and systems engineers. If you're a software engineer or researcher who's curious and passionate about Level 4 autonomous driving, we'd like to meet you. The Waymo Simulator is a massive, load\-bearing distributed system that acts as the final gatekeeper for our technology, evaluating the Waymo Driver and proving its road\-readiness. As a Senior Engineer on the Simulint team, you will help tackle an infinitely large, ambiguous challenge: ensuring the simulation environment is indistinguishable to the Waymo Driver from the real world. You'll architect the validation pipelines, automated integration test layers, and agentic triage loops that protect this investment, so that every simulation produces usable data. This is a front\-line systems role where you will have the autonomy to solve problems with no answer sheet, harden code at a company\-wide scale, and directly accelerate our path to fully automated, high\-velocity releases. **You will:** * Architect release reliability: Design, build, and operationalize multi\-stage gated release processes that shift left on regression detection and prevent bad simulations from ever reaching production. * Own the SIT layer: Lead the strategy and execution of the Simulator Integration Test (SIT) framework, catching breaking changes at presubmit and protecting the simulator platform at release time. * Optimize test suites at scale: Continuously measure and improve precision, recall, execution cost, and latency across massive distributed test suites. * Pioneer agentic automation: Drive our transition from human\-led triage to intelligent, agentic loops by automating failure monitoring, bug disposition, and test gap coverage. * Partner cross\-functionally: Collaborate closely with simulation customers and engineering teams across Waymo to translate ambiguous system needs into structured, dependable delivery roadmaps. * Harden systems and eliminate toil: Identify systemic reliability bottlenecks, champion code hardening and error handling, and dramatically reduce operational on\-call toil. **You have:** * BS, MS, or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * Domain Experience: 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience focusing on release engineering, CI/CD pipelines, backend infrastructure, or automated testing of complex software systems. * Proactive Hardening \& Failure Prediction: Demonstrated ability to anticipate and predict failure modes—proactively evaluating "what if this happens?"—and building robust protections and guardrails before issues occur. * Technical Breadth: Hands\-on proficiency in at least one modern backend or infrastructure language (e.g., Python, Java, or C\+\+) with strong debugging and system\-hardening capabilities. * Problem Solving: Track record of taking ambiguous, open\-ended reliability challenges and decomposing them into clean, tractable engineering solutions. **We prefer:** * Working knowledge of or familiarity with C\+\+ to analyze and debug simulation engine or physics failures. * Experience with cloud\-scale infrastructure, distributed computing, or large\-scale data processing pipelines. * Production Validation \& Monitoring: Proven experience designing, maintaining, and scaling automated build, validation, and gated deployment pipelines in enterprise distributed environments, including testing and monitoring systems in production. * Familiarity or experience leveraging LLMs and agentic workflows to accelerate developer productivity, triage bugs, or automate root\-cause analysis. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.description: **Position:** Director of Business Systems Engineering * Onsite \| Mechanicsburg, PA * Monday–Friday \| Full\-Time \| Salary, Exempt Looking for an opportunity to lead hands\-on engineering, champion AI and automation, and build the systems that run a fast\-growing company? West Shore Home is hiring a Director of Business Systems Engineering to lead the technical function of our Business Systems team. Reporting to the Chief Systems Officer, you'll own the architecture, engineering standards, quality assurance, platform health, and delivery capability for our enterprise applications: Salesforce CRM and CPQ, ERP, integration platforms, and the proprietary applications that run the business. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role for someone who will set and model a high bar for design quality, automation, testing, and security, and redesign how engineering work gets done so the team grows in capability faster than it grows in headcount. Adoption and measurable business results, not deployment, are the measure of success. What You’ll Do * Technical architecture: Own the architecture of our enterprise application landscape, including Salesforce (CRM, CPQ, and related clouds), ERP, the integration platform, data flows, Assurance team, own how the team is organized to serve the business, and own hiring, succession, career paths, and skill growth in line with the West Shore Home Managerial Leadership Practices (MLPs) * Engineering standards: Set and enforce standards with the architects for design reviews, source control and CI/CD, automated testing, code and configuration quality, documentation, security, and release management * Quality assurance: Own QA strategy, test planning, automated and regression coverage, and defect management, supporting user acceptance testing and go/no\-go decisions while They communicate project information to client, project manager, or other design personnel working on projects. They maintain good working relationships with clients and staff. They work at the level of their team and adjacent teams, make technical decisions for their team’s domain without requiring manager or architect approval, plan on a horizon of a quarter to six months, frame ambiguous problems before solving them, and deliver hands\-on while providing required local technical leadership. **Job Duties** * Acts as an expert in assigned areas of software engineering. Mentors other more junior engineers to be more effective in their role. * Maintains accountability for quality of services in their assigned area and success of assigned projects for on\-time, on\-budget, and on\-scope delivery. * Acts as a planning consultant for their team when identifying technical risks and dependencies. Works with product and their direct manager to prioritize technical debt reduction, leads migrations within their domain, and recommends whether a system should be maintained, reengineered, or retired, supported by data. * Participates in on\-call rotation and acts as the escalation point when less experienced engineers cannot resolve an incident in their domain. * Reviews and approves designs for their team, and authors design documents and decision records for multi\-team features. * Challenges requirements that are incomplete, contradictory, or technically infeasible. * Drives and is accountable for improvements identified in retrospectives and post\-mortems. * Chooses the right asynchronous pattern for each problem (Batch, Queueable, Schedulable, Platform Events) and teaches the team why.
