jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI-Native Systems
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote, USA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Research \& Development **Staff Software Engineer, AI\-Native Systems** =============================================== **Location:** Remote (US) **We are** ---------- Virtual care only works if the infrastructure behind it does. Wheel builds that infrastructure: the systems that let telehealth run at scale for the patients, clinicians, and companies that depend on it. We're not bolting AI onto old workflows; we're rebuilding how care gets delivered, with AI in the product and in how we build it. We do this in a live, regulated healthcare environment where getting it right matters. This is the next architecture of virtual care, and we're building it now. **You are** ----------- A staff\-level engineer who has built software in a regulated, high\-stakes domain (ideally health tech; fintech and insurtech count too) and knows what that demands: sensitive data, regulatory constraints, and the cost of getting it wrong. You've designed and shipped AI and agentic systems in production, you know where they break, and you have opinions, held loosely and argued well, about building them safely. You're a builder first, and you've done real work in small, scrappy teams. You still write the hard parts of the code yourself, and you've done it recently. You don't need a platform org, TPMs, or layers of review to move. You operate as a domain owner, not a task owner. You take a problem that isn't well\-formed, define it, tie it to what the business has committed to, and lead a group of engineers to a shipped, measured outcome. Your impact shows up in other people's work: the patterns they reuse and the ambiguity you removed before it cost the team a quarter. You get things done. You have sharp judgment about what actually moves the outcome, you'd rather ship something useful this week than something perfect next quarter, and you know when good enough is good enough (and when, in healthcare, it isn't). And you're good to work with. You're curious, generous with your time, quick to give credit, and you can disagree hard without making it personal. Smart matters here; kind matters just as much. Bonus points if people genuinely enjoy being on a team with you. **The Work** ------------ ### **Technical Leadership \& Direction** * Own the technical direction for a significant AI\-native area of the platform, such as patient and clinician experiences, care delivery, or the AI platform layer other teams build on. * Act as tech lead for a team or cross\-team initiative: break down ambiguous problems, sequence delivery, clear blockers, and keep the team pointed at the outcome rather than the ticket. * Connect day\-to\-day engineering to quarterly commitments and company goals, and make those links visible to the team. * Write and review design docs. Make and document the load\-bearing calls, including "not yet" and "buy, don't build." ### **AI \& Agent Engineering** * Design and build production AI features and agents: retrieval, orchestration, tool calling, guardrails, evaluation, and observability. * Define what "production\-ready" means for AI here (testability, rollback safety, cost ceilings, failure modes, human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries) and hold the bar in review. * Take on the hardest parts of the build yourself. This is a hands\-on role; you are expected to be in the code every day. ### **Healthcare\-Grade Engineering** * Treat privacy, security, and responsible AI use on sensitive health data as hard engineering requirements, and turn compliance constraints into concrete architecture. * Partner with clinical, compliance, and legal stakeholders early, so safety and review are designed in rather than bolted on. * Build for the realities of healthcare: integrations with clinical systems, auditability, and high\-reliability workflows. ### **Cloud\-Native Delivery** * Own full\-stack delivery in TypeScript/Node.js and Python: services, APIs, data jobs, and the interfaces on top. * Own deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting in production, including on\-call, and improve the operational posture of what you inherit. ### **Measure \& Improve** * Own the evaluation strategy for your area: metrics, test harnesses, and plans for accuracy, latency, safety, and cost. * Instrument systems so their behavior is legible after the fact, not just at demo time. * Kill approaches that aren't working, early and visibly. ### **Stakeholders \& The Org** * Work directly with product, operations, clinical, and business leaders to decide which use cases are worth building. * Explain trade\-offs and risks clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, up to the executive team. * Mentor engineers through code review, design review, and pairing, and build reusable patterns that raise the bar beyond your own team. **What success looks like** --------------------------- * **First 30 days:* on't. * A record of shipping outcomes, not just output: you can point to what you delivered, why it mattered, and the judgment calls you made to get it out the door. * Recent hands\-on output: in the last two years you've personally built and debugged significant production systems, not only directed others. * Meaningful time at a startup or growth\-stage company where you owned what platform, release, or infrastructure teams would handle elsewhere. * A track record of technical leadership as an IC: owning a domain, leading multi\-engineer efforts to completion, and driving decisions across teams without positional authority. * A collaborative, low\-ego style: you raise the people around you and make hard conversations easier, not harder. * Fluent use of AI development tools as a force multiplier, with judgment about when to trust, verify, or override them. * Strong cloud\-native fundamentals: CI/CD, observability, and running what you build. Fluency with relational data and SQL. * Clear written and verbal communication, including design docs that change minds. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. **Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.** Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. **For everyone, everywhere.** More about **our mission** and **what we offer**. **Job Description** Wise is building the infrastructure for money with a clear ambition: to become the everyday account people rely on, whether they're managing money at home or across borders. Customers should be able to receive their salary, pay bills, earn on their balances, and move money internationally—all from a single account that is simple \& transparent. As a Software Engineer on the North America Account team, you'll work on products that customers interact with every day. You'll own meaningful problems from discovery through production, improving the reliability and experience of receiving money, expanding access to local account capabilities, evolving our interest offering, and building the platform that powers Wise's everyday account experience in North America. Your work will directly influence customer growth, engagement, trust, retention, and the value customers receive from holding money with Wise. **Qualifications*** Demonstrate proficient knowledge and hands\-on expertise in Java. * Bring a strong product mindset, connecting engineering decisions to customer outcomes such as account adoption, customer engagement, reliability, trust, and long\-term value. * Take end\-to\-end ownership of impactful projects, from understanding customer problems and shaping solutions through implementation, rollout, measurement, and ongoing operational excellence. * Build and evolve highly available backend services using Java, Spring Boot, relational databases, microservices, and well\-designed APIs. * Design resilient distributed systems with thoughtful approaches to asynchronous processing, data consistency, observability, scalability, security, and operational reliability. * Work closely with Product, Design, Operations, Compliance, Treasury, and other engineering teams to deliver solutions that balance customer experience, regulatory requirements, and technical excellence. * Write maintainable, well\-tested software while continuously improving engineering practices, operational tooling, and service health. * Communicate technical concepts clearly to a variety of audiences and contribute to collaborative decision\-making across teams. * Raise the engineering bar by mentoring teammates, providing constructive feedback, reviewing designs and code, and reducing operational and knowledge silos across the team. **Additional Information** For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive. We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences. Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers. If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs. Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer I
jobs.description: **The Cybersecurity Engineer I is responsible for the implementation and management of the Credit Unions security solutions and technologies (e.g., SIEM, IDF/IPS, firewalls, proxies, endpoint protection). Responsible for implementing controls minimize risks in the key areas associated with information security function identified by senior Cybersecurity Engineer's or Cyber Operations Analysts gap analyses.** 1\) Security Infrastructure Management \- Configure, monitor, and maintain firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), VPNs, and endpoint protection. Ensures proper policies, procedures, risk mitigation activities, and operating controls are followed. Collaborate with cross\-functional IT teams to contain threats and implement remediation strategies for identified vulnerabilities. Implement recommendations from senior engineers on cybersecurity risks, trends, and best practices. Support the development and enforcement of security policies, procedures, and standards. Provide security expertise and guidance during project planning, implementation, and post\-deployment phases. Ensure alignment with organizational security standards, compliance requirements, and best practices (20%). 4\) Documentation – Properly document IT Security systems and procedures. (10%) Required Skills **The person in this position must be skilled in the basic principles of Information Security protection, including but not limited to the tools, processes, and industry trends relative to this field of IT. Hence, the following are required:** 1\) A bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science or a similar field is preferred. Candidates who present an equivalent combination of formal training/certifications and at least 2 years of practical experience specific to Information Security may also be considered. 2\) Security\+ Certification or Associate CISSP is required. Candidates without these certifications will be considered and required to obtain proper certification(s) within the first year of employment. 3\) Understanding of SIEM, EDR, firewalls, and vulnerability management tools. Proficiency in SIEM, EDR, firewalls, and vulnerability management tools. Proficiency in SIEM, EDR, firewalls, and vulnerability management tools. 4\) Demonstrate an understanding of Microsoft Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365/Entra ID, and Microsoft Active Directory; Microsoft certifications are preferred (e.g., SC\-200\). 5\) Demonstrate an understanding of computer networking and secure protocols (e.g. SSL, FTPS, HTTPS, IPSEC, etc.); Network\+ or Palo certification is preferred. 6\) Proficient working knowledge of security technologies, such as access management, security monitoring, and data encryption. 7\) Knowledge of new and/or innovative initiatives that have improved efficiency, quality, security, and service levels within the IT security arena. 8\) Demonstrate an understanding of regulatory \& risk frameworks (e.g., NCUA Part 748, GLBA, NIST CSF 2\.0, etc.) 9\) Excellent verbal and written communication skills in preparing reports, presentations, and documentation. 10\) The ability to work independently and troubleshoot problems with speed and efficiency.

The Data Engineering team serves an important role for all participants in the energy markets, collecting new data and creating derivative, value\-added datasets that help our clients solve problems. Oracle PL/SQL. **Position Details** * Salary range: $90,000 \- $136,000 * Full\-time * Hybrid * Location: Boulder, CO, Dedham, MA, or Chicago, IL * Reports to: Manager of Data Collections * Travel cadences * Build scalable, reliable, well\-tested data pipelines with monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks built in from the start * Design data models, shared keys, and cross\-reference mappings that allow datasets from different systems to be joined and trusted * Ensure the highest possible completeness, timeliness, quality, and integrity of Yes Energy data * Partner with product management to prototype and validate new use cases, turning ideas into datasets that demonstrate customer value * Use AI\-assisted and agentic development tools and harnesses to accelerate development, testing, documentation, and data validation, and help refine how the team applies them * Provide off\-hours support for the data pipelines you build, including nights \& weekends as analysis, and tuning * Plan and coordinate data migrations and integrations between systems * Contribute to technical departmental standards in such areas as change control, configuration management, development methodology, and coding standards * Support customers and internal teams with data\-related questions * Participate in product release testing **Minimum Qualifications** * At least 3 years integrating and transforming messy data from multiple disparate sources into unified, production\-grade datasets * Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants or agentic development tools in day\-to\-day engineering work **Knowledge Skills \& Abilities** * Stewardship of data quality problems and solutions; passion for data quality * Creative problem solving abilities and comfort bringing structure to ambiguous, early\-stage problems * Analytic and troubleshooting skills * Ability to apply a testing mindset to own code * Ability to work effectively with AI agents and harnesses: writing clear specifications, critically reviewing AI\-generated code, and building tests and guardrails around it * Ability to embrace a customer service mindset * Strong communication, interpersonal, a C  Lambdas, Kinesis, etc.) **Preferred Qualifications** * Energy Markets experience is preferred * Oracle PL/SQL experience * Experience working with large\-scale time series data * Experience unifying data across multiple systems or business domains * Experience with data transformation and orchestration frameworks (e.g., dbt, Airflow) **At Yes Energy, we value connecting directly with candidates. The business is a leader in all aspects of information content collection and management, developing and delivering data and market analytics solutions. Yes Energy has a team of 400\+ amazing professionals in Boulder, CO (HQ); Boston, MA; Chicago, IL; Glendora, CA; Richmond, VA; London, United Kingdom; Auckland, New Zealand; and Bucharest, Romania. **Culture** Yes Energy has been named one of the Best Places to Work in Colorado, and we have the culture to prove it. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Payments Technology
jobs.description: Zions Bancorporation’s Enterprise Technology and Operations (ETO) team is transforming what it means to work for a financial institution. With a commitment to technology and innovation, we have been providing our community, clients and colleagues the best experience possible for over 150 years. Help us transform our workforce of the future, today. Zions Bancorporation is seeking a Software Engineer to join our dedicated Payments Team within Retail Technology Solutions. In this role, you will be instrumental in developing, modernizing, and maintaining mission\-critical payment applications, with a primary focus on our Teller Capture platform, back\-office check processing, and downstream settlement workflows. As our team transitions from legacy application support toward a modern software engineering and DevOps ecosystem, you will actively contribute to platform re\-engineering, architecture upgrades, vendor evaluation/integrations, and system reliability initiatives. You will partner closely with product owners, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and vendor partners to ensure our retail payment systems deliver high availability, secure transaction processing, and exceptional operational performance. **Responsibilities:** **Application Development \& Maintenance:** Design, develop, test, and deploy software solutions supporting branch Teller Capture, back\-office item processing, remittance, and downstream payment routing systems. **System Modernization \& Engineering:** Participate in the architectural evolution and migration of legacy payment components toward modern, resilient architectures (microservices, RESTful APIs, cloud\-ready services, and modern front\-end frameworks). **Vendor Platform Integration:** Assist in technical evaluations, proof\-of\-concept builds, and integration testing for vendor\-supplied payment and capture platforms (such as Teller Capture and image processing solutions). **Data Processing \& Transformations:** Build and refine data translation pipelines, file ingestion engines, and formatting tools handling complex transaction files (e.g., XML/XSLT transformations, delimited flat files, and X9 image cash letter standards). **Security \& Vulnerability Remediation:** Champion secure coding best practices. Proactively address vulnerability scanning findings, maintain encrypted credential storage, and partner with Enterprise Information Security (EIS) to remediate audit and compliance findings. **Database \& Query Engineering:** Maintain, optimize, and support database schemas, stored procedures, and complex queries across enterprise database environments (such as Oracle and MS SQL Server). **DevOps \& Release Management:** Guide configuration management, source control (Git), automated CI/CD pipeline deployments, and IT change management processes to facilitate seamless code promotion across environments. **Production Support \& Reliability:** Provide tier\-2/tier\-3 engineering support for critical payment capture systems; diagnose root causes, conduct performance tuning, and resolve production incidents to protect customer transaction SLAs. **Documentation \& Testing:** Maintain robust technical documentation, architectural runbooks, interface specifications, and automated unit/integration test suites. **Qualifications:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 1\+ years of experience in software development, database technologies, version control systems, DevOps tools, cloud computing platforms, and microservices architecture or other directly related experience. Working knowledge of modern programming languages such as Java, C\#, or Python. Experience with application development using various technologies, languages, databases, integrations, frameworks, and systems. Familiarity with software development lifecycles, SQL and database systems, Java programming, and application servers (e.g., WebSphere, Tomcat Java). Strong skills in software design, integration, high\-performance development, debugging, problem\-solving, and testing. Excellent analysis, judgment, and project management abilities. Effective interpersonal communication skills, both verbal and written, with technical and non\-technical staff. Ability to analyze and map business requirements to appropriate solutions, work independently or in a team, and adapt to changing technology and priorities. Financial or banking services experience is a plus. **Visa Sponsorship:** This Software Engineer position is currently not eligible for employment visa sponsorship (e.g., H\-1B visa). This includes, for example, situations where a candidate may have temporary work authorization while enrolled in school or upon graduation (e.g., CPT, OPT) but would need H\-1B visa sponsorship within a few years of employment in order to maintain employment eligibility. **Location:** This position is fully in office (5 days a week) at the Zions Technology Center \- 7860 South Bingham Junction Blvd, Midvale, UT 84047 **Benefits:** Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance \- START DAY ONE! Life and Disability Insurance, Paid Parental Leave and Adoption Assistance Health Savings (HSA), Flexible Spending (FSA) and dependent care accounts Paid Training, Paid Time Off (PTO) and 11 Paid Federal Holidays 401(k) plan with company match, Profit Sharing, competitive compensation in line with work experience Mental health benefits including coaching and therapy sessions Tuition Reimbursement for qualifying employees Employee Ambassador preferred banking products \#dice

jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200\+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in\-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. **Role** We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer to join our team. This hands\-on role in Santa Clara,CA, reporting to the Director of Engineering in the Digital Experience department. As the Principal Software Development Engineer for ZDX UI, you will be the visionary architect leading the charge into the next era of enterprise observability: AI\-first user experiences. You won't just build dashboards; you will reinvent how enterprise IT, network and security teams troubleshoot and remediate user experience issues at global scale. You will champion an AI\-augmented engineering culture—utilizing agents and automate engineering pipelines to accelerate development velocity. **What you'll do (Role Expectations)** * Visualize next\-gen diagnostic intelligence by creating highly performant, real\-time data visualizations (using D3, WebGL, or Canvas) to turn complex network telemetry into intuitive, natural\-language root\-cause narratives * Turn complex data into clear customer action by partnering with Product, UX, backend, and platform teams to deliver intuitive dashboards and prototyping AI\-assisted experiences where they demonstrably improve customer outcomes * Own frontend performance, accessibility, security, automated testing, observability, and production readiness while enforcing code reviews, independent validation, and safeguards for sensitive data * Lead hands\-on with AI coding assistants and agentic development tools across discovery, implementation, and debugging, turning successful experiments into repeatable team practices * Raise the team's engineering capability by mentoring engineers and setting frontend technical direction by architecting scalable React components and shared UI foundations for ZDX and Experience Center integration **Who You Are (Success Profile)** * You are customer\-obsessed, anchoring UI decisions in real troubleshooting needs and judging success by how effortlessly customers can understand complex problems and take action. * You are driven by innovation, actively exploring AI tools and new engineering approaches, conducting practical experiments, and scaling what works while distinguishing genuine improvement from mere novelty. * You act like an owner, taking full responsibility from initial technical direction through to production outcomes, maintaining absolute accountability for code correctness, security, and maintainability. * You champion simplicity, effortlessly distilling complex data, requirements, and system architectures into intuitive user experiences and clear engineering plans. * You are a high\-trust collaborator, building alignment across teams, communicating technical tradeoffs candidly, and helping others grow by sharing AI workflows, lessons learned, and constructive feedback. **What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)** * Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem\-solving. Hands\-on use of AI coding assistants or agentic development tools in real engineering work, with concrete examples of improved delivery or quality and the ability to explain how outputs were validated * Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering complex, production\-grade enterprise web applications, with technical leadership across multiple engineers or teams * Deep expertise in JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, and browser fundamentals, including component design, asynchronous programming, and state management such as Redux or equivalent approaches * Experience building data\-intensive interfaces and integrating APIs, with sound approaches to client\-side caching, filtering, pagination, error handling, and rendering performance * Proven ability to deliver reliable frontend software through automated unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing; performance profiling; accessible and secure UI design; and production debugging * Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs, communicate architectural tradeoffs, mentor engineers, and lead cross\-functional delivery without relying on reporting authority, including helping peers adopt effective and responsible AI\-assisted development practices **What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)** * Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency * Experience with digital experience monitoring, observability, network or application performance products, or interactive visualization of time\-series and high\-volume telemetry * Experience evolving shared frontend platforms, design systems, or micro\-frontends across product teams, including TypeScript adoption, package versioning, CI/CD, and backward\-compatible migrations * Experience scaling AI\-assisted engineering beyond personal use through reusable agent workflows, repository guidance, automated validation, or team enablement, with measured results; jobs.description: **Location** ------------ New York; Atlanta; Boston; Chicago; Detroit **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * Premuim US Locations (Los Angles, New York, Washington)$167K – $238K • Offers Equity * US General$147K – $215K • Offers Equity For roles based in the **United States**, the typical starting salary range for this position is listed on the job posting. These salary ranges reflect what we reasonably and in good faith believe to be the minimum and maximum pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation may be higher or lower than the amounts listed, and the ranges may be subject to future adjustments. An individual’s placement within the range will depend on various factors, including (but not limited to) education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, location, performance, and the needs of the business or organization. If you have any questions or comments about compensation as a candidate, please get in touch with us at paytransparency \[at] clickhouse \[dot] com. **About the team** ------------------ The Integrations Ecosystem org builds the drivers, SDKs, connectors and BI integrations that make ClickHouse feel native in any stack. The Language Clients team maintains the official clients for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C\+\+ and C\#, plus the ODBC, JDBC and ADBC drivers. We're small, senior and remote across North America and EMEA. **The role** ------------ We're looking for a product\-minded engineer to own ClickHouse's Go clients. You'll decide what the clients should do by talking to the developers who use them, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. Then you'll build it, with deep Go expertise, and measure whether it worked. Your scope is the SDK and what builds on it: clickhouse\-go and ch\-go, and the collectors, pipelines, agents and tools that write millions of rows per second through your code. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Know who uses the clients and what they're trying to do. Define what good looks like (time to first query, error clarity, throughput, adoption by key integrations), measure it, and let that drive the roadmap. * Be the voice of ClickHouse for Go developers. Speak at GopherCon and Go meetups, and write the posts, tutorials and examples that developers and AI assistants find when they search for how to use ClickHouse from Go (SEO and GEO). Answer questions where the community asks them. * Own the Go clients and their ecosystem: clickhouse\-go, ch\-go, database/sql, releases and support. Evolve them without breaking the people who depend on them. * Keep the clients the fastest Go option for the fastest analytical database, and make sure the client is never the bottleneck. Performance is part of every release, not an afterthought: profile, change, measure again, catch regressions in CI, and publish the numbers. * Partner with the projects built on the clients, from the OpenTelemetry Collector to ClickHouse Grafana datasource and ClickPipes, and catch their regressions before they ship. * Review and co\-maintain other clients, and take part in cross\-client decisions on types, errors and protocol features. * Bring written proposals about where we invest next. You set direction rather than wait for it. * Make the clients enterprise\-ready: TLS and mTLS, cloud authentication, safe credential handling, vulnerability response, a small dependency footprint, and the questions large Go shops ask before they adopt. * Shape the clients for agents as users: an API, docs and error messages an AI coding agent can use correctly on the first try. * Extend our AI development platform, with new workflows for maintaining the clients: consistency checks across languages, issue triage, release checks. **About you** ------------- * Product\-minded with a bias for action. You'd rather run an experiment and bring back data than wait for approval, you measure whether it worked, and you can explain what you chose not to build. * 5\+ years in software, much of it on data\-intensive systems: drivers, SDKs, ingestion, streaming, observability or analytics. * Deep Go expertise: the runtime and garbage collector, escape analysis, the memory model, pprof and the execution tracer. You reason about throughput and latency down to allocations and bytes on the wire, and you prove it with tests and benchmarks. * Strong Go concurrency instincts: context, goroutines and channels, bounded pools, backpressure, clean shutdown, and the leaks and races that come with each. * Beyond Go, productive in at least one more of our client languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, Rust, C\+\+, C\#). You'll review and co\-own across clients. * You've built or substantially extended a Go module other engineers depend on. You understand semantic import versioning and treat breaking changes accordingly. * Strong grasp of database fundamentals: SQL, query execution and analytical workloads. Judgment about when to use database/sql and when to drop down to the protocol. * Enthusiastic about working in public. You've given talks or written technical content, or you're keen to, and you see it as part of the job rather than a distraction from it. * Thoughtful use of AI development tools, with the judgment to review what comes out. * Clear writing. Most coordination happens in design docs, PRs and RFCs. **Nice to have** ---------------- * ClickHouse, especially its type system and native format, or another columnar or OLAP engine. * Contributions to Go data or observability infrastructure: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Kafka clients, database drivers. * Building or maintaining a database/sql driver. * Apache Arrow or ADBC in Go. * Experience designing SDKs, docs or error messages with AI coding agents as the consumer. * Protocol or wire\-format work on a database driver or network client. **Learn more** -------------- * clickhouse\-go on GitHub and ch\-go on GitHub * ClickHouse Go client documentation * Chasing that 32 ms tail latency in ClickHouse ### **Perks** * **Flexible work environment** \- ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote\-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. * **Healthcare** \- Employer contributions towards your healthcare. * **Equity in the company** \- Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. * **Time off** \- Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. * **A USD$500 Home office setup** if you’re a remote employee. * **Global Gatherings** – We believe in the power of in\-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company\-wide offsites. ### **Culture \- We All Shape It** As part of a rapidly scaling start\-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. ### **Equal Opportunity \& Privacy** ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Compensation Range: $147K \- $238K

memory services for multi\-turn, context\-aware agents. * **Agent Communication:** Implement multi\-agent communication (A2A) protocols and shared context systems. **System Architecture \& Execution** * **Microservices Leadership:** Execute the transition to cloud\-native, event\-driven backend services using microservices or service mesh architectures. * **Workflow Design:** Build and manage task monitoring. **Integrations \& Data Services** * **Data Pipeline Ownership:** Implement and maintain RAG pipelines and integrations with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS). * **Telemetry Integration:** Ensure all backend services support LangSmith\-based evaluation and comprehensive observability. **Security \& Reliability** * **Tenant Isolation:** Implement RBAC, API authentication, and multi\-tenant isolation logic. * **Engineering Excellence:** Set the standard for automated testing (unit, integration, load) and implement OpenTelemetry for full system visibility. * **Mentorship:** Provide technical guidance and code reviews for more junior backend engineers on the team. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * 6\+ years of backend engineering experience. * 1\-2\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI/ML platform development. * Expert Proficiency: Strong programming skills in Java and Python. * Framework Expertise: Hands\-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or LangSmith. * Distributed Systems: Deep understanding of event\-driven architectures, microservices, and Kubernetes. * Cloud \& Data: Solid experience with AWS, Terraform, and a mix of relational (PostgreSQL) and Vector databases. * Orchestration: Practical experience with workflow engines like Temporal or Airflow and messaging systems like Kafka. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with AI\-driven planning systems or dialog state tracking. * Background in enterprise security (RBAC, SSO, OAuth2\). * Experience working in a high\-growth SaaS or startup environment. * Active contributions to open\-source backend or AI frameworks. **Additional Information** **Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues \- Thurs) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.** The annual base salary range for this position is $225,000\- $278,000\. This role is also eligible for a target bonus. Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, experience, job\-related skills, and level. Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability, and life insurance. Equity \+ ESPP, flexible PTO, flexible spending, commuter benefits, and wellness benefits are also offered. Freshworks also offers adoption and parental leave benefits. At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

jobs.title: Director of Data Platform & Engineering
jobs.description: **Director of Data Platform \& Engineering** **About Us** At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer\-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives. **Position Summary** We are seeking a Director of Data Platform \& Engineering to own everything upstream of the business: the ingestion, warehouse, orchestration, and data infrastructure that every report, partner data feed, and agentic AI product at Gifthealth depends on. This position plays a key role in supporting the Data Platform \& Engineering team (not labeled as a formal department in the source job description) and reports to the CTO, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards. Peers in this role include the Director of Data \& Analytics, Director of Engineering, Director of IT, and Director of IT Security. The team today is a small, senior data engineering group with a platform mandate and room to grow, covering ingestion, warehouse, orchestration, data infrastructure, and the staging and intermediate dbt layers. You'll lead the engineers who build and run our Snowflake warehouse, Fivetran and custom ingestion, the foundational dbt layers, and the orchestration around it, and you'll be hands\-on enough to review a dbt model, read a slow query plan, or debug a failed load when it matters. The bigger reason this role exists is the seam between software engineering and data. Our product and platform engineers ship GifthealthOS and our hub services every day, including the real\-time partner integrations that drive operational workflows. Our data team turns what those systems produce into analytics, partner deliverables, and AI inputs. Nobody owns the handoff between them today. You will: the data contracts, change data capture, schema change discipline, and shared onboarding and monitoring standards that let the two sides work as one system. You'll sit at the same table as the Director of Engineering and the Director of Data \& Analytics, and the bridge you build is made of contracts and standards, not reorgs. This is a builder's role in a regulated environment. Our data includes protected health information, and our manufacturer and payer partners hold us to contractual timeliness and quality SLAs. The right person treats HIPAA, auditability, and data contracts as design inputs, not afterthoughts, and still ships fast. **Key Responsibilities** * **The bridge between engineering and data:** + **Data contracts with product and platform engineering:** define what GifthealthOS and our hub services commit to emitting (tables, events, change notices), review schema changes before they ship, and make breaking a downstream dataset as visible as breaking a build. + **Change data capture from the operational systems:** own CDC from RDS and the event streams the warehouse and AI products consume, designed with the engineers who own the source systems rather than reverse\-engineered after the fact. + **One partner onboarding and monitoring standard:** a shared checklist and observability pattern so a manufacturer or pharmacy feed looks the same operationally whether Engineering built it or your team did. Engineering adopts the standard; you write and maintain it. + **The SLA evidence layer:** proving timeliness and completeness to a partner is a reporting problem even when the feed itself is operational. You own the monitoring and audit trail that answers 'did we meet it' for every partner commitment, across both teams. + **One set of infrastructure practices:** run data infrastructure inside the same AWS accounts, IaC, CI/CD, observability, and on\-call model the platform team uses, instead of a parallel stack with its own rules. + **A seat in engineering's rituals:** architecture reviews, release planning, incident reviews, and design docs, so new features and integrations ship with their data story already answered. * **Where the lines are:** + **Engineering owns operational integrations end to end:** anything that runs through GifthealthOS or Digi\+Hub and drives a workflow, such as real\-time specialty pharmacy status feeds, manufacturer hub APIs, e\-prescribing and claims paths. You get that data via CDC and contracts, not by owning the integration. + **You own warehouse\-bound integrations:** SaaS and vendor ingestion, batch files from pharmacies and vendors used for reporting, and every outbound reporting deliverable to manufacturers and payers. + **Data \& Analytics owns meaning:** marts, metrics, and the semantic layer. You own sources through the staging and intermediate dbt layers. You and the Director of Data \& Analytics hold that line together and move it deliberately when it needs to move. + **The routing rule is yours version control, code review, testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability as non\-negotiables. + Experience with regulated or sensitive data: you've designed access controls, masking, audit, and retention for PHI, PII, or financial data and been through a SOC 2, HITRUST, or similar audit. + Operational ownership: you've defined SLOs for data, run on\-call, led incident response, and reduced recurring failures over time. + Demonstrated application of the above Qualification + Cost accountability: you've owned a warehouse and tooling budget and made it smaller or more predictable without slowing the business down. + Influence without authority: you've changed how a software engineering team you didn't manage ships data, and you can explain a lineage problem to an engineer, a freshness SLA to a manufacturer partner, and a platform investment to a board member. + Nice to have: pharmacy, PBM, hub services, or life sciences experience, especially with NCPDP claims, e\-prescribing, eligibility, or prior authorization data. + Nice to have: experience sourcing from a Rails and PostgreSQL application, including CDC from RDS and partnering with product engineers on data contracts. + Nice to have: experience supporting a BI migration (Looker, Domo, Tableau) from the platform side, including sunsetting legacy extracts and pipelines. + Nice to have: building data foundations for ML or LLM products, including feature pipelines, evaluation datasets, retrieval corpora, and model monitoring. + Nice to have: experience in a growth\-stage company where you built the function rather than inheriting it. **Our Stack** * **Warehouse:** Snowflake * **Ingestion:** Fivetran, custom Python connectors, CDC from AWS RDS * **Transformation:** dbt * **Orchestration:** Airflow and n8n today, consolidating * **BI and analytics:** Looker, Metabase * **Source systems:** GifthealthOS (Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL), pharmacy management system, CloudScript and Digi\+Hub services, Five9, Zendesk, Mixpanel * **Cloud and infra:** AWS (RDS, S3, Lambda), GitHub * **Delivery and tracking:** Linear, Notion, Slack * **AI:** Anthropic Claude, in\-house voice and agentic AI products built by Engineering, predictive modeling in Data \& Analytics **Work Environment** * **Location**: Remote (US). * **Schedule**: Full\-time; standard business hours. * May require participation in an on\-call rotation and flexibility for incident response and data SLA escalations. * Regular collaboration with Engineering, Data \& Analytics, Security, pharmacy operations, hub services, and finance to ensure alignment. **Key Essential Functions** * Must be able to work at a computer for extended periods * Must be able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, with engineers, leadership, and cross\-functional partners * Must be able to handle and access PHI in compliance with HIPAA and data governance requirements * Must be able to review code, debug production systems, and respond to incidents, including during on\-call rotations **Employment Classification** **Status:** Full\-time **FLSA:** Exempt **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement** Gifthealth is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you do not meet every requirement but still feel you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply! **Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required of personnel. Gifthealth reserves the right to modify job duties or descriptions at any time.
